title: Expert Java Developer (Flowable) - hybrid from Cracow
description:
Expert Java Developer (Flowable) - hybrid from Cracow

Job Overview

Expert Java Developer (Flowable) - hybrid from Cracow. The person in this role will join a team responsible for delivering and maintaining high-performance, real-time streaming and time-series data platforms. The role requires extensive hands-on experience with Java and Flowable within microservices architectures, and the ability to collaborate with multiple technology teams to translate business requirements into scalable global solutions.

Note: This is a hybrid model arrangement with at least 3 days weekly in the office in Cracow.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement new functionalities using Java, Flowable, Spring Boot and related technologies.
  • Maintain and support existing applications, diagnosing and resolving production issues in a timely manner.
  • Contribute to architecture and design discussions for microservices and data streaming solutions.

  • Experience with security technologies including Azure AD and OAuth.
  • Practical experience with Kafka and data streaming architectures; expertise in high-throughput, real-time systems is required.
  • Familiarity with databases and caches including CosmosDB, PostgreSQL and Redis.
  • Proficiency in building and consuming REST APIs and working within Azure cloud environments.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Build and dependency management experience with Maven and Gradle.
  • Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals and modern software development lifecycle practices.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and to work effectively across distributed teams.
  • Experience applying AI-assisted development tools in the software development process.
  • Flexibility regarding working hours. Autonomy to choose the way you work. We trust you.

  • Outstanding integration trips to various places in Europe for all employees.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager based in Ireland.

Join a globally distributed technology organization where you will drive critical IT and Information Security initiatives across multiple technical and business teams. In this hands-on role, you will coordinate projects from initial planning through implementation and operational handover, ensuring clear ownership, priorities, and measurable outcomes. You will play a key role in advancing security improvements, coordinating vulnerability remediation, and ensuring critical actions are completed on time. By consolidating information across multiple Jira environments, you will turn fragmented project data into actionable insights that support better decision-making. You will collaborate closely with IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and Platform/DevOps teams in a fast-paced, international environment. This is an opportunity to take ownership, improve delivery processes, and make a meaningful impact on technology operations and organizational security.

Accountabilities

  • IT Project and Initiative Management

    • Lead IT projects and internal technology initiatives from requirements gathering and planning through implementation, rollout, and operational handover.

    • Define project scope, milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, timelines, and success criteria.

    • Coordinate delivery across IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Information Security, and business teams.

    • Proactively identify and resolve blockers, manage competing priorities, mitigate risks, and drive decisions to keep projects on track.

    • Oversee initiatives involving identity and access management (IAM/SSO), Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, enterprise SaaS, endpoint technologies, AWS and cloud services, corporate connectivity, internal systems, and IT automation.

    • Information Security Delivery Management

      • Coordinate security initiatives across Information Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform/DevOps, and Red Team and Blue Team functions.

      • Track vulnerability findings and remediation activities from identification through validation and closure, ensuring clear ownership and realistic target dates.

      • Manage follow-up actions arising from penetration tests, Red Team/Blue Team exercises, security reviews, incidents, and ongoing security improvement programs.

      • Ensure security-related tasks are appropriately prioritized, supported by actionable remediation plans, and completed within agreed timelines.

      • Identify stalled, overdue, or high-risk activities and drive escalation, prioritization, and cross-team follow-up.

      • Facilitate security delivery without directly conducting security testing or vulnerability analysis.

      • Jira Management, Task Governance, and Analytics

        • Maintain consolidated visibility of IT and Information Security initiatives distributed across multiple Jira instances, projects, teams, and workflows.

        • Establish consistent reporting practices, ensuring data quality, traceability, and reliable visibility into delivery progress.

        • Monitor backlogs, aging tasks, overdue work, vulnerability remediation progress, throughput, and other relevant delivery metrics.

        • Analyze historical and current data to identify recurring issues, delivery bottlenecks, emerging risks, and performance trends.

        • Automate data collection, aggregation, and reporting wherever practical to improve operational efficiency.

        • Transform fragmented task-level information into actionable management insights that support prioritization and informed decision-making.

        • Cross-Team Coordination and Governance

          • Serve as a central coordination point between Information Security, IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform/DevOps, system owners, business functions, and management.

          • Maintain clear visibility of risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and commitments across distributed teams.

          • Clarify ownership, facilitate prioritization, and resolve coordination challenges when teams have competing demands.

          • Deliver concise management updates focused on progress, trends, exceptions, risks, and decisions requiring attention.

          • Establish practical project governance and delivery processes that strengthen accountability without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

            • Requirements:

            • At least 5 years of experience in IT/IS Project Management, Security Project Management, Technical Project Management, or a related field.

            • Demonstrated experience delivering technology or security initiatives across multiple technical teams and managing complex dependencies.

            • Experience working closely with Information Security and Engineering organizations, with a practical understanding of how technical teams operate.

            • Strong hands-on experience with Jira for project coordination, task tracking, backlog management, and delivery governance.

            • Experience working across multiple Jira projects, workflows, or systems, ideally with an understanding of how to consolidate information from different environments.

            • Proven ability to produce consolidated reports, define and monitor KPIs, and analyze delivery trends using task-level data.

            • Strong project management capabilities, including scope definition, timeline management, prioritization, risk mitigation, dependency tracking, and stakeholder coordination.

            • Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across different functions and time zones.

            • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior management.

            • Strong analytical thinking, organizational skills, and attention to detail, combined with a proactive approach to identifying problems and driving solutions.

            • Ability to work independently, take ownership of delivery outcomes, and balance structured governance with the flexibility required in a fast-moving technology environment.

              • The following qualifications and experience are considered an advantage:

              • Experience managing vulnerability remediation programs and coordinating security improvement initiatives.

              • Familiarity with Red Team and Blue Team activities and the coordination of security testing follow-up actions.

              • Experience consolidating data across multiple Jira instances or building automated Jira reporting solutions.

              • Knowledge of operational dashboards, workflow automation, and delivery analytics.

              • Exposure to AWS, cloud infrastructure, or cloud security environments.

              • Experience working in large-scale online technology organizations or high-availability environments.

              • Relevant professional certifications, such as PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, CISSP, CISM, Security+, Agile, or Scrum.

                • Benefits:

                • Competitive compensation: A competitive salary package aligned with experience and responsibilities.

                • Performance incentives: Individual performance-based bonuses paid quarterly, with additional referral and flash bonus opportunities.

                • Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely in an environment designed to support sustainable and flexible working practices.

                • Flexible working hours: Core working hours from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. in your local time zone, with flexibility outside this window.

                • Paid time off: 28 days of paid annual leave to support rest, personal commitments, and work-life balance.

                • Quality equipment: Access to high-quality equipment to help you work efficiently from your preferred location.

                • Company retreats: Annual company retreats offering opportunities to connect with colleagues, strengthen collaboration, and build professional relationships.

                • International collaboration: Work with distributed teams across technology, infrastructure, security, and business functions.

                • Professional impact: Take ownership of meaningful technology and security initiatives while contributing to improved operational performance and delivery practices.

title: Lead Software Developer
description:
Salary: $135,000 – $145,000 per year (pro rata)

About us

At UpTrade, we believe that investing in cryptocurrencies can unlock financial freedom. UpTrade is an innovative crypto broker providing traditional brokerage services for modern digital assets. We bring trusted, expert and timely support for investors wanting to embrace the volatility of global cryptocurrency opportunities. Our clients are our focus. We build long term relationships built on trust and performance. They value our full-service approach of having real conversations with their own broker. Our active management approach means that clients can be reassured that their portfolio is being monitored, and their broker will proactively connect with them when a market opportunity presents. Our high conviction approach is backed by world-class research that guides the value narratives we share with clients.

About the role

As Lead Software Developer, you will own UpTrade's various applications, backend platform and the cloud they run on. You will build and operate serverless services in Node.js and TypeScript, containerized apps using ECS, frontend & UX features on React, keep financial workflows correct and secure, and deploy, maintain, and update internal tools in secure cloud environments. You will provision and maintain AWS, Cloudflare, Terraform, and private networking, including open-source self-hosted software where it fits better than a SaaS product. This is a hands-on role, working closely with the founders.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, implement & improve frontend features using React.

  • Design, build, and maintain serverless services on AWS in Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Design MongoDB models for financial workflows, and APIs to exchanges, wallets, and other external services.

  • Review changes for correctness, performance, and risk.

  • Deploy, maintain, and update internal software tools in secure cloud environments.

  • Stand up and look after open-source self-hosted alternatives where they replace a SaaS product.

  • Provision and maintain AWS, Cloudflare, Terraform, and private networking.

  • Keep access least-privilege, secrets safe, and systems observable and recoverable.

  • Apply secure coding and data handling across application code and infrastructure.

  • Own what you ship, including deployment, monitoring, and production fixes.

About you

  • 6+ years, with recent senior backend / dev ops roles

  • Strong Node.js and TypeScript, and production experience with MongoDB

  • Production AWS, including Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, S3, and SQS or SNS, plus Terraform.

  • Experience with Cloudflare, private networking, and operating the systems you have built.

  • Experience deploying and maintaining internal tools, including self-hosted open-source alternatives to SaaS.

  • Strong cloud and application security. Security engineering experience is highly desirable.

  • Fintech, trading, or payments experience is an advantage.

  • Agentic coding is part of how you work.

  • Real production experience with AWS and serverless systems.

  • Ability to work autonomously in a small team.

title: Founding Frontend Engineer
description:
Role Overview

NAVI is end-to-end production planning, from sales order to shop floor. We connect to a factory’s ERP, learn how it actually runs, and pair AI agents with mathematical optimization to plan the materials and schedule the floor in between. We started on the factory floor, solving problems we hit ourselves.


This role is for graduating seniors who care about interfaces the way most engineers care about infrastructure. Our planners make high-stakes calls inside our UI every day. Confusing output does not just annoy, it hits a production floor. You work part-time through your final year and convert directly to a full-time Software Engineer offer in May at $80,000 to $120,000 base plus competitive equity. No re-interview, no separate return-offer process: the part-time work is the evaluation.


We are a small team, in person in NYC, on hard problems, starting early. That is not for everyone and we respect it. Before you apply, be honest with yourself about whether you want to work this way. It is easy to be excited in an interview and burned out by month two. The trade is real: ownership from day one, and room to grow as the company does.


First round is a technical interview. You write a small, smart Python script, no AI assistance. If that is not something you can do on your own, we would rather not spend the time, yours or ours.


What You'll Do

  • Own the frontend end to end, from the data model to the pixels a planner stares at all day.
  • Build dense, fast interfaces for real scheduling data: capacity and due-date views, scenario trees, constraint views that make tradeoffs legible.
  • Sweat the details that prevent mistakes, not just display data: latency, clarity under pressure, and a sane state for every edge case and every pile of messy ERP data.
  • Ship real production code from week one, not a side project parked in a corner.
  • Have a real say in what we build and how it feels, working directly with the team.


What We're Looking For

  • Graduating May 2027, available full-time immediately after.
  • Genuine craft for UI and UX. You notice bad interfaces and cannot leave them alone.
  • Strong JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals, and real opinions about how frontend should be built.
  • Creative and proactive. You find the problem worth solving instead of waiting to be handed one.
  • Low ego. Strong opinions, held loosely, dropped the moment the evidence disagrees.
  • Judgment about AI: you know when to let a model do the work, when to do it yourself, and how to tell the difference. (That is exactly why the interview is hands-on and AI-free.)
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and messy, real-world factory data.

Nice to Have

  • Data visualization chops: canvas, SVG, D3, or WebGL.
  • A portfolio or design background that shows taste, not just tutorials.
  • Manufacturing, supply chain, ERP, or ops exposure.


What We Offer

  • $1,500 to $2,500 per month depending on hours committed.
  • Direct continuation to a full-time offer in May: $70,000 to $100,000 base plus competitive equity.
  • Stack: React, TypeScript, Next.Js, Tailwind.
  • We cannot sponsor or transfer work visas for this role. You must be authorized to work in the U.S. now and in the future without sponsorship.

title: 23108 - Administration Officer (POAS)
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity.

Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised role: all successful candidates will be appointed to the nearest viable office nearest to their home postcode and on its respective pay scale. This will be at either a HQ building (subject to desk allocation, a Justice Collaboration Centre (JCC) or a Justice Satellite Office (JSO) – See Map. All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity).

For current MoJ employees, your base location will need to be changed to the nearest viable office (to your home postcode), either at a HQ building, JCC or JSO within the National Office Network and moved its location’s respective pay scale (any legacy arrangements/locations will need to be amended).

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

MoJ candidates who are on a specialist grade, will be able to retain their grade on lateral transfer.

All candidates who are currently in receipt of Mark Time / Pay Protection should ensure they are familiar with the new policy on permanent and temporary promotion which can be found on the employee intranet.

Flexible working hours

The Ministry of Justice offers a flexible working system in many offices. Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week. MoJ welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the MoJ’s Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service.

There is also a scheme to allow qualifying staff to buy or sell up to three days leave each year. Additional paid time off for public holidays and 1 privilege day. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis.

Pension

The Civil Service offers a choice of pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender employees.

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5359 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Software Engineer (Java)
description:
We are building the financial system for the next century. One where control sits in the hands of customers — not banks. Where money moves on rails that are faster, smarter, and radically more efficient. Where wealth management tools help you grow your savings for decades — and build generational wealth. Where fewer intermediaries mean more value stays where it belongs: in our customers’ pockets.

We operate with long-term ambition and absolute conviction. We are not here to iterate on the past — we are here to redesign it. This is a defining moment to join us.

We are building what we believe will become one of the most important financial institutions in the world. That requires exceptional talent, relentless standards, and people who care deeply about the work. At ARQ, we are turning the financial system upside down — starting in the Americas. We are nimble, but ambitious. We move fast, learn fast, and innovate relentlessly. Technology is our greatest ally, and execution is our edge. We build as a team. We think long term. We aim for world-class in everything we do. If you are exceptional at what you do — and ready to help redefine finance — we’d love to meet you. Are you ready to build what comes next?

About the team

We believe that small teams of exceptional people outcompete massive companies with mediocre talent. That’s why we have assembled a group of people who have done it before at iconic companies like Revolut, Apple, Uber, Amazon, and Block. We’ve owned some of the most loved and profitable products in the world, delivered transaction platforms operating at massive scale, created beautiful mobile applications — and built things that have changed the lives of millions of people.

We don’t believe in 9-to-5 and we don’t believe in work-life balance as most companies sell it. We believe building the largest financial institution in the world takes long hours, every day, for years — and we like it that way. If you don’t, don’t apply.

To reshape the global financial system, we’ve raised capital from some of the world’s best investors: Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, Brevan Howard Digital, Y Combinator, and Kaszek Ventures.

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. Track record of building complex products that millions of people use in hypergrowth startups

Latest technology to work with

Strong team that will help you improve your skills

title: Machine Learning Engineer: Ranking & Personalization

Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

### DESCRIPTION

**Management Aide Program**

The Management Aide Program offers students and recent graduates hands-on local government experience and professional development through workshops, guided tours, one-on-one mentoring, networking luncheons, and a CliftonStrengths assessment.

**Internship Duration and Schedule**

The internship is a six-month assignment. Work schedules and hours vary by department based on operational needs. Upon successful completion, participants may have an opportunity to compete for an extended internship assignment, depending on City needs, available funding, and the applicable selection process.

For more information about the **Management Aide Program**, [**click here**](https://www.torranceca.gov/Government/Jobs-Landing/Jobs/Internships-Volunteer-Opportunities/Management-Aide-Program).

**Office of Emergency Services**

The City’s Office of Emergency Services (OES) is seeking a motivated, service-oriented intern interested in emergency management, disaster preparedness, and community resilience. **The Management Aide** will gain hands-on experience supporting emergency planning, Emergency Operations Center (EOC) readiness, training and exercises, public preparedness outreach, research, and coordination with City departments and partner agencies.

The **Management Aide** will help maintain emergency plans and resources, prepare reports and educational materials, track improvement efforts, and support emergency operations as needed. This internship offers an opportunity to learn how local government prepares for, responds to, and recovers from emergencies and disasters.

**Explore Firsthand Experiences**

Want to know more about the program’s impact? Hear from past participants about how the program has supported their professional growth and success. [**Click here**](https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/b933a7f1e6964997bfbd49fce0fb9a1a/) to read their testimonials.

### QUALIFICATION GUIDELINES

**The Management Aide Program is an entry-level position open to the following candidates:**

- **Recent graduates** of a Bachelor's program; or
- **Current graduate students** or recent graduates of a Master's program in Public Administration, Emergency Management, Public Policy, Business Administration, or a related field; and
- Six months of experience in a public sector setting; and
- A strong interest in pursuing a career in public administration

**Notes:**

**Recent Graduates -** Candidates must have graduated within one year of submitting their application.

**Expected Graduation Date -** Candidates who are expected to graduate with their bachelor's degree before the start of the internship must complete their degree requirements prior to the program’s start date. The Management Aide Internship is an entry-level position for recent graduates who have completed their bachelor's degree, and candidates must have officially graduated by October 2026 to be eligible for consideration.

**Ideal Candidate**

_Successful candidates will possess the following:_

- Coursework or experience related to emergency management, disaster preparedness, homeland security, public safety, GIS, communications, or related disciplines.
- Familiarity with the Incident Command System (ICS), National Incident Management System (NIMS), Emergency Operations Centers, or Standardized Emergency Management System (SEMS).
- Experience supporting community outreach, public education, training, exercises, or special events.

**Desirable Training and Certifications:**

**Applicants who have completed any of the following FEMA Independent Study courses or related training are encouraged to identify them in their application:**

- FEMA IS-100 — Introduction to the Incident Command System
- FEMA IS-200 — Basic Incident Command System for Initial Response

**Additional desirable training may include:**

- Community Emergency Response Team (CERT) training
- Emergency Operations Center training

### HOW TO APPLY & EXAM PROCESS

**Application Process:**

Interested candidates must submit an online application, a supplemental questionnaire, and a resume through **www.TorranceCA.Gov/Jobs**. **Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.**

- **Application period opens:** **Friday, October 9, 2026**
- **Application period closes:** **Thursday, October 15, 2026 at 12:00 PM (noon)**

**Interview Process:**

- **Panel Interview:** Weighted 100% (Tentatively scheduled for the week of October 19, 2026)
- Only those candidates who best meet the City and Department’s needs will be invited to an interview.

### SPECIAL NOTES

Applicants with disabilities who require special testing arrangements **must contact Civil Service prior to the examination date(s).** If you have a disability for which you require an accommodation, please contact us at (310) 618-2967 before the test date.

As a condition of employment, candidates must pass an employment and criminal history background check.

_The provisions of this announcement do not constitute an expressed or implied contract, and any provisions contained in this announcement may be modified or revoked without notice._

The City of Torrance is a welcoming and culturally-rich community. As a pillar of public service, we strive to be an employer of choice by attracting and retaining a talented workforce where people of diverse backgrounds, cultures, religions, and lifestyles are valued. Our mission is to create an inclusive environment where our staff are empowered to perform at their highest level and contribute towards making a positive impact.

title: Java Backend Services Developer
description:

title: Seasonal Key Holder - Ross Park Mall
description:
We’re looking for music and pop culture fanatics to help create the best experience for our customers. As a Hot Topic Seasonal Key Holder at Ross Park Mall, you’ll be a huge part of our success by supporting the store leadership team in providing the best customer experience, ensuring that fellow fans are able to get their hands on the merch they love. You’ll use your fandom knowledge to help train new recruits and ensure their success, while also supporting your Store Manager in daily operations and meeting sales targets.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Provide an amazing shopping experience that will encourage customers to return. They’ll be impressed by your product knowledge, customer experience skills and use of the Force
  • Step in and step up when needed. You’ll provide leadership support and help run the store when your Manager gets pulled away
  • Understand store sales plan and comp sales goals, and help drive sales by increasing key KPIs: UPT and ADT
  • Cover the sales floor zone and ensure that assigned areas are up to visual standards. You’ll also help in the opening and closing of the store
  • Work the register; you’ll process sales transactions and use your fandom knowledge to drive add on sales. We’ll need you to also be able to close out the register and communicate and shortages or overages to your Store Manager
  • Assist with planogram changes including store map, wall, fixture, & merchandising mix
  • Let your voice be heard! You’ll communicate fashion & music trend information to management and respective HQ partners
  • While we welcome wizards, we don’t like it when spells are stolen. You’ll work with Store Management to ensure there’s no misuse of spells and wizardry around theft.
  • Support the maintenance of the mother ship; you’ll help keep the stock room organized and the store tidy.
  • Train and coach new Sales Associates as needed to help them quickly get acclimated to the team
  • Any other activities as assigned by your Store Leader

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Previous experience working in a retail environment. If you love music and pop culture, you’re in the right place!
  • Superpowers in providing customer service and selling
  • A High School Diploma or GED equivalent
  • Avenger like collaboration and communication skills, as well as Captain America-like leadership
  • The usual retail stuff: able to stand and walk around during scheduled hours, reaching for merch using a ladder, step stool and pole. You’ll also have to be able to move around boxes of awesome merchandise that may weigh up to 50 pounds

title: Tenant Engagement Officer (Retrofit)
description:
Do you enjoy making a real difference to customers' lives through excellent communication and support?
Are you confident building positive relationships with customers, contractors, and colleagues while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment?
Do you have a passion for delivering outstanding customer service and helping people navigate change with empathy and professionalism?

Here at Bromford Flagship LiveWest, we're looking for a proactive and customer-focused Tenant Engagement Officer (Retrofit) to support customers throughout their retrofit journey. Working closely with project teams, contractors, and installers, you'll play a vital role in ensuring customers are informed, supported, and engaged before, during, and after energy efficiency improvements are completed in their homes.

Location: Negotiable across any Flagship Office (travel across the geography required)
Hours: Full Time
Contract: 12 month Fixed Term Contract

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

As a Tenant Engagement Officer, you will:

  • act as the primary point of contact for customers throughout retrofit projects, ensuring a positive customer journey.

  • provide clear, timely, and professional communication to customers via home visits, telephone calls, email, and written correspondence.

  • support and engage customers before, during, and after the installation of energy efficiency measures.

  • work closely with project managers, contractors, installers, and wider project teams to ensure customers are kept informed throughout the process.

  • provide additional support to vulnerable customers and ensure services remain accessible and inclusive for everyone.

  • gather feedback and identify opportunities to improve the customer experience across retrofit projects.

DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE

  • experience in a customer-facing, tenant engagement, housing, community, or customer service role.

  • strong communication skills with the ability to adapt your approach to meet different customer needs.

  • experience building positive relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.

  • the ability to manage competing priorities and organise workload effectively.

  • a compassionate and empathetic approach, particularly when supporting vulnerable customers.

  • knowledge of energy efficiency, retrofit programmes, PAS 2035, or domestic energy improvements such as insulation, renewable technologies, or heating systems.

  • a full UK driving licence and the ability to travel across the region when required.

  • a Level 3 Domestic Energy Assessor qualification (nice to have)

WHY JOIN US?

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in improving customers' homes and supporting our long-term sustainability ambitions.

You'll have the chance to:

  • make a tangible difference to customers by helping them benefit from warmer, more energy-efficient homes.

  • build expertise in retrofit delivery, customer engagement, and energy efficiency programmes.

  • work collaboratively with a range of internal teams and external partners.

  • support customers through meaningful home improvement projects that positively impact their daily lives.

  • be part of a values-led organisation committed to helping people thrive.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • competitive salary and benefits package - up to £30,843

  • car allowance

  • health and wellbeing support

  • learning and development opportunities

  • generous annual leave entitlement

  • pension scheme

Full benefit details depend on office location.

HOW TO APPLY

To apply, please click "Apply Online" below. You will be asked to attach your CV (in MS Word or PDF format) and provide a supporting statement outlining why you're the right person for the role.

Important Information

Closing Date: Monday 26th October
Interview Date: Thursday 5th and Friday 6th November

About Us
Flagship is part of Bromford Flagship Livewest. By joining us, you become part of a one of the largest housing providers in the UK - delivering community-focused services across the East, Central and South West of England. We manage approximately 120,000 homes, serving around 300,000 customers, and with firm ambitions to deliver an additional 50,000 new homes by 2040.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by Lightspeed's Data Office is hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to design and own the data models that drive decisions across financial performance, GTM activities, and product insights. You'll partner with stakeholders across Finance, Revenue Ops, Marketing, and Product to deliver the analytics foundation the business runs on.

If you are someone who enjoys building data pipelines that power real business decisions and want to design canonical models that unify fragmented source systems across multiple CRMs, ERPs, and product platforms, then this role is for you. You can sit down with Finance to talk revenue recognition or with Product to map activation funnels, and walk away with a clear data model in your head. You hold a high bar on quality, push back constructively when it matters, and don't wait to be handed a well-defined problem. You scope the work, drive it to completion, and bring others along.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Design and build the data models that power the business: financial reporting (GTV, MRR, revenue recognition), GTM analytics, and product and operational insights
  • Design for scale and maintainability while staying pragmatic, shipping incremental value, gathering feedback, and iterating as you go
  • Turn ambiguous business requirements from Finance, Revenue Ops, Marketing, and Product teams into well-scoped technical solutions with effort estimates
  • Collaborate across our Hub & Spoke architecture, partnering with upstream data owner teams, downstream Looker/LookML developers, and other domain pods (Retail, Hospo, Operations) to design models that work end-to-end
  • Treat documentation as a first-class deliverable: column descriptions, model contracts, and architectural notes that power both human reviewers and AI/LLM-assisted workflows
  • Diagnose root problems, not symptoms, and drive systemic fixes rather than one-off patches
  • Own pipeline health end-to-end: monitor proactively, lead incident response, and surface risks before they become delivery problems
  • Autonomously manage personal sprint commitments and contribute to team-level planning, including task breakdown, effort estimation, and priority sequencing
  • Mentor junior engineers through coaching, code reviews, and technical sessions, and set the bar for what good looks like

What You Will Bring To The Team

  • Expert-level SQL: query performance, clean, maintainable code, and advanced analytical techniques (e.g. window functions)
  • Proven experience designing enterprise-grade dimensional models on modern cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake, including partitioning, incremental patterns, and performance optimization
  • Hands-on experience modelling SaaS / CRM / ERP source systems such as Salesforce or NetSuite, with a clear understanding of how their object models translate into clean dimensional schemas
  • Proven Dataform or dbt expertise in production: materializations, incremental strategies, snapshots, and macros
  • You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, clarifying needs, surfacing tradeoffs, and driving alignment
  • A security and compliance mindset: GDPR, SOX, and data access controls are part of the job, not an afterthought

Some Additional Things That Would Be a Bonus

  • CI/CD experience (e.g. GitHub Actions): automated testing, linting, and deployment workflows
  • Python or JavaScript for data engineering tooling
  • LookML or equivalent semantic layer experience
  • Familiarity with data contracts for pipeline validation
  • Experience using AI/LLM-assisted tooling to accelerate development workflows: code generation, documentation, debugging, or review
  • Revenue/finance domain knowledge (ARR, MRR, NetSuite, revenue arrangements)

What’s In It For You

  • Real ownership: you'll own canonical data models that leadership relies on, with the autonomy to design them properly and the influence to evolve team standards
  • A modern, well-maintained stack (Dataform, BigQuery, Looker, GitHub Actions, OpenCode) with active investment in developer experience and tooling
  • High-quality peers who care about craft, code reviews that make you better, and time to do things the right way
  • Direct line of sight to business impact: your work powers conversations with the CFO, GTM leadership, and Product teams
  • A growing Data Office at a publicly traded company headquartered in Montreal

Be a Changemaker, You’ll Enjoy

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work
  • A culture that celebrates performance
  • The chance to make an impact in a team that's big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard
  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies
  • Equity options, because this is your company too
  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters
  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career
  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best
  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community
  • Interest groups, employee-led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams
  • Computer purchase program to get your personal MacBook
  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families
  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)
  • Unlimited paid time off policy
  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year
  • Health insurance: Immediate access to health, dental, vision, and life insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Employer RRSP contribution of up to 4% of base salary to a maximum of $5,000
  • Health and wellness benefit of $500 per year
  • Employee Technology Purchase Program: Ability to an interest-free loan to purchase certain Apple products
  • Paid leave and assistance for new parents
  • Mental health online platform and counselling & coaching services
  • Volunteer day
  • We got you covered! A variety of snacks, coffee, and teas are always accessible and available in the office kitchen - Tuesday: Pancakes, Wednesday: Lunch is served, and Thursday is Happy Hour with a variety of drinks and snacks.

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities.

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.

At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skill set, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the total compensation for this position to be in the range of $115,000 TO $135,000 CAD. Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, RRSP plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off.

This role represents an existing vacancy at Lightspeed.

Lightspeed also uses artificial intelligence-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by our recruiting and hiring teams.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here. Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who We Are

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

title: Lead AI Engineer, Agentic Systems
description:
Location: Sydney

Contract Type: Permanent

MinterEllison is one of Australia’s largest independent law and consulting firms. With a heritage of almost 200 years, we are known for our excellence, and our authentic and enduring relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. Clients seek out MinterEllison to help them solve complex problems every day. We do this by our full-service legal offering and complementary consulting offering.

We offer opportunities to work on industry-leading mandates for top-tier clients, while being part of a high-performing and collaborative team that values excellence, diversity of thought, curiosity, and inclusion. We value our people and empower them to achieve their ambitions - with the support, trust and autonomy to grow their careers in meaningful ways.

At MinterEllison, we're leading the way with AI and other emerging technologies, powering innovation right across our firm. You will have the opportunity to engage with AI tools we've built, and other external AI tools, to enhance efficiencies and excellence internally and with our clients.

We support sustainable ways of working regarding how, when and where you work and offer a wide range of social, financial and health benefits (see https://www.minterellison.com/-/media/Minter-Ellison/Files/Careers/MinterEllison-Employee-Benefits-Dec_2025.pdf)

The Team

Our AI Enablement team builds agentic AI systems for use in legal work. Its platforms support areas including large-scale due diligence, regulatory reasoning across FIRB, continuous disclosure, competition and environmental law, and visa eligibility assessment. Several systems are already operating in production. You will join a small, senior team working directly with partners and subject-matter experts. The team brings together AI engineering, probabilistic modelling, production platform delivery and practical legal expertise to create systems that experts can inspect and govern.

Your Role

This is an end-to-end engineering role for someone who wants to build production AI systems in a complex, regulated environment. You will take ownership across agent orchestration, evaluation, deployment and the interfaces through which legal experts govern the systems they use. The breadth of this role extends from research-grade modelling to production platform engineering. It offers the opportunity to work with live systems, real users and the experts whose knowledge those systems are designed to encode.

In this role, you will:

  • design and build multi-agent orchestration, Model Context Protocol servers and supporting tooling for production legal workflows
  • create deterministic evaluation harnesses and regression suites that make agent quality measurable
  • implement OpenTelemetry tracing to improve the observability of agent runs
  • model regulatory reasoning through Bayesian networks and related probabilistic techniques
  • develop expert-facing interfaces that allow legal specialists to inspect and edit regulatory rules
  • deploy and operate secure, observable and supportable platforms on AWS
  • work directly with partners and subject-matter experts to translate legal judgement into robust technical systems
  • contribute to appropriate governance and assurance for AI used in regulated work.

About You

We welcome applications from experienced AI engineers who can demonstrate:

  • production experience with LLM agent frameworks and tool-calling architectures, including systems deployed beyond the prototype stage
  • a rigorous evaluation discipline and the ability to demonstrate whether a model or system change has improved performance
  • experience applying Bayesian inference, Bayesian networks or comparable statistical reasoning to a real-world domain
  • strong Python software-engineering capability
  • sufficient React and TypeScript experience to build usable, expert-facing interfaces
  • production AWS experience, including security and identity considerations relevant to regulated data
  • sound judgement when working with non-technical experts
  • a strong understanding of governance requirements associated with AI in regulated environments.

Exposure to AI assurance standards such as ISO 42001 will be viewed favourably

How to apply

We encourage applications from people of all ages, abilities, cultural backgrounds, genders (including trans or gender diverse), LGBTQ+ people and those with carer responsibilities. We particularly encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people to apply.

We prefer to connect with people directly, so please submit your CV by clicking on the 'Apply' button. We encourage all applications, including if you do not meet all the criteria listed for the role. Your application will also enable us to consider you for other opportunities that may be available at MinterEllison.

If you are currently a MinterEllison employee, please apply through the internal careers page.

If you would like further information, require any adjustments throughout the recruitment process or for a confidential discussion, please contact Simon.Gillin@minterellison.com.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
Culture

We treat your time as the scarce asset that it is. We respect people being heads-down and having the time to get into a flow. Distractions and context switching are things we work to minimize. We have meetings for specific purposes, and leverage async channels when appropriate.

Mash has an open and direct culture. We believe that not making a decision is a decision - and a terrible one at that. We have strong conviction and a bias for action. We can agree to disagree, and move forward after reviewing the details. As we learn, we will reevaluate, iterate and push forward.

About Mash

We're a dynamic team with experience at startups, and scaling products at big tech including Google, Amazon, Ada, D2L, CourseHero, Rakuten, Dayforce, PagerDuty, ROSS Intelligence & Lazer. We have top AI staff, including from programs such as MScAC, and advisors that have built startups and led some of the largest organizations in big-tech over the past 15 years.

We don't use any seniority titles, and plan not to for as long as feasibly possible (learn more about why).

Mash investors include Whitecap Venture Partners, Castle Island Ventures, Maple VC, Strategic Cyber Ventures, Aquanow, Spacecadet, and angel investors including Sunny Madra (formerly Groq, now NVIDIA), Balaji Srinivasan (former CTO of Coinbase, author of The Network State), Austin Hill (co-founder of Zero-Knowledge Systems and Blockstream), Josh Troy (multi-startup CFO/co-founder, including Urbint) and John Pfeffer (former partner at KKR, co-founder of Pfeffer Capital).

Role & responsibilities

As an AI-focused software engineer on the Mash team, you will:

  • Ship core AI features within the Mash platform.
    • Architect LLM-powered solutions and manage related infrastructure.
    • Apply information retrieval techniques for search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), working with embedding models and vector databases.
    • Develop processes and tooling for measuring and iterating on LLM output quality, leveraging eval frameworks and observability platforms.
    • Create tooling to collect and leverage internal datasets for evaluation, few-shot prompting, fine-tuning and more.
    • Develop bespoke ML/NLP models, when appropriate.
  • Build production data pipelines to ingest knowledge sources.
  • Stay up to date on cutting-edge research in the ML/NLP space and identify opportunities to apply new techniques within the Mash platform.
  • Work closely with a cross-functional team (product, design, engineering).
  • Discover and understand user needs.

Our stack

  • AI: Always iterating and changing - recently - Python, Agent Harnesses (e.g., home-brewed, open-source), Inference across open-weight and frontier LLM models, NLP models, speech-to-text, and lots more.
  • Application: Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy), TypeScript, React Native with Expo, Next.js.
  • Data: Postgres, Cloud Storage, Prefect.
  • Infrastructure: GCP (e.g., Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, Eventarc), Terraform, Docker, Dagger, Kubernetes, Tilt, OpenTelemetry.

Skill set

  • 4+ years of building production software at scale with a multi-year focus on AI.
  • Proficiency in 1+ programming languages, such as Python, Go, Rust, C++, or Java.
  • You've shipped LLM-powered features to real users: agents and tool calling, context design, retrieval and structured outputs.
  • You've built evals, datasets or regression checks that drive meaningful and provable improvement in a customer/user experience.
  • Experience with event-driven systems, building cloud-native software (with cloud providers such as Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, etc.), working with data (both structured and unstructured) and developing data pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of backend system design and scalable architectures.
  • You use AI coding agents as a normal part of how you build.
  • Bonus: agent harnesses, structured interactions, speech or audio pipelines, entity resolution, sandboxing and isolation, privacy-preserving ML.

Cultural fit

We're looking for an individual who:

  • Responds well to open-ended problems and thrives on autonomy - is a self-starter and problem solver.
  • Thrives in collaborative environments and is laser-focused on team goals.
  • Has great communication skills.
  • Has a passion for lifelong learning.
  • Has strong user empathy, and a user experience first mindset.

title: Plejecenterleder med øje for, hvilken retning vi skal.
description:
Er du klar til at tage et plejecenter under dine vinger og vise, hvordan kompetencer og fagligheder vokser i en frugtbar hverdag?

- Så lad din karriere blomstre videre på Trollehøj Plejecenter, hvor en sektionslederstilling venter på at stå i fuldt flor.

Hvad tilbyder vi i stillingen?
Trollehøj er et velfungerende plejecenter med cirka 50 kompetente og engagerede medarbejdere, der hver dag summer af engagement for et fagligt, tværfagligt og professionelt samarbejde for at skabe det bedste hjem for borgerne.
Plejecentret består af 36 plejeboliger, der ligger i naturskønne omgivelser i den østlige del af Svendborg.

På Trollehøj er der et stærkt fællesskab og stor villighed og lyst til at løse opgaverne.

Vi har et succesfyldt samarbejde med frivillige fra lokalområdet, som vi ønsker at udvide.

I sektionen er der fokus på medarbejdernes kompetencer i forhold til borgernes behov, og der er et tæt samarbejde med blandt andet læger, terapeuter, demenskonsulenter, Myndighedsafdelingen samt Hjælpemidler & Hverdagsteknologi. Vi har fokus på borgerperspektivet, og lægger vægt på at understøtte borgerne i at kunne leve det gode liv i hverdagen. Derfor vægter vi et godt samarbejde med borgere og pårørende.


Kollegialt bliver du en del af et velfungerende team med syv lederkollegaer i Plejecenter Øst, som arbejder tæt sammen om at løse opgaverne. Herudover har vi et nært samarbejde med de øvrige lederkollegaer på ældreområdet.


Svendborg Kommune har en visionær ledelsespolitik med fokus på ledelsesudvikling, både på det individuelle og det organisatoriske plan.

I forbindelse med din opstart designer vi et onboardingprogram til dig, skræddersyet til dine behov og forudsætninger. Du tilknyttes en mentor og der er kontinuerlig sparring med din områdeleder, som du refererer til.

I det daglige har du et tæt samarbejde med husets sygeplejersker, sosu’er og øvrige medarbejdere, herunder tillidsvalgte og nøglepersoner. Og ikke mindst din assisterende leder. Den assisterende leder understøtter ledelse og planlægning. Du vil naturligvis også indgå i et tæt samarbejde med borgere, pårørende og plejecentrets frivillige hjælpere.

Du får administrativ assistance fra områdekontoret og fra ældreområdets stab, der bistår dig med eksempelvis udviklingsopgaver, kvalitetssikring og juridiske og faglige spørgsmål. Desuden kan du få sparring af kompetente HR-konsulenter og økonomikonsulenter.

Vi ønsker os, at du:

  • At du går forrest og viser vejen med en struktureret ledelse, så alle præsterer bedst muligt i arbejdet.
  • Har blikket der ser og møder medarbejdere med forskellige fagligheder og personligheder.
  • Ihærdigt arbejder med kultur og understøtter det stærke fællesskab.
  • Er synlig, tilgængelig og tydelig i din fremtræden
  • Får øje på de gode historier og hverdagsoplevelser.

Som sektionsleder på Trollehøj er forståelse for ledelsesansvar, samarbejde og sammenhæng i en stor organisation vigtige pejlemærker. Vi ser gerne, at du har en relevant sundhedsfaglig uddannelse og gerne ledelseserfaring. Måske har du allerede diplom i ledelse eller er indstillet på at tage uddannelsen. Det vil også være en stor fordel at du har erfaring med personcentreret omsorg ud fra Kitt Woods teori om personcentreret omsorg.

Ansøgningen
I din ansøgning vil vi gerne læse konkrete eksempler på hvordan du:

  • Skaber motivation og får andre til at performe.
  • Er tydelig, nærværende og inkluderende i din ledelse.
  • Arbejder struktureret og skaber balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.
  • Reflekterer og kommunikerer i forbindelse med at du skal implementere og udvikle.
  • Har fokus på borgerperspektivet og det gode samarbejde med beboerne, pårørende og andre samarbejdspartnere.

Ældreområdet

Når du arbejder på ældreområdet, møder du bag hver enkelt dør et unikt menneske. Et menneske, du gør en forskel for. Hos os har du frihed til at møde netop dét menneske – måske i en lille snak, i en svær stund eller med en hjælpende hånd.
Vi har ikke én færdig opskrift på det gode ældreliv, fordi vi hylder forskelligheden. Men vi gør os altid umage med at møde det enkelte menneske med værdighed.
Vi insisterer på at skabe de bedste rammer for, at du kan udføre dit arbejde godt og meningsfuldt. Vi har også høje forventninger til dig og til din faglighed. Du får lov at bruge det, du kan, og arbejde med det, du brænder mest for.
Du vil få en synlig leder, du kan sparre med, og dejlige kolleger at dele hverdagen med.

Om Svendborg Kommune
Svendborg Kommune er i vores øjne en arbejdsplads af en helt perfekt størrelse: Vi er små nok til at være tæt på hinanden i et varmt uhøjtideligt fællesskab med korte kommandoveje og uden skjulte dagsordner. Og vi er store nok til at have god plads til ambitioner, høj faglighed og rige muligheder for udvikling.

Vi holder af hverdagen og insisterer på, at det skal være rart at gå på arbejde. Vi har travlt, men ikke for travlt til at hjælpe hinanden.

Vores værdier findes ikke kun på papiret, vi bruger dem faktisk som kompas hver dag. Vi møder hinanden i øjenhøjde, i dialog og med tillid, og sammen skaber vi en tryg ramme, hvor vi alle kan løse vores opgaver selvstændigt, fleksibelt og ansvarligt.

Løn og ansættelse

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte Områdeleder Karin R. Larsen på telefon 2488 6825.

Ved stillingens besættelse skal en aktuel privat straffeattest forvises.

Der vil i rekrutteringsforløbet blive indhentet referencer.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem 48.119,00 og 76.333,00 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

Ansøgningsfrist den 01.11.2026 kl. 23.59.

Tiltrædelse den 01.01.2027 eller efter aftale.

1. samtale forventes afholdt den 04.11.2026.

2. samtale forventes afholdt den 24.11.2026.

Der vil være en profiltest mellem 1. og 2. samtale og mulighed for individuel samtale med områdeleder.

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

title: Seasonal Key Holder
description:
Get some, give back! We're looking for pop culture fanatics to help create the best experience for our customers.

title: Senior Engineering, Automation & Productization Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Engineering, Automation & Productization Consultant based in India.

We are seeking an experienced engineering consultant to support enterprise networking and digital transformation initiatives within a large, global organization. In this remote consulting role, you will transform architectural concepts into scalable, standardized, and production-ready solutions. You will combine enterprise networking expertise with Python-based automation, technical design, validation, and implementation support. Working across architecture, engineering, security, cloud, and operations teams, you will help improve deployment efficiency and establish repeatable engineering practices. You will also contribute to technical governance, documentation, and knowledge transfer, ensuring solutions are reliable, secure, and operationally sustainable. This opportunity is ideal for a proactive technical specialist who can bridge strategy and execution while delivering practical results in a fast-paced enterprise environment.

Accountabilities

  • Architecture and engineering: Support the development and review of High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), ensuring solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, supportability, and operational readiness. Establish and maintain engineering standards, design guidelines, and reference architectures, and participate in technical governance forums and design reviews.

  • Enterprise networking: Apply expertise in routing, switching, TCP/IP, LAN/WAN technologies, VLAN design, network segmentation, and enterprise connectivity. Review connectivity architectures and implementation approaches, support network security integration, and contribute to enterprise and cloud connectivity planning.

  • Automation and development: Identify opportunities to automate deployment and operational workflows. Develop and maintain Python-based scripts, integrate REST APIs, and create reusable automation templates, frameworks, and engineering accelerators that improve consistency and operational efficiency.

  • Productization and standardization: Convert individual solutions and pilot implementations into repeatable production models. Develop deployment methodologies, implementation playbooks, reusable design templates, and engineering best practices. Capture lessons learned and translate implementation experience into standardized frameworks and practical guidance.

  • Validation and implementation support: Support solution testing, validation, pilot deployments, and first implementations. Investigate implementation challenges, recommend remediation actions, and refine designs based on field feedback to ensure solutions meet technical and operational requirements.

  • Cloud and platform integration: Support integration across enterprise networks, applications, security platforms, and cloud environments. Contribute to hybrid architecture design and help ensure reliable connectivity and effective interoperability between systems.

  • Documentation and knowledge transfer: Create and maintain architecture documentation, engineering specifications, deployment guides, operational procedures, and implementation instructions. Conduct technical walkthroughs and knowledge-transfer workshops to support smooth handovers to engineering and operations teams.

  • Consulting and stakeholder collaboration: Work independently across architecture, engineering, implementation, and operational teams. Gather requirements, facilitate technical discussions, engage stakeholders, and help align engineering solutions with enterprise objectives and delivery standards.

    • Requirements:

    • Professional experience: At least 10 years of experience in enterprise networking, engineering, automation, or solution architecture, ideally within large, global enterprise environments. Candidates should have a proven record of delivering technical solutions across architecture, implementation, validation, and operational handover.

    • Enterprise networking expertise: Strong knowledge of routing and switching, TCP/IP, LAN/WAN technologies, VLAN design, network segmentation, enterprise network security fundamentals, connectivity design, and network integration.

    • Automation and programming skills: Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, REST APIs, JSON, YAML, Git or other version-control systems, scripting, and automation frameworks. The ability to identify automation opportunities and develop reusable engineering solutions is essential.

    • Architecture and technical design: Experience developing and reviewing HLDs and LLDs, defining solution architectures, establishing engineering standards, and producing clear technical documentation. title: Senior Flight Software Engineer
description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Flight Software Engineer is responsible for determining how our spacecraft behaves and operates in orbit and building reliable software to ensure it happens. The team is responsible for all phases of development, starting from requirements capture through testing and flight operational support.

Responsibilities

  • Develop reliable flight software that determine how the spacecraft, satellite bus, and reentry capsule operate throughout the entire mission.
  • Write quality structured bare metal, RTOS, or Linux based software for embedded processors in C++.
  • Own all aspects of software development, from design, testing, and integration.
  • Scope projects including requirements capture and initial design trades given open-ended problems.
  • Ensure system quality and performance through software test, verification, and validation (V&V) technique.
  • Teamwork, communicate and problem solve in a collaborative environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.
  • 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.
  • Experience with development in C++, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • End-to-end experience building and launching a spacecraft.
  • Experience developing and testing real-time embedded systems.
  • Experience with safety-critical software, especially for aerospace applications.
  • Experience with CCSDS telemetry and telecommand system.
  • Experience with F' or cFS framework.
  • Experience with Python, or Rust.
  • Knowledge of basic analog and digital electronics.
  • Familiarity with SPI, I2C, CAN, EtherCAT.

Pay Range
