  • Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.

title: Senior Scientist- Translational PKPD
description:
The Position

Why Genentech

We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.


This opening is for a Senior Scientist position in the translational Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics (tPKPD) department within the Development Sciences division in Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) unit.


The focus of this position is to support the preclinical pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamics (PKPD) efforts to guide the design, delivery and development of biologics in the Genentech pipeline. Core responsibilities include providing technical support for the PKPD assessment of drug candidates and marketed products and working independently or under the direct supervision of a Scientist.


The Opportunity:


The responsibilities of this Senior Scientist position will :


  • Design, conduct, analyze and interpret all in vitro and in vivo ADME and PKPD studies that are necessary to understand the pharmacology of drug candidates in animals and predict their behavior in humans
  • Prepare summary tables and reports for non-clinical studies; may prepare documents for regulatory agencies, including INDs and BLAs under the supervision of a Scientist
  • Present data at project teams and department meetings and conferences as appropriate
  • Publish innovative PKPD focused research in high quality scientific, technical or medical journals.
  • Manage an active laboratory program that supports basic research in PKPD and also supports pipeline projects
  • Collaborate with other departments such as Clinical Pharmacology, Research, Bioanalytical Sciences, Safety Assessment, PD Biomarker/OMNI, Antibody Engineering, Non-clinical Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Technical Development, and others
  • Participate in compliance and safety related activities. Perform other duties, as assigned

Who You Are:


  • Ph.D., or M.D., or PharmD degree or equivalent curriculum in pharmacology, pharmaceutical science, biology, bioengineering, chemistry, physiology or related disciplines is required (experience is specific to job level). Persons without a formal degree who have comparable depth and breadth of training and experience (gained at Genentech or elsewhere), and who meet job-specific criteria, are eligible for consideration
  • 1-2 years of relevant industry experience in translational PKPD/pharmacology or equivalent Postdoctoral experience is preferred
  • Outstanding record of accomplishment in his/her field as evidenced by his/her co authored publications, patents, internal reports and/or regulatory filings.
  • Strong knowledge of laboratory techniques and safety is required; Regular GLP and laboratory safety training is required
  • Experience in quantitative PKPD software (e.g., WinNonlin, NONMEM, ADAPT II, Matlab, Simbiology, R)
  • Demonstrated independent thought and creativity in relevant discipline; independently designs, carries out, analyzes, interprets, and documents studies and experiments.
  • Good communication skills, independently presents at department and project team meeting

title: Dietitian HCC
description:
JOB PURPOSE\:

Responsible for assuming professional responsibility and accountability for the Dietary Services Department in the provision of nourishing, palatable, well-balanced diets to meet the daily nutritional and special dietary needs of each resident according to their comprehensive resident assessment and plan of care. In collaboration with the Dietary Manager and Administrator, allocates department resources in an efficient and economic manner to ensure each resident receives food in amount, type, consistency and frequency to maintain usual body weight and nutritional values.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES\:

1. Interviews patient/family to obtain pertinent nutrition information needed for the development of an individualized dietary plan of care for residents.

2. Completes appropriate clinical documentation in the medical record pertaining to the nutritional needs of the patient in accordance with the patient comprehensive assessment and care plan to comply with regulatory guidelines.

3. Completes and updates dietary assessments as part of the comprehensive resident assessment process.

4. Reviews regular and therapeutic diet orders to ensure they are served as prescribed and in accordance to the menu.

5. Reviews and documents patient’s cultural backgrounds that may affect food consumption.

6. Interviews patient/family member to obtain updated information needed to accommodate individual needs and preferences and to protect and promote patients/residents’ rights.

7. Works cooperatively with members of the interdisciplinary team to develop, implement and evaluate residents’ plan of care.

8. Attends care plan conferences and communicate resident concerns and responses to interventions to the interdisciplinary team members and direct care staff.

9. Provides quarterly audits of the clinical record to identify any potential opportunities for improvement and ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines.

10. Identifies ways to accommodate residents’ choices, preferences and customary routines in regards to dining and include the approaches in the plan of care and communicate to appropriate staff members.

11. Adjusts menus as deemed appropriate to meet the preferences of the resident population of the facility.

12. Conducts regular meal observations, record reviews, and resident interviews for adherence to prescribed diet orders and nutrition interventions.

13. Conducts quality assurance functions that include regular compliance rounds of the Dietary Department’s food preparation and storage areas for adherence to regulatory guidelines.

14. Directs staff in improving the quality of foods served and the dining experience.

15. In collaboration with the Dietary Manager, conduct interviews and hire staff that meet the qualifications to perform all essential functions of the job.

16. Gathers and presents supplemental documentation to avoid potential deficiencies.

17. Collaborates with Corporate Dietitian for timely responses to requests for information and suggestions to improve quality of Dietary Services.

description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

About the team + role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll architect, build, and scale the backend services, infrastructure, and data systems that support Robinhood’s next-generation crypto, web3, and wallet offerings. You’ll provide technical leadership to deliver a best-in-class trading experience for cryptocurrencies and tokenized assets—including perpetual futures—to customers worldwide, solving complex distributed systems and correctness challenges in an environment where the systems you build move real customer assets continuously around the clock.

title: Senior Software Developer (Contract)
description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Developer to join Ashbury on a contract basis, starting immediately, to build out our portfolio of AI-assisted regulatory and artwork tools. This is a hands-on development role: most of your week will be spent designing, writing, testing and shipping code, taking prototypes that already exist and turning them into tools our advisors use every day.

Ashbury is a trusted technical and regulatory services provider to the food industry. We are developing tools that improve the speed, accuracy and consistency of specification and artwork work, including Pack Copy and final-artwork alignment, artwork version comparison, international regulatory adaptation and retailer-specific specification checks. These tools combine document processing, OCR and rules with generative AI, and you will work alongside our IT team and regulatory specialists to deliver them in small, usable releases.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and build the features behind Ashbury’s regulatory and artwork tools, taking working prototypes through to production and delivering in small, frequent releases that save advisor time and reduce regulatory or artwork risk.
  • Choose the right approach for each problem, blending deterministic rules, document processing, OCR and generative AI, and favouring reproducible, explainable outputs where they feed regulated decisions.
  • Build LLM-backed features properly: structured prompting, evaluation against representative test data and golden outputs, and clear thresholds for accuracy, latency and cost before anything is released.
  • Work directly with our regulatory specialists to turn retailer and market knowledge into testable rules, reusable components and terminology mappings.
  • Write well-tested, maintainable code in source control, ship through our existing Azure DevOps pipelines and document what you build so the internal team can support and extend it.
  • Follow secure-by-design practices (least privilege, secrets management, privacy controls, dependency hygiene) and take part in code reviews with the rest of the development team.
  • Help shape the technical direction of the tools as they grow, including how they are hosted on Azure, working with Ashbury’s IT team rather than owning the platform alone.

Experience:

Essential

  • Senior-level software engineering experience, including building new products, developing and maintaining existing ones in production.
  • Hands-on proficiency with C#/.NET and Azure (Functions, App Service, storage and AI services), with strong API, data-processing and systems-integration skills.
  • Practical experience building LLM-backed features: prompt design, evaluation, guardrails and cost control, using Azure OpenAI or similar APIs.
  • Experience taking prototypes or digital products through to production launch, controlled rollout and ongoing improvement.
  • Comfortable working in a small team alongside non-technical specialists, turning their knowledge into clear, testable increments.

Desirable

  • Experience with OCR, computer vision, PDF processing, artwork comparison, multilingual content, rules engines or document intelligence.
  • Python for data-processing or AI tooling alongside the .NET stack.
  • TypeScript/React, or experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform.
  • Containers, Git workflows and automated testing in an Azure DevOps environment.
  • Experience in FMCG, retail, regulatory technology or another controlled environment.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:

In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring game quality throughout development, working closely with engineering, design, art, and production teams. You will develop comprehensive testing strategies, investigate complex technical issues, and help deliver polished, responsive, and reliable gameplay experiences. Your expertise will be particularly valuable in testing Unreal Engine 5 systems, multiplayer functionality, and networked interactions. By identifying risks early and driving continuous quality improvements, you will directly influence the stability and overall player experience of an ambitious PvPvE multiplayer shooter. This opportunity combines technical problem-solving, creative collaboration, and meaningful ownership within a globally distributed team.

        • Help ensure multiplayer features deliver a consistent, responsive, and enjoyable experience.

        • QA Processes, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

          • Maintain accurate bug-tracking workflows, QA documentation, and testing reports using Jira or similar platforms.

          • Monitor defect trends, testing results, and quality metrics to identify recurring problems and areas requiring additional coverage.

          • Contribute to automated testing initiatives, internal QA tools, and scripts where appropriate.

          • Collaborate with production and QA leadership to prioritize defects according to severity, development milestones, and release requirements.

            • Strong professional experience in game development QA, ideally in a Senior QA Engineer, QA Engineer, or similarly technical quality assurance role.

            • Demonstrated experience creating, maintaining, and executing structured test plans, test cases, and regression test suites.

            • Excellent bug investigation and reproduction skills, including the ability to document complex technical issues clearly and precisely.

            • Working knowledge of at least one relevant scripting or programming technology, such as Python, C#, Lua, Unreal Blueprints, or Unreal scripting tools.

            • Experience with QA and defect-tracking platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Bugzilla.

            • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.

            • Experience analyzing QA data, defect trends, and testing outcomes to identify recurring issues, quality gaps, and potential risks.

            • Confidence collaborating directly with technical teams and discussing issues with engineers to support effective investigation and resolution.

            • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work independently across multiple features and development areas.

            • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

            • A proactive, detail-oriented mindset and a commitment to identifying quality issues early rather than relying solely on final-stage testing.

            • Genuine enthusiasm for video games and a strong understanding of what makes gameplay polished, responsive, balanced, and enjoyable.

            • Residence in Europe or a CET-compatible time zone, with sufficient overlap with Central European working hours to participate consistently in team meetings, daily collaboration, and project discussions.

              • Experience developing or maintaining automated testing frameworks, QA scripts, or internal testing tools.

              • Familiarity with performance, load, or stress testing.

title: Graphics Engineer, Kernel API Team
description:
The opportunity

We're looking for a graphics engineer to join the Graphics Kernel API team. The team works on a standalone, low-level graphics abstraction layer that gives Unity a single, consistent interface across every platform and graphics driver we support. The team owns the cross-driver abstraction that keeps behavior consistent across every backend, the validation layer and conformance test suite that catch misuse, and the specifications and design records that document how it all fits together. It's the layer every driver team implements against, and the one the rest of the engine is built on. You'll work alongside other graphics developers and the individual driver teams on clean, efficient APIs - keeping them consistent across a wide range of hardware, and making sure they're testable, debuggable and well documented. It's a good place to build real depth in cross-platform rendering.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop and maintain the common API layer and the cross-driver abstraction layer beneath it, helping keep behavior consistent across D3D12, Vulkan, Metal, WebGPU and console backends.
  • Contribute to the validation layer and conformance test suite, so that misuse is caught early and every driver can be held to the same contract.
  • Work with the lower-level driver teams to make sure new API additions are practical to implement and perform well on real hardware.
  • Improve the performance, testability and stability of the systems you work on, from the API surface down to how commands reach the driver.
  • Contribute to the specifications and documentation that keep the API coherent as it evolves.
  • Take part in technical design reviews and code reviews.
  • Work with stakeholders and higher-level engine teams to understand requirements, plan work, communicate progress and solve problems as they come up.

What we're looking for

  • Software engineering fundamentals, and experience writing multi-threaded C++.
  • An understanding of real-time 3D graphics programming, including modern GPU architecture and resource management.
  • Experience with a modern graphics API such as Direct3D 12, Vulkan or Metal.
  • The ability to diagnose bugs and performance issues using industry-standard tools.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented approach, good communication skills, and a real interest in rendering and cross-platform development.
  • A willingness to jump into unfamiliar technical areas.
  • Graphics fundamentals matter more to us here than experience with any one API.
  • If you've worked in D3D12 or Metal and haven't touched Vulkan - or the other way round - we'd still like to hear from you.
  • You might also have Experience writing conformance tests, validation layers, or other tooling that holds multiple implementations to a shared specification.
  • Familiarity with CPU and GPU debugging and profiling tools such as RenderDoc, PIX, or platform-specific captures.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity or another real-time 3D engine.

Base Salary Range

Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location: Canada Montreal CAD$89,100 - CAD$133,700 CAD gross. title: Solutions Engineer
description:
About TinyMCE

TinyMCE is the rich text editor behind the content experiences of thousands of software companies and enterprises worldwide. It's part of Tiugo Technologies, a portfolio that also includes CKEditor, Uploadcare, and ButterCMS. We're growing into AI-powered content creation, adding AI capabilities on top of the editor that developers already build on.

The Role

You'll be our first dedicated Solutions Engineer. You'll lead the technical side of our most complex deals, mainly TinyMCE AI and strategic enterprise opportunities for the core editor. You'll work each deal alongside our Account Executives, Account Managers, and Product Managers, and you'll set the standard for how we win technically.

This is a player-coach role in practice, even though you won't manage anyone. You'll be involved in deals directly. You'll also build the playbooks, a demo library, and POC framework the rest of the team uses. That work matters as much as the deals. There's no SE leader here to hand you a playbook, because you're writing it.

What You'll Do

Win complex technical deals

  • Lead technical discovery across customer architecture, content workflows, integration requirements, and AI ambitions

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers evaluate architecture choices and challenging assumptions when appropriate

  • Deliver tailored demos rooted in the customer’s use case and needs; not feature tours

  • Own the technical win from discovery through architecture, security review, and sign-off

  • Translate technical capabilities into business outcomes

Run evaluations that lead to decisions

  • Establish clear evaluation criteria and lead disciplined POCs with defined success criteria, outcomes, timelines, and checkpoints

  • Guide build vs. buy and competitive evaluations with a credible view of cost, time to value, and risk

  • Know when a POC isn't the right next step and say so

Make the AI story credible

  • Explain our AI architecture from user experience and orchestration to underlying models to technical and business audiences

  • Navigate topics including LLM APIs, RAG, model choice, data privacy, and security

  • Partner with AEs and AMs to turn technical differentiation into business cases champions can take to economic buyers

Build the SE motion

  • Create reusable demo and discovery frameworks, POC processes, and competitive playbooks

  • Serve as the technical voice of the field to Product and Engineering, bringing structured feedback on customer needs, product gaps, and competitive pressure

  • Enable AEs and AMs to handle first-level technical and AI discovery independently

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in technical pre-sales (Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Solutions Architect) at a B2B SaaS company, ideally selling to developers or product teams

  • A consultative, solutions-first mindset. You can map a customer's content workflows end to end, spot where the editor and AI fit (and where they don't), and design a proposed solution. Our products are building blocks, not plug-and-play, and every strategic deal takes some shaping.

  • Experience winning complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise evaluations and running structured POCs

  • Technical fluency with JavaScript, modern front-end frameworks, APIs, SDKs, and integration patterns

  • Working knowledge of modern AI architecture, including LLM APIs, orchestration, RAG, model selection, data privacy, and security

  • Ability to connect technical decisions to measurable business value

  • Strong communication across audiences, from engineers and architects to senior business leaders

  • The judgment and initiative to succeed while establishing our playbook

Nice to Have

  • Experience as the first or an early SE for a company or product line

  • Software engineering experience before moving into pre-sales

  • Experience selling into regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or legal

Why Join TinyMCE

Build our SE motion from the ground up, shape how we take AI to market, and influence the product through direct exposure to our most strategic customers. Do so in a profitable, growing PSG portfolio company with an enviable customer base and financial strength. Alongside joining a great team in an impactful role, some of our benefits include:

title: Principal Infrastructure Architect: Data Platform
description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.

As a Principal Infrastructure Architect on our Infrastructure Architecture team, you will be the architecture team's partner to ZoomInfo's data engineering organization. Data engineering owns the platforms and the products built on them. You bring the infrastructure patterns, evaluation rigor, and cross-team alignment that help them build and run those platforms well on GCP.

This is a cloud architect seat with a data specialty. You bring the same cloud, Kubernetes, networking, and infrastructure-as-code foundation as the rest of the architecture team, plus enough hands-on depth in data systems to be credible with the engineers who run them.

The work breaks down four ways:

  • Patterns. You establish and maintain the paved-road patterns data teams build on: infrastructure as code, CI/CD for data jobs and pipelines, monitoring and alerting, performance, and cost. You keep them easy to consume and self-service.
  • Enablement and alignment. You help data teams adopt those patterns, review their designs, and work through hard infrastructure trade-offs with them.
  • Evaluation. You run POCs of new data technologies and vendor offerings as part of the procurement and technology-lifecycle process, and you write recommendations engineering leaders can act on.
  • Shared stewardship. You take a full share of the architecture team's general work: weekly architecture reviews across all domains, standards and ADRs, and infrastructure consulting for any team that needs it.

The data estate is broad. We don't expect deep experience across all of it. We expect real depth in some areas and the ability to build depth in others as the work demands. Patterns get adopted here through leadership and communication rather than positional authority. You'll write reference implementations, open the first PRs, and stay hands-on through enablement when a critical initiative calls for it.

What You'll Do

  • Establish infrastructure patterns for data workloads. Design and maintain reference patterns for provisioning and operating the data platforms ZoomInfo runs: streaming and messaging (Kafka/Confluent, Pub/Sub), operational databases (PostgreSQL/Cloud SQL, MongoDB), analytical stores (BigQuery, Snowflake), search (Elasticsearch/Solr), pipeline orchestration and processing (Apache Airflow/Cloud Composer, Dataflow/Apache Beam), and open table formats (Apache Iceberg). Ship them as Terraform modules, GitOps workflows, and documented standards that data teams can adopt without reinventing them.
  • Build the data paved road. Today's delivery tooling is application-centric. Define CI/CD and GitOps patterns for data jobs and pipelines, and partner with platform engineering and data engineering to make data delivery as safe and automated as application delivery.
  • Establish performance, cost, and observability patterns. Give data teams the patterns and guidance to run stores and pipelines efficiently (query and storage optimization, partitioning and clustering, tiering and retention, workload isolation, right-sizing) and the monitoring, alerting, and SLO practices that make performance and cost visible. Set the baseline patterns for backup, restore, and disaster recovery of data stores, including RTO/RPO targets. Partner with FinOps on data-layer spend. Review workloads with teams against these patterns and help them align.
  • Evaluate new technologies. Run structured POCs of emerging data technologies and vendor offerings as part of the procurement and technology-lifecycle process. Recent examples include graph and distributed SQL databases, stream processing (Apache Flink, Confluent Flink), and schema management and cataloging. Weigh self-hosted against vendor-managed, map migration and exit paths, model cost, and write up a recommendation.
  • Bring managed data services inside the perimeter. Define the patterns for connecting vendor-managed data planes (Confluent Cloud, Snowflake, MongoDB Atlas, and similar) to our GCP environment: private connectivity (Private Service Connect, PrivateLink, VPC peering), VPC Service Controls, identity and encryption across the boundary (workload identity, CMEK, in-transit), and the DNS and routing that go with them. Model egress and cross-region cost, and set the exfiltration controls that keep those services inside the compliance perimeter.
  • Support data consolidation and governance efforts. Contribute infrastructure guidance to data engineering's work on consolidating where data lives and is accessed (BigQuery, Snowflake, object storage) and on data classification, residency, and access policy.
  • Prototype and hand off. Build the reference implementation, write the ADR, and partner with the owning teams to roll the pattern out. Stay hands-on through POC and initial enablement.
  • Participate in architecture review. Bring a consistent, documented rubric to weekly architecture reviews across all domains, including designs that have nothing to do with data. Expand the standards library and ADR catalog. Take a share of the team's general consulting and support load.
  • Enable teams. Host design reviews and workshops. Serve as the infrastructure consultant to data teams making complex choices.

What We're Looking For

  • Influence and communication. You can present a recommendation, show its value, and back it with prototypes, benchmarks, and documented rationale. You've gotten patterns adopted across engineering organizations you don't manage by working with the teams involved.
  • Cloud infrastructure foundation. Production experience architecting on GCP and/or AWS beyond the data services: compute and Kubernetes (GKE or equivalent) as the runtime for data workloads, VPC networking and private connectivity to managed services, IAM and workload identity, and cost and reliability trade-offs. Strong Terraform and GitOps skills, including designing and reviewing modules other teams depend on. You can review a service-mesh or network design in architecture review with credibility.
  • Hands‑on data infrastructure experience at scale. You've built and operated the infrastructure under data platforms at multi‑terabyte to petabyte scale, with high throughput, high concurrency, and latency‑sensitive workloads, and you know what breaks in production.
  • Depth in at least two data domains, fluency across the rest. Deep production experience in at least two of: streaming and stream processing (Kafka/Confluent, Flink); relational operational databases (PostgreSQL); NoSQL (MongoDB); columnar analytics and lakehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Iceberg); search (Elasticsearch/Solr); pipeline orchestration and processing (Airflow, Dataflow/Beam). Enough fluency in the others to evaluate, review, and learn them quickly.
  • Performance and cost engineering. You've diagnosed and fixed expensive or slow data workloads (query plans, storage layout, pipeline design, warehouse spend) and turned the fixes into reusable patterns and monitoring that other teams picked up.
  • Development and operational depth. You can dive into code to prove out a pattern and test behavior under load, and you'd rather ship a working prototype than a diagram.
  • Technology evaluation. You've run rigorous evaluations that separate vendor pitch from architectural fit, and your recommendations have been used by engineering leaders and procurement.

Bonus Points

  • Supported a lakehouse or data mesh migration from the infrastructure side.
  • Implemented data classification, residency, or privacy/compliance (GDPR/CCPA) controls at the infrastructure layer.
  • Run graph or distributed SQL databases in production.
  • Know the infrastructure demands of AI/ML data workloads (feature stores, vector databases, embedding pipelines).
  • Built or applied AI‑augmented developer or architecture workflows (agent‑driven pipeline provisioning, MCP servers, LLM‑based rubric evaluation).
  • Run or participated in an Architecture Review Council or equivalent governance body.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10–15+ years of cloud infrastructure, platform, or data infrastructure engineering experience, including several years establishing patterns and standards that multiple teams depend on.

title: Founding Senior Software Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding Senior Software Engineer based in Portugal.

Join a fast-growing technology startup building an AI-powered platform that transforms how organizations discover, understand, and act on information from across the digital world. As a key member of a lean engineering team, you will have the opportunity to shape the technical architecture, influence core product decisions, and drive development from concept to production. You will build scalable software systems and integrate advanced AI capabilities into real-world workflows. Your work will reach hundreds of customers quickly, giving you direct visibility into product impact and user feedback. This role offers significant ownership, technical autonomy, and the opportunity to help establish engineering foundations for long-term growth. If you enjoy solving complex challenges, moving quickly, and building impactful products in an ambitious startup environment, this opportunity is for you.

Accountabilities

  • Architect, design, and develop core software systems, making key technical decisions across the technology stack while balancing immediate product needs with long-term scalability.

  • Integrate AI and machine learning capabilities into production workflows, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, embeddings, prompt execution, agentic systems, and fine-tuned models.

  • Design and improve data processing systems, distributed architectures, and real-time pipelines to efficiently ingest, process, and analyze large volumes of information across text, audio, and video.

  • Collaborate closely with the engineering team and other stakeholders to translate product requirements into effective technical solutions.

  • Deliver features rapidly, gather user feedback, and iterate continuously to improve product functionality and performance.

  • Contribute to engineering best practices, technical standards, and infrastructure decisions that support the team's continued growth.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 3 years of experience building, deploying, and scaling production-grade software systems, with strong foundations in backend engineering, services, data modeling, and distributed systems.

    • Deep expertise in at least one technical area, combined with a willingness to expand your knowledge across the broader engineering stack.

    • Proficiency in one or more relevant backend technologies, such as Python, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, with an understanding of high-concurrency systems.

    • Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS or GCP, as well as containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes and modern CI/CD pipelines.

    • A strong understanding of software architecture, system reliability, performance optimization, and designing solutions that can scale with business needs.

    • Expertise in one or more of the following areas:

      • Data Engineering: Experience with Spark, Kafka, Flink, BigQuery, large-scale ETL processes, or streaming data pipelines.

      • AI and Machine Learning: Hands-on experience deploying LLMs, RAG pipelines, embeddings, fine-tuned models, or optimized inference systems in production.

      • Backend Engineering: Experience developing robust APIs, backend services, and high-performance applications.

      • A strong product-oriented mindset, with enthusiasm for building quickly, shipping features frequently, and incorporating user feedback into continuous improvement.

      • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional stakeholders.

      • A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving, with the confidence to take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the direction of a growing engineering organization.

        • High-impact work: Deliver new features and capabilities directly to a growing customer base, with a clear connection between your work and business outcomes.

        • Technical autonomy: Influence decisions across the technology stack and choose practical solutions that balance innovation, performance, and scalability.

        • AI-driven innovation: Work hands-on with modern AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, and agentic systems, to solve real-world problems.

        • Strong engineering environment: Collaborate with an experienced, ambitious engineering team with backgrounds at leading technology companies.

        • Fast development cycles: Build, ship, and iterate rapidly, with opportunities to see your work reach customers without unnecessary bureaucracy.

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Software Engineer

Function: Engineering

Location: Metro DC Preferred (Hybrid: Tuesdays & Thursdays In-Office)

Type: Full-Time (must be currently authorized to work in the United States)

Reports To

VP of Engineering

About Holokai

Holokai is building the platform enterprises need in today's dynamic AI landscape to accelerate the secure adoption of AI. Our product lets organizations deploy AI tools safely through model access controls, distributed governance, and real-time policy enforcement, while still delivering real user productivity through a desktop chat experience and integrated agentic workflows. We are an early-stage startup with pilot customers, rapid product iteration, and direct customer feedback loops.

The Role

We're looking for a backend engineer to build core products alongside our co-founders and senior engineering team. You won't pull pre-scoped tickets from a backlog. You'll work with our senior engineers and leadership to decide what to build, then build it well.

The Holokai platform spans a user desktop application, policy enforcement engine, an agentic workflow orchestrator, a model-agnostic gateway, and a SaaS management console. You'll work across all of it, primarily in TypeScript and Go with some Python. The hard parts are genuinely hard, including sub-100ms policy evaluation, multi-model orchestration, and enterprise-grade security. We want someone who stays clear-headed in that complexity.

We need engineers who have built and owned critical production solutions running at real scale to serve exacting enterprise customers. We're heavy AI users in how we build, not just in what we ship. AI-assisted development is core to how this team works;
we want someone who puts AI to work but catches it when it's about to steer them wrong. Write simple code, ship often, and own what you put in production.

What You'll Work On

  • Backend services: APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and core business logic
  • Policy enforcement: deterministic evaluation engines, rules processing, and classification
  • Agentic orchestration: multi-step AI plans using LLM's, executed as deterministic workflows with policy checkpoints built in
  • Model gateway: routing and translation across LLM providers, token management, and request handling
  • Data layer: PostgreSQL schema design, query optimization, and data modeling
  • Production ownership: you monitor, debug, and fix what you ship

Who Thrives Here

  • Engineers who write code every day and want to keep it that way
  • People who use AI tools seriously and keep hunting for the next edge
  • Self-starters who take a problem, find the approach, and deliver without being told how
  • People drawn to the applied science of AI who want to make enterprise AI work for real

How We Work

At a start-up our size and stage, there's no living in a silo. Engineering, product, sales, and customer success all own success together. We work hard and support each other, and no amount of great code makes up for being difficult to work with. We need curious people who have played the tech start-up game long enough to learn humility, drive and the genuine joy of working and succeeding on a great team.

Required Skills

  • Strong production experience in TypeScript and Go (Python a plus): real services running in production, not scripts and notebooks
  • Designing and building APIs (REST, gRPC, or similar) and backend service architecture
  • Relational databases, PostgreSQL: schema design, query performance, migrations
  • Reading and extending code you didn't write, quickly and confidently
  • Fluent with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar);
    you use them daily and they make you meaningfully faster
  • Production experience with AWS
  • Containerized deployments (Docker, ECS, EKS, or similar)
  • Self-directed and comfortable with minimal structure in a fast-moving start-up environment

Nice to Have

  • LLM APIs and AI/ML pipelines: prompt engineering, model integration, token economics
  • Policy engines or rules-based systems (OPA/Rego, decision engines, or similar)
  • Message queues and event-driven architectures (RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka)
  • Frontend chops (React);
    not the focus, but handy for closing the loop on a feature
  • Enterprise security, compliance, or governance experience (e.G. SOC 2, GDPR, etc.)

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation commensurate with experience, with the opportunity for equity participation. We offer comprehensive Healthcare Coverage (including Vision, Dental, and Life), Unlimited PTO, Hybrid flexibility, and more.

Education

Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

How to Apply

  • Complete the LinkedIn process or send your resume and a brief note to talent@holokai.ai

  • You're a yoga instructor who wants a steady, professional environment beyond the Yoga studio

This role might be made for you.

What You'll Do
As a StretchLab Flexologist, you'll deliver one-on-one assisted stretching sessions in a clean, calm, professional studio. You'll work with clients across all ages and fitness levels — from athletes who want to perform better, to seniors who want to move without pain, to desk workers who've been tight for years. Every session, you'll draw on your knowledge of anatomy and human movement to customize stretching plans that make a real difference.
No cold calling. No selling. Just hands-on, purpose-driven work you'll feel good about.

What a Great Day Looks Like

  • You arrive at a clean, welcoming studio and review your client schedule for the day
  • You work with 4–6 clients in focused, 25- or 50-minute sessions
  • A longtime client tells you their back pain has improved dramatically — and they're moving like they haven't in years
  • You finish your shift energized, not drained
What We're Looking For
You hold a current license, certification, or degree in a health or fitness field, such as:
  • Licensed Massage Therapist (LMT)
  • Certified Personal Trainer (NASM, ACE, NSCA, ACSM, or similar)
  • Degree in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, or a related field
  • Physical Therapist or Physical Therapist Assistant
  • Occupational Therapist
  • Athletic Trainer
  • Registered Yoga Teacher (RYT 200+)
  • Or a similar credential that includes anatomy, physiology, or kinesiology
Prior stretching experience is NOT required. If you have the educational foundation, we will train you in our proven StretchLab methodology.

What You'll Get
  • Competitive hourly pay, sales commission on recovery tools (and sometimes tips)
  • Flexible scheduling — great for supplemental income or primary employment
  • Full training and certification in the StretchLab Flexologist methodology
  • A supportive, professional team environment
  • Meaningful work where you see clients transform week over week
Ready to Apply?
Fill out the application, include your resume, and get it all started.
We'd love to meet you.

Hear what our Flexologists say:
"I knew I was fairly sensitive to movement and how my own body moved, but I never realized that sensitivity could translate to working with someone else’s body. The first time I noticed a muscle tensing, relaxing, or creating resistance to a movement, it was almost an “oh!” moment. I realized I could actually feel the muscle “talking” to me through the movement and use that information to understand what the client’s body was telling me.” ~Jackie

“PNF cycles! I had no idea what they were, and now I use them in every stretch. It’s crazy how something so simple can make such a difference in how deep and effective a stretch feels.” ~Lily

“Coming into StretchLab with a background in personal training and health coaching, I thought I had a pretty good understanding of the human body. But I quickly realized there’s a HUGE difference between knowing how to train muscles and knowing how to properly stretch someone else’s body. It really opened my eyes to how much more there is to learn!” ~Marissa

“The hands-on training really puts things into perspective! You can understand something on paper all day long, but actually applying that knowledge to another person’s body is a whole different ball game!” ~Marissa

description:
About the Role

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let's shape the future of wealth management together. We are seeking an experienced Senior Frontend Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping the frontend architecture of mission critical financial platforms, driving technical excellence. You bring deep expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript and React, combined with strong engineering judgment, a passion for high quality user experiences, and a solid understanding of enterprise scale systems in regulated environments. In addition to enhancing our core platform, the team is building a strategic new channel that brings investment capabilities directly to the bank's external clients through seamless integration with the e-banking platform. Engineers joining the team will have the opportunity to shape the architecture, scalability, and operational model of this highly visible initiative from an early stage. Note: This is a 12 months contract role with an external agency payroll provider. Your Challenge

Partner closely with UX/UI designers and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into intuitive, high‑quality user experiences. Deliver high‑quality, production‑grade React and TypeScript code for complex financial applications. Address advanced frontend challenges such as state management, performance optimization, and integration with distributed backend systems. Proactively refactor and modernize existing codebases where required. Support troubleshooting and root‑cause analysis in both development and production environments. Contribute actively in an agile, fast‑paced, and highly collaborative environment. Your Profile

Skills Requirements Extensive, hands‑on experience in JavaScript and TypeScript, with a strong focus on React at enterprise scale. Deep understanding of modern frontend ecosystems, tools, and frameworks (React, Node.js, build tooling). Proven experience working with design systems and large, shared component libraries. Solid understanding of Unix/Linux environments and bash scripting. Experience in the financial services or other highly regulated industries is a plus. Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure. Knowledge of microservices architecture and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Exposure to API security, OAuth2, and related standards. Excellent analytical, decision‑making, and problem‑solving skills. Strong communication skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to influence technical direction. Proven ability to thrive in agile, cross‑functional teams. About Julius Baer

The international reference in wealth management Julius Baer is the leading Swiss wealth management group. We focus on servicing and advising sophisticated private clients from around the world, taking into account what truly matters to them – in their business and personal life, today and for future generations. Headquartered in Zurich, we are present in around 60 locations worldwide, including Bangkok, Dubai, Dublin, Frankfurt, Geneva, Hong Kong, London, Luxembourg, Madrid, Mexico City, Milan, Monaco, Mumbai, Santiago de Chile, Shanghai, Singapore, Tel Aviv, and Tokyo. Why join Julius Baer?

At Julius Baer our employees enjoy the benefits of a global company with the support and collegiality of a much smaller one. We are growing quickly, but we remain dedicated to maintaining our accessible structure with flat hierarchies, and approachable and supportive leaders. With offices around the world, we offer an international and stimulating work environment and the opportunity to work with a diverse team of highly motivated colleagues, bringing the best of the bank to our clients. Our core values of Care, Passion, and Excellence define the tone of how we interact with each other and our partners. Committed to your success Whether nurturing young talent with our renowned apprentice scheme, enabling ambitious university graduates to put theory into practice with our Graduate Programme, or providing first‑class opportunities for experienced professionals, we look after our employees. We believe in continuous learning as a company and as individuals, which is why we put a focus on the health and well‑being of our employees and offer flexible working options, a wide array of benefits, and extensive career development programmes. or contact us via the Contact Form.

title: Customer Advocacy Program Manager, Zoom Contact Center

As the dedicated Customer Advocacy Program Manager for Zoom Contact Center, you will own the end-to-end customer advocacy lifecycle for Zoom's CX product line, turning customer voices into a strategic engine that drives market proof, AI visibility, and competitive differentiation. Working closely with Product Marketing, GTM, and Customer Success teams, you will build and manage a pipeline of customer stories, secure references for analyst evaluations, lead the always-on reviews program across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, and steward the CX Council as a vehicle for deepening long-term advocate relationships. This role sits at a meaningful intersection of strategy and execution, requiring someone equally comfortable shaping the advocacy roadmap for a high-growth product line and rolling up their sleeves to source the next customer reference. If you are energized by the full advocacy lifecycle and want to make the customer voice a core pillar of how Zoom Contact Center goes to market, this is the role for you.


About the Team

The Customer Advocacy team is part of Zoom's broader Content and Marketing organization, responsible for building the customer evidence that drives awareness, consideration, and pipeline across Zoom's product portfolio. We work at the intersection of customer relationships, product marketing, and go-to-market strategy, turning real customer experiences into stories, references, reviews, and council engagements that build trust in the market. Our work directly supports analyst evaluations, demand generation, and Zoom's AI visibility across the modern buyer journey.


Responsibilities

  • Own and execute a pipeline of Zoom Contact Center customer stories in video and written formats for Zoom.com, media, and press opportunities, managing the full lifecycle from customer identification through final publication.
  • Identify and place customer speakers for CX-related owned and third-party events and webinars, matching the right advocates to the right moments across the marketing calendar.
  • Partner with Analyst Relations, Product Marketing, and GTM to identify and secure strong customer references for key analyst evaluations including Gartner, IDC, and Forrester, aligned to evaluation-specific product, vertical, and geography requirements.
  • Lead the always-on Zoom Contact Center reviews program across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, treating reviews as a strategic content engine and maximizing AEO/GEO visibility while surfacing opportunities for intent lead generation, comparison reports, and managed services.
  • Collaborate with Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, and Content teams to leverage customer reviews and market reports for demand generation, content enablement, and scaled advocacy impact.
  • Lead the CX Council end to end, managing member communications, meeting scheduling, agendas, and content preparation in partnership with the CX Council Executive Sponsor and key product leaders, while cultivating council members into long-term advocates across the full advocacy program.
  • Partner with Customer Success and GTM teams to continuously identify, develop, and maintain a pipeline of customer advocates whose stories, references, and participation support core Zoom Contact Center messaging pillars, product capabilities, and target verticals.

  • 8+ years of B2B high-tech marketing experience in roles such as integrated marketing, campaigns, field marketing, or content, combined with 3-5 years of direct experience in Customer Advocacy, Customer Marketing, or Content.
  • Demonstrated experience managing customer advocacy programs and third-party review platforms including Gartner Peer Insights, G2, and TrustRadius, with the ability to operate reviews as a strategic, always-on content engine.

  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs, stakeholders, and deadlines across a complex cross-functional environment.
  • Comfort with data, metrics, and target-setting, including experience managing toward stretch goals, reporting on program performance, and using data to prioritize advocacy investments.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Analyst Relations teams, with a strong understanding of the B2B technology buyer journey and the role customer evidence plays in purchase decisions.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Location: In one of NAC's 4 offices (Columbus, Los Angeles, Seattle, or Spokane)

Department: Information Technology

Reports To: Data Leader

Position Overview

NAC is looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our delivery team, with a specific focus on designing, building, and optimizing data solutions on Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric. This role is critical to helping NAC unlock the full value of our data assets, supporting advanced analytics, reporting, and digital transformation across the firm.

The ideal candidate is confident working with a modern data stack, automating data pipelines, and delivering reliable, scalable, high-quality data solutions in enterprise environments. The day-to-day work ranges from ingesting data out of firm business systems into a governed lakehouse to tuning the models and datasets that our reporting depends on, with an emphasis on solutions that keep working without constant attention.

This position reports to our Data Leader and will work closely with IT leadership and the data team, as well as resources supporting data architecture and data governance.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Pipeline Development & Integration

· Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data integration workflows using Microsoft Azure services such as Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, and related technologies.

· Develop and maintain ETL/ELT processes that support business reporting, analytics, and machine learning.

· Build ingestion patterns for a range of sources, including business applications, APIs, relational databases, and file-based feeds.

· Implement scheduling, orchestration, automation, and error handling so recurring data loads run reliably with minimal manual intervention.

Microsoft Fabric & Analytics Platform

· Implement and support Microsoft Fabric solutions, including dataflows, lakehouses, data warehouses, and real-time analytics features.

· Organize data in OneLake using a layered approach that keeps raw, enriched, and curated data clearly separated and traceable.

· Develop and maintain curated datasets and semantic models that support Power BI reporting and self-service analysis.

· Monitor capacity, refresh schedules, and job performance, and tune them as adoption and data volumes grow.

Data Modeling & Optimization

· Optimize data architectures for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency in cloud environments.

· Apply dimensional modeling and other established modeling patterns so data is understandable, reusable, and consistent across reporting.

· Write and tune advanced SQL, along with Python or PySpark notebooks, for complex transformation work.

· Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve data workflows, resolving failures and performance bottlenecks at the source rather than working around them.

Data Quality, Security & Governance

· Ensure high-quality, secure, and compliant data management practices in line with firm policy, client contractual obligations, and applicable data protection regulations.

· Implement data quality rules, validation, and monitoring so issues are caught before they reach reporting or decision-making.

· Apply access controls, sensitivity handling, and lineage practices in partnership with the resources supporting data governance.

Collaboration, Migration & Documentation

· Collaborate with data architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data solutions aligned with business goals.

· Support the migration and modernization of legacy data systems into Azure and Microsoft Fabric environments.

· Translate technical options and trade-offs into terms business stakeholders can act on.

· Produce and maintain technical documentation for data pipelines, architecture, and engineering best practices.

· Follow source control and deployment practices, including Git-based development and structured promotion across environments.

title: 23142 - Business Administrator - HMP / YOI Norwich
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Please be advised that we have 3 roles available, one in Security, one in our Offender Management Unit and one in Management Coordination.

We encourage applications from people from all backgrounds and aim to have a workforce that represents the wider society that we serve. We pride ourselves on being an employer of choice. We champion diversity, inclusion and wellbeing and aim to create a workplace where everyone feels valued and a sense of belonging. To find out more about how we do this visit: .

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

If you are a current NPS employee, this vacancy may be available on a Loan basis for up to 2 years. Applications are invited from suitable qualified staff.

The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

Benefits

Annual Leave

-The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays

-You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays. These hours are added to your annual leave allowance. There is a requirement to work some public and bank holidays subject to your shift pattern and the operational needs of the establishment

Pension

-The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Work Life Balance

HM Prison & Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. Work life balance provides greater opportunities for staff to work more flexibly wherever managers and establishments can accommodate requests to do so. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

Season Ticket Advance

-After two months’ service, you’ll be eligible to apply for a season ticket advance to purchase a quarterly or longer-period season ticket for travel between home and your place of work

Childcare Vouchers

For any moves across the Civil Service may have implications on your ability to carry on claiming childcare vouchers

Training

HMPPS is committed to staff development and offers a range of training and development opportunities, including areas such as Equality and Diversity, Dealing with Challenging Behaviour, Suicide Prevention and Anti Bullying Programmes

-There are opportunities to access promotion programmes and HMPPS provides a variety of training appropriate to individual posts

-All staff receive security and diversity training and an individual induction programme into their new roles

Eligibility

-All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

-All external candidates are subject to 6 months probation. Internal candidates are subject to probation if they have not already served a probationary period within HMPPS

-All staff are required to declare whether they are a member of a group or organisation which the HMPPS considers to be racist

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Backend Developer
description:
TL;DR


In office - Copenhagen based. Not a remote position. At Lumilab, we’re building a lean team of top performers. We’re looking for an exceptional backend developer to continuously develop and scale the platform that lets operators deploy their own agents. You’ll design, ship and own new features and system, from architectural decisions to how they perform in production.


You bring high agency, strong engineering judgement and a track record of delivering results independently. You take full ownership of what you build and expect the same standard from your teammates.


Why Lumilab?


We’re building Agentic Operations for the physical world. Our vision is that the next billion distributed assets in the physical world will be operated by teams orchestrating AI agents. Lumilab is building the layer that makes that possible.


Since launching 12 months ago, we’ve gained customers across eight countries. Last month alone, usage of our software grew by 56%.


That growth brings engineering challenges: running more agents, handling more data and making increasingly complex workflows reliable. You’ll help build the next version of our platform, giving operators the tools to configure and deploy agents for monitoring, reporting and operational tasks.


Joining now means having a direct say in our architecture, engineering practices and product. You’ll work close to the founders and customers, see your work used in real operations and own substantial parts of the system.


We offer a competitive base salary and equity, reflecting the responsibility you take and the company you help build.


Who We’re Looking For


We’re building a lean team of exceptional developers, and we’re deliberate about keeping the bar high. Every person needs to deliver strong results, work independently and take full ownership of what they build. We’re looking for top performers who want that level of responsibility and expect the same standard from their teammates.



  • You’ve owned products or systems end-to-end. You’ve built and operated production software in a startup or scale-up, or taken comparable responsibility elsewhere. You can explain the decisions you made, the trade-offs involved and what happened after launch.

  • You have high agency. You identify what needs doing, bring ideas and act on them. You’re comfortable turning an unclear problem into a concrete plan with minimal direction.

  • You move quickly with high standards. You have strong backend fundamentals, write maintainable, performant software and make deliberate trade-offs. You finish work and check that it solves the problem.

  • You learn fast and adapt. You can get to grips with unfamiliar systems, investigate problems methodically and change course when the evidence calls for it. You’re willing to experiment, get things wrong and learn from feedback.

  • You build with AI as your default. You use AI coding tools throughout development and expect them to generate most of your code. You understand, review and test what they produce, and take full responsibility for the result.


What You’ll Do


Design, develop and scale the backend platform that allows operators to configure, deploy and run their own agents.



  • Extend and improve our agent deployment framework with new capabilities for monitoring agents, automated reports and operational workflows.

  • Develop and evolve APIs, data models and integrations to support new features and agent capabilities.

  • Improve scheduling, execution and failure recovery so the platform stays reliable as usage and complexity grow.

  • Write clean, performant code and understand its behavior throughout the product, from API requests and database queries to agent execution in the runtime.

  • Take features from problem definition to production, working with the team and customers to understand their impact and improve them after launch.


How We Work


We’re building a lean team where each person owns meaningful parts of the product. We agree on goals and interfaces, then give people the autonomy to deliver. We design our systems and divide work so that teammates can ship independently, with few dependencies slowing them down.


Ownership includes understanding the problem, choosing an approach, implementing it and making sure it works in production. We communicate decisions early, ask for input when it is needed and follow through.


We believe the best argument wins. Everyone’s perspective has value, and we expect people to listen carefully, challenge ideas openly and update their views when someone makes a stronger case.


We keep exploring new tools and approaches, adopting them when they help us build better software or deliver faster.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team in LATAM and assist our financial services client on an automation platform project that serves the fitness and wellness industry.


Requests from our clients and product roadmap pile up faster than we ship them — bugs, small features, well-scoped client asks. You'll own that execution stream.


You'll work day-to-day with our Product Owner, who leads design and tactical priorities. Your work comes from a dedicated board with tickets that already have designs, specs, and a clear reason behind them: either a capability that moves the product forward or a direct client request. As you learn the product and codebase, you'll take on larger projects and eventually run as a parallel stream alongside our senior engineers.

  • Identify and fix technical debt when you encounter it, even if it's outside the scope of your ticket

  • Investigate problems rigorously, separating verified facts from assumptions

  • Communicate clearly with different roles and stakeholders (engineers, product, clients)

    • Pride in customer impact — we care deeply about helping our customers run better businesses

title: Founding Senior Software Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding Senior Software Engineer based in Netherlands.

Join a fast-growing technology startup building an AI-powered platform that transforms how organizations discover, understand, and act on information from across the digital world. As a key member of a lean engineering team, you will have the opportunity to shape the technical architecture, influence core product decisions, and drive development from concept to production. You will build scalable software systems and integrate advanced AI capabilities into real-world workflows. Your work will reach hundreds of customers quickly, giving you direct visibility into product impact and user feedback. This role offers significant ownership, technical autonomy, and the opportunity to help establish engineering foundations for long-term growth. If you enjoy solving complex challenges, moving quickly, and building impactful products in an ambitious startup environment, this opportunity is for you.

Accountabilities

  • Architect, design, and develop core software systems, making key technical decisions across the technology stack while balancing immediate product needs with long-term scalability.

  • Contribute to engineering best practices, technical standards, and infrastructure decisions that support the team's continued growth.

    • Requirements:

    • Deep expertise in at least one technical area, combined with a willingness to expand your knowledge across the broader engineering stack.

    • Proficiency in one or more relevant backend technologies, such as Python, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, with an understanding of high-concurrency systems.

    • Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS or GCP, as well as containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes and modern CI/CD pipelines.

    • A strong understanding of software architecture, system reliability, performance optimization, and designing solutions that can scale with business needs.

      • Data Engineering: Experience with Spark, Kafka, Flink, BigQuery, large-scale ETL processes, or streaming data pipelines.

      • Distributed Systems: Knowledge of high-volume systems, fault tolerance, scalability, and eventual consistency.

      • AI and Machine Learning: Hands-on experience deploying LLMs, RAG pipelines, embeddings, fine-tuned models, or optimized inference systems in production.

      • Backend Engineering: Experience developing robust APIs, backend services, and high-performance applications.

      • A strong product-oriented mindset, with enthusiasm for building quickly, shipping features frequently, and incorporating user feedback into continuous improvement.

      • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional stakeholders.

      • A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving, with the confidence to take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the direction of a growing engineering organization.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in Ireland.

Join a fully remote game development environment dedicated to creating engaging, high-quality multiplayer gaming experiences with a strong artistic identity. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring game quality throughout development, working closely with engineering, design, art, and production teams. You will develop comprehensive testing strategies, investigate complex technical issues, and help deliver polished, responsive, and reliable gameplay experiences. Your expertise will be particularly valuable in testing Unreal Engine 5 systems, multiplayer functionality, and networked interactions. By identifying risks early and driving continuous quality improvements, you will directly influence the stability and overall player experience of an ambitious PvPvE multiplayer shooter. This opportunity combines technical problem-solving, creative collaboration, and meaningful ownership within a globally distributed team.

Accountabilities

  • Test Planning and Quality Assurance

    • Define and execute comprehensive test coverage across game features, systems, and builds throughout the development lifecycle.

    • Create and maintain structured test plans, test cases, and regression suites based on technical specifications and gameplay requirements.

        • Test multiplayer and networked gameplay systems, identifying issues involving replication, connectivity, latency, synchronization, matchmaking, and player interactions.

        • Validate gameplay behavior across different network conditions and multiplayer scenarios.

        • Support internal playtests, translating observations and player feedback into actionable quality improvements.

        • Help ensure multiplayer features deliver a consistent, responsive, and enjoyable experience.

        • QA Processes, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

          • Maintain accurate bug-tracking workflows, QA documentation, and testing reports using Jira or similar platforms.

          • Monitor defect trends, testing results, and quality metrics to identify recurring problems and areas requiring additional coverage.

          • Contribute to automated testing initiatives, internal QA tools, and scripts where appropriate.

            • Demonstrated experience creating, maintaining, and executing structured test plans, test cases, and regression test suites.

            • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.

            • Experience analyzing QA data, defect trends, and testing outcomes to identify recurring issues, quality gaps, and potential risks.

            • Confidence collaborating directly with technical teams and discussing issues with engineers to support effective investigation and resolution.

            • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

            • A proactive, detail-oriented mindset and a commitment to identifying quality issues early rather than relying solely on final-stage testing.

            • Genuine enthusiasm for video games and a strong understanding of what makes gameplay polished, responsive, balanced, and enjoyable.

            • Residence in Europe or a CET-compatible time zone, with sufficient overlap with Central European working hours to participate consistently in team meetings, daily collaboration, and project discussions.

              • The following experience would be an advantage:

title: Product Manager
description:

title: Uinninvalvoja
description:
Kotkan kaupungin liikuntapalveluissa on haettavana kaksi (2) uinninvalvojan vakituista työsuhdetta 1.12.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Liikuntapalveluiden kohderyhmä on laaja aina vauvaikäisistä ikääntyviin liikuntapalveluiden käyttäjiin. Vuosittainen liikuntatilojen käyttömäärä on vakiintunut noin 1,5 miljoonaan käyntikertaan. Kotkassa toimii kaksi uimahallia ja kesäaikaan maauimala. Uinninvalvoja toimii liikuntapäällikön alaisuudessa liikuntapalveluiden uinninvalvontatehtävissä.

Kelpoisuusehtona tehtävään on vähintään ammatillinen perustutkinto tai vastaava. Uinninvalvojan tulee olla 18 vuotta täyttänyt ja hänellä tulee olla suoritettuna ensiapukurssi. Tehtävään valitun on suoritettava myös hyväksytysti uinninvalvojan testiuinti. Eduksi luetaan myös kokemus uinninvalvontatehtävistä sekä suoritettu SUH:n uinninvalvojakurssi.
