title: Senior Product Designer/Product Manager
description:
Hi, I'm Willi, and I lead Product at Modash.

I'm looking for a Senior Product Designer/Product Manager to own the payments experience in our Payments/Creator team.

Background & reason for hiring

Modash helps brands scale creator partnerships on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Brands pay creators in lots of different ways: free products, one-time payments and affiliate commissions. Today those are separate flows rather than one coherent experience.

This role is about building one payment experience that handles all of them, on both sides:

  • Brand side - setting up the deal and paying for it
  • Creator side - getting paid

You own the entire workflow end to end. The role combines design and product management in one person: you decide what to build and why, and then you design how it works.

This is what you'll own:

The payments experience

Free products, one-time payments and affiliate commissions, for brands and creators alike, from setting up the deal to the creator getting paid. You work on prototypes and concepts for future iterations, design them, collect feedback and get the requirements ready for engineering.

Running development cycles

  • Prepping user stories and explaining them to the engineers
  • Doing the QA once the work is ready
  • Giving and receiving feedback in retros
  • Deciding when it's good enough to get into customers' hands - it's your product

The customer voice and the story

  • Talking with customers about their pains and needs around paying creators, gifting products and running affiliate programs
  • Keeping everyone in the company up to date on your roadmap, new releases and plans for the next sprints
  • Working closely with product marketing so your product stands out and customers understand what's new
  • Tracking your impact using customer feedback and north star metrics

Your first months in Modash will bring

  • Onboarding with the product and Creator teams on how brands and creators use Modash today
  • Customer calls with brands and creators, plus time in Fullstory and Amplitude to see where the payment flows break down
  • Joining sprint planning with the engineering team and getting to know the backlog

Team structure

You'll report to me (Head of Product) and work closely with a dedicated engineering team lead Besnik. You'll also join a group of talented designer/PMs Renata, Maksym & Heidi who own other parts of our B2B SaaS product, and you'll work with them on product ideas, the shared design system and synced roadmaps.

Requirements

Required skills and experience

  • Experience as both a product designer & product manager or in a hybrid PM/design role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
  • You've written great user stories and communicated your designs clearly to developers
  • You've prioritized work with a bigger goal in mind and built a roadmap yourself. You can explain why some things came first and others didn't make the cut.
  • You've worked with a design system to keep the experience coherent
  • Extreme attention to detail. You notice the wrong spacing, the unclear label and the missing edge case, and you don't ship sloppy work.
  • Get-it-done attitude. We all run into roadblocks every day. We're looking for someone who finds solutions, motivates themselves and keeps getting things done.
  • You're used to, and actually enjoy, a fast pace and constant change in a growing company
  • You aspire to be great. We're not shooting for mediocrity here.
  • Interest in the creator economy. Our mission is to help creators get paid. You don't need to live and breathe the creator world, but we'd like your values to align with ours.
  • You're fluent in English. Our team is spread across many countries, and we work together in English every day.

Nice to haves:

  • UX work on affiliate, marketplace or payments products
  • Strong instincts in research or analytics (you don't need to be an expert in both)
  • Experience with our tools: Figma, Linear, Notion, Amplitude and Fullstory

If you meet most but not all of these, don't let that stop you from applying. We're not looking for a finished product, and we'd be happy to grow with you.

Benefits

What we're offering

  • Fully remote working in Europe 🏠 As long as you have a reliable internet connection, work wherever is best for you. At home, in a café, on a beach. Whatever works.
  • Compensation. Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 65,000€ - 85,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.
  • Flexible working hours ⏱ We trust you to do your job without anyone looking over your shoulder. Do your best work whenever it suits you.
  • Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you're happy and well rested, you'll do better work. Take the time you need to enjoy a balanced life.
  • Personal development 🧠 When you grow, we benefit. If there's a course, book or conference that will help you upskill, we'll cover it.
  • Ownership 💡 You're the expert at what you do, so you should have the freedom to make decisions and act quickly. No unnecessary red tape. Got an out-of-the-box idea? You'll have the autonomy to try things you might not be able to at other companies.
  • Regular team offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

title: Senior Tax Analyst
description:

In this hands-on role, you will support the development of a scalable, well-controlled tax compliance function covering multiple jurisdictions across North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region. You will take ownership of recurring indirect tax compliance, including sales and use tax, GST/HST, and VAT, while helping bring key processes in-house. Working closely with Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Legal, People/Payroll, Operations, and external tax advisors, you will ensure accurate filings, timely payments, and reliable financial records. You will also investigate tax discrepancies, maintain compliance documentation, and support audits, notices, and new jurisdiction registrations. This is an opportunity for a detail-oriented tax professional to strengthen internal controls, improve tax processes through technology, and contribute to a growing international finance function.

Accountabilities

  • Manage recurring indirect tax compliance across U.S. sales and use tax, Canadian GST/HST, EU VAT/OSS, Australian GST, New Zealand GST, and additional jurisdictions as the business expands.

  • Support the transition of recurring indirect tax compliance from external providers to the internal tax team, beginning with the January 2027 compliance cycle.

  • Prepare monthly and quarterly tax returns, supporting workpapers, and related documentation, ensuring all filings and payments are accurate and completed on time.

  • Extract, validate, and reconcile tax data from NetSuite, Avalara, payment processors, and other systems, investigating discrepancies between taxes collected, reported, paid, and recorded in the general ledger.

  • Coordinate with tax technology providers and external advisors on filings, data requests, tax notices, registrations, taxability questions, and outstanding compliance matters.

  • Assist with state, federal, and international tax notices, audits, and information requests, ensuring correspondence and resolutions are properly documented.

  • Support federal, state, and international direct tax compliance by gathering data, preparing workpapers, and coordinating returns, extensions, estimated payments, and tax provision activities with external advisors.

  • Work with People and Payroll teams on state tax registrations, payroll tax notices, withholding compliance, and related filings as needed.

  • Research taxability, nexus requirements, filing obligations, and new jurisdiction requirements, supporting registrations and the implementation of new compliance processes.

  • Identify opportunities to improve tax processes, documentation, internal controls, and automation through effective use of Avalara, NetSuite, and other tax technology.

    • Experience with U.S. sales and use tax and/or international VAT/GST compliance is strongly preferred.

    • Experience with Avalara and NetSuite, particularly tax data extraction, reconciliation, and compliance workflows, is strongly preferred.

    • Experience supporting corporate income tax compliance and coordinating with external tax advisors is an advantage.

    • CPA, Enrolled Agent (EA), Master of Science in Taxation (MST), or a comparable tax or accounting credential is preferred but not required.

    • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail and accountability for deliverables.

    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across finance and operational teams as well as with external advisors.

    • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing deadlines, document procedures, and contribute to building scalable compliance processes.

Hours: 37.5

Job Description:

Department Overview

About TD Securities – Global FICC (Fixed Income, Currency, Commodities) Technology

TD Securities is a leading North American investment bank and financial services provider that offers advisory and capital market services to corporate, government, and institutional clients worldwide. We offer a range of services across corporate and investment banking, capital markets, global transaction services, research & strategy and ESG Solutions.

The Global FICC Technology group aims to drive business growth for our partners in the Front-Office, Operations and beyond. We do this with a mandate of delivering innovative new products, expanding our trading tool capabilities and modernizing critical platforms.

About the Team

Atomic Innovation (FICC Technology) is an exciting, innovative and growing team with the mission of transforming the app landscape across TD Securities. We do this by designing and developing next-gen platforms that produce a tangible impact to all business areas that depend on them. We’re a specialized team of builders with a focus on delivering innovative full-stack solutions, but with a deep-rooted passion of crafting beautiful UIs.

As part of the Atomic team, you will build and own a diverse range of products that power our business, spanning multiple business lines. This includes working with our industry-leading Desktop Interop platform or helping to scale our Metals, Energy or FX Trade Automation streams.

We also strive to create a fun, but professional and inclusive work culture here in the Atomic team. In the last year, we have coordinated numerous team socials with activities like bowling, boat cruises, park hangouts and gaming at the local arcade.

Senior Back-End Developer

Atomic – App Innovation & Design

Atomic is building the next generation of trade and workflow automation products for TD Securities’ Fixed Income, Foreign Exchange and Commodities businesses. We are looking for a Technical Product Designer who can turn complex, high-value workflows into simple, intuitive products used by front-office and operations teams.

About Atomic

Atomic Innovation is transforming the application landscape across TD Securities.

We are a multidisciplinary team of product designers, engineers, and technology professionals building modern products for some of the bank’s most sophisticated business areas. Our portfolio spans Metals, Energy, Foreign Exchange, FX Options, Fixed Income, and Operations, along with the shared FICC Unified Desktop platform that brings these experiences together.

We work directly with Front-Office Sales & Trading users, Operations teams, and subject-matter experts to understand complex workflows and turn them into products that are simpler, faster, and more intuitive. We value thoughtful product decisions, strong engineering, polished user experiences, and practical solutions that create meaningful value for our users.

The Opportunity

Atomic is looking for a Senior Back-End Developer to join the team building Atomic FX. Although the role carries a senior title, it is primarily a hands-on individual-contributor position focused on one product rather than technical leadership across the broaderAtomicportfolio.

You will work on Atomic FX alongside more senior developers, front-end engineers, product partners, and Foreign Exchange business users. You will learn the workflows behind the product, contribute to technical discussions, build and support back-end services, and help improve the application as user needsevolve.

You do not need to begin the role as capitalmarketsexpert or arrive ready to define the architecture independently. You should be curious about Foreign Exchange workflows, comfortable asking questions, receptive to guidance and feedback, and interested in developing your skills within an experienced engineering team.

What You’ll Do

Role & Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of robust, scalable backend services and APIs using Java (versions 17, and 21) with Spring Boot, supporting critical platforms such as Atomic FX.
  • Architect and implement high-performance, secure, and maintainable server-side solutions, integrating with relational databases (MS SQL Server 2012) and ensuring seamless connectivity with front-end applications.
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders in the Foreign Exchange domain within Capital Markets to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
  • Design and implement solutions for both on-premises and Azure cloud environments, leveraging best practices for hybrid infrastructure.
  • Mentor and guide junior and intermediate developers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, code quality, and adherence to best practices in Java development.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues, driving root cause analysis and implement long-term solutions to enhance system stability and reliability.
  • Champion the adoption of modern DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines (TeamCity, Maven, GitHub), automated testing frameworks, and deployment strategies to improve development efficiency and code quality.
  • Ensure backend components are designed for extensibility, security, and compliance with enterprise standards, while adhering to industry best practices.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the backend architecture, evaluating and integrating new technologies to keep the platform at the forefront of industry trends.
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions to ensure high-quality deliverables.
  • Stay updated on emerging technologies and frameworks in the Java ecosystem, providing recommendations for continuous improvement and innovation.

Our Technology Stack

  • Backend: Java (versions 17/21), Spring Boot, Go, WebSocket, Rest API, Linux
  • Testing: Vitest, Jest, Junit, Mockito, AssertJ, JaCoCo, Sonarqube
  • Database: PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server
  • Message Queues: Solace
  • CI/CD: Teamcity, Maven, Azure, Github, Google Cloud Platform

Additional technology stack for reference, but not required for this role:

  • Frontend (For Reference): React, Typescript, React Router, React Query, Zustand, AgGrid, React Hook Form
  • Build Tools: Vite, Rollup
  • Client-side Interop: Glue42 (interop.io)
  • Styling: CSS & SCSS modules
  • Design : Figma

Who You Are

You are an experienced back-end developer with strong Java fundamentals and a practical approach to software engineering. You can take a well-defined problem, work through the technical details, and deliver reliable code while knowing when to ask for context or support.

You enjoy working as part of a collaborative product team. You are comfortable engaging directly with business users, learning an unfamiliar domain, and working with more senior developers who can provide architectural direction and product context.

You care about code quality, testing, and maintainability, but you do not make solutions more complicated than they need to be. You communicate clearly, respond well to feedback, and take responsibility for the work you deliver.

Most importantly, you are curious and dependable. You want to understand the workflow behind the code, contribute meaningfully to Atomic, and continue developing your engineering judgment through hands-on experience.

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial hands-on work with Java, Spring Boot, and SQL databases.
  • Experience building andmaintainingproductionREST APIs and back-end services.
  • Strong understanding of service design, data modelling, concurrency, performance, error handling, testing, and secure development practices.
  • Experience with asynchronous or event-driven workflows, messaging or queues, or real-time communication patterns such asWebSocket.
  • Experience supporting production systems, diagnosing issues, and contributing to durable fixes.
  • Experience with automated testing, code review, source control, build tooling, and continuous integration and delivery practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within established architecture and collaborate with developers ofdifferent experiencelevels.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to discuss technical decisions with engineering and business partners.
  • A degree, diploma, or equivalent practical experience in computer science, engineering, technology, ora relateddiscipline.

title: RCM Associate (Charge Posting)
description:
About Amperos

Amperos is healthcare's first AI-native denial management and revenue recovery platform. Our agentic AI works claims end-to-end, from portal follow-ups and payor calls to appeals and medical records, so providers can resolve more denials, recover more revenue, and focus on what matters most: serving patients.

We just closed a $16M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with continued participation from Uncork Capital and Neo. We're still small, still early, and going after a $260B+ problem that's only getting worse. If you want to work on hard problems that matter, alongside people who care deeply about the mission (and each other), we'd love to meet you.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Charge Posting or Payment Posting Specialist with 2+ years of experience in RCM to join our team. You'll work at the intersection of traditional claim submission or payment posting workflows and cutting-edge AI, helping our customers submit claims accurately and efficiently while ensuring our automation systems perform at the highest standard.

You'll be responsible for entering charges, verifying claim accuracy, managing charge submissions to insurance companies, and tracking claims through posting and adjudication. As our product and customer base evolve, your responsibilities may shift to align with near-term priorities—this is a role with meaningful ownership and room to grow.

What you'll do

Charge Posting:

  • Post and manage charges accurately

  • Enter charges and claims into customer PM systems and Amperos platforms using clinical documentation

  • Verify coding accuracy, modifiers, and medical necessity before claim submission

  • Research bundling rules, frequency limitations, and other clinical editing logic to prevent denials

  • Identify and escalate claim errors (incorrect coding, unbundled charges, missing documentation) before submission

  • Track charge submission status and manage claim resubmissions when needed

  • Maintain organized documentation of all charge-related activity

Payment Posting:

  • Post payments, adjustments, and denials from ERAs, EOBs, and lockbox files into customer PM systems and Amperos platforms

  • Balance daily batches, reconcile to bank deposits, and resolve missing or mismatched ERAs

  • Flag underpayments and denials

  • Resolve unapplied cash, credit balances, refunds, and recoupments, and transfer balances

What we're looking for

  • At least 2 years of experience in medical billing, charge entry, or coding verification

  • Strong working knowledge of medical coding

  • Experience with leading PM systems, including eCW, ModMed, Athenahealth, and more

  • Solid understanding of insurance claim submission requirements and pre-authorization processes

  • Ability to identify coding errors and clinical editing issues before claim submission

  • Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable in documentation and follow-through

  • Ability to work US hours (9am–6pm ET) to collaborate with our team and customers

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes and priorities can change

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with eligibility for a bonus on anniversary date

  • Paid sick days and vacation days

  • Meal stipends

  • Opportunity to grow with a rapidly scaling company and be an early member of a global billing team, as we expand our billing team in India

Our Values

  • Lead with Empathy - Great products and teams are built on empathy—whether for our customers, users, or team members. We take the time to walk in others' shoes, listen actively, and truly understand their challenges, needs, and perspectives.

  • Humbly Ambitious - We combine humility with ambition. No task is beneath us, and no challenge too big. Greatness comes from being willing to do whatever it takes, while having the courage to take bold risks and learn from failures.

  • Radical Agency - Own your domain. Drive initiatives with autonomy and accountability. Think deeply, communicate with the team, and maintain a bias for action.

title: Test Coordinator / Business Analyst
description:
Overview

Alchemy Partners is an Australian-owned and led boutique consulting firm that partners with clients to improve business performance through better collaboration. We work with our clients to design and deliver solutions to complex challenges, helping them achieve their transformation goals and drive sustainable results.

We are seeking an experienced Test Coordinator / Business Analyst to support a nationally significant Federal Government technology program involving multiple jurisdictions and stakeholders.

This is a hands-on delivery role suited to a pragmatic, organised and collaborative professional who can quickly get up to speed in an established project environment, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities and support the transition towards national implementation.

The successful candidate will bring strong business analysis and coordination skills, sound technical aptitude and the ability to work calmly and effectively across business and technical teams.

About the Role

Working within the Technical Delivery workstream, you will play an important role in coordinating testing activities, supporting business users and ensuring issues, actions and decisions are captured, communicated and progressed effectively.

You will join a well-established project approaching a critical delivery phase. We are looking for someone who is comfortable picking up work already in progress, understanding agreed requirements and decisions, and focusing on what needs to happen next rather than revisiting work that has already been completed.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, technical delivery teams and representatives from States and Territories to support UAT, manage information and help maintain delivery momentum.

As the program progresses, the role is expected to evolve towards implementation coordination and supporting national rollout activities.

Key Responsibilities Include:

  • Coordinating UAT activities, including planning, scheduling, participant engagement, issue management and follow-up.

  • Providing hands-on support to business users and project teams during testing, ensuring activities run smoothly and issues are promptly addressed.

  • Capturing and documenting testing outcomes, observations, defects, actions and decisions, and coordinating their resolution through established project processes.

  • Working with technical teams to understand testing progress, dependencies and issues, translating technical discussions into clear, actionable information for business stakeholders.

  • Supporting the preparation of UAT materials, testing schedules, progress updates and reporting.

  • Maintaining clear documentation and traceability between agreed business requirements, testing activities and outcomes.

  • Engaging collaboratively with other project workstreams, business representatives and jurisdictional stakeholders to coordinate activities and resolve dependencies.

  • Identifying and escalating delivery risks, issues and emerging concerns in a timely and constructive manner.

  • Supporting business readiness, implementation planning and coordination of activities associated with the broader national rollout.

This is primarily a coordination and business analysis role, rather than a technical testing position. You will not be expected to develop testing tools or personally execute technical test scripts. Your focus will be on supporting those undertaking testing and ensuring activities, information and issues are effectively coordinated.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a capable and dependable professional who combines strong analytical skills with a practical, delivery-focused mindset.

You will be comfortable working in a complex environment with highly experienced stakeholders, bringing structure, clarity and a calm approach to the work.

You Will Bring:

  • Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Test Coordinator or UAT Coordinator.

  • Experience coordinating UAT or business acceptance testing activities, including managing issues, actions, dependencies and stakeholder communications.

  • Strong business analysis skills, including the ability to interpret requirements, understand business processes and document outcomes clearly.

  • Good technical aptitude and confidence participating in discussions with technology teams, without needing to be a technical specialist.

  • Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple activities and competing priorities.

  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the confidence to work across business teams, technical teams, project workstreams and external stakeholders.

  • A calm, measured and collaborative approach, particularly when working with diverse stakeholders and competing perspectives.

  • Sound judgement and critical thinking, balanced with the pragmatism to work within established project decisions, processes and delivery timeframes.

  • The ability to quickly understand an unfamiliar project environment, work independently and maintain momentum with minimal direction.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly in translating complex discussions into clear actions and practical outcomes.

Highly Desirable Experience:

  • Working on large-scale Commonwealth Government technology or business transformation programs.

  • Supporting national implementations or rollouts involving States and Territories as delivery or implementation partners.

  • Coordinating activities across government agencies, jurisdictions, external service providers or other complex stakeholder networks.

  • Experience in Health, Education, Social Services, regulatory environments or other nationally coordinated government programs.

Why Join Alchemy Partners?

We offer:

  • The opportunity to contribute to a nationally significant government program with meaningful outcomes.

At Marketplacer, we value engineers who thoughtfully leverage tools like Copilot or LLM assistants to streamline workflows, experiment faster, and focus on solving complex business problems. We view AI tools as an asset to core software engineering, not a replacement for fundamental design, architecture, and problem-solving skills.

What you'll own

  • Solution Design: Design, implement, and maintain high-performance, scalable, and secure software for our cloud-native SaaS platform.

  • Code Quality: Drive quality through rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration.

  • Continuous Improvement: Champion new ideas and software engineering best practices, including the practical use of developer tools and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Cross-functional Delivery: Partner closely with Product and UX/UI to ship high-quality features.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years' experience with object-oriented programming (e.g., Ruby, Python, Java, C#, or similar) and web application frameworks (such as Ruby on Rails). Strong general engineering foundations and adaptability are key.
  • Hands-on experience incorporating AI coding tools or LLM APIs into daily workflows or features, with a balanced approach to code quality, testing, and security.
  • Comfort with automated testing, CI/CD, and continuous integration practices.
  • Solid SQL skills and experience with relational and non-relational databases.
  • Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS) and data services.
  • A track record of building cloud-native solutions and solving real scaling problems.
  • Experience designing and validating architectures.
  • Strong communication skills, spoken and written.

How you'll show up

  • Open, friendly, and collaborative. You are quick to ask for help and just as quick to offer it.

  • A strong product mindset and a drive to solve real-world problems.
  • Proactive about building cloud-native solutions and tackling scaling challenges.
  • Committed to DevSecOps practices.
  • A sharp analytical thinker who enjoys complex problems.
  • Thoughtful Pragmatist. You are someone who adopts helpful technology to increase leverage without compromising architectural integrity, security, or engineering standards.

Why Marketplacer

At Marketplacer, you’ll be part of a dynamic team driving innovation in the e-commerce and marketplace space. We value collaboration, customer-centricity, and continuous learning. This is your opportunity to shape the success of our platform and grow your career in a supportive and global environment.

We view software engineering as a craft that continually evolves with better tools. You'll have real autonomy over technical design and implementation, the opportunity to shape our engineering practices, and a direct impact on building scalable, high-quality software for our platform.

In addition, you’ll have access to:

Marketplacer is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and experience levels that align with the above.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Salary: $7,000 – $10,000 per month

About Rida

Rida builds technology that powers real-world field and delivery operations for healthcare, retail and enterprise customers.

We are developing AIDA, our AI operations layer, to manage customer and operational conversations, coordinate workflows, handle exceptions and initiate work across field-service and delivery networks.

AIDA and Rida’s existing technology platform work together: AIDA provides the intelligence and workflow layer, while Rida’s production applications and services execute, track and manage the underlying operations.

The role

We are looking for a senior, hands-on full-stack engineer to build AI-powered field and delivery services across AIDA and Rida’s wider technology platform.

You will build new AIDA products while also extending the production systems, APIs and operational applications that allow AI-generated decisions and workflows to be executed reliably.

You should be equally comfortable building new products and working with established production systems.

What you will build

  • AI-powered tools for managing customer and operational conversations.

  • Field-service workflows covering job intake, scheduling, assignment, vendor coordination, status tracking, proof of work and exception handling.

  • Delivery workflows covering order management, driver and operations applications, tracking, proof of delivery and service recovery.

  • Human-in-the-loop controls for reviewing and approving AI-recommended actions.

  • Operational dashboards and control towers for customers and internal teams.

  • Integrations between AIDA, Rida’s applications and customers’ enterprise systems.

  • Reusable workflow and application components that can support different customers and industries.

What you will do

  • Develop and maintain frontend applications using JavaScript and Vue.js.

  • Build and improve backend services, REST APIs, GraphQL APIs and webhooks.

  • Design reliable application workflows and PostgreSQL data models.

  • Integrate with messaging platforms, customer systems and third-party services.

  • Work on production applications deployed on AWS.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex issues across frontend, backend, database and infrastructure layers.

  • Improve application architecture, automated testing, observability and deployment reliability.

  • Apply secure development practices across authentication, permissions, secrets, APIs and sensitive customer data.

  • Work closely with product, operations and commercial teams to translate real operational requirements into scalable software.

  • Participate in architecture decisions, code reviews, incident response and technical planning.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering speed and quality.

What we are looking for

  • At least five years of professional full-stack software-engineering experience.

  • Strong JavaScript and preferably TypeScript experience.

  • Strong practical experience with Vue.js and Node.js.

  • Experience designing and maintaining REST and GraphQL APIs.

  • Strong PostgreSQL and data-modelling knowledge.

  • Experience operating and troubleshooting production systems on AWS.

  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, logging, monitoring and production incident resolution.

  • Good understanding of application and cloud security, including authentication, access control, secrets management, encryption and protection of sensitive data.

  • Ability to understand complex existing systems while building new products on top of them.

  • Strong ownership, technical judgment and written communication.

Particularly valuable experience

  • AI agents, LLM applications or workflow automation.

  • WhatsApp, messaging or conversational products.

  • Field-service management, logistics or delivery platforms.

  • B2B SaaS and enterprise system integrations.

  • High-volume transactional or operational systems.

  • Event-driven architecture and asynchronous processing.

  • SOC 2 or other security-governed environments.

Direct AI experience is helpful but not essential. Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals and production ownership are more important.

What success looks like

Within your first six months, you will have:

  • Shipped AI-powered field or delivery capabilities used in live operations.

  • Built reliable integrations between AIDA, Rida and external systems.

  • Taken independent ownership of important application services.

  • Improved the reliability, security and maintainability of production systems.

  • Helped establish reusable engineering patterns as AIDA expands into new use cases.

Why join Rida

  • Build AI products that coordinate real-world services and operations.

  • Work on live enterprise use cases rather than experimental demonstrations.

  • Develop both the AI workflow layer and the systems that execute its decisions.

  • Take meaningful product and technical ownership.

  • Work closely with decision-makers, customers and operational users.

  • See the direct impact of what you build.

Our Platform Engineering team builds and operates backend services that power intelligent workflows and developer-facing capabilities, enabling product teams across eBay to move faster while maintaining high quality and performance. As a Senior Software Engineer – Backend, you will architect and develop core platform services, solving complex technical problems and shaping scalable solutions for critical platform features. What you will accomplish:

  • Design, build, and evolve scalable backend services and APIs that power intelligent workflows and developer-facing capabilities, directly improving developer productivity and delivery speed.
  • Drive system architecture and technical decisions with a focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability, simplifying systems and reducing technical complexity where possible.
  • Own end-to-end delivery of features and services from design through production, upholding high standards for code quality, testing, and operational readiness.
  • Improve system performance, scalability, and efficiency by proactively identifying bottlenecks, strengthening observability, and effectively troubleshooting production issues.
  • Collaborate closely with product, data, and partner engineering teams to deliver impactful solutions, clearly communicating technical trade-offs, risks, and progress.
  • Mentor and support junior engineers, sharing knowledge, reinforcing engineering guidelines, and continuously adopting new technologies and approaches to raise the bar for the team.

What you will bring:

title: Founding Senior Software Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding Senior Software Engineer based in France.

Join a fast-growing technology startup building an AI-powered platform that transforms how organizations discover, understand, and act on information from across the digital world. As a key member of a lean engineering team, you will have the opportunity to shape the technical architecture, influence core product decisions, and drive development from concept to production. You will build scalable software systems and integrate advanced AI capabilities into real-world workflows. Your work will reach hundreds of customers quickly, giving you direct visibility into product impact and user feedback. This role offers significant ownership, technical autonomy, and the opportunity to help establish engineering foundations for long-term growth. If you enjoy solving complex challenges, moving quickly, and building impactful products in an ambitious startup environment, this opportunity is for you.

Accountabilities

  • Architect, design, and develop core software systems, making key technical decisions across the technology stack while balancing immediate product needs with long-term scalability.

  • Own feature development end-to-end, from technical design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Integrate AI and machine learning capabilities into production workflows, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, embeddings, prompt execution, agentic systems, and fine-tuned models.

  • Build scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems capable of supporting significant business growth while making pragmatic infrastructure and architecture decisions.

  • Develop high-performance APIs, backend services, and internal interfaces that power the product, ensuring reliability, security, and a seamless customer experience.

  • Design and improve data processing systems, distributed architectures, and real-time pipelines to efficiently ingest, process, and analyze large volumes of information across text, audio, and video.

  • Collaborate closely with the engineering team and other stakeholders to translate product requirements into effective technical solutions.

  • Deliver features rapidly, gather user feedback, and iterate continuously to improve product functionality and performance.

  • Contribute to engineering best practices, technical standards, and infrastructure decisions that support the team's continued growth.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 3 years of experience building, deploying, and scaling production-grade software systems, with strong foundations in backend engineering, services, data modeling, and distributed systems.

    • Deep expertise in at least one technical area, combined with a willingness to expand your knowledge across the broader engineering stack.

    • Proficiency in one or more relevant backend technologies, such as Python, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, with an understanding of high-concurrency systems.

    • Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS or GCP, as well as containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes and modern CI/CD pipelines.

    • A strong understanding of software architecture, system reliability, performance optimization, and designing solutions that can scale with business needs.

    • Expertise in one or more of the following areas:

      • Data Engineering: Experience with Spark, Kafka, Flink, BigQuery, large-scale ETL processes, or streaming data pipelines.

      • Distributed Systems: Knowledge of high-volume systems, fault tolerance, scalability, and eventual consistency.

      • AI and Machine Learning: Hands-on experience deploying LLMs, RAG pipelines, embeddings, fine-tuned models, or optimized inference systems in production.

      • Backend Engineering: Experience developing robust APIs, backend services, and high-performance applications.

      • A strong product-oriented mindset, with enthusiasm for building quickly, shipping features frequently, and incorporating user feedback into continuous improvement.

      • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional stakeholders.

      • A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving, with the confidence to take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the direction of a growing engineering organization.

        • Benefits:

        • Meaningful ownership: Play a foundational role in shaping the product, engineering architecture, and technical direction of a growing startup.

        • High-impact work: Deliver new features and capabilities directly to a growing customer base, with a clear connection between your work and business outcomes.

        • Technical autonomy: Influence decisions across the technology stack and choose practical solutions that balance innovation, performance, and scalability.

        • AI-driven innovation: Work hands-on with modern AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, and agentic systems, to solve real-world problems.

        • Strong engineering environment: Collaborate with an experienced, ambitious engineering team with backgrounds at leading technology companies.

        • Fast development cycles: Build, ship, and iterate rapidly, with opportunities to see your work reach customers without unnecessary bureaucracy.

        • Startup growth opportunity: Help establish the technical foundations of an expanding business and grow alongside the product and engineering organization.

        • Remote work: The role is advertised for Romania, offering the opportunity to contribute in a remote-first working environment.

title: Senior HRIS Business Analyst (Req #1320)
description:

The Senior HRIS Business Analyst partners with HR, Payroll, Talent, Recruitment, IT, and business leaders to improve processes, optimize technology solutions, and support strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for analyzing business needs, managing system enhancements, supporting HR technology platforms, and delivering projects that improve efficiency, automation, reporting, and the employee experience.

  • SDLC Project Management – Have knowledge of the software development process from requirements through delivery to production. Work with implementation team to deliver to customer expectations. Thoroughly document and communicate all project risks to project team.
  • Software Analysis – Define requirements and evaluate existing functionality details to understand current system and future needs. Recognize and recommend to the business areas where efficiencies can be gained by altering the process or automating the process.

  • Change Management – Ensure project compliance to ePlus Change Management process. Coordinate the resolution of software defects as part of the QA and Change Management process. Review and plan upcoming releases, communicate to the business.
  • Communication – Ensure all stakeholders are communicated with in a timely and consistent manner. Elicit requirements from the business to use to produce the scope and requirements.
  • Process Improvement - Evaluate and improve HR processes through automation, standardization, and system enhancements.
  • Partnership - Partner with stakeholders to gather, document, and analyze business requirements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent experience.

  • Deep understanding of user experiences principles and a strong ability to translate customer needs into technical requirements and process enhancements.
  • Skilled in identifying potential project and operational risks, evaluating their impact, and proactively recommending mitigation strategies.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience driving process improvement using established methodologies (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, Agile).
  • Experience with Workforce Management (WFM) systems, including scheduling, timekeeping, and labor optimization (preferably UKG Workforce Management).

As a BoxLunch Seasonal Key Holder, you’ll be a huge part of our success by supporting the store leadership team in providing the best customer experience, ensuring that fellow fans are able to get their hands on the merch they love. You’ll use your fandom knowledge to help train new recruits and ensure their success, while also supporting your Store Manager in daily operations and meeting sales targets.

Pay range starting at $10.85/hr - $12.55/hr.
Please note the pay range for this position starts as listed in the job posting, but other factors such as an individual’s education, location, meeting the minimum job requirements for the role, training and experience, will determine the final salary for potential new hires.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Provide an amazing shopping experience that will encourage customers to return. They’ll be impressed by your product knowledge, customer experience skills and use of the Force
  • Step in and step up when needed. You’ll provide leadership support and help run the store when your Manager gets pulled away
  • Understand store sales plan and comp sales goals, and help drive sales by increasing key KPIs: UPT and ADT
  • Cover the sales floor zone and ensure that assigned areas are up to visual standards. You’ll also help in the opening and closing of the store
  • Work the register; you’ll process sales transactions and use your fandom knowledge to drive add on sales. We’ll need you to also be able to close out the register and communicate and shortages or overages to your Store Manager
  • Assist with planogram changes including store map, wall, fixture, & merchandising mix
  • Let your voice be heard! You’ll communicate fashion & music trend information to management and respective HQ partners
  • While we welcome wizards, we don’t like it when spells are stolen. You’ll work with Store Management to ensure there’s no misuse of spells and wizardry around theft.
  • Support the maintenance of the mother ship; you’ll help keep the stock room organized and the store tidy.
  • Train and coach new Sales Associates as needed to help them quickly get acclimated to the team
  • Any other activities as assigned by your Store Leader

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Previous experience working in a retail environment. If you’re passionate about philanthropy & all things pop culture, you're in the right place!
  • You'll have to be at least 18 years of age to join the fandom force
  • A high school Diploma or GED equivalent
  • Avenger like collaboration and communication skills, as well as Captain America-like leadership
  • The usual retail stuff: able to stand and walk around during scheduled hours, reaching for merch using ladder, step stool and poles. You’ll also have to be able to move around boxes of awesome merchandise that may weigh up to 50 pounds

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
All Gravy is the AI-native people operating platform for hospitality and retail.

We're modernising how frontline teams work, replacing scattered tools and outdated systems with a single app that's actually built for the way people work & socialise today. Our AI Colleague gives staff instant answers & executes day-to-day tasks, freeing up managers to focus on people & customers instead of paperwork. We work with some of the most exciting brands in hospitality and retail, including Gail's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, Pizza Pilgrims, Ottolenghi, Q8 and 7-Eleven. Today over 2,000 restaurants and stores trust us to run their teams.

We've grown 10x in two years and are accelerating into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to create better work lives for the 80% of the world that do not sit behind a desk.

About the role

We are looking for an ambitious Staff Software Engineer who will be a pivotal member of building and scaling the most critical parts of our product. This is a role for someone who has already made AI a core part of how they work. The kind of person who spots the problem worth solving and doesn't wait for permission to go after it. You're a builder who loves the pace of a startup or scale-up, where things move fast and ownership is real. As a Staff Engineer here, you won't just be maintaining a critical system, you'll be shaping how AI transforms what it can do.

What You Will Do

The ideal candidate possesses a versatile skill set, demonstrating capability across the entire spectrum of software development at All Gravy.

  • AI-Native Development: A versatile understanding of how to leverage AI in your day-to-day development workflow. The best candidates are top-tier at working with AI tools, can demonstrate concrete ways they've integrated them into how they ship code, and actively contribute back to how the wider team adopts and improves its AI-assisted ways of working.

  • Full-Stack Development: You will take ownership of features across the full application stack from the manager and employee-facing interfaces where schedules are built and shifts are picked up, to the robust, scalable back-end services and data layers that power them.

  • Hands-On Technical Approach: Comfortable reading and writing code (ideally TypeScript/Node.js, given our stack), reviewing architecture, and working directly with infrastructure. You can ship a fix, not just file a ticket.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with our product teams to ensure everything integrates harmoniously across the All Gravy ecosystem, and contribute to shared standards and architectural decisions.

We have a full-fledged TypeScript-based tech stack in All Gravy which means our current developer team seamlessly switches between development tasks.

All Gravy is undergoing high growth hence the job and responsibilities will develop over time, and there will be plenty of opportunities for you to learn and grow.

You'll thrive here if you

We're looking for people with great energy, a good sense of humour, and a drive for getting things over the line. You think elegantly but act pragmatically, love being part of a team, and never stop learning

  • Genuinely AI-native. You can walk us through exactly how you use AI tools today, which ones, in what situations, and what's changed about how you build. This is a core part of the role, not a checkbox.

  • 7+ years of proven full-stack experience across React, React Native, TypeScript, and Node.js.

  • Ability to design and architect highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable distributed systems.

  • Startup or scale-up background. You know what it means to move fast, make pragmatic calls, and revisit them when the time is right.

  • Fluent English, spoken and written.

  • Based within European time zones, whether from our Copenhagen or London office or remotely.

An advantage if you have experience in:

  • NestJS

  • MongoDB

Why All Gravy

  • Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.

  • AI at the center, not the side. We're not sprinkling AI on top, it's woven into everything we build. You'll use it, push it, and help define what it means for the future of work.

  • Top equipment. You'll receive all new equipment to do your best work

  • A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.

  • Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.

  • You'll work with people who've built, scaled, and won. Ex-founders, operators, all here because they want to do it again, bigger.

  • The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. We work hard and celebrate harder.

Even if you do not tick every box on this page, you might be the perfect fit for the job! We treasure our learning culture and encourage all humble people to apply.

title: Teknisk projektleder til Ejendomsdrift
description:
Ejendomsdrift søger en ny kollega til området Administration, Sikring og Teknik. Bliv en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor der er fokus på udvikling og på at skabe fremtidens tekniske og datadrevne ejendomsdrift.

Jobbet

Som Teknisk Projektleder får du en central rolle i udviklingen, optimeringen og driften af bankens bygninger og tekniske installationer. Du får ansvar for at lede tekniske projekter på tværs af områder som el, ventilation, varme, VVS, CTS/BMS og øvrige bygningsinstallationer. Du er med fra de første idéer og behovsafklaringer til implementering og endelig aflevering, - og du vil have ansvar for at sikre, at projekterne bliver gennemført med fokus på kvalitet, økonomi og tidsplan.

Du arbejder med at skabe stabile, robuste og energieffektive løsninger, der understøtter både en sikker drift og bankens bæredygtighedsambitioner. Samtidig bidrager du til energioptimering, reduktion af bygningernes klimaaftryk og udviklingen af intelligente, datadrevne løsninger inden for bygningsdrift.

I rollen får du et tæt samarbejde med eksterne rådgivere, entreprenører og serviceleverandører, som du koordinerer og følger op på gennem hele projektforløbet. Du har fokus på risikostyring og bidrager direkte til risikovurderinger, beredskabsarbejde samt efterlevelse af myndighedskrav og interne standarder.

Derudover bliver du en vigtig sparringspartner for kolleger og interne interessenter i tekniske og bygningsrelaterede spørgsmål. Du deltager i Smart Building-initiativer med fokus på IoT, sensorer, bygningsautomatik og digitale platforme, og du sikrer en tydelig rapportering af projektstatus, økonomi, risici og beslutningsbehov til relevante interessenter.

Teamet

Som vores nye tekniske projektleder bliver du en del af teamet ”Administration, Sikring og Teknik”, der organisatorisk er tilknyttet Ejendomsdrift. Du vil komme til at arbejde tæt sammen med fagligt kompetente specialister, projektledere, og tekniske servicemedarbejdere.

Vi er kendetegnet ved stort engagement, nysgerrighed og en uformel omgangstone. Vi har et mål om at være blandt de bedste inden for vores område og arbejder målrettet med digitalisering, procesoptimering, standardisering og datadrevet bygningsdrift.

Vi tager ejerskab for vores ansvarsområder og arbejder for at sikre en professionel, bæredygtig og effektiv drift af Jyske Banks ejendomme. Ejendomsdrift har arbejdssteder på Hjemstedet i Silkeborg og i Glaskuben i København.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant teknisk uddannelse som f.eks.: Maskinmester, El-installatør, Ingeniør, Teknisk installatør, Bygningskonstruktør eller en anden relevant teknisk baggrund

Du har erfaring med projektledelse og tekniske projekter inden for f.eks. el, ventilation, varme, VVS, CTS/BMS eller bygningsautomatik.

Gennem dit arbejde har du opnået en solid teknisk forståelse og udviklet gode kompetencer inden for planlægning, koordinering og gennemførelse af projekter. Du kan skabe struktur og fremdrift i komplekse opgaver og bevare overblikket over økonomi, tid, kvalitet og risici.

Det er vigtigt, at du forstår betydningen af at etablere og vedligeholde gode relationer på tværs af organisationen

Personligt er du

  • Pligtopfyldende og struktureret med evnen til at skabe fremdrift i komplekse projekter
  • Analytisk og løsningsorienteret med fokus på kvalitet og resultater
  • En dygtig samarbejdspartner, der kommunikerer tydeligt på tværs af organisationen
  • Arbejder målrettet og værdsætter det fælles resultat
  • Nysgerrig på teknologi, digitalisering og nye løsninger

Som person vægter du din faglighed højt og motiveres af at skabe værdi gennem tekniske løsninger. Du arbejder struktureret, tager ansvar og formår at bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag. Samtidig har du lyst til løbende at udvikle både din egen faglighed og fremtidens ejendomsdrift.

Vi tilbyder

Et selvstændigt og afvekslende job i en engageret enhed med kompetent faglighed og realistiske ambitioner.

Du vil opleve frihed under ansvar, få en bred kontaktflade med dygtige kolleger og samarbejdspartnere, samt mulighed for at arbejde med både klassisk teknisk projektledelse og fremtidens digitale bygningsløsninger.

En arbejdsplads med attraktive arbejds- og ansættelsesforhold, herunder pensionsordning, sundhedssikring og mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

Værdierne i Jyske Bank, handlekraft, uhøjtidelighed, ligeværd, hæderlighed og sund fornuft, mærkes i afdelingen og i samarbejdet med både kolleger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Arbejdssted

Dit faste arbejdssted vil være Jyske Banks i København på Kalvebodbrygge.

Stillingen indebærer aktivitet på tværs af Jyske Banks lokationer.

Ansøgning

Vi oplever mangfoldighed som en fordel i vores opgaveløsning og i vores fællesskab. Derfor opfordrer vi alle til at søge.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV senest 20. oktober 2026.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og afslutter rekrutteringen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

title: 23120 - County Court Bailiff
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity.

Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised role: all successful candidates will be appointed to the nearest viable office nearest to their home postcode and on its respective pay scale. This will be at either a HQ building (subject to desk allocation, a Justice Collaboration Centre (JCC) or a Justice Satellite Office (JSO) – See Map. All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity).

For current MoJ employees, your base location will need to be changed to the nearest viable office (to your home postcode), either at a HQ building, JCC or JSO within the National Office Network and moved its location’s respective pay scale (any legacy arrangements/locations will need to be amended).

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

MoJ candidates who are on a specialist grade, will be able to retain their grade on lateral transfer.

All candidates who are currently in receipt of Mark Time / Pay Protection should ensure they are familiar with the new policy on permanent and temporary promotion which can be found on the employee intranet.

Flexible working hours

The Ministry of Justice offers a flexible working system in many offices. Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week. MoJ welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the MoJ’s Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service.

There is also a scheme to allow qualifying staff to buy or sell up to three days leave each year. Additional paid time off for public holidays and 1 privilege day. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis.

Pension

The Civil Service offers a choice of pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender employees.

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5359 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Software Engineer, Android
description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The Role

You’ll make Mecka’s capture hardware practical for the people recording the real world. You’ll build the Android applications that connect our devices, guide recording, and show users their progress and how to recover when something goes wrong. The work sits where physical hardware, mobile software and everyday use meet. Getting it right across many phones and operating conditions helps more people contribute high-quality data for robot learning.

What You’ll Do

  • Build clear app workflows for connecting hardware and capturing data.
  • Integrate device interfaces and media capabilities into native Android software.
  • Design status displays and recovery flows so users stay on track through disconnections, permission changes and interrupted transfers.
  • Improve responsiveness, video performance, memory use and battery consumption across supported phones.
  • Add diagnostics, and work with firmware engineers to reproduce issues and test complete user workflows.

What You Bring

Must-have:

  • 3–4 years of experience building and debugging native Android applications with connected hardware or media features on real devices, with strong Kotlin or Java skills.
  • A solid understanding of Android lifecycle, concurrency, permissions, background execution and networking.
  • The ability to design reliable app state that preserves user progress when connections or processes are interrupted.
  • Hands-on experience profiling and debugging performance, memory and connectivity on real Android devices.
  • The ability to build clear user interfaces and automated tests for important app workflows.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with USB host APIs, UVC cameras, MediaCodec, Camera2 or native C++ integration.
  • Experience with device provisioning, recording apps or large file transfers.

Inclusive Hiring at Mecka

We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive candidate experience. Should you require any accommodation whatsoever during the interview process, please inform us without any hesitation. Mecka is dedicated to ensuring equal treatment and opportunity in all phases of recruitment, selection, and employment, in compliance with employment law. We do not discriminate based on gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other protected category. Mecka is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, fostering a culture of inclusivity and maintaining a work environment that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment

Mecka uses artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly to support administrative and efficiency-focused aspects of our recruitment process. This includes activities such as drafting job descriptions, generating interview questions, note-taking and recordings, and support sourcing and scheduling workflows. All candidate evaluations, interviews, and hiring decisions are made by members of the Mecka team. While AI tools may assist with screening and assessment, they do not replace human judgment in selection decisions. Our use of AI is intended to streamline routine tasks, improve consistency, and enhance the overall candidate experience. We are committed to upholding principles of fairness, transparency, and accountability in all hiring activities. Mecka regularly reviews its recruitment practices to mitigate bias and to ensure alignment with applicable laws and evolving best practices.

title: Senior Data Ingestion Engineer
description:
Workload: Full-time / Part-time / availability of approx. 160 hours

Type of Contract: B2B

We are looking for Senior Data Ingestion Engineers to join a high-impact team developing scalable, automated document processing workflows. In this role, you will design and maintain robust data ingestion pipelines capable of extracting, transforming, and loading structured and unstructured document data using AWS Textract, Python, SQL, and AWS serverless orchestration tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Architecture & Development: Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end document data ingestion pipelines.
  • OCR & Text Extraction: Implement and refine OCR data extraction solutions using AWS Textract for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured document formats.
  • Orchestration & Workflow Management: Design automated pipeline workflows using AWS Step Functions and manage cloud storage and lifecycle rules via AWS S3 .
  • Data Processing & Transformation: Write efficient, clean Python scripts and complex SQL queries to parse, clean, validate, and transform incoming data.
  • Monitoring & Reliability: Set up automated alerts, performance monitoring, logging, and error-handling routines utilizing AWS CloudWatch .
  • Collaboration: Partner with client engineering teams in an agile environment working within Central European Time (CET) business hours.

Required Skills and Experience
