title: Funnel Conversion (CRO) Lead at AIOS — Remote, $150k-$300k/yr (including equity)
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

The opportunity as Funnel Conversion Lead at AIOS

We are building a world-class team.

As Funnel Conversion Lead at AIOS, you are DRI for the end-to-end website CVR from Meta ads in a specific country.

You’ll deeply understand our target customer in your specific country, think of macro tests to run, then get them executed. You’re responsible for the whole process: idea → hypothesis → test → result → learning → idea. You’re responsible for a specific country’s landers, quiz, checkout.

This is a hands-on role, and you’ll live in the weeds running experiments each day. We run on Omniconvert, PostHog, and Hex, but you’ll remain tool-agnostic and able to operate across whatever testing + analytics stack is required.

Great performance in the role means we can rapidly scale Meta spend in your specific country. Funnel Conversion is critical to scaling up our international growth efforts. If you nail the role, you’ll be a leading candidate for future senior roles across the Growth & Product teams.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time most weekdays.

You’ll lead a Product Squad, consisting of you + 1x SWE + 1x Web Designer.

You'll work closely with our existing Funnel Conversion Lead (Michael McCann) and you’ll report to our Head of Performance (Dave Lane). You’ll also work closely with our CEO (Richie Cartwright). I (Richie) am intense, so you’ll also be intense.

You’ll work long days and regularly work on weekends. Our default workweek is 50-60hrs/wk.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key Responsibilities

Meta Click → Sale CVR: You are DRI for the end-to-end website CVR from Meta ads in a specific country.

  1. Customer & marketing understanding: You must go deep on our target customer(s) in your specific country. Why are they converting and why are they not? Specifically at this stage of the GLP-1 take-up cycle in this specific country.

  2. Ideas & prioritizing: You have many ideas, both macro & micro, produced from customer insights / session data / market research / funnel performance. You create precise hypotheses and order them ruthlessly. Your experiments are always well designed to avoid unhelpful ambiguity of results.

  3. Execution: You are DRI for getting tests shipped. You run a Product Squad of 1x Engineer + 1x Designer. Tests get shipped rapidly and always to high-quality.

  4. Measure & learn: You measure everything important and use that information to inform your future testing.

  5. Improve tooling: You’re responsible for improving your own tooling. You don’t wait for someone else.

Key Traits

  1. Experience: You've spent 4+ years running a high volume (>hundreds) of experiments for DTC ecommerce brands in high-pace, high-transaction-volume environments. I have a strong preference for people who understand & enjoy the scary intensity of a high-growth startup.

  2. Macro swings: You don’t get stuck in hill climbing when we have no idea whether we’re yet on the right hill.

  3. Zest: You just get consumer. You have strong taste for consumer experience and can tell when a flow feels dead, cringe, slow, confusing, or magical.

  4. Funnel literacy: You understand the ad-to-landing-page handoff and how Funnel Conversion interacts with paid efficiency (CPL, CAC, quality score, LP experience).

  5. Hands-on & autonomous: You've personally owned end-to-end testing, from ideation and setup all the way to QA and readouts. You haven’t simply managed an agency and/or a team. You don’t need your hand held & you don’t get overwhelmed easily.

  6. Analytics: You’re maniacal about your metrics. You're comfortable inside the data, naturally curious, and able to dig past top-line numbers into segments and behaviour. You have a hunger to improve and are constantly upskilling. You care a weird amount about your analytics stack.

  7. Design: You’re comfortable with design principles & wireframing so can work closely with design to get what you want into pixels.

  8. Engineering: You’re sufficiently technical so code doesn’t bother you. You see turning your ideas into pixels as part of your remit, not something separate from you.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2030 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

"You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $150k-$300k/yr (including equity)

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

  2. In addition, you’re welcome to email me richie+hiring@joinfella.com

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager based in Romania.

Join a globally distributed technology organization where you will drive critical IT and Information Security initiatives across multiple technical and business teams. In this hands-on role, you will coordinate projects from initial planning through implementation and operational handover, ensuring clear ownership, priorities, and measurable outcomes. You will play a key role in advancing security improvements, coordinating vulnerability remediation, and ensuring critical actions are completed on time. By consolidating information across multiple Jira environments, you will turn fragmented project data into actionable insights that support better decision-making. You will collaborate closely with IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and Platform/DevOps teams in a fast-paced, international environment. This is an opportunity to take ownership, improve delivery processes, and make a meaningful impact on technology operations and organizational security.

Accountabilities

  • IT Project and Initiative Management

    • Lead IT projects and internal technology initiatives from requirements gathering and planning through implementation, rollout, and operational handover.

    • Define project scope, milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, timelines, and success criteria.

    • Coordinate delivery across IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Information Security, and business teams.

    • Proactively identify and resolve blockers, manage competing priorities, mitigate risks, and drive decisions to keep projects on track.

    • Oversee initiatives involving identity and access management (IAM/SSO), Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, enterprise SaaS, endpoint technologies, AWS and cloud services, corporate connectivity, internal systems, and IT automation.

      • Coordinate security initiatives across Information Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform/DevOps, and Red Team and Blue Team functions.

      • Track vulnerability findings and remediation activities from identification through validation and closure, ensuring clear ownership and realistic target dates.

      • Manage follow-up actions arising from penetration tests, Red Team/Blue Team exercises, security reviews, incidents, and ongoing security improvement programs.

      • Ensure security-related tasks are appropriately prioritized, supported by actionable remediation plans, and completed within agreed timelines.

      • Identify stalled, overdue, or high-risk activities and drive escalation, prioritization, and cross-team follow-up.

      • Facilitate security delivery without directly conducting security testing or vulnerability analysis.

      • Jira Management, Task Governance, and Analytics

        • Maintain consolidated visibility of IT and Information Security initiatives distributed across multiple Jira instances, projects, teams, and workflows.

        • Establish consistent reporting practices, ensuring data quality, traceability, and reliable visibility into delivery progress.

        • Monitor backlogs, aging tasks, overdue work, vulnerability remediation progress, throughput, and other relevant delivery metrics.

        • Analyze historical and current data to identify recurring issues, delivery bottlenecks, emerging risks, and performance trends.

        • Automate data collection, aggregation, and reporting wherever practical to improve operational efficiency.

        • Transform fragmented task-level information into actionable management insights that support prioritization and informed decision-making.

          • Serve as a central coordination point between Information Security, IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform/DevOps, system owners, business functions, and management.

          • Maintain clear visibility of risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and commitments across distributed teams.

          • Clarify ownership, facilitate prioritization, and resolve coordination challenges when teams have competing demands.

          • Deliver concise management updates focused on progress, trends, exceptions, risks, and decisions requiring attention.

          • Establish practical project governance and delivery processes that strengthen accountability without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

            • Requirements:

            • At least 5 years of experience in IT/IS Project Management, Security Project Management, Technical Project Management, or a related field.

            • Demonstrated experience delivering technology or security initiatives across multiple technical teams and managing complex dependencies.

            • Experience working closely with Information Security and Engineering organizations, with a practical understanding of how technical teams operate.

            • Strong hands-on experience with Jira for project coordination, task tracking, backlog management, and delivery governance.

            • Experience working across multiple Jira projects, workflows, or systems, ideally with an understanding of how to consolidate information from different environments.

            • Proven ability to produce consolidated reports, define and monitor KPIs, and analyze delivery trends using task-level data.

            • Strong project management capabilities, including scope definition, timeline management, prioritization, risk mitigation, dependency tracking, and stakeholder coordination.

            • Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across different functions and time zones.

            • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior management.

            • Strong analytical thinking, organizational skills, and attention to detail, combined with a proactive approach to identifying problems and driving solutions.

            • Ability to work independently, take ownership of delivery outcomes, and balance structured governance with the flexibility required in a fast-moving technology environment.

              • The following qualifications and experience are considered an advantage:

              • Experience managing vulnerability remediation programs and coordinating security improvement initiatives.

              • Familiarity with Red Team and Blue Team activities and the coordination of security testing follow-up actions.

              • Experience consolidating data across multiple Jira instances or building automated Jira reporting solutions.

              • Knowledge of operational dashboards, workflow automation, and delivery analytics.

              • Exposure to AWS, cloud infrastructure, or cloud security environments.

              • Experience working in large-scale online technology organizations or high-availability environments.

              • Relevant professional certifications, such as PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, CISSP, CISM, Security+, Agile, or Scrum.

                • Benefits:

                • Competitive compensation: A competitive salary package aligned with experience and responsibilities.

                • Performance incentives: Individual performance-based bonuses paid quarterly, with additional referral and flash bonus opportunities.

                • Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely in an environment designed to support sustainable and flexible working practices.

                • Flexible working hours: Core working hours from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. in your local time zone, with flexibility outside this window.

                • Paid time off: 28 days of paid annual leave to support rest, personal commitments, and work-life balance.

                • Quality equipment: Access to high-quality equipment to help you work efficiently from your preferred location.

                • Company retreats: Annual company retreats offering opportunities to connect with colleagues, strengthen collaboration, and build professional relationships.

                • International collaboration: Work with distributed teams across technology, infrastructure, security, and business functions.

                • Professional impact: Take ownership of meaningful technology and security initiatives while contributing to improved operational performance and delivery practices.

title: Staff Technical Product Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Technical Product Manager based in Canada.

In this senior technical product leadership role, you will own the roadmap for an enterprise integration and automation platform connecting critical business systems, financial applications, customer platforms, and data infrastructure. You will translate complex, evolving business needs into a clear, prioritized roadmap that supports operational scale, international expansion, and technology modernization. Working closely with business leaders, engineers, and enterprise architects, you will make informed decisions about APIs, integration patterns, and platform architecture. You will also help shape how AI agents and automation capabilities are integrated into enterprise workflows. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced platform product leader who combines technical depth with strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and a passion for building scalable, reliable systems in a fast-growing technology environment.

Accountabilities

  • Own and continuously prioritize the business technology services platform roadmap, translating evolving business needs into a structured backlog that supports scalability, international expansion, and ERP decoupling.

  • Consolidate demand across business technology services and integration automation platforms into a single, transparent intake and prioritization process.

  • Partner with senior stakeholders across Finance, Supply Chain, Member Experience, Commercial, and Corporate functions to understand requirements, clarify business objectives, and define actionable platform initiatives.

  • Own technical product decisions related to API contracts, versioning, and integration patterns, including platform-based versus custom development, synchronous versus event-driven integrations, and batch versus real-time processing.

  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture and senior integration engineers on complex system design, infrastructure decisions, and platform boundaries.

  • Develop and communicate a compelling platform strategy, explaining technical trade-offs, investment priorities, business value, and expected outcomes to executive and cross-functional audiences.

  • Align integration architecture with data infrastructure, including data lakehouse and data mesh capabilities, ensuring upstream integration decisions support downstream analytics and data products.

  • Define and evaluate requirements for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and AI agents supporting the business technology ecosystem, in collaboration with AI productivity teams.

  • Contribute to establishing and scaling an Integration and Automation Engineering team, partnering with leadership on team structure, hiring, and the transition from contractor-led delivery to a permanent team.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 10 years of experience in technical product management or platform management, including substantial ownership of infrastructure, integration, or API platforms rather than exclusively customer-facing products.

    • Strong technical proficiency, with the ability to write or critically review technical specifications, OpenAPI definitions, event schemas, and API contracts, as well as defend build-versus-buy and versioning decisions.

    • Working knowledge of core AWS services used in integration platforms, such as API Gateway, Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, and SQS/SNS, sufficient to evaluate architectural trade-offs and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.

    • Direct experience with integration platform-as-a-service (iPaaS) solutions such as Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, or similar technologies.

    • Strong understanding of API design, versioning, contract management, and integration architecture.

    • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business requests into clear, actionable, and technically feasible requirements.

    • Experience owning platform roadmaps that serve multiple internal teams, including managing competing priorities and consolidating demand across different stakeholders and backlogs.

    • Proven ability to negotiate priorities and trade-offs with senior stakeholders, including directors and executive-level leaders.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and their business implications to non-technical audiences.

    • Practical experience using large language model (LLM) assistants and AI-powered development tools, such as Claude, Cursor, Claude Code, or Lovable, for research, drafting, analysis, prototyping, and problem-solving.

    • Sound judgment when applying AI tools, including the ability to validate outputs and recognize situations where AI is not appropriate.

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience establishing or governing an AI control plane, MCP gateway, or agent observability and policy layer.

      • Experience with ERP integrations or modernization and decoupling initiatives involving NetSuite or similar systems.

      • Familiarity with data lakehouse and data mesh architectures, including Databricks, and an understanding of how integration design affects analytics and data products.

      • Experience transitioning a contractor-led function into a permanent platform engineering team.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive base salary and equity compensation.

        • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

        • Mental health and wellness resources.

        • A personal smart ring and discounts for friends and family.

        • 20 days of paid time off, 13 paid holidays, and 8 flexible wellness days.

        • Paid sick leave and parental leave.

        • Remote work flexibility.

description:
NICE TO MEET YOU!

We are looking for a (Senior) Product Manager (m/f/d) Prop Tech who is passionate

about driving the expansion and growth of our B2C customer journey. Be part of our

journey to develop innovative, digital products to offer our customers the best possible service

and to revolutionize the real estate industry.

You are passionate about putting the user at the center of your work and developing the ideal

user experience for their interests and needs.

In order to achieve this, you take over the lead of one of our B2C development teams, are

primarily responsible for its output, set the mission and direction and act as a role model with

your motivation and your drive.

As a (Senior) Product Manager (m/f/d) Prop Tech you are fully responsible for the following tasks:

 Have responsibility for planning, prioritizing, and executing throughout the product lifecycle

 Drive the vision and strategy for your product, communicate continuously with all stakeholders

and keep them informed

 Be our expert for the needs of your users, know the objectives and KPIs of your product and

derive the relevant next steps from them

 You understand that innovative new product solutions can only be created in a crossfunctional team and form the link to all other relevant areas

WHO ARE YOU?

 You have at least 3 years of experience as a product manager in the B2C sector

 You are familiar with the long-term further development of digital products, ideally in complex

structures

 You have experience in dealing with various agile methods and can apply them in different

situations

 You think in a user-centric manner and understand how to combine and apply user needs and

KPIs

 You are characterized by a hands-on mentality, your drive and personal responsibility and you

have excellent communication skills (in German and English)

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

 The best of both worlds: a modern prop-tech company backed by Engel & Völkers as a real

estate company, with more than 40 years in more than 15 different countries.

 An agile work culture with flat hierarchies and international, cross-functional teams

 The chance to contribute directly to the success of the company with your skills and

experience and to contribute your personal touch

 New challenges where you can grow professionally and personally

 A technology-driven environment built on the latest tech stack: Golang, Kotlin, NodeJS, ReactJs,

NextJS, Nx, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes etc.

 Flexible working hours and 30 days holiday

 Work remotely from anywhere in Germany or at our beautiful HQ near the Port of Hamburg

o Individual training budget or independent learning via our Udemy account

o Subsidy for your HVV ticket, fitness studio, pension plan

o 25€/month company credit card

o and many other company benefits

title: Economist Researcher – Chemicals
description:
**Location:** Norwich (Agile working available)

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an Economist Researcher to join our Chemicals division to support delivery of high-quality economic and policy analysis within the UK and EU chemicals regulatory framework.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early career economist who wants to work at the centre of regulatory decision making. Our work directly informs regulatory outcomes under UK REACH and EU REACH, supporting both industry and public sector clients in navigating complex regulatory requirements.

You will contribute to a wide range of projects including chemical policy development, regulatory advice, impact assessment and socio-economic analysis. The work you support will influence regulatory decisions, support sustainable chemical use, and contribute to improving human health and environmental protection.

You will work closely with experienced economists, scientists and policy specialists, gaining hands-on experience in applied economic analysis within a highly respected consultancy environment.

**Why Join RPA**

Risk & Policy Analysts Limited (RPA) is a 100 percent employee-owned, B Corp certified consultancy with over 30 years of experience delivering high-quality economic, scientific and policy analysis.

Our Chemicals division is widely recognised for its expertise in Authorisation, Restriction, and broader regulatory policy. We combine economics, regulatory insight and technical expertise to deliver robust, defensible evidence to regulators, industry and policymakers.

As an employee-owned business, our people directly benefit from our success through tax-free profit share and equity participation. Based in central Norwich, we operate an agile working policy that supports flexibility in working hours and location while providing strong mentoring, structured development and long-term career progression.

In 2024 we were recognised as a Sunday Times Best Employer and consistently achieve strong employee engagement results.

**What You Will Do**

Conduct literature reviews and desk-based research

Collect, organise and analyse qualitative and quantitative data

Build and maintain structured datasets and databases

Support economic analysis and contribute to economic modelling where appropriate

Assist in preparing clear, structured technical reports and client deliverables

Contribute to presentations and supporting materials

Work across multiple projects, managing your time to meet deadlines and quality standards

Support senior colleagues in delivering projects for both public and private sector clients

Develop your technical, analytical and consulting skills through structured on-the-job learning

**What We Are Looking For**

Essential

Degree in Economics or a closely related discipline (minimum 2:1 or equivalent)

Strong analytical and desk-based research skills

Ability to analyse and interpret qualitative and quantitative information

Strong organisational skills and ability to manage your own workload

Excellent written English and ability to produce clear, structured written material

Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word

Willingness to learn and develop new skills

**Salary and Benefits**

£26,227.50

33 days holiday, increasing to 38 days including bank holidays

Private healthcare from day one

Tax-free profit share through Employee-Owned Trust (after six months)

Enhanced family policies

20 days full sick pay

5 times salary death in service cover

Paid volunteering leave

Flexible and agile working arrangements

**Contract Details**

Permanent position

Full-time

Based in Norwich, with flexible and hybrid working available

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Equal opportunities employer

**How to Apply**

If you are excited to begin your career in economic consulting and want to contribute to work that directly shapes UK and EU chemicals regulation, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV, and why you are looking to join RPA to [applications@rpaltd.co.uk](mailto:applications@rpaltd.co.uk) **(REF: Economist Researcher Chemicals 0226)**, or use the form below and upload your CV directly.

title: 23144 - Business Administrator (BA)
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

If you are a current NPS employee, this vacancy may be available on a Loan basis for up to 2 years. Applications are invited from suitable qualified staff.

The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

Benefits

Annual Leave

-The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays

-You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays. These hours are added to your annual leave allowance. There is a requirement to work some public and bank holidays subject to your shift pattern and the operational needs of the establishment

Pension

-The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Work Life Balance

HM Prison & Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. Work life balance provides greater opportunities for staff to work more flexibly wherever managers and establishments can accommodate requests to do so. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

Season Ticket Advance

-After two months’ service, you’ll be eligible to apply for a season ticket advance to purchase a quarterly or longer-period season ticket for travel between home and your place of work

Childcare Vouchers

For any moves across the Civil Service may have implications on your ability to carry on claiming childcare vouchers

Training

HMPPS is committed to staff development and offers a range of training and development opportunities, including areas such as Equality and Diversity, Dealing with Challenging Behaviour, Suicide Prevention and Anti Bullying Programmes

-There are opportunities to access promotion programmes and HMPPS provides a variety of training appropriate to individual posts

-All staff receive security and diversity training and an individual induction programme into their new roles

Eligibility

-All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

-All external candidates are subject to 6 months probation. Internal candidates are subject to probation if they have not already served a probationary period within HMPPS

-All staff are required to declare whether they are a member of a group or organisation which the HMPPS considers to be racist

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Seasonal Key Holder
description:
Get some, and give back! We're looking for pop culture fanatics to help create the best experience for our customers.
We’re looking for music and pop culture fanatics to help create the best experience for our customers. As a BoxLunch Seasonal Key Holder, you’ll be a huge part of our success by supporting the store leadership team in providing the best customer experience, ensuring that fellow fans are able to get their hands on the merch they love. You’ll use your fandom knowledge to help train new recruits and ensure their success, while also supporting your Store Manager in daily operations and meeting sales targets.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Provide an amazing shopping experience that will encourage customers to return. They’ll be impressed by your product knowledge, customer experience skills and use of the Force
  • Step in and step up when needed. You’ll provide leadership support and help run the store when your Manager gets pulled away
  • Understand store sales plan and comp sales goals, and help drive sales by increasing key KPIs: UPT and ADT
  • Cover the sales floor zone and ensure that assigned areas are up to visual standards. You’ll also help in the opening and closing of the store
  • Work the register; you’ll process sales transactions and use your fandom knowledge to drive add on sales. We’ll need you to also be able to close out the register and communicate and shortages or overages to your Store Manager
  • Assist with planogram changes including store map, wall, fixture, & merchandising mix
  • Let your voice be heard! You’ll communicate fashion & music trend information to management and respective HQ partners
  • While we welcome wizards, we don’t like it when spells are stolen. You’ll work with Store Management to ensure there’s no misuse of spells and wizardry around theft.
  • Support the maintenance of the mother ship; you’ll help keep the stock room organized and the store tidy.
  • Train and coach new Sales Associates as needed to help them quickly get acclimated to the team
  • Any other activities as assigned by your Store Leader

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Previous experience working in a retail environment. If you’re passionate about philanthropy & all things pop culture, you're in the right place!
  • You'll have to be at least 18 years of age to join the fandom force
  • A high school Diploma or GED equivalent
  • Avenger like collaboration and communication skills, as well as Captain America-like leadership
  • The usual retail stuff: able to stand and walk around during scheduled hours, reaching for merch using ladder, step stool and poles. You’ll also have to be able to move around boxes of awesome merchandise that may weigh up to 50 pounds

Experience with Cisco networking, SCCM deployment tools, Microsoft Intune and Point of Sale technologies is highly desirable. Our hiring is centred on capability and performance, regardless of gender, gender identity, race, origin, age, educational background, disability, or religious beliefs. We're here to empower you to shine. Our willingness to adapt ensures you can chart your path with us! Join us at SkyCity and be extraordinary by being you.

title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
At Range, we're building towards a world where anyone can live the financial life they imagine for themselves. If that sounds like a mission you want to be a part of, let's create it together.

We're building AI-powered wealth management. Investments, taxes, retirement, estate planning, all in one platform instead of scattered across different advisors and apps. We're backed by Google's Gradient Ventures, Cathay Innovation, Scale Venture Partners, and more. We're growing fast while still small enough that everyone's work is visible and impactful.

About the role

Range runs IT the way we run engineering: in code, with AI, and with security built in. Our identity, groups, and DNS live in GitHub and ship through CI/CD. We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to own that system end to end.

We add new Rangers every month across three offices. Your job is to make their first day work, their last day smooth, and everything in between fast and secure. As a registered investment adviser, we hold ourselves to a high bar on access control and auditability. You'll build IT that clears that bar without slowing anyone down.

You'll work closely with our security and infrastructure team and partner with People, Finance, and every department lead.

This role is based at Range's headquarters in McLean, VA, in office Monday–Friday, and supports our New York and Seattle offices with occasional travel.

What you'll own

  • Employee lifecycle. Onboarding, role changes, and offboarding (planned and same-day) across Google Workspace, SSO-connected apps, VPN, password manager, Slack, and GitHub. Where there are checklists and hand-offs, you will turn them into automated, auditable workflows.

  • Identity and access. Run Google Workspace as our identity provider, with SAML/OIDC SSO and SCIM provisioning. Design role- and department-based access, enforce least privilege and time-bound admin rights, and run regular access reviews.

  • Apple fleet. Own our macOS fleet through MDM and Apple Business Manager. Manage procurement, inventory, and recovery of hardware across all three offices.

  • SaaS management. Run app intake and security review, manage licenses and seats, track spend, and cut sprawl. Know which tools we pay for, who uses them, and what they can access.

  • IT as code. Manage Workspace configuration, groups, DNS, and through infrastructure-as-code (Pulumi) in GitHub, with pull-request review and CI.

  • Support that scales. Own the IT support channel and escalations. Write self-service docs, and build AI agents and automations that resolve common requests (password resets, access requests, app installs) without a human in the loop.

  • Security and compliance. Partner with security on SOC 2 controls, endpoint incident response, and the evidence regulators and auditors ask for.

  • Office technology. Keep Wi-Fi, networking, conference rooms, and peripherals working in McLean, New York, and Seattle.

Who you are

  • An owner. You own problems until they're solved. When an offboarding is immediate, it's your top priority, and you finish it.

  • Automation-first. If you've done something twice by hand, you're already scripting it. You'd rather fix the system than close the ticket.

  • AI-native. You use AI every day to write scripts, triage requests, and build tools. You see it as the way a small IT function supports a fast-growing company.

  • Security-minded. Least privilege is your default. You can explain to a teammate why they're getting admin rights for an hour instead of forever.

  • Service-oriented. You're patient and clear with non-technical colleagues, and you care how IT feels to the people using it.

  • Calm under pressure. Security incidents, lost laptops, and a same-day departure on a Friday don't rattle you.

  • You care about outcomes. Every account, every device, every workflow is built around how Rangers actually experience it.

Where you operate at this level

You produce high-quality, impactful work that drives team success. You take full ownership by proactively identifying and addressing challenges while staying focused on solutions. You lead by example with positivity, reframing setbacks as opportunities to learn and grow. You collaborate openly through radical transparency, ensuring alignment and trust among teammates and stakeholders.

Not for you if

  • You want to close tickets, not build systems

  • You make changes in admin consoles and never write them down, let alone codify them

  • You think security is someone else's job

  • You need a fully written playbook before you can act

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in IT systems administration or corporate engineering

  • Deep Google Workspace administration experience

  • macOS fleet management with a modern MDM (Jamf, Kandji, Mosyle, or similar) and Apple Business Manager

  • Hands-on SSO and identity experience: SAML, OIDC, SCIM, MFA, and RBAC

  • Scripting in TypeScript, Python, or Bash, and comfort working in Git with pull requests.

  • A track record of automating onboarding, offboarding, and access management

  • Strong security fundamentals: least privilege, encryption, endpoint protection, and incident response

  • Clear written communication, from runbooks to company-wide announcements

What will set you apart

  • Infrastructure-as-code in Pulumi or Terraform, applied to identity and SaaS.

  • Building IT automations or AI agents (Okta Workflows, Tines, Zapier, or custom)

  • SOC 2 or regulated financial services experience (RIA, broker-dealer, bank)

  • Networking and VPN experience (Wi-Fi, firewalls, Tailscale/WireGuard, OpenVPN)

  • AWS IAM Identity Center or Okta administration

  • Supporting multiple offices at a startup

Compensation

Base salary range: $120,000 – $190,000

This is the base salary range we expect in good faith to pay for this role at the time of posting. Where an offer lands within the range depends on the scope and complexity of work the candidate can own independently and demonstrated depth at this level.

Other compensation and benefits

The range above reflects base salary only. Our offer packages also include equity in the form of stock options, so total compensation for this role will exceed the base salary range.

We do not ask for or consider salary history. You are welcome to ask questions about compensation at any point in the process.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: 100% employer-covered medical insurance for employees (75% for dependents), plus dental and vision coverage

  • 401(k): Retirement savings program to support your future

  • Paid Time Off: time to reset and recharge + most federal holidays

  • Parental Leave: Comprehensive leave policy for growing families

  • Meals: Select meals covered throughout the week

  • Fitness: Monthly movement stipend

  • Equity & Career Growth: Early exercise eligibility and a strong focus on professional development

  • Annual Compensation Reviews: Salary and equity refreshes based on performance

  • Boomerang Program: After two years at Range, you can take time away to start your own company. We'll hold your spot for 6 months - and pause your equity vesting, which resumes if you return

title: To faglige ledere til Dagtilbud og beskyttet beskæftigelse
description:
Vil du være med til at sætte retning for Fremtidens Dagtilbud og har du lyst til at stå midt i faglighed, mennesker, drift og udvikling?

Vi styrker den faglige ledelse i Dagtilbud og beskyttet beskæftigelse og søger derfor to faglige ledere, som sammen med lederen af Dagtilbud og beskyttet beskæftigelse skal være med til at lede og udvikle vores tilbud på tværs af Frederikshavn, Sæby og Skagen.

Vi er samtidig midt i arbejdet med at forme Fremtidens Dagtilbud og vores nye fælles fundament. Derfor søger vi ikke bare en leder, der kan få hverdagen til at fungere. Vi søger dig, der har lyst til at være med til at udvikle, udfordre og skabe noget sammen med medarbejdere og borgere.

En leder tæt på praksis

Som faglig leder bliver du en del af den daglige ledelse og får en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage nødvendigvis ligner hinanden.

Du kommer tæt på både borgere og medarbejdere og skal kunne bevæge dig mellem faglig sparring, borgerrelaterede drøftelser, medarbejdersamtaler, samarbejdspartnere og de større organisatoriske linjer. Du skal kunne holde mange bolde i luften, prioritere og skabe struktur også når tempoet er højt. Samtidig skal du kunne løfte blikket og se sammenhænge og muligheder.

Det er netop kombinationen af nærværende ledelse, faglighed, drift og udvikling, vi søger. Vi skal være et ledelsesteam, der supplerer og udfordrer hinanden fagligt og sammen skaber tydelighed og retning.

Vi leder efter en leder med faglig tyngde

Vores målgruppe spænder bredt. Vi arbejder med voksne borgere med forskellige og komplekse behov og med både aktivitets- og samværstilbud efter SEL § 104 og beskyttet beskæftigelse efter SEL § 103. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du har erfaring fra det specialiserede socialområde og kan omsætte din faglige viden til praksis.

Du skal kunne være nysgerrig på det, der ligger bag en borgers adfærd, og kunne understøtte medarbejderne i at arbejde fagligt, systematisk og med blik for den enkelte borgers ressourcer, muligheder og udvikling.

Du skal også have lyst til at være tæt på faglig dokumentation, opfølgning og kvalitet og kunne se værdien i, at dokumentationen bliver et redskab til faglig refleksion og udvikling og ikke bare en administrativ opgave.

Du skaber retning og får mennesker med dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er en leder, der:

  • har en relevant pædagogisk eller socialfaglig uddannelse og erfaring fra det specialiserede socialområde
  • har faglig tyngde inden for området og kan omsætte din viden til praksis
  • kan skabe retning og følgeskab gennem tillid, relationer og tydelig kommunikation
  • har ro i dig selv og kan skabe ro omkring dig, når hverdagen bliver kompleks
  • tør træffe beslutninger og stå på mål for dem
  • arbejder struktureret og følger op på det, du sætter i gang
  • kan håndtere både drift, personale, faglig udvikling og strategiske opgaver
  • har blik for både den enkelte medarbejder og det samlede arbejdsfællesskab
  • bidrager til psykologisk tryghed, hvor det er muligt at stille spørgsmål, være uenig og bede om hjælp
  • har mod på at udfordre ”vi plejer” og prøve noget nyt.

Og så håber vi, at du har ja-hatten på. Ikke fordi du skal sige ja til alting, men fordi du ser muligheder og har lyst til at finde svarene sammen med andre.

Kan du se dig selv i Sammen om god ledelse?

I Frederikshavn Kommune hedder vores ledelsesgrundlag Sammen om god ledelse. Et stærkt fællesskab er afsæt for god ledelse, og vi tror på, at vi lykkes bedst, når vi leder sammen og på tværs. Ledelsesgrundlaget bygger på Mod, Ansvarlighed og Ordentlighed.

Som leder skal du kunne se dig selv i, at vi har mod til at gå nye veje og omsætte idéer til handling. At vi står på mål for vores opgaver og medarbejdere, tager nødvendige prioriteringer og deler ansvaret. Og at vi leder med integritet, tillid og respekt og kommunikerer åbent om beslutninger, forslag og idéer. Det er derfor ikke kun tre ord på et stykke papir. Det handler om den måde, vi er ledere på.

En organisation i bevægelse

Vi er i gang med at udvikle Fremtidens Dagtilbud og vores fælles fundament. Vi har ikke alle svarene endnu og det skal vi heller ikke have. Du får derfor en vigtig rolle i både at stå på det, vi allerede ved virker, og være med til at undersøge, hvad vi kan gøre anderledes og bedre.

Det ligger tæt op ad kommunens fokus på Fremtidens Fællesskab: at vi sammen skaber stærke fællesskaber og finder nye løsninger på de udfordringer, vi står overfor.

Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger bliver til, når vi bringer faglighed, erfaring, nysgerrighed og forskellige perspektiver sammen.

Hvem er vi?

Dagtilbud og beskyttet beskæftigelse er en del af Specialiseret Dagtilbud i Center for Handicap og Psykiatri i Frederikshavn Kommune.

Vi har tilbud i Frederikshavn, Sæby og Skagen fordelt på fire matrikler og arbejder med voksne borgere med forskellige funktionsnedsættelser og støttebehov. Vi tilbyder aktiviteter og samvær efter Servicelovens § 104 og beskyttet beskæftigelse efter § 103.

Vi er mange dygtige medarbejdere med forskellige fagligheder og en stor variation i vores opgaver. Det giver en meningsfuld hverdag og kræver, at vi samarbejder, hjælper hinanden og løfter blikket fra den enkelte matrikel.

Det får du hos os

Du får mulighed for at:

  • blive en del af et ledelsesteam med tæt sparring og fælles ansvar
  • få en central rolle i udviklingen af Fremtidens Dagtilbud
  • arbejde både strategisk, fagligt og tæt på praksis
  • sætte dit faglige og ledelsesmæssige aftryk på en organisation i udvikling
  • samarbejde med engagerede medarbejdere og ledere på tværs
  • være med til at skabe stærke arbejdsfællesskaber præget af tillid, tydelighed og psykologisk tryghed.

Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis to ens ledere. Vi søger to mennesker, der hver især kommer med noget forskelligt, og som sammen kan skabe et stærkt ledelsesteam.

Måske er det dig?

Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i det, du har læst, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Ledererfaring er en fordel, men vigtigst er det, at du har lyst og mod til at tage ledelsesansvar og kan se dig selv i den rolle, vi beskriver.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du kan stå stærkt i din faglighed og samtidig være nysgerrig på andres. At du kan skabe struktur uden at blive rigid og være tydelig uden at blive firkantet. Og at du kan skabe følgeskab uden at skulle have alle svarene selv.

Du skal have kørekort og mulighed for at benytte egen bil, da jobbet indebærer, at du ugentligt skal være synlig på vores forskellige tilbud rundt omkring i kommunen.

Vi glæder os til at møde dig.

Praktisk information

Ansøgningsfrist: 6. november 2026

Job Description

At Norton Rose Fulbright, people thrive because of a shared commitment to quality, unity and integrity. The highly regarded law firm consistently receives recognition from Great Place to Work and Top Workplaces, two companies that specialize in assessing organizational culture. Teams collaborate across regions, value new ideas and deliver meaningful client solutions, supported by a culture that embraces ambition, development and shared success. With more than 3,000 lawyers and 3,000 business services professionals working together across 50 offices worldwide, this global law firm provides a full range of legal services to leading corporations and financial institutions operating in key markets and sectors.

Norton Rose Fulbright is seeking an experienced Compliance (Lateral Hiring Conflicts) Analyst with conflicts review experience to join our US team. Compliance Analysts conduct conflict-of-interest research and analysis by reviewing matter intake, performing corporate and database research, and identifying potential issues for lawyer review. This role will focus primarily on conflict-of-interest checks related to the US firm’s lateral hiring efforts. This team plays a vital role in protecting the firm’s integrity—enabling confident, compliant client engagement through accurate and timely conflict analysis.


The position requires a self-starter to become proficient in understanding and using the conflicts of interest database to perform the firm’s conflict checks. Candidate must have excellent research and strong organizational skills with a keen attention to detail. The Compliance Analyst should be able to consistently exercise discretion and independent judgment.


The US Compliance Team consists, at present, of the Deputy General Counsel, two Assistant Deputy General Counsels, three Counsel and Senior Managers, as well as a team of Compliance Lawyers, Senior Compliance Analysts, Compliance Analysts and Client/Matter Intake Analysts. The US Compliance Team works daily with Norton Rose Fulbright Compliance Teams in Australia, Canada, Europe, the Middle East and Asia.


This role may be performed remotely from any state where the firm maintains an office (Texas, California, Colorado, Illinois, Minnesota, Missouri, New York, and the District of Columbia). Employees must also be able to attend the office as needed at the direction of their supervisor.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Ensure exemplary client service to all internal and external clients; proactively promote client service throughout department and among teams; respond to peer requests with recognition that request serves a client or firm need.
  • Respond to lawyer and staff requests to perform conflicts of interest searches.
  • Review information submitted by lawyers and support staff for completion and accuracy; follow-up with lawyers and support staff as needed to clarify information.
  • Research corporate history of clients and parties; search websites for information about corporate affiliations (such as parent/subsidiary).
  • Use Boolean searching and search terms to query the conflicts database. Apply judgment to design effective database searches and to distinguish relevant search results from those that are irrelevant.
  • Review generated conflict reports for relevancy and relatedness based on the submitted information and identify potential conflicts issues. Independently analyze the report with limited guidance.
  • Work closely with assigned Compliance Attorney to ensure compliance workflow is as accurate and efficient as possible.
  • Summarize the basis for potential conflicts and communicate any potential conflicts to assigned Compliance Attorney.
  • Develop familiarity with Global Practice Standards program and policies and answer inquiries regarding share dealings and related issues.

title: Registered Training Organisation Specialist
description:
The Role

The RTO Specialist is integral to the effective operation and strategic growth of Auto & General's internal RTO. This role is singularly focused on managing the RTO's learning operations, specifically overseeing the expansion of its scope by adding new qualifications, ensuring rigorous compliance with ASQA standards, and collaborating with business stakeholders to align accredited learning pathways with organisational needs. This specialist ensures the RTO remains compliant, agile, and responsive to our evolving training requirements.

Position Accountabilities

The RTO Specialist is directly accountable for:

RTO Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring that all RTO learning operations, including qualifications on scope, training delivery, and assessment practices, are consistently compliant with the VET Quality Framework and ASQA standards.
Scope Integrity & Expansion: Proactively managing and expanding the RTO's scope of qualifications in a compliant and strategic manner, effectively meeting the organisation's evolving training needs.
Quality of VET Outcomes: Upholding and continuously improving the quality of accredited training and assessment outcomes within Auto & General's RTO learning operations.
Accurate Data & Reporting: The integrity, accuracy, and timely submission of all VET-related data and compliance reports to ASQA and internal stakeholders.
Effective Stakeholder Integration: Ensuring RTO learning operations are seamlessly integrated with business unit training requirements through collaborative engagement with internal stakeholders.


What experience you’ll bring

  • Demonstrated experience in an RTO environment with a strong focus on compliance, scope management, and learning operations.
  • Expert-level understanding of the VET Quality Framework, ASQA requirements, and national training packages.
  • Proven experience in the process of adding qualifications to an RTO's scope.
  • Strong background in developing, implementing, and reviewing training and assessment strategies and materials within an RTO context.
  • Proficiency in AVETMISS data collection, analysis, and reporting.
  • Exceptional organisational skills with meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, capable of articulating complex regulatory requirements and collaborating effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) - preferably Docebo and RTO management software e.g. Wisenet.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders, translating their needs into compliant RTO solutions.
  • Anticipates potential compliance risks and proactively develops robust solutions.
  • Takes full ownership of RTO operational integrity and compliance outcomes with unwavering diligence.
  • Demonstrates flexibility and efficiency in managing evolving RTO requirements and regulatory changes.
  • Certificate IV in Training and Assessment (TAE40122 or equivalent) is essential.
  • Relevant tertiary qualification in Education, Business, or a related field will be highly regarded.


Our Perks


Location –Toowong

Close to a variety of public transport and easy parking options, the Toowong office has excellent end of trip facilities (including secure bike storage and showers), outdoor spaces and plenty of modern collaborative areas to work and connect with colleagues.

Conveniently based at Toowong Village tower with views of the mountains and the Brisbane River, our location is only 4 km from the city and provides access to retail, restaurants and other amenities.

The benefits of working at A&G

Be rewarded - we recognise high performance and reward our people for their hard work through bonuses and other perks.
Work flexibility - with options to work from home up to two days per week.
Options for leave - life happens, so we’ve got volunteer days, an additional paid ‘ME’ day, paid parental leave and the opportunity to purchase additional leave to cover all of the big stuff.
Grow with us - we’ve got learning and professional development opportunities to suit everyone.

title: Data Service Delivery Manager
description:

title: Data Governance Analyst
description:
Salary: $108,307 plus 15% Superannuation

About Icon Water

Icon Water is an iconic Canberra organisation that has been delivering essential water and wastewater services to the ACT community for more than 100 years.

Our people play a vital role in delivering services that support the health, prosperity and liveability of our region. Guided by our values of Care, Connection, Community and Courage, we are committed to building a high-performing, inclusive workplace where our people can thrive while making a meaningful contribution to the Canberra community.

Icon Water is an Equal Opportunity Employer which values diversity and inclusion. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, people with disabilities, people from culturally diverse backgrounds and all ages. We also have a strong focus on gender balance within the organisation and encourage women to apply.


The Opportunity

Data is a critical asset that supports decision-making, operational performance and customer outcomes across Icon Water. As a Data Governance Analyst, you will help strengthen the governance, quality and integrity of enterprise data by supporting the implementation of data governance frameworks, policies and practices across the organisation.

Working with a broad range of business and technology stakeholders, you will drive improvements in data quality, compliance and data management maturity, helping ensure trusted information supports the delivery of essential services to the Canberra community. This role forms part of the Enterprise Architecture Branch within the Digital and Data portfolio and reports to the Data Governance Lead

What You Bring

You are a collaborative and adaptable data professional with strong analytical skills and a passion for improving how organisations manage and use information. You build effective relationships, communicate complex concepts clearly and influence stakeholders to achieve positive outcomes. Driven by continuous improvement, you take ownership of your work, embrace change and contribute to a culture of accountability, learning and high performance.

Success in this role will be supported by:

  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Data and Information Management, Information Systems or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience in Data Governance, Data Management, Information Management or a related specialist role within a medium to large organisation.
  • Strong knowledge of data governance, data quality, metadata management, master data management and data stewardship principles.
  • Experience implementing or supporting governance frameworks, policies, standards and governance improvement initiatives.
  • Sound understanding of data privacy, information security, records management and relevant regulatory obligations, including the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and Territory Records Act 2002 (ACT).
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to embed effective data governance practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical business outcomes.
  • Professional certifications in data governance or data management disciplines such as CDMP, DCAM, ICCP or equivalent will be highly regarded.
  • Experience working with modern data, analytics and cloud technologies will be highly regarded.

Why Join Icon Water

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of data governance within an organisation that delivers services essential to the Canberra community every day. You'll work across a diverse stakeholder landscape, influence enterprise-wide governance practices and contribute to initiatives that strengthen data quality, compliance and organisational decision-making. If you are passionate about data, governance and driving meaningful business outcomes, you'll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact while developing your career in a purpose-driven organisation.

In return, we offer:

  • Competitive remuneration package - Salary starting from $108,307
  • 15% employer superannuation contribution
  • Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities
  • Free gym membership and wellbeing initiatives
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • A supportive and values-led workplace culture

How to Apply

If you're passionate about data, governance and delivering solutions that make a meaningful impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your current CV and a brief cover letter outlining your suitability for the role.

Applications close Monday 26 October 2026.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Stephen.Herbert@iconwater.com.au.

Full working rights in Australia are required. We are unable to provide sponsorship for this position.

For further information on the role, including key accountabilities and position requirements, please refer to the Position Description on the Icon Water Careers Portal.

description:

What is your new project?

Fast-growing mobile entertainment platform redefining how people consume scripted content. We create premium, short-form, vertical series designed for modern viewing habits: fast-paced, immersive, mobile-first, and always available on demand.

Domain: Media and Entertainment

Location: Israel

Company size: 11-50 employees

Founded in: 2024

What makes this project exciting?

We are seeking an AI Creative Project Manager to shape the fast-paced, rapidly growing world of mobile micro-drama. Our series—including characters, environments, wardrobe, and overall visual identity—are generated entirely via Generative AI and produced by global partners.

This is not a traditional writing or directing role; instead, you will act as a high-level creative gatekeeper. You will review AI-generated episodes, identify creative bottlenecks, and provide precise direction to elevate the final output.

What makes you a great fit

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Degree in Film, Cinema, or related fields.
  • 5–10 years in long-form, narrative or scripted content, ideally as a Script Supervisor, Script Editor, Director, or Showrunner.
  • Deep understanding of micro-drama dynamics, including dramatic structures, fast pacing, returning genres, character archetypes, and cliffhangers.
  • Strong analytical skills to gauge viewer engagement and translate user behavior into actionable creative direction.
  • Professional working proficiency in English at an intermediate to high level.
  • Familiarity with or strong openness to integrating Gen-AI tools into modern creative pipelines.

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Build and maintain production folders using Gen-AI tools to ensure consistency across characters, locations, and wardrobe.

title: Retail Customer Experience Associate, Roosevelt - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Customer Experience Colleague, you will create exceptional, personalized shopping experiences for our customers. You’ll prioritize customer satisfaction by actively engaging with shoppers across all touchpoints - both in-store and online - and drive cross-category sales to support overall business goals. With a deep understanding of fashion, fit, and function, you will make tailored product recommendations and leverage digital tools to enhance the customer journey. You also will work across different departments daily, often transitioning between multiple areas throughout the day.

In this role, you’ll also play a key part in client relationship building through outreach tools like My Client and social media. Your collaborative approach with peers, store leaders, and brand partners will help identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and elevate the overall customer experience. In addition to service and selling, you’ll support operational excellence through floor readiness, event execution, merchandise setup, and opening/closing procedures.

A positive, can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-caliber service will be key to your success in this role.

How Our Selling Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride, greet teammates with a warm hello, and help ensure the sales floor is clean, organized, and prepared for customers. Before getting started, they review their sales goals, learn about new arrivals and top-selling items, and stay up to date on current trends and promotions - so they’re fully informed and ready to engage, educate, and sell with confidence.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - offering a warm welcome, making eye contact, and creating friendly, personal conversations to create customer relationships to bring the customers back.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem
  • At least 2 years of selling or customer experience preferred

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems that power a global travel platform serving millions of users daily. We own mission-critical domains across inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms. Our systems run with high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations, powered by modern technologies such as Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike, along with strong foundations in CI/CD, automation, and observability. As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end-to-end - from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team.   • Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context

Technical
