  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs & system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
  • Strong coding and problem-solving ability
Beyond the technical bar:

  • Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
  • Experience communicating trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly

title: Copy of Senior Manager, Food Safety and Quality Assurance (FSQA)
description:
About the role:

UPSIDE Foods is building the food system of the future. We produce real meat from animal cells, and we are moving from pre-commercial production toward commercial scale.

This role owns food safety and quality assurance across our production operations, covering both FDA and USDA production. You will be the person accountable for our FDA Food Safety Plan and USDA HACCP plan, our unique integrated quality management system we continue to build from the ground up.

Extending the above, we are in the process of both SQF and ISO-9000 certifications, which you will lead. This is not maintaining an established system. It is designing one, getting an organization of scientists and operators to adopt it, and taking it through certification, all while ensuring regulatory compliance for Food Safety.

This role is for a “working” manager… being on the floor as much as they are at their desk. Multi-tasking from support of basic and challenging floor issues to creating, reviewing all needed documents and data.

If you want a QA role where the systems are already written and your job is to sustain them, this is not it. If you want to build them, read on.


What you'll do:

Food safety systems

  • Own the FSP and HACCP end to end — preventive controls, hazard analysis, critical control points, monitoring, verification, and reassessment under 9 CFR 417
  • Maintain Sanitation Standard Operating Procedures and the sanitation verification program under 9 CFR 416
  • Own the Environmental Monitoring Program (EMP), including zone-based sampling design, trend analysis, and the investigation and corrective action process when results move the wrong direction
  • Maintain preventive controls and the food safety plan for FDA-regulated stages of production under 21 CFR 117
  • Own allergen control, sanitation chemical management, pest control oversight, and the master sanitation schedule
  • Lead recall readiness, including mock recalls, traceability exercises, and hold-and-release procedures

Regulatory compliance

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for USDA-FSIS in-plant inspection personnel and manage the daily working relationship on the USDA production floor.
  • Maintain the establishment's Grant Of Inspection (GOI) and all conditions attached to it
  • Manage regulatory correspondence, including responses to USDA Noncompliance Records, and drive the corrective and preventive actions that close them
  • Own label review and FSIS label approval submissions
  • Lead FDA Inspections and pre-market consultation activity for new cell lines, media formulations, and process changes
  • Track food safety regulatory developments across a category where the rules are still forming

Quality Management System

  • Lead the design, documentation, and rollout of a quality management system conforming to FDA and USDA-FSIS food safety standards
  • Buildout the documented information architecture — document control, revision control, record retention, and the approval workflows that keep them current
  • Implement risk-based thinking as a working practice rather than a paperwork exercise, including risk and opportunity registers tied to actual process decisions
  • Stand up the internal audit program: auditor training and qualification, audit schedule, audit execution, and finding closure
  • Establish the management review process and prepare the inputs that make it a decision-making forum rather than a status report
  • Own nonconforming output control, the CAPA system, and root cause analysis methodology — and coach the organization on using them properly
  • Build supplier and external provider controls, including qualification criteria, approved supplier lists, incoming material controls, and performance monitoring
  • Own calibration and measurement traceability across production and laboratory equipment
  • Select and manage the accredited certification body, and lead the organization through Stage 1 and Stage 2 certification audits
  • Drive continual improvement as an operating habit, using data from audits, nonconformances, customer feedback, and process metrics

Team and cross-functional leadership

  • Lead, develop, and grow the FSQA team, including hiring as the function scales
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Facilities, and R&D so quality requirements are built into processes rather than inspected in afterward
  • Own FSQA training content and delivery for production personnel, including onboarding and annual refreshers
  • Serve as a quality voice in change control, ensuring process and equipment changes are assessed for food safety and regulatory impact before implementation
  • Report quality performance to leadership with metrics that drive decisions

Qualifications:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Biology, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 7+ years in FDA food safety and quality assurance, including 3+ years leading people
  • PCQI certified with experience building and implementing Food Safety Plans
  • Working knowledge of 9 CFR 416 and 417, and 21 CFR 117
  • Hands-on experience implementing or substantially building a quality management system — ISO 9001, a GFSI-benchmarked scheme, or equivalent
  • Proven ability to write clear procedures that people actually follow, and to get adoption in an organization that has not previously worked to a formal system

Preferred

  • Direct experience in a USDA-FSIS inspected establishment, including day-to-day interaction with in-plant inspection personnel
  • HACCP certification and demonstrated ownership of a HACCP plan through reassessment
  • ISO 9001:2015 Lead Auditor certification
  • Experience taking an organization through initial ISO 9001 certification
  • Background in cell culture, fermentation, biopharmaceutical, or other aseptic manufacturing environments
  • Experience in a startup or scale-up moving from pilot to commercial production
  • Familiarity with GFSI schemes (SQF, BRCGS, FSSC 22000)
  • Statistical process control and data analysis capability

Working conditions:

This role is based on site and requires daily presence in production areas. Expect to gown into controlled environments, work around processing equipment, and be available for occasional off-shift or weekend coverage during production runs, audits, or incidents. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Compensation Range: $150,000 - 170,000

*Pay may vary depending on factors including job-related knowledge and skills.


UPSIDE Foods is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Our company-wide mission is to create a product for everyone, so we are deeply committed to having teams and leaders that reflect this mission.

title: Senior platform engineer, ai & fabrics
description:

Technologie

Hybrid Work Model

BMO is building the platform capabilities that make enterprise AI safe, governed, and scalable. We are seeking experienced Senior Engineers to help build and operate the core infrastructure that governs how AI runs at BMO: the AI Gateway, Policy Engine, Identity Fabric, AI Registry, Guardrails Runtime, and AI Observability.

This is a build-and-run engineering role. You will design, implement, and operate significant components of these platform capabilities; writing production code, building integrations, and helping run what you. You will not build the AI models or applications themselves (those are domain-owned); you help build the governed platform they run on and the runtime evidence that proves they run within policy, across AWS, Azure, and Microsoft AI surfaces, under OSFI and OCC expectations.

You are a hands-on engineer with a strong production track record who takes ownership of your components, cares about operability and correctness, and collaborates well within your team. You work within technical direction and standards set by the team's Principal Engineers and Leads, contribute to design discussions, and mentor more junior engineers. You are energized by hardening and scaling real engineering assets; an existing developer portal, an AI registry, a body of policy-as-code, and gateway integrations into enterprise-grade capabilities.

What You'll Build & Operate

Working within one of the platform squads, you will build and operate components of one or more of the following:

Enterprise AI Control Plane

  • Portal & Registry: features of the AI Registry (agents, models, tools, channels, evaluations), self-service onboarding flows, and lifecycle workflows; integrations with external registries.
  • Policy Engine: components of the policy-as-code infrastructure (Cedar/OPA), the compilation pipeline, GitOps-based distribution, and the policy simulation sandbox.
  • Observability & Audit: telemetry pipeline components, OpenTelemetry GenAI instrumentation, trace correlation, and audit-lake ingestion supporting regulator-ready evidence.
  • Governance & Lifecycle: certification workflow components, compliance-scoring automation, and evidence-generation tooling.

AI Domain Orchestration

  • Gateway Runtime: components of the inline enforcement engine: request-time policy evaluation, routing, residency, budget/quota, and circuit breaking, built to strict latency budgets; domain-hub deployment across AWS and Azure.
  • Guardrails Runtime: stages of the safety pipeline (input moderation, prompt-injection defense, PII, output validation, hallucination detection, policy enforcement), including bilingual EN/FR support.
  • Identity Fabric: components of workload identity for AI (SPIFFE/SPIRE), token-exchange flows, trust-boundary configuration, Entra Agent ID integration, and cross-cloud token federation.

Note on scope: Two of these platforms (Identity Fabric, Policy Engine) are built with AI as the incubation context but are designed to transition to bank-wide ownership at maturity.

What You'll Do

  • Own and deliver components/features within your squad's capability, design (with guidance), implement, test, ship, and help operate in production.
  • Participate in on-call for the services your team runs.
  • Build APIs, MCP Servers, integrations, and tooling through which domains, DevOps pipelines, and enterprise systems consume platform capabilities.
  • Write clean, well-tested, well-instrumented code; build operability in from the start (metrics, tracing, SLO-aware design).
  • Ensure your components produce the runtime evidence connecting AI activity to policy enforcement, identity, and lineage for model-risk and regulatory review.
  • Contribute to design discussions and technical decisions, applying standards and patterns set by Principal Engineers and Leads.
  • Mentor junior engineers and collaborate actively across the squad.
  • Partner day-to-day with AI Developer Experience, AI Security, and AI SDLC counterparts as needed to deliver your work.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (Master's an asset).
  • 5+ years of software/platform engineering experience, including hands-on experience building and operating production services.
  • Experience with production operations (deployments, monitoring, incident response, on-call), ideally in a regulated industry (financial services an asset).
  • Hands-on depth in at least one of: API/gateway services; policy-as-code/authorization; workload identity/security; observability/telemetry; audit/data platforms.

Required Core Skills

Platform Engineering Foundations

  • Solid software-engineering fundamentals: clean, tested, maintainable code; API design; and an understanding of distributed-systems concepts (latency, resilience, availability).
  • Strong programming skills (Python and/or Go preferred; TypeScript/Java an asset) for building services, APIs, and integrations.
  • Working proficiency in cloud-native development on AWS and/or Azure: containers/Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation/ARM).
  • Practical CI/CD, GitOps, and DevSecOps experience; Git-based workflows (Bitbucket/GitHub), Jira, Confluence.

Capability-Specific Depth (one or more)

  • Policy/Authorization: Cedar, OPA/Rego, or comparable authorization systems.
  • Identity/Security: SPIFFE/SPIRE, mTLS, OAuth/OIDC, token exchange, or federated identity.
  • Observability/Audit: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, Dynatrace/Splunk or equivalents, immutable/audit data stores.
  • Gateway/Guardrails: API gateway usage/development, LLM routing/abstraction, prompt-injection/PII defenses, or AI evaluation.
  • Registry/Portal: service catalogues, asset registries, lifecycle/onboarding workflows.

GenAI & Governance Context

  • Working knowledge of GenAI platform patterns (LLM/AI gateways, RAG, agentic patterns, embeddings, guardrails) sufficient to build supporting infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML tooling (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, SageMaker, MLflow) and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) an asset.
  • Awareness of Responsible AI, AI/data governance, privacy, cloud security, and IAM as applied to AI workloads.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (Professional an asset) / ML - Specialty
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate / Azure Solutions Architect Expert

title: Lager Souschef til Nailster i Hørning
description:
Har du energi, drive og lyst til at være med til at drive et effektivt e-commerce lager, hvor der hele tiden arbejdes på at gøre tingene lidt smartere, hurtigere og bedre?

Nailster søger en lagersouschef, der kan blive lagerchefens højre hånd og være med til at sikre en effektiv, struktureret og velfungerende lagerdrift på vores lager i Hørning.

Vi leder ikke kun efter en, der kan holde styr på dagens opgaver.

Vi leder efter en person med energi og liv i øjnene, som tager naturligt ansvar, går forrest og motiveres af at skabe flow, struktur og forbedringer. En person, der lægger mærke til, hvis noget kan gøres smartere – og som gør noget ved det.

Din rolle

Som lagersouschef får du en central og meget hands-on rolle i den daglige drift.

Du bliver lagerchefens stedfortræder og nærmeste sparringspartner og skal kunne tage ansvar for lagerdriften, når lagerchefen ikke er til stede.

Samtidig er det vigtigt, at du ikke er typen, der leder fra sidelinjen. Du skal være synlig i driften, kende processerne og være klar til selv at tage fat, når der er behov for det.

Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder bliver blandt andet:

  • At være lagerchefens højre hånd og stedfortræder
  • At planlægge, prioritere og koordinere den daglige drift
  • At sikre, at dagens opgaver, deadlines og målsætninger bliver nået
  • At fordele opgaver og skabe tydelig retning for lagerteamet
  • At sikre et effektivt flow fra varemodtagelse til færdig kundeordre
  • At følge op på kvalitet, produktivitet og effektivitet
  • At identificere flaskehalse og forbedringsmuligheder
  • At arbejde aktivt med lean, optimering og smartere arbejdsgange
  • At sikre høj standard for orden, oprydning og rengøring på lageret
  • At hjælpe med oplæring og udvikling af medarbejdere
  • At tage ansvar og træffe beslutninger i den daglige drift
  • At gå forrest og selv tage del i arbejdet, når situationen kræver det

Det er vigtigt for os, hvordan du tænker

Vi ønsker hele tiden at drive vores lager bedre.

Derfor leder vi efter en person, som ikke bare accepterer:

"Sådan plejer vi at gøre."

Du skal have lyst til at stille spørgsmål som:

Kan vi gøre det her hurtigere?
Kan vi fjerne et unødvendigt step?
Hvorfor opstår den her flaskehals?
Hvordan skaber vi et bedre flow?
Hvordan sikrer vi, at lageret altid fremstår ryddeligt og organiseret?

Du behøver ikke komme med en lang uddannelse i lean eller logistik, men du skal have interessen og mindsettet til hele tiden at lede efter forbedringer.

Vi forestiller os, at du

Har høj energi, naturligt drive og lyst til at tage ansvar.

Du er typen, der selv får øje på, hvad der mangler, og som ikke nødvendigvis venter på, at nogen fortæller dig, hvad næste opgave er.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • Har naturlige lederegenskaber og tør tage ansvar
  • Kan skabe energi og retning omkring dig
  • Er struktureret og har et stærkt overblik
  • Går op i orden, struktur og en arbejdsplads, der fungerer
  • Er nysgerrig på, hvordan processer kan optimeres
  • Er tydelig og ordentlig i din kommunikation
  • Kan motivere mennesker og få et team til at arbejde mod samme mål
  • Bevarer overblikket, når tempoet er højt
  • Er løsningsorienteret og handlekraftig
  • Er stabil og har en høj arbejdsmoral
  • Selv er klar til at smøge ærmerne op og tage fat

Erfaring fra lager, logistik, e-commerce, produktion eller en anden driftsorienteret virksomhed vil være en fordel.

Det vigtigste er dog dit mindset: Du skal have lyst til at drive en effektiv operation og få en tilfredsstillelse ud af, at tingene spiller.

Hverdagen hos Nailster

Nailster er en e-commerce virksomhed i vækst, og vores lager er en helt central del af kundeoplevelsen.

Der kan være stor forskel på en almindelig dag og eksempelvis Black Friday, julehandel eller andre store kampagneperioder.

Derfor skal du trives i en hverdag, hvor der nogle gange skal træffes hurtige beslutninger, flyttes rundt på ressourcer og findes løsninger undervejs.

Til gengæld får du også mulighed for reelt at påvirke, hvordan vi driver vores lager, og være med til at udvikle vores processer i takt med, at virksomheden vokser.

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle med reel indflydelse på den daglige lagerdrift
  • Rollen som lagerchefens højre hånd og stedfortræder
  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på arbejdsgange, struktur og processer
  • En virksomhed i vækst, hvor der er kort vej fra idé til handling
  • En energisk arbejdsplads med højt tempo og godt samarbejde
  • En hverdag med både ansvar, variation og praktisk drift
  • Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer og gældende overenskomst

Arbejdstid

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling.

Arbejdstiden placeres typisk på hverdage mellem kl. 7.00 og 18.00.

Som en del af lagerets ledelse forventer vi samtidig en vis fleksibilitet. I særligt travle perioder kan der forekomme længere arbejdsdage samt enkelte weekendvagter hen over året.

Ansøgning

Kan du se dig selv som den person, der sammen med vores lagerchef får mennesker, processer og drift til at spille?

Så send din ansøgning og dit CV til lagerchef Lau Sørensen på:

ls@nailster.com

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Postdoctoral Researcher – Disability Employment Policy
description:
The Burton Blatt Institute (BBI) brings together researchers, evaluators, trainers, and practitioners to address the most pressing challenges facing people with disabilities. Our work moves in two directions: our research and evaluation produce the evidence, and our training, technical assistance, outreach, and consulting put that evidence into practice. This combination allows us to inform policy, shape practices, and build capacity in the communities we serve.

BBI invites applications from highly qualified recent Ph.D. graduates who possess demonstrated interest in pursuing a career in disability policy research. This is a full-time research position, located at Syracuse University campus. The Postdoctoral Scholar will be deeply engaged in BBI’s disability employment-sponsored projects and support data gathering, analysis, writing, and publication. The position will report to BBI’s Director of Research and Research Assistant Professor.

This position is part of a bargaining unit and is represented by a union, SEIU Local 200 United.

For 30 years, we've been on a mission to change banking for good. Since 2014, Capital One Canada’s software studio has grown from a team of 10 to a team of over 250. Here are a few of the ways we’re helping people take control of their credit:

We build our own products and release them with a speed and agility that allows us to get new customer experiences to market quickly. Preferred Qualifications:

Working at Capital One.

    Whether you’re looking to upskill, pivot into new business areas, or master your craft, you’ll have access to tools and mentorship to reach your potential and define your career trajectory.

  • Find your rhythm:

    We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.

  • Benefits built for your life:

    We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in annual tuition subsidies.

You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.

Automation & Technical Integration

Develop and support Power Apps solutions for project and portfolio management activities.

Support integrations among Microsoft Project Server, SharePoint, Power BI, SAP, and other enterprise systems.

Use SQL and Python for reporting, data validation, and process automation.

Collaborate with PMO, IT, Finance, Project Controls, and partners.

Maintain system and process documentation and stay current with relevant PPM practices and Microsoft technologies.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in information systems, Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related discipline

2–5 years of experience administering Microsoft Project Server or Project Online in a PMO, SPMO, Project Controls, or Portfolio Management environment

2+ years of experience developing Power BI reports and supporting business process automations.

Understanding of project scheduling, resource management, and portfolio governance practices.

Knowledge of cost controlling (with SAP) and risk management (with ARM)

Microsoft Project Server / Project Online, Microsoft Project Professional, and Project Web App (PWA)

SharePoint and Microsoft Teams

Power BI, DAX, Power Query,

Power Automate and Power Apps

SQL and Python for reporting, data validation, and automation

Working knowledge of REST APIs and enterprise-system integration

title: Senior Customer AI Engineer - Token Factory
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Customer AI Engineer – Token Factory based in France.

Join an innovative AI infrastructure environment focused on helping businesses bring advanced AI applications from experimentation to reliable production at scale. In this role, you will bridge engineering, delivery, and customer success, ensuring AI workloads perform efficiently and reliably in real-world environments. You will guide customers through the transition from proof of concept to production while optimizing performance, scalability, cost, and system reliability. Working closely with customer engineering teams and internal product and infrastructure specialists, you will troubleshoot complex challenges and deliver practical technical solutions. You will also play a key role in managing production incidents and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to combine deep technical expertise, customer collaboration, and end-to-end ownership while contributing to the evolution of modern AI infrastructure.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the transition from proof of concept to production

    • Own the customer journey from initial proof of concept (PoC) through production deployment and ongoing scaling.

    • Ensure customer AI workloads are deployed successfully, remain stable, and scale to meet evolving business requirements.

    • Accelerate time-to-production and time-to-value by identifying and addressing technical obstacles throughout implementation.

    • Optimize AI workload performance and reliability

      • Develop a thorough understanding of customer architectures, AI use cases, and infrastructure requirements.

      • Monitor and improve inference performance, including latency, throughput, resource utilization, and cost efficiency.

      • Identify performance bottlenecks, investigate root causes, and implement practical solutions to improve system reliability and scalability.

      • Apply best practices for inference frameworks and AI infrastructure to support efficient production workloads.

      • Serve as a trusted technical partner

        • Work directly with customer engineering teams, machine learning specialists, and other technical stakeholders to ensure successful AI deployments.

        • Provide guidance on implementation best practices, performance optimization, troubleshooting, and production readiness.

        • Translate complex technical challenges into clear recommendations and actionable solutions.

        • Collaborate with Solution Architects and internal engineering teams to align customer requirements with platform capabilities.

        • Coordinate production incidents and technical risks

          • Act as a primary technical point of contact for production-related issues and deployment challenges.

          • Coordinate incident investigation and resolution with internal Product, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams.

          • Communicate clearly with customers during high-pressure situations, providing timely updates and driving issues toward resolution.

          • Identify potential risks proactively and implement measures to minimize disruption to customer workloads.

          • Drive continuous improvement and customer outcomes

            • Identify opportunities to optimize existing deployments, improve customer outcomes, and expand the effective use of AI infrastructure.

            • Gather structured feedback from real-world customer deployments and communicate insights to Product and Infrastructure teams.

            • Contribute to improvements in platform capabilities, deployment practices, and operational processes.

            • Help develop scalable approaches that improve the overall customer experience and support long-term adoption.

              • Requirements:

              • Practical experience with AI inference frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT, or similar technologies, with an understanding of their application in production environments.

              • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or high-load applications, including the technical challenges associated with scalable production deployments.

              • Familiarity with AI and machine learning workloads, particularly large language models (LLMs), model inference, and the infrastructure required to serve them efficiently.

              • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, investigate system behavior, identify performance bottlenecks, and develop effective solutions.

              • Experience working directly with technical customers, such as software engineers, machine learning teams, or infrastructure specialists.

              • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and adapt communication to different audiences.

              • A strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

              • Ability to manage multiple customer engagements, competing priorities, and technical challenges in a fast-moving environment.

              • A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset, with the confidence to investigate problems independently and coordinate the right resources when needed.

              • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with customer engineering teams, Solution Architects, Product teams, and Infrastructure specialists.

              • The following experience is considered an advantage:

                • Hands-on experience with GPU workloads, AI infrastructure, or large-scale model inference environments.

                • Previous experience in solutions engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), or technical support within business-to-business (B2B) technology environments.

                • Experience helping customers deploy, optimize, and maintain complex cloud-based or AI-powered applications in production.

                  • Benefits:

                  • Competitive compensation: An attractive compensation package aligned with your expertise and experience.

                  • Career growth: Opportunities to develop your technical expertise and progress professionally in a rapidly evolving AI infrastructure environment.

                  • Continuous learning: Exposure to advanced AI technologies, inference frameworks, and real-world production challenges.

                  • Remote work flexibility: Work remotely from within Europe, with the opportunity to manage your work effectively and independently.

                  • Ownership and autonomy: Take responsibility for customer outcomes and influence technical decisions that directly affect production success.

                  • Collaborative culture: Work alongside talented engineers and specialists in an international, innovative, and fast-moving environment.

                  • Meaningful technical impact: Help businesses move AI applications into production and improve the performance, reliability, and cost efficiency of their workloads.

                  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with customer engineering teams and internal specialists across product development, infrastructure, and AI engineering.

                  • Opportunity to shape AI infrastructure: Contribute insights from real-world customer deployments to improve platform capabilities and support the future of AI.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Scientist based in Switzerland.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a key role in shaping business strategy through advanced analytics, experimentation, and data-driven insights. You will investigate the factors influencing customer acquisition, conversion, monetization, and retention, helping teams make smarter decisions and accelerate sustainable growth. Working at the intersection of Data Science, Product, and Growth, you will turn complex business questions into actionable recommendations with measurable impact. You will own analytical projects end to end, from working with raw data and building reliable data models to applying statistical methods and communicating findings. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders, you will challenge assumptions, uncover new opportunities, and influence strategic priorities. This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise, commercial thinking, and analytical ownership within a collaborative, international, and innovation-driven environment.

Accountabilities

  • Lead business-critical investigations across the customer journey, from acquisition and activation to conversion, monetization, and retention, translating findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Analyze marketing channel performance, attribution, and incrementality across SEO, paid search, CRM, and emerging channels to evaluate investment effectiveness and identify growth opportunities.

  • Design, implement, and evaluate A/B tests in collaboration with Product and Growth teams, applying statistical analysis, causal inference, and quasi-experimental methods where traditional experimentation is not feasible.

  • Build, test, document, and maintain reliable, production-ready data models using SQL, Python, and data transformation tools, ensuring the quality and integrity of analytical foundations.

  • Go beyond descriptive reporting to explain business performance, identify underlying drivers, challenge assumptions, and recommend concrete actions that improve business outcomes.

  • Investigate unexpected changes in traffic, conversion rates, and customer behavior, developing analytical frameworks, predictive models, and data products that help teams identify and act on opportunities faster.

  • Partner with Product Managers, Growth specialists, engineers, and senior leadership to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical approaches and measurable results.

  • Take ownership of analytical projects from initial problem definition and data preparation through modeling, interpretation, stakeholder communication, and implementation of recommendations.

    • Requirements:

    • Significant experience in applied Data Science or advanced analytics, ideally within a SaaS, digital product, product-led growth, or marketing-driven business, with a proven ability to influence business decisions.

    • Advanced SQL and data modeling skills, including experience designing, building, testing, documenting, and maintaining reliable data models. Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tools is highly valued.

    • Strong Python programming skills, with the ability to conduct statistical analyses, develop predictive models, and build practical data products.

    • Solid knowledge of statistics, experimentation, and causal inference, including experience designing and evaluating A/B tests and selecting appropriate methods for complex analytical questions.

    • Experience in Growth or Marketing Analytics, with a strong understanding of acquisition channels, conversion funnels, attribution, incrementality, and customer behavior. Experience analyzing SEO or paid search performance is a plus.

    • Strong product and commercial acumen, with the ability to connect metrics to business outcomes, prioritize high-value questions, and identify opportunities for improvement.

    • An end-to-end ownership mindset, with the ability to manage the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data and modeling to interpretation, communication, and actionable recommendations.

    • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, enabling you to explain complex analytical findings clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • A curious, proactive, and independent approach, with a willingness to challenge assumptions, explore unfamiliar problems, and go beyond the initial request.

    • Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an international working environment.

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience in subscription-based or product-led growth businesses, particularly in conversion optimization, pricing, retention, or customer lifetime value.

      • Hands-on experience with marketing incrementality, attribution modeling, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), or quasi-experimental techniques.

      • Experience developing analytical frameworks or data products that are adopted and used by business teams.

      • Previous experience in a lean, high-impact Data team, independently owning both analytical projects and the underlying data models.

      • A proven track record of influencing Product, Growth, or Marketing strategy through rigorous analysis and clear, evidence-based recommendations.

        • Benefits:

        • Meaningful business impact: Contribute to a global digital product used by more than 60 million people every month, with your analyses directly informing business performance and growth.

        • Autonomy and ownership: Take responsibility for complex analytical challenges from start to finish and see your recommendations translate into real business decisions.

        • Collaborative environment: Work closely with experienced Data, Product, and Growth leaders in a team that values curiosity, knowledge sharing, and thoughtful decision-making.

        • Remote flexibility: Enjoy a remote working environment across supported European locations, with a hybrid option for team members based in Zurich.

        • Generous annual leave: Benefit from 30 vacation days each year.

        • Sabbatical leave: Access extended leave after more than two years with the company.

        • Parental support: Receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave at 100% of salary for all new parents.

        • Professional development: Access an annual personal development budget of up to CHF 2,000, plus time off for courses and training.

        • Continuous learning: Benefit from internal knowledge-sharing sessions and external coaching opportunities during working hours to strengthen technical and interpersonal skills.

        • Innovation opportunities: Participate in dedicated hack days to experiment, collaborate, and develop new ideas.

        • International exposure: Work with a diverse, global team in an established digital product environment that combines scale with the agility of a lean organization.

Assist commercial lenders in managing member business relationships including loans, deposits and other related services.


Essential Job Duties:

  • Initiate the generation of documentation for both complex and non-complex business loans and ensure that such loans comply with all applicable rules and regulations.
  • Initiate complex loan request process; obtain applicant data and all pertinent codes and input into loan software system. Order title policies, appraisals, UCC reports, and other documents needed to originate business loans.

  • Review complex loan origination and closing documents to verify accuracy of loan payments and loan values, and to ensure that the loans comply with SLFCU guidelines.
  • Close non-complex loans.
  • Set up and maintain business loan files for documentation and compliance, title work and UCC filings.
  • Ensure all audit and security policies and procedures are followed in accordance with Credit Union policy and federal regulations.

### DESCRIPTION

**WE STRONGLY ENCOURAGE APPLICANTS TO READ THE JOB ANNOUNCEMENT IN ITS ENTIRETY**

**BEFORE SUBMITTING AN APPLICATION FOR THIS POSITION.**

**____________________________________________________________**

**The City of Torrance recognizes the principles of diversity and inclusion, and strives to ensure equal opportunities for its workforce, applicants and community members. If you are a person who wants to make a difference, give back to your community, and be a voice for change, apply to the City of Torrance today.** **The** [**City of Torrance**](https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/e11911255ee04ae9aa83ec7a980e4e8d) **is recruiting for a** [**Planning Associate**](https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/torranceca/classspecs/newprint/1134248) **to be part of the** [**Community Development**](https://www.torranceca.gov/Government/Departments-Offices/Departments-Offices/Community-Development) **team!**

**The Department**

The **Community Development Department** oversees and initiates plans for: economic growth; commercial, industrial, and residential development and re-development; zoning; code enforcement; permitting; and building inspections.  The Department has 70 employees over 10 different divisions: Administration, Development Services, Environmental & Noise Abatement, Downtown, Housing, GIS, Plan Check, Building Inspection, Engineering, and Permit Center.

**The Division**

The [**Planning Division**](https://www.torranceca.gov/Government/Departments-Offices/Departments-Offices/Community-Development/Planning-Division) is committed to urban planning and design to provide an attractive, safe, and enriching environment that assures a high quality of life. The Planning Division is comprised of two sections:

**Development Review** is focused on reviewing development plans for conformance with land use policies and standards, and is responsible for processing development applications, conducting environmental review, and responding to inquiries on zoning and land use.  Development Review also provides staff support to the Planning Commission and to the City Council.

**Comprehensive Planning** is focused on developing plans, policies and programs to guide development in Torrance, and is responsible for maintaining the General Plan, conducting special studies related to land use, and collaborating with regional and state agencies.  Comprehensive Planning also provides staff support to the Historic Preservation Commission, the Planning Commission and the City Council.

**The Position**

As part of the Planning Division team, the **Planning Associate** performs complex professional planning and housing tasks and interprets and explains zoning and housing regulations.  The **Planning** **Associate** collects, computes, records and interprets land use, demographic, economic and other data for planning  purposes; conducts studies which involve office and field research and the interpretation of data; prepares  maps, charts, and other graphic materials to be used in planning studies; writes comprehensive reports on  zoning variances, conditional use permits, redevelopment activities and other applications to be submitted  to the Planning Commission and City Council; makes oral presentations to the City Council,  Redevelopment Agency, City Commissions, and committees; and performs related work as required.

For more information about the duties of the position, click [**here**](https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/torranceca/classspecs/newprint/1134248) **.**

### QUALIFICATION GUIDELINES

**Education and Experience**

Graduation from an accredited college or university with a major in city or regional planning, architecture, geography, landscape architecture, engineering, public administration, or a closely related field.

Two years of responsible professional urban planning experience which includes technical work in one of the following areas: General Plan Preparation and Maintenance, Design/Development Review Administration, CEQA Administration, or Redevelopment/Housing Administration.

A Master's Degree in Planning may be substituted for one year of required experience.

**License and/or Certificates**

A valid California Class C Driver's License is normally required.

**Ideal Candidate:**

_Successful candidates will possess the following:_

- Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey complex information, prepare professional written materials, and communicate effectively with a diverse range of audiences;
- Excellent public speaking and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently present information, recommendations, and project updates to staff, stakeholders, community members, commissions, and elected officials;
- Extensive knowledge of municipal planning principles, practices, policies, and processes, with the ability to apply this knowledge to a variety of planning, development, and community-related initiative;
- Thorough knowledge of the techniques and processes involved in developing long-term projects and preparing redevelopment plans, including the ability to research, analyze, coordinate, and communicate planning concepts and recommendations;
- Excellent time management and organizational skills, with the ability to effectively prioritize workload, meet established deadlines, and manage multiple assignments and projects concurrently;
- High comfort level and proficiency with technology and digital tools; and
- Flexibility and availability to work occasional evenings and weekends, as required to attend meetings, public hearings, community events, or other work-related activities.

### HOW TO APPLY & EXAM PROCESS

Interested candidates must submit an online application and supplemental questionnaire at [www.TorranceCA.Gov/Jobs](http://www.torranceca.gov/Jobs). First review of the applications will be those received by **Sund** **ay, October 25, 2026, at 11:59 p.m.** Application submission will remain open until the position is filled. If a sufficient number of qualified applications are received by the first review date, there is a possibility that the recruitment may close at that time.

Only those candidates who best meet the City and Department's needs will be invited to participate in the examination process which will consist of the following components:

Visit [www.TorranceCA.Gov](http://www.torranceca.gov/) to find out more information about the City of Torrance.

Applicants with disabilities who require special testing arrangements must contact Human Resources prior to the examination date(s). If you have a disability for which you require an accommodation, please contact us at (310) 618-2915 prior to the test date.

title: Senior Tax Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Tax Analyst based in United States .

In this hands-on role, you will support the development of a scalable, well-controlled tax compliance function covering multiple jurisdictions across North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region. You will take ownership of recurring indirect tax compliance, including sales and use tax, GST/HST, and VAT, while helping bring key processes in-house. Working closely with Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Legal, People/Payroll, Operations, and external tax advisors, you will ensure accurate filings, timely payments, and reliable financial records. You will also investigate tax discrepancies, maintain compliance documentation, and support audits, notices, and new jurisdiction registrations. This is an opportunity for a detail-oriented tax professional to strengthen internal controls, improve tax processes through technology, and contribute to a growing international finance function.

Accountabilities

  • Manage recurring indirect tax compliance across U.S. sales and use tax, Canadian GST/HST, EU VAT/OSS, Australian GST, New Zealand GST, and additional jurisdictions as the business expands.

  • Support the transition of recurring indirect tax compliance from external providers to the internal tax team, beginning with the January 2027 compliance cycle.

  • Prepare monthly and quarterly tax returns, supporting workpapers, and related documentation, ensuring all filings and payments are accurate and completed on time.

  • Extract, validate, and reconcile tax data from NetSuite, Avalara, payment processors, and other systems, investigating discrepancies between taxes collected, reported, paid, and recorded in the general ledger.

  • Prepare tax journal entries, accruals, adjustments, and balance sheet reconciliations while maintaining complete and organized supporting records.

  • Maintain the tax compliance calendar, including registrations, filing frequencies, tax identification numbers, portal access, deadlines, and filing and payment confirmations.

  • Coordinate with tax technology providers and external advisors on filings, data requests, tax notices, registrations, taxability questions, and outstanding compliance matters.

  • Assist with state, federal, and international tax notices, audits, and information requests, ensuring correspondence and resolutions are properly documented.

  • Support federal, state, and international direct tax compliance by gathering data, preparing workpapers, and coordinating returns, extensions, estimated payments, and tax provision activities with external advisors.

  • Work with People and Payroll teams on state tax registrations, payroll tax notices, withholding compliance, and related filings as needed.

  • Research taxability, nexus requirements, filing obligations, and new jurisdiction requirements, supporting registrations and the implementation of new compliance processes.

  • Identify opportunities to improve tax processes, documentation, internal controls, and automation through effective use of Avalara, NetSuite, and other tax technology.

  • Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, People/Payroll, and Operations on tax-related initiatives, forecasts, exposure analyses, and ad hoc projects.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field.

    • 4–7 years of progressive tax experience in a corporate tax department, public accounting firm, or advisory environment.

    • Strong hands-on experience in tax compliance, account reconciliations, and Excel, with the ability to manage recurring monthly and quarterly deadlines across multiple jurisdictions.

    • Experience with U.S. sales and use tax and/or international VAT/GST compliance is strongly preferred.

    • Experience with Avalara and NetSuite, particularly tax data extraction, reconciliation, and compliance workflows, is strongly preferred.

    • Experience supporting corporate income tax compliance and coordinating with external tax advisors is an advantage.

    • CPA, Enrolled Agent (EA), Master of Science in Taxation (MST), or a comparable tax or accounting credential is preferred but not required.

    • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail and accountability for deliverables.

    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across finance and operational teams as well as with external advisors.

    • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing deadlines, document procedures, and contribute to building scalable compliance processes.

      • Benefits:

      • Annual base salary of USD $95,000–$120,000, depending on geographic location, relevant experience, skills, and other job-related factors.

      • Eligibility for a performance-based bonus, subject to the applicable plan terms.

      • Flexible working arrangements, ranging from fully remote to hybrid, depending on the role and team setup.

      • Seven company-paid holidays.

      • Generous family leave policies.

      • Front-loaded paid time off.

      • Competitive 401(k) matching for eligible full-time employees.

      • Health, dental, and vision insurance for eligible full-time employees.

      • Food and grocery budget.

      • Contributions toward health and wellness.

      • Additional vacation encouragement, including a bonus for taking five consecutive days off.

      • Collaborative team culture supported by regular communication and digital collaboration tools.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Scientist based in Spain.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a key role in shaping business strategy through advanced analytics, experimentation, and data-driven insights. You will investigate the factors influencing customer acquisition, conversion, monetization, and retention, helping teams make smarter decisions and accelerate sustainable growth. Working at the intersection of Data Science, Product, and Growth, you will turn complex business questions into actionable recommendations with measurable impact. You will own analytical projects end to end, from working with raw data and building reliable data models to applying statistical methods and communicating findings. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders, you will challenge assumptions, uncover new opportunities, and influence strategic priorities. This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise, commercial thinking, and analytical ownership within a collaborative, international, and innovation-driven environment.

Accountabilities

  • Lead business-critical investigations across the customer journey, from acquisition and activation to conversion, monetization, and retention, translating findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Analyze marketing channel performance, attribution, and incrementality across SEO, paid search, CRM, and emerging channels to evaluate investment effectiveness and identify growth opportunities.

  • Design, implement, and evaluate A/B tests in collaboration with Product and Growth teams, applying statistical analysis, causal inference, and quasi-experimental methods where traditional experimentation is not feasible.

  • Build, test, document, and maintain reliable, production-ready data models using SQL, Python, and data transformation tools, ensuring the quality and integrity of analytical foundations.

  • Go beyond descriptive reporting to explain business performance, identify underlying drivers, challenge assumptions, and recommend concrete actions that improve business outcomes.

  • Investigate unexpected changes in traffic, conversion rates, and customer behavior, developing analytical frameworks, predictive models, and data products that help teams identify and act on opportunities faster.

  • Partner with Product Managers, Growth specialists, engineers, and senior leadership to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical approaches and measurable results.

    • Strong Python programming skills, with the ability to conduct statistical analyses, develop predictive models, and build practical data products.

    • Solid knowledge of statistics, experimentation, and causal inference, including experience designing and evaluating A/B tests and selecting appropriate methods for complex analytical questions.

    • Experience in Growth or Marketing Analytics, with a strong understanding of acquisition channels, conversion funnels, attribution, incrementality, and customer behavior. Experience analyzing SEO or paid search performance is a plus.

    • Strong product and commercial acumen, with the ability to connect metrics to business outcomes, prioritize high-value questions, and identify opportunities for improvement.

    • An end-to-end ownership mindset, with the ability to manage the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data and modeling to interpretation, communication, and actionable recommendations.

    • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, enabling you to explain complex analytical findings clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • A curious, proactive, and independent approach, with a willingness to challenge assumptions, explore unfamiliar problems, and go beyond the initial request.

    • Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an international working environment.

      • Hands-on experience with marketing incrementality, attribution modeling, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), or quasi-experimental techniques.

      • Experience developing analytical frameworks or data products that are adopted and used by business teams.

      • Previous experience in a lean, high-impact Data team, independently owning both analytical projects and the underlying data models.

title: Home Study Caseworker
description:
SUMMARY:

The Home Study Caseworker is responsible for conducting comprehensive assessments of individuals and families seeking to adopt, ensuring compliance with all state, federal, and agency regulations. This role involves evaluating home environments, interviewing prospective adoptive parents, verifying documentation, and preparing detailed reports to support adoption readiness and placement decisions.

JOB DUTIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Conduct in-depth home study assessments for individuals and couples seeking to adopt, ensuring compliance with state, federal, and agency requirements.
  • Interview prospective adoptive parents and household members to evaluate parenting capacity, motivations for adoption, and overall readiness.

  • Educate families on the adoption process, including legal requirements, matching procedures, post-placement expectations, and trauma-informed parenting.
  • Write thorough and objective home study reports that include social histories, evaluations, and recommendations for approval.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with prospective adoptive families to guide them through the pre-adoption process.
  • Address concerns or gaps identified during the home study and work with families to develop plans for readiness.
  • Ensure all documentation is completed accurately and submitted within required timeframes.
  • Collaborate with legal teams, adoption specialists, and placement coordinators to support matching and placement decisions.
  • Provide support and referrals for pre-adoption training, counseling, or resources as needed.
  • Attend trainings, team meetings, and professional development opportunities to remain current on adoption practices and policies.
  • Perform other duties and special projects assigned to support organizational objectives and enhance operational efficiency.

About the Job
This is a field-based, relationship-building role with a product that’s genuinely easy to believe in. You’ll drive a planned route on Indianapolis north/south side and nearby suburbs every day, introducing our repair service and building relationships with the property managers and facility managers who keep calling back once they’ve seen what we can do. No sales background required — you’ll be given a proven script and real coaching from day one.

Perks and Benefits
  • Competitive Pay — $50,000–$70,000 OTE (base salary + commission + bonuses). Your base is guaranteed — commission grows as your accounts do.
  • Time Off — Paid holidays and paid time off.
  • Work-Life Balance — Full-time, standard business hours — no nights, no weekends. Most of your time is spent in the field; light admin can be done from home or wherever works for you.
  • Training & Support — Structured onboarding, national sales training at Surface Experts HQ, weekly 1:1 coaching, and access to a dedicated support center for admin assistance.
  • Team — Small business owner is involved, available daily, and leads weekly team meetings.
A Day in the Life
  • Start your morning at office: plan your route, review your target accounts, prep follow-up notes from the day before.
  • Drive your planned route — typically 12–15 stops across north and south side of Indianapolis including outlying suburbs,
  • Walk into apartment communities, maintenance offices, and commercial properties to introduce yourself and build relationships with the people who make repair decisions.
  • Deliver a proven introduction and ask questions to better understand the needs and motivations of our customers.
  • Follow up with contacts who weren’t available, keep your pipeline moving, and watch early conversations become recurring accounts.
  • Log every visit, note, and follow-up in our software before your day ends.
  • Attend a weekly team meeting to review numbers, share wins, and get coaching
What We’re Looking For
You haven’t held a sales title before — but you’ve worked in a role where showing up consistently, communicating clearly, and genuinely taking care of people was the job. That foundation transfers well here, and we’ll give you the tools and coaching to build on it.
  • People-oriented and persistent — You’re comfortable introducing yourself to new people and building rapport quickly. You follow up because you said you would.
  • Eager to learn — You’ll be given a proven script and a clear playbook. Your job is to absorb it, deliver it well, and keep improving with coaching.
  • Reliable and routine-driven — This role runs on daily habits — routing, logging visits, sending follow-ups. The people who succeed here execute the process every single day.
  • Detail-oriented by habit — You log your visits, track your contacts, and treat follow-up like part of the job — not an afterthought.
  • Self-directed — You manage your own schedule and route. Accountability lives in your daily logs and your results.
Backgrounds That Tend to Transfer Well
  • Retail or customer service — you know how to read a room and handle objections gracefully.
  • Hospitality — you’re used to making people feel at ease and building rapport quickly
  • Property management or real estate — you already speak the language of the people we call on.
  • Any people-facing role where showing up consistently and communicating clearly was the job.
Requirements
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • Must be based in or near Indianapolis— daily travel throughout the north and south side and nearby suburbs.
  • Comfortable learning new software — CRM and routing tools provided and trained.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish a plus.

About Surface Experts of Central Indiana
Surface Experts is a hard surface repair company. We can fix minor damage to many surfaces, including bathtubs, cabinets, floors, appliances, countertops, furniture, elevator panels… you name it! Our services save time and money compared to resurfacing or replacing, so satisfied customers keep coming back. Surface Experts of Central Indiana is a growing franchise with the support of a national organization’s systems and training. You’ll have direct access to the owner, quality leads loaded into your software, and consistent support from day one.
Compensation: $50,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year



About Surface Experts

Surface Experts is an all-inclusive surface repair service provider. We repair small damage to surfaces like Floors, Countertops, Bathtubs, Cabinets, Appliances, Furniture, Elevator Panels … Almost Everything!. We pride ourselves in our ability to provide incredibly fast service, while maintaining a friendly and professional atmosphere in our support center and on jobsites. We combine old school skill sets with new technology and products, resulting in a durable and appealing repair all provided with a smile.

  • Most repairs are simple and smaller than a dinner plate, yet our competition focuses on complete resurfacing. Our objective is a happy customer and a long-term relationship. We focus on saving our customers time, money and wasted materials that end up in a landfill.
  • Our typical repair requires only 1 to 2 tablespoons of product so our technicians can carry their entire set of tools and equipment in a small vehicle. Our approach is clean and free of odors in less than two hours.
Our Mission

Our mission is to develop outstanding teams by investing in strong relationships. Together we work to solve our customers’ problems by reducing the waste of time, money and materials which end up in landfills.

Our Vision

To establish and lead a nationally recognized market for surface repair as an alternative to replacement or complete refinishing. Our goal is to be represented in every major metropolitan area, and for our brand to be synonymous with spot repair among all facilities and maintenance management.

  • No Jerks
  • Be Humble
Be a Problem Solver

  • Be Curious
  • Seek to Understand the Cause of the Problem
  • Work Smart
  • Constantly Improve
Trust the Process

  • Be Organized
  • Be Teachable
  • Put Business Needs Above Personal Wants

All inquiries about employment at this franchisee should be made directly to the franchise location, and not to Surface Experts Corporate.

We're looking for an Intermediate Software Developer, Full Stack (Python/React) to join our growing AI Engineering team and help build reliable, production-grade AI and data products for one of Canada's largest P&C insurers. At North Bay Regional Center, we believe all people with developmental disabilities should have the same opportunities as are available to all other citizens. As one of the 21 nonprofit Regional Centers throughout California, we offer a comprehensive program supporting the needs of our communities, provided by driven and passionate employees who ensure that we achieve our goals daily.


Who We Serve

North Bay Regional Center (NBRC) provides advocacy, services, support, and care coordination to children and adults diagnosed with intellectual and developmental disabilities and their families in Napa, Sonoma and Solano counties. We partner with community-based organizations and agencies to empower our clients to thrive and live as independently as possible within the geographically, culturally, and ethnically diverse communities we serve.


North Bay Regional Center is a nonprofit private corporation that contracts with the Department of Developmental Services to coordinate services and support for individuals with developmental disabilities. At North Bay, we’re promoting opportunities by supporting choices for people with developmental disabilities. North Bay Regional Center serves over 12,000 people living within the geographic boundaries of Napa, Sonoma and Solano counties.


NATURE OF WORK:

An Early Intervention Service Coordinator provides intake and ongoing assessments of infants and toddlers (0 to 3 years of age) eligible for Early Intervention Services under California Early Start program mandates. You will assist eligible children and their families with the coordination of other resources, in development of an Individualized Family Service Plan and participate in periodic reviews of the IFSP every six months or more frequently if conditions warrant and take an active role in transition services for toddlers. You will provide service coordination to assist the families in accessing services necessary to enhance the development of the child and the capacity of the family to meet the needs of the child. You may participate in educational and prevention out-reach activities and serve as liaison to other community organizations that work with populations at high risk for having a developmental disability. Bilingual: English/Spanish required.

title: Compliance Engineer
description:
This is a remote position.

Commercial / Compliance Engineer

Anonymous Role Specification

Role Purpose

The client requires a Commercial / Compliance Engineer to lead the preparation, coordination, and delivery of product compliance documentation for submission to National Highways. The role will focus on ensuring the product technical file is fully aligned with National Highways requirements and achieves product acceptance by December. The successful candidate will act as the bridge between commercial, compliance, and technical teams in the UK and Germany, ensuring all documentation, evidence, and technical submissions meet the expectations of government bodies, transport authorities, and highways organisations.

Key Responsibilities

The role will cover the following core areas:

Compliance & Product Acceptance
  • Review, interpret, and understand National Highways technical documentation, standards, and compliance requirements.
  • Prepare and manage the product technical file in line with National Highways specification.
  • Identify gaps between existing product documentation and required compliance standards.
  • Coordinate the collection of technical evidence, certifications, test data, and supporting documentation.
  • Drive the product acceptance process through to completion by the December deadline.
Technical Documentation
  • Read and analyse technical product documentation, compliance files, and authority specifications.
  • Translate compliance requirements into clear actions for internal engineering and technical teams.
  • Ensure all technical documents are accurate, complete, structured, and submission-ready.
  • Maintain version control and auditability of all compliance-related documentation.
Stakeholder Management
  • Liaise closely with technical teams in Germany and the UK.
  • Act as the key point of contact between the client and relevant highways or government authority stakeholders where required.
  • Understand and navigate the expectations of organisations such as National Highways, local highways authorities, and Transport for London.
  • Support communication between commercial, technical, and regulatory stakeholders.

Commercial & Authority Interface

  • Understand the commercial importance of achieving product acceptance within the target timeframe.
  • Support the client in positioning the product appropriately for use within UK highways and transport infrastructure.
  • Help interpret the nuances of working with government bodies, public authorities, and transport agencies.
  • Ensure compliance activity supports wider commercial objectives and customer requirements.
Required Experience
  • Proven experience in compliance, technical documentation, product acceptance, or technical submissions within transport, highways, ITS, traffic technology, infrastructure, or a related sector.
  • Experience working with government bodies, public authorities, transport authorities, or regulated infrastructure environments.
  • Strong understanding of technical files, compliance evidence, and formal product approval processes.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and apply complex technical specifications.
  • Experience liaising with engineering or technical teams across different locations or countries.
  • Familiarity with National Highways, UK highways authorities, TfL, or similar organisations would be highly advantageous.
Key Skills
  • Strong technical documentation and compliance management skills.
  • Ability to interpret standards, specifications, and regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Commercial awareness and ability to work to fixed deadlines.

•Strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to coordinate technical input from multiple teams.
  • Confident working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Organised, proactive, and deadline-driven.

Desired Background

•Compliance Engineer

•Product Approval Engineer

•Technical Documentation Engineer

•Certification Engineer

•ITS Engineer

•Highways Technology Engineer

•Technical Project Engineer

  • Systems Engineer with compliance experience
  • Commercial Engineer within infrastructure or transport technology

Project Objective

The primary objective of this role is to ensure the client product technical file meets National Highways requirements and supports successful product acceptance by December.

Summary

This is a commercially important compliance-focused role requiring someone who can understand technical product documentation, interpret authority requirements, coordinate with UK and German technical teams, and manage the product acceptance process with National Highways.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Scientist based in Netherlands.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a key role in shaping business strategy through advanced analytics, experimentation, and data-driven insights. You will investigate the factors influencing customer acquisition, conversion, monetization, and retention, helping teams make smarter decisions and accelerate sustainable growth. Working at the intersection of Data Science, Product, and Growth, you will turn complex business questions into actionable recommendations with measurable impact. You will own analytical projects end to end, from working with raw data and building reliable data models to applying statistical methods and communicating findings. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders, you will challenge assumptions, uncover new opportunities, and influence strategic priorities. This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise, commercial thinking, and analytical ownership within a collaborative, international, and innovation-driven environment.

Accountabilities

  • Lead business-critical investigations across the customer journey, from acquisition and activation to conversion, monetization, and retention, translating findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Analyze marketing channel performance, attribution, and incrementality across SEO, paid search, CRM, and emerging channels to evaluate investment effectiveness and identify growth opportunities.

  • Design, implement, and evaluate A/B tests in collaboration with Product and Growth teams, applying statistical analysis, causal inference, and quasi-experimental methods where traditional experimentation is not feasible.

  • Build, test, document, and maintain reliable, production-ready data models using SQL, Python, and data transformation tools, ensuring the quality and integrity of analytical foundations.

  • Go beyond descriptive reporting to explain business performance, identify underlying drivers, challenge assumptions, and recommend concrete actions that improve business outcomes.

  • Investigate unexpected changes in traffic, conversion rates, and customer behavior, developing analytical frameworks, predictive models, and data products that help teams identify and act on opportunities faster.

  • Partner with Product Managers, Growth specialists, engineers, and senior leadership to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical approaches and measurable results.

  • Take ownership of analytical projects from initial problem definition and data preparation through modeling, interpretation, stakeholder communication, and implementation of recommendations.

    • Requirements:

    • Significant experience in applied Data Science or advanced analytics, ideally within a SaaS, digital product, product-led growth, or marketing-driven business, with a proven ability to influence business decisions.

    • Advanced SQL and data modeling skills, including experience designing, building, testing, documenting, and maintaining reliable data models. Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tools is highly valued.

    • Strong Python programming skills, with the ability to conduct statistical analyses, develop predictive models, and build practical data products.

    • Solid knowledge of statistics, experimentation, and causal inference, including experience designing and evaluating A/B tests and selecting appropriate methods for complex analytical questions.

    • Experience in Growth or Marketing Analytics, with a strong understanding of acquisition channels, conversion funnels, attribution, incrementality, and customer behavior. Experience analyzing SEO or paid search performance is a plus.

    • Strong product and commercial acumen, with the ability to connect metrics to business outcomes, prioritize high-value questions, and identify opportunities for improvement.

    • An end-to-end ownership mindset, with the ability to manage the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data and modeling to interpretation, communication, and actionable recommendations.

    • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, enabling you to explain complex analytical findings clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • A curious, proactive, and independent approach, with a willingness to challenge assumptions, explore unfamiliar problems, and go beyond the initial request.

    • Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an international working environment.

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience in subscription-based or product-led growth businesses, particularly in conversion optimization, pricing, retention, or customer lifetime value.

      • Hands-on experience with marketing incrementality, attribution modeling, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), or quasi-experimental techniques.

      • Experience developing analytical frameworks or data products that are adopted and used by business teams.

      • Previous experience in a lean, high-impact Data team, independently owning both analytical projects and the underlying data models.

      • A proven track record of influencing Product, Growth, or Marketing strategy through rigorous analysis and clear, evidence-based recommendations.

        • Benefits:

        • Meaningful business impact: Contribute to a global digital product used by more than 60 million people every month, with your analyses directly informing business performance and growth.

        • Autonomy and ownership: Take responsibility for complex analytical challenges from start to finish and see your recommendations translate into real business decisions.

        • Collaborative environment: Work closely with experienced Data, Product, and Growth leaders in a team that values curiosity, knowledge sharing, and thoughtful decision-making.

        • Remote flexibility: Enjoy a remote working environment across supported European locations, with a hybrid option for team members based in Zurich.

        • Generous annual leave: Benefit from 30 vacation days each year.

        • International exposure: Work with a diverse, global team in an established digital product environment that combines scale with the agility of a lean organization.

Working at the intersection of Data Science, Product, and Growth, you will turn complex business questions into actionable recommendations with measurable impact.
