title: Information Analyst
description:
• Provide high quality data analysis to improve cancer outcomes in New Zealand
  • Wellington based | Full-time | Permanent
  • Salary midpoint of $93,639. Actual salary dependent on your experience

Ko ake mahi - What you'll do

Join us as an Information Analyst and help shape the future of cancer care through data-driven insights. You'll turn raw data into powerful stories that guide decisions at Te Aho o Te Kahu. From analysing cancer datasets to creating interactive data dashboards, your work will make a real impact.

You'll collaborate with our sector partners, tailor information products, and publish high-priority statistics that matter. Using your analytical skills and project know-how, you'll deliver clear, actionable insights while fostering strong relationships across health agencies.

If you're passionate about transforming data into change, this is your chance to make a difference. Join a team committed to equity, innovation, and improving cancer outcomes for all.

  • Deliver high‑quality analysis and insights: Use advanced analytical tools-including SNOMED CT ontology-based analytics-to extract, analyse, interpret, and report on cancer‑related datasets.
  • Create accessible information products: Develop and publish data products such as reports, analyses, and interactive R Shiny dashboards for internal and external audiences.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders: Work closely with clients and sector partners to understand their needs, develop fit‑for‑purpose knowledge products, and ensure information is clear, accurate, and meaningful.
  • Advance data quality and understanding: Build deep knowledge of key cancer datasets, support stakeholders in interpreting published information, and ensure data is processed, cleansed, and validated to the highest standard.
  • Strengthen equity and system improvement: Embed equity considerations and Te Tiriti o Waitangi obligations in all work, contribute to improving D&A tools and processes, and support monitoring frameworks that inform key programmes and service development.


Ko pūkenga - What you'll bring

  • A relevant tertiary qualification (or equivalent experience) and strong analytical capability, with the ability to interpret and present complex numerical data clearly.
  • Proficiency in SQL, R, or Python, with a preference for experience in R/R Shiny; knowledge of SNOMED CT (training provided) and AI/ML concepts is an advantage.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder‑engagement skills, including gathering requirements and translating technical insights for diverse audiences.
  • Strong project planning, time management, and data quality skills-able to cleanse, validate, and deliver high‑quality analysis to deadlines.
  • An understanding of Māori tikanga and kawa, and a commitment to upholding Te Tiriti o Waitangi and equity principles in all work.


Ko wai mātou - About us

Te Aho o Te Kahu, the Cancer Control Agency, provides national leadership for and oversight of cancer control.

Te Aho o Te Kahu takes a whole-of-system focus on preventing and managing cancer and oversees system-wide prioritisation and coordination of cancer care in New Zealand. It is accountable for ensuring transparency of progress towards the goals and outcomes in the National Cancer Action Plan. Te Aho o Te Kahu is equity-led, knowledge-driven, person/whānau-centred and outcomes focused.

The Data and Analytics (D&A) Team will lead the implementation of an integrated approach to collect, analyse, and communicate high quality cancer data to drive planning, quality improvement, and monitoring activities across the cancer sector.

We offer a supportive environment for you to grow on both at personal and professional level. We care about your wellbeing and offer a flexible working environment to promote a healthy work/life balance as well as a host of other benefits.

Join Te Aho o Te Kahu - Ngā tūranga e wātea ana

Working at Te Aho o Te Kahu is inspiring, meaningful and rewarding. The Agency provides an incredible opportunity to work alongside other passionate individuals in leading efforts to drive the changes required to improve cancer outcomes for all New Zealanders.

Ngā uaratanga - Our Agency Values:
Our Vision Tō Tātou Whāinga
Fewer cancers Kia whakaiti iho te mate pukupuku
Better survival Kia runga noa ake te mataora
Equity for all Kia taurite ngā huanga

We are equity led, whānau centred, knowledge driven and outcomes focused. For more information see our website

Me pēhea te tono mai - How to apply

Click here to view the position description.Please follow the online process at our Careers Website to apply. Please ensure you upload a CV and covering letter with all applications. If you have any questions, email the recruitment team at recruitment@health.govt.nz. To apply, you must hold the right to work in New Zealand. For information on work visa eligibility, check out the Immigration New Zealand website.

Applications close on midnight Friday 23rd October 2026. We are reviewing applications as they come in and interviews may take place during the advertising period. Please note if we receive a high number of applications this job may close prior to the closing date. This role is Wellington based and the successful candidate will need to be based in Wellington.

We are not utilising recruitment agencies at this time. If you are interested in applying for this position, please do so directly through our careers page.

All candidates will be notified of the outcome of their application via email. Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete an interview process, reference checks, and a criminal check.

We value diversity and are committed to working in an inclusive and respectful way. We welcome applicants from all walks of life and appreciate the richness of experience that your point of difference could bring to us. description:

And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here .

title: Founding Ios Engineer
description:
GREAT CODE can help the sick heal. Not solely through experts, but by those WHO LIVED IT.


Healhub is looking for an exceptional Founding iOS Engineer to take ownership of our native iOS application as we move into our first real-world pilot.


This is a full-time, 40-hour/week founding-team role. We are pre-funding, so there is no salary initially. The position comes with 2% equity, subject to 4-year vesting with a 1-year cliff. We expect this to become a salaried position once Healhub raises sufficient funding


We want this to be completely clear upfront: we’re looking for someone who has the circumstances and runway to genuinely make Healhub their full-time work.


THIS IS THE MISSION: HEALHUB


Healhub helps people searching for answers find and learn from others who have lived through similar health experiences.


We believe people carry knowledge that is often lost because their experiences are difficult to capture, compare, and find. We’re building Healhub to change that.


It’s a plus if you’ve faced serious health challenges yourself and understand firsthand what it’s like to search for answers.


WHERE WE ARE NOW


We have a working native iOS application in TestFlight, an established backend and AI/search infrastructure, interactive 3D characters, video, matching, and a small engineering team that has been building together.


We’re now preparing for our first focused pilot with real users.


Our current iOS engineer needs to step back from his responsibilities for personal reasons. He will help interview and directly onboard the engineer who takes over, including codebase walkthroughs and knowledge transfer.


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR


You must be respected by experienced iOS engineers for your skills.


You’ve shipped real native iOS products and know how to work inside an existing codebase… not just build demos from scratch.


You know what you know, and you’re humble about it. You understand your limits but love to push them.


You’re self-motivated, disciplined, and thrive on ownership and responsibility.


You have a strong sense of UX, can’t stand poor performance, and love turning well-planned design and art into great code and products.


Most importantly, you execute. When you take responsibility for something, the team can depend on you to carry it through.


AREAS OF EXPERIENCE


Native iOS development

Swift

UIKit

API/backend integration

Video/media on iOS

Performance optimization and debugging

TestFlight / App Store release process

Git and collaborative development


Experience with RealityKit / SceneKit / 3D is a strong plus.


Native Android / Kotlin experience is also especially valuable as Healhub expands beyond iOS.


Your responsibility will be to take ownership of Healhub’s iOS application: developing it, improving it, solving problems, shipping releases, and working closely with the rest of the engineering team as we move through our pilot and beyond.


OWNERSHIP


This position begins with 2% equity, subject to standard 4-year vesting with a 1-year cliff.


We believe ownership should grow when someone’s contribution and responsibility grow significantly. Exceptional long-term contribution or expansion of the role may lead to additional equity grants.


LOCATION


Remote.


U.S. or near-U.S. time zones are preferred because of team collaboration, but we will consider an exceptional candidate elsewhere if the working hours genuinely work.


This project will be hard. It’s a startup. Everyone on the team expects the most of themselves.


We’re not looking for someone simply searching for their next job. We’re looking for someone who wants to use exceptional engineering skills to build something that could genuinely help people.


Let’s connect people… and help them find a way forward.

We are looking for a Business Analyst to join a banking technology and operations team supporting business applications, projects and system enhancements.

This is a great opportunity for a BA who enjoys working closely with business users, technology teams and project stakeholders, with exposure to requirements gathering, impact assessment, data flows, solution design and UAT management.

description:
_Advertising Salary_Salary Details:

**This post is part-time, 14 hours per week and fixed-term until 28 September 2028. The salary stated above is the pro-rata amount, the full-time salary would be £41,086 -** **£46,54****2****per annum (Incl. LWA).**

The University of Westminster is seeking to appoint an innovative Research Associate to join the School of Social Sciences (0.4 FTE basis) on the Economic and Social Research Council (ESRC) funded project, Centring Mothers’ Voices in the Prevention of Gangs and Serious Youth Violence. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a pioneering and impactful research project that places mothers at the heart of efforts to prevent gangs and serious youth violence.

The project recognises the crucial role mothers play as protectors, advocates and sources of support within their families and communities. Working closely with Dr Sally Atkinson-Sheppard, the successful candidate will contribute to a participatory and co-produced programme of research that brings together mothers, practitioners and other stakeholders to develop new knowledge and influence policy and practice.

The role will involve undertaking a literature review and policy analysis, conducting qualitative photovoice interviews with mothers and practitioners, supporting data collection and analysis, and contributing to research outputs including reports, policy briefings and academic publications. The successful candidate will also play an important role in impact and dissemination activities, including supporting and managing a steering group of mothers and contributing to the development of resources designed to influence policy and practice.

The successful candidate will have experience of conducting research with vulnerable groups, strong qualitative research skills, excellent written and verbal communication abilities, and a commitment to collaborative and inclusive research practices. They will be able to work effectively as part of a research team while managing their own workload and contributing positively to the wider academic community..

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager based in Switzerland.

Join a globally distributed technology organization where you will drive critical IT and Information Security initiatives across multiple technical and business teams. In this hands-on role, you will coordinate projects from initial planning through implementation and operational handover, ensuring clear ownership, priorities, and measurable outcomes. You will play a key role in advancing security improvements, coordinating vulnerability remediation, and ensuring critical actions are completed on time. By consolidating information across multiple Jira environments, you will turn fragmented project data into actionable insights that support better decision-making. You will collaborate closely with IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and Platform/DevOps teams in a fast-paced, international environment. This is an opportunity to take ownership, improve delivery processes, and make a meaningful impact on technology operations and organizational security.

Accountabilities

  • IT Project and Initiative Management

    • Lead IT projects and internal technology initiatives from requirements gathering and planning through implementation, rollout, and operational handover.

    • Define project scope, milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, timelines, and success criteria.

    • Coordinate delivery across IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Information Security, and business teams.

    • Proactively identify and resolve blockers, manage competing priorities, mitigate risks, and drive decisions to keep projects on track.

    • Oversee initiatives involving identity and access management (IAM/SSO), Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, enterprise SaaS, endpoint technologies, AWS and cloud services, corporate connectivity, internal systems, and IT automation.

    • Information Security Delivery Management

      • Coordinate security initiatives across Information Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform/DevOps, and Red Team and Blue Team functions.

      • Track vulnerability findings and remediation activities from identification through validation and closure, ensuring clear ownership and realistic target dates.

      • Manage follow-up actions arising from penetration tests, Red Team/Blue Team exercises, security reviews, incidents, and ongoing security improvement programs.

      • Ensure security-related tasks are appropriately prioritized, supported by actionable remediation plans, and completed within agreed timelines.

      • Identify stalled, overdue, or high-risk activities and drive escalation, prioritization, and cross-team follow-up.

      • Facilitate security delivery without directly conducting security testing or vulnerability analysis.

      • Jira Management, Task Governance, and Analytics

        • Maintain consolidated visibility of IT and Information Security initiatives distributed across multiple Jira instances, projects, teams, and workflows.

        • Establish consistent reporting practices, ensuring data quality, traceability, and reliable visibility into delivery progress.

        • Monitor backlogs, aging tasks, overdue work, vulnerability remediation progress, throughput, and other relevant delivery metrics.

        • Analyze historical and current data to identify recurring issues, delivery bottlenecks, emerging risks, and performance trends.

        • Automate data collection, aggregation, and reporting wherever practical to improve operational efficiency.

        • Transform fragmented task-level information into actionable management insights that support prioritization and informed decision-making.

        • Cross-Team Coordination and Governance

          • Serve as a central coordination point between Information Security, IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform/DevOps, system owners, business functions, and management.

          • Maintain clear visibility of risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and commitments across distributed teams.

          • Clarify ownership, facilitate prioritization, and resolve coordination challenges when teams have competing demands.

          • Deliver concise management updates focused on progress, trends, exceptions, risks, and decisions requiring attention.

          • Establish practical project governance and delivery processes that strengthen accountability without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

            • Requirements:

            • At least 5 years of experience in IT/IS Project Management, Security Project Management, Technical Project Management, or a related field.

            • Demonstrated experience delivering technology or security initiatives across multiple technical teams and managing complex dependencies.

            • Experience working closely with Information Security and Engineering organizations, with a practical understanding of how technical teams operate.

            • Strong hands-on experience with Jira for project coordination, task tracking, backlog management, and delivery governance.

            • Experience working across multiple Jira projects, workflows, or systems, ideally with an understanding of how to consolidate information from different environments.

            • Proven ability to produce consolidated reports, define and monitor KPIs, and analyze delivery trends using task-level data.

            • Strong project management capabilities, including scope definition, timeline management, prioritization, risk mitigation, dependency tracking, and stakeholder coordination.

            • Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across different functions and time zones.

            • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior management.

            • Strong analytical thinking, organizational skills, and attention to detail, combined with a proactive approach to identifying problems and driving solutions.

            • Ability to work independently, take ownership of delivery outcomes, and balance structured governance with the flexibility required in a fast-moving technology environment.

              • The following qualifications and experience are considered an advantage:

              • Experience managing vulnerability remediation programs and coordinating security improvement initiatives.

              • Familiarity with Red Team and Blue Team activities and the coordination of security testing follow-up actions.

              • Experience consolidating data across multiple Jira instances or building automated Jira reporting solutions.

              • Knowledge of operational dashboards, workflow automation, and delivery analytics.

              • Exposure to AWS, cloud infrastructure, or cloud security environments.

              • Experience working in large-scale online technology organizations or high-availability environments.

              • Relevant professional certifications, such as PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, CISSP, CISM, Security+, Agile, or Scrum.

                • Benefits:

                • Competitive compensation: A competitive salary package aligned with experience and responsibilities.

                • Performance incentives: Individual performance-based bonuses paid quarterly, with additional referral and flash bonus opportunities.

                • Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely in an environment designed to support sustainable and flexible working practices.

                • Flexible working hours: Core working hours from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. in your local time zone, with flexibility outside this window.

                • Paid time off: 28 days of paid annual leave to support rest, personal commitments, and work-life balance.

                • Quality equipment: Access to high-quality equipment to help you work efficiently from your preferred location.

                • Company retreats: Annual company retreats offering opportunities to connect with colleagues, strengthen collaboration, and build professional relationships.

                • International collaboration: Work with distributed teams across technology, infrastructure, security, and business functions.

                • Professional impact: Take ownership of meaningful technology and security initiatives while contributing to improved operational performance and delivery practices.

title: Director, Medical & Regulatory Writing
description:
About Tr1X

Tr1X is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing engineered Tr1 cell therapies to restore immune balance in autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Leveraging the unique biology of Tr1 cells, the company is advancing a pipeline of off-the-shelf allogeneic and in vivo CAR-Tr1 therapies designed to deliver targeted immunoregulation and address diseases driven by immune dysfunction, including transplant-related complications. Founded by pioneers in the discovery of Tr1 cells, Tr1X, Inc. is focused on developing durable, potentially curative therapies for conditions with high unmet need. For more information, visit www.tr1x.bio.

Position Summary

The Director, Medical and Regulatory Writing reports to the Vice President, Head of Regulatory Affairs and provides strategic planning, development, review, and delivery of high-quality medical, clinical, and regulatory documentation supporting Tr1X clinical programs. The role is responsible for establishing and executing medical writing strategies across clinical development programs, ensuring the timely preparation of scientifically accurate, regulatory-compliant documentation. The Director drives document quality and operational excellence and collaborates with senior leaders across Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Translational Medicine, CMC/Technical Operations, and other functions.

The position plays a critical role in supporting regulatory milestones and submissions throughout the product lifecycle, while ensuring alignment with applicable regulatory requirements, scientific standards, and corporate objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Regulatory to develop and implement the medical writing strategy in alignment with corporate objectives, clinical development plans, regulatory strategies, and program goals.
  • Author (writes & edits) high-quality documents across all program areas as needed such as clinical study protocols, protocol amendments, ICFs, clinical study reports, DSURs, Investigator’s Brochures, as well as more complex documents, e.g., INDs, NDAs, briefing packages, etc.
  • Prepare and perform a quality review of clinical study protocols, protocol amendments, clinical study reports, investigator brochures, clinical summaries, and other essential clinical development documents.
  • Lead, manage, and coordinate process for preparation of documents. This includes leading adjudication meetings to align on scope and to resolve comments, as well as driving timelines and interacting with Regulatory to coordinate final delivery for publishing.
  • Ensure scientific conclusions are evidence-based, appropriately supported by clinical data, and consistent across the clinical and regulatory documentation portfolio.
  • Establish standards for document consistency, reference verification, data presentation, medical terminology, and scientific interpretation.
  • Advise leadership and cross-functional teams on document strategy, content risks, submission readiness, resource constraints, and critical timelines.
  • Establish medical writing standards, processes, governance frameworks, templates, and quality-control procedures across development programs.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance document quality, operational efficiency, consistency, timeliness, and compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and guidance, including ICH guidelines, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and relevant FDA regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee implementation of quality assurance processes for medical writing deliverables, including content review, document QC, traceability, and controlled document management.
  • Partner with Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs to support inspections, audits, submission readiness assessments, and corrective and preventive actions when required.
  • Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional team members in Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Translational Medicine, CMC, and Quality.
  • Resolve complex content disagreements and drive timely decisions across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Evaluate appropriate technologies, automation, and artificial intelligence-enabled writing tools while maintaining scientific oversight, confidentiality, data integrity, and regulatory compliance.
  • Perform other responsibilities based on business needs.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific discipline, such as life sciences, biomedical sciences, or a related scientific field and a minimum 10 years of closely related experience. An advanced degree in a relevant scientific discipline preferred.
  • Experience working in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or contract research organizations; experience in both sponsor and CRO environments is advantageous; experience on the sponsor side required.
  • Proven expertise in advanced medical and regulatory writing.
  • Extensive knowledge of clinical development processes, clinical trial methodologies, regulatory submission requirements, and regulatory authority expectations.
  • Must have strong knowledge of ICH M11 and principles of the Common Protocol Template (CPT).
  • Experience with preparing global protocols and ICFs for studies in multiple regions (e.g. US, EU, UK, Japan)
  • A successful track record of delivering high-quality medical and regulatory documentation within defined timelines and quality standards.
  • Knowledge of regulatory guidelines and standards.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent scientific judgment and ability to apply critical thinking to document preparation and review.
  • Strong interpersonal, organizational, project management, and verbal and written communication skills.
  • Advanced computer skills in Microsoft Office 365 programs.

Other Requirements

  • Legally authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.
  • Position is on-site in San Diego, CA

The job responsibilities and requirements provided above are intended to describe the general nature of the work performed by individuals assigned to this job classification. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and requirements. Tr1X retains the right to add, change, or delete duties, education, experience or any other requirements of the position at any time.

Working at Tr1X

At Tr1X, our team is united by a singular shared mission: to transform patients’ lives through breakthrough science. We are a group of skilled experts driven by urgency, innovation and a collaborative spirit. Our culture thrives on excellence, positivity, persistence and the agility to tackle new challenges head-on. With an unwavering commitment to patients, science and one another, we foster an environment where team members feel engaged, supported and empowered to make a meaningful impact. We envision a world where autoimmune diseases are not just being treated but are cured.

Base Pay Range Anticipated: $200,000 - $220,000

Tr1X considers a variety of factors to determine salary such as education, years of experience, time in the position level, training, knowledge, skills, geographic location, and the market value of the position.

Compensation and Benefits

Tr1X provides a fair and competitive total rewards program that includes base salary; discretionary annual target bonus; incentive stock options; 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution; health and welfare insurance plans for employees (and their families) that include medical, dental, vision, long-term and short-term disability, and life insurance; paid time off (PTO); and paid holidays.

Tr1X embraces a diverse, open, and inclusive environment and believes a strong culture connection is key to success. Tr1X is committed to fairness in recruitment, hiring, transfer, promotion or any other employment practice without regard to race, color, citizenship, national origin, ancestry, religion, sex, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and expression, age, physical and medical disability, medical condition, genetic information, political affiliation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you are an individual needing assistance to complete an employment application or would like to request an accommodation, please contact the Human Resources department at careers@tr1x.bio.

Notice to Employment Agencies

The Tr1X talent acquisition program is managed through internal resources, and unsolicited referrals and resumes are not accepted from employment agencies, unless advance written authorization is granted from the human resources department. Tr1X shall not be liable for any fees arising from any unsolicited or unauthorized candidate information received relative to position vacancies.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
For our client an IT company specializing in new product development and R&D, focused on solving complex challenges in the tech industry we are looking for a Senior Java Developer based in Poland or Lithuania.

Responsibilities

  • Feature development — design, implement, and integrate new functionality using Java 17–21 and the Spring ecosystem; participate in architectural discussions and code reviews;
  • Application support & maintenance — provide ongoing support, troubleshoot production issues, and fix bugs to ensure high availability and stable performance;
  • Cloud deployment — manage deployment, configuration, and hosting of applications on AWS infrastructure; contribute to infrastructure improvements;
  • Data persistence — handle database interactions, schema design, and query optimization using MySQL and Hibernate ORM;
  • Build management — use Gradle and Maven for dependency management and build automation;
  • Technical ownership — contribute to architectural decisions, propose and evaluate technical solutions, and drive continuous improvement of the codebase.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of commercial Java development experience;
  • Deep knowledge of Java 17–21 (records, sealed classes, virtual threads, pattern matching);
  • Strong command of the Spring ecosystem — Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security;
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL), query optimization, and Hibernate / JPA;
  • Solid AWS experience — EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch or equivalent services;
  • Proficiency with Gradle and/or Maven;
  • Strong understanding of REST API design and microservices architecture;
  • Experience writing clean, testable code with unit and integration tests (JUnit, Mockito);
  • Confident reading and reviewing others' code; track record of meaningful code reviews;
  • Upper-Intermediate English or above — comfortable in written and spoken communication with the team.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Docker and container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS);
  • Familiarity with message brokers — Kafka, RabbitMQ;
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI);
  • Exposure to reactive programming (Project Reactor, WebFlux);
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK);
  • Understanding of DDD, CQRS, or event-driven architecture patterns.

title: Seasonal Key Holder

Please note the pay range for this position starts as listed in the job posting, but other factors such as an individual’s education, location, meeting the minimum job requirements for the role, training and experience, will determine the final salary for potential new hires.

title: 23114 - Probation Officer - Bradshaw House PIPE Approved Premises

description:
The current vacancy is based at Bradshaw House PIPE Approved Premises. The role is AP based with no option for hybrid working.

Bradshaw House is a Psychologically Informed Planned Environment (PIPE) and is also an Enabling Environment as awarded by the RCPsych.

This involves working with individuals with personality disorders/personality difficulties. The PIPE model is heavily focused on a relational approach, and as such there is an expectation of engaging/working even more closely with staff and residents.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals

  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families

title: Founding Senior Software Engineer
description:

      • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional stakeholders.

      • A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving, with the confidence to take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the direction of a growing engineering organization.

        • High-impact work: Deliver new features and capabilities directly to a growing customer base, with a clear connection between your work and business outcomes.

        • Technical autonomy: Influence decisions across the technology stack and choose practical solutions that balance innovation, performance, and scalability.

        • AI-driven innovation: Work hands-on with modern AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, and agentic systems, to solve real-world problems.

        • Strong engineering environment: Collaborate with an experienced, ambitious engineering team with backgrounds at leading technology companies.

        • Fast development cycles: Build, ship, and iterate rapidly, with opportunities to see your work reach customers without unnecessary bureaucracy.

        • Startup growth opportunity: Help establish the technical foundations of an expanding business and grow alongside the product and engineering organization.

title: Urban Designer
description:
You will be responsible for creating clear and accurate technical design work. You will use your professional skills and experience to complete tasks with minimal supervision. The work plays a key role in delivering complex projects that support our mission to provide high quality and sustainable infrastructure.


- Contract: Permanent
- Location: Hybrid with 2-3 days a week working from the Bristol Hub
- Full-time (35 hours per week). We welcome conversations about flexible working arrangements and job-share opportunities.
- £ 33,265 per annum (pro rata for part time)
- Closing date: 23:59 on 18 October 2026
- Reference: 200aREC

### About the role

**Team**: Delivery/ Infrastructure

As an Urban Designer at Walk Wheel Cycle Trust, you will work as part of a multi-disciplinary team which includes designers, engineers, technicians and other specialists. Together, you will deliver projects and programmes that support the Trust’s strategic priorities to create new and improve existing places for people to walk, wheel and cycle.

You will be responsible for creating clear and accurate technical design work. You will use your professional skills and experience to complete tasks with minimal supervision. The work plays a key role in delivering complex projects that support our mission to provide high quality and sustainable infrastructure.

In this role, you will use your design/technical knowledge, to apply practical and creative problem solving, producing clear and accurate technical design work, as well as engagement outputs for non-technical audiences/members of the public/children and young people. You will work closely with colleagues across different disciplines and contribute to solutions that help improve places for people to walk, wheel and cycle. Your contribution is important to creating high quality, sustainable and inclusive active travel networks.

Our Urban Designers also often lead community engagement related to infrastructure design, bringing communities and partners along a journey where early involvement can help shape outcomes that work for local communities. If this is something that interests you, there will be opportunities to get involved in designing and delivering community/stakeholder/school engagement events, as part of our established collaborative design process. We will arrange any necessary DBS certificates needed.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Use technical design expertise and design software including AutoCAD and Adobe Creative Suite, to produce accurate and reliable project outputs and deliverables, including improvements to the National Cycle Network.


- Collaborate with internal colleagues to deliver a wide range of impactful project design outputs and reports/documents, that support our strategy, making active travel a genuine choice for everyday journeys.


- Engage with external partners, regulatory authorities, local communities and other key stakeholders to scope, shape and deliver solutions that work for people.


- Engage with communities and young people, to collaboratively design active travel improvements that work for local people.


- Manage straightforward projects from start to finish through all RIBA stages.


- Use of street and active travel design guidance to support design development and outputs. Use of key guidance documents will include Active Travel England’s guidance and tools, Manual for Streets, LTN 1/20, National Design Guide, Healthy Streets, Inclusive Mobility, Traffic Signs Manual and Specification for Highway Works.


- Contribute to business development activities by preparing agreed project proposals and supporting with tender submissions.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a creative, fastmoving environment and wants to stretch their skills across a wide range of disciplines. Working for the Trust means being part of a passionate, multiskilled team where you’ll collaborate with our designers, engineers, behaviour change colleagues, ecologists, sustainability experts and other specialists to shape real, positive change in communities. It’s an opportunity to grow your technical expertise, tackle meaningful challenges, empower local communities to shape changes, and make a visible impact on the places people walk, wheel and cycle every day.

### About you

We’re looking for someone who has experience and understanding in the areas listed below. You don’t need to meet every requirement - if you feel you’d be a good fit, we encourage you to apply.

- A design degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant design field, such as Urban Design, Landscape Architecture, Architecture, or another relevant and clearly demonstrated design specialism, with at least two years of experience.

   OR five years of work experience in a relevant design role.


- Competence in using design software that is appropriate for the role, e.g. AutoCAD suite including Civil 3D and other packages.


- A working understanding of street and active travel design guidance, healthy street design, and inclusive design principles.


- Ability to take a holistic design approach to creating places and routes that facilitate people travelling actively, whilst helping people feel safe, welcome, and included.


- A working understanding of health and safety management, including how to apply the CDM Regulations.


- The ability to work in a way that promotes the safety and wellbeing of children, young people and adults at risk.


### Living our values

At the Walk Wheel Cycle Trust, we’re a values‑driven organisation. We’re looking for people who are:

**Always Learning**– curious, open‑minded and committed to continuous improvement.

**Championing Equity** – inclusive, respectful and focused on ensuring everyone has a voice and fair opportunity to succeed.

**Taking Ownership**– proactive, responsible and empowered to make things better.

**Delivering Together** – collaborative, transparent and motivated by shared success.

Through our values we make it possible for more people to walk, wheel and cycle safely, healthily and joyfully.

### Additional information

- Application deadline: **23:59, 18 October 2026**


- Interviews will be held at our Bristol Hub, during the week commencing 02 November 2026. To apply, please complete our online application form.


- We actively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, particularly those underrepresented in our workforce, including people of colour and candidates with disabilities.


- Adjustments are available throughout the application process.


At Walk Wheel Cycle Trust, you'll be part of a movement to make it easier for people to walk and cycle.

We're all here to change things. You'll be part of an incredible community of talented, passionate, creative problem solvers all working together to change things for the better.

We act locally and think big - we have a vision of a society where the way we travel creates healthier places and happier lives for everyone.

You'll be questioning the status quo and daring to imagine a different world. You'll work on exciting, impactful projects that will stretch and empower you and you'll be rewarded by seeing the difference you make to people, communities and the planet.

We believe including everyone is central to who we are and what we want to achieve. We welcome difference and pride ourselves on creating a culture where you can be yourself and where your wellness is supported.

You'll be guaranteed to make friends for life and work with a team that is incredibly flexible, supportive, ethical and fun.

##### Wellbeing

- 28 days leave per annum plus bank holidays for full-time working.
- Ability to buy an extra week of annual leave (pro rata for part-time staff).
- Staff volunteer days.
- 24/7 free, impartial and confidential support service.
- We are members of the Green Commute Initiative and Cycle Scheme who both offer cycle to work schemes.

##### Financial

- Up to two extra days of paid leave (pro rata for part‑time colleagues) when travelling sustainably for holidays
- Group Personal Pension scheme with a 6% or 7% of basic salary contribution being matched by Walk Wheel Cycle Trust.
- Bike, computer and season ticket loans.
- Discount benefits.
- London Weighting Allowance of £4,530 for all those living within a London Borough (32 local authority districts plus the City of London).
- Death in service benefit – 3 times annual salary.

##### Family-friendly

- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.
- Flexible Working practices (full-time hours are 37.5 per week, Monday - Friday).

title: Office of the CEO - Business Value Creation
description:
About Pallet

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.

As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

San Francisco · In-person, five days a week

You could be a Business Value Creation Manager anywhere; why us?

  • Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on the path to IPO ($50M raised, 700% revenue growth in 2 years, targeting a $6T market)
  • Work directly with our CEO and Founder, Sushanth Raman
  • Help transform a massive industry and scale us toward a $10B+ business

About the opportunity:

This role sits in the Office of the CEO and owns the business value case for strategic enterprise accounts: what the deployment is worth, whether it delivered, and what happens next commercially. You'll build the models, run the customer conversations, and stay on the account through the change program. You'll work day-to-day with Sushanth, our office of the CEO team, sales, and agent product management.

Why this role is different:

  • The recommendation is where the work starts, not where it ends. Here you build the value case, sit with the operators while it deploys, and beyond.
  • A seat in the Office of the CEO. You work directly with Sushanth, our founder and CEO. No bureaucratic layers in between.
  • The interesting problems here are unglamorous. Freight brokers, 3PLs, carriers, messy TMS and ERP data, operators who've sat through three failed automation pilots. AI applied to an industry with real operational depth, which is the only kind that survives a diligence question.
  • This is intense. SF office five days a week, 60+ hour weeks, customer calls on short notice. If you're leaving consulting for better hours, this isn't it. If you're leaving because you want to own the outcome, this is.
  • The scope compounds. You're early enough that what you build becomes the standard, rather than a slide in someone else's deck.

How you will make an impact:

  • Own the value case for strategic accounts. Pick the drivers, size the prize, and defend the assumptions in front of a customer SVP who has heard a lot of promises about AI

title: Head of Funnel Conversion (CRO) at AIOS — Remote, $200k-$400k/yr + up to 0.3%
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

The opportunity as Head of Funnel Conversion at AIOS

We are building a world-class team.

As Head of Funnel Conversion at AIOS, you are DRI for the end-to-end website CVR from Meta ads across all countries.

You will manage the rapidly expanding Funnel Conversion team, which consists of country-specific Product Squads (1x per country): 1x Funnel Conversion Lead + 1x Engineer + 1x Designer.

You’ll guide Funnel Conversion Leads to deeply understand our target customer in their specific country, think of macro tests to run, then get them executed. You’ll hold them responsible for the whole process: idea → hypothesis → test → result → learning → idea. You’ll hold them responsible for the specific country’s landers, quiz, checkout.

This is a management role, though you’ll always stay hands-on. We currently run on Omniconvert, PostHog, and Hex — but I’m sure you’ll have strong views on this and make the changes you see fit.

Great performance in the role means we can rapidly scale Meta spend globally across many countries. Funnel Conversion is critical to scaling up our international growth efforts. If you nail the role, you’ll be a leading candidate for senior roles in Growth & Product.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time most weekdays.

Our existing Funnel Conversion Lead (Michael McCann) will report directly to you.

We don’t currently have a separate Head of Growth, so you’ll report directly into me, our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) am intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work on weekends. Our default workweek is 50-60hrs/wk.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key Responsibilities

Meta Click → Sale CVR: You are DRI for the end-to-end website CVR from Meta ads across all countries.

You will manage the rapidly expanding Funnel Conversion team, which consists of country-specific Product Squads (1x per country):

  • 1x Funnel Conversion Lead

  • 1x Engineer

  • 1x Designer

You will be an excellent IC yourself at the below, and you will create the environment for your Leads to be excellent too:

  1. Customer & marketing understanding: Leads must go deep on our target customer(s) in their specific country. Why are they converting and why are they not? Specifically at this stage of the GLP-1 take-up cycle in this specific country.

  2. Ideas & prioritizing: Leads have many ideas, both macro & micro, produced from customer insights / session data / market research / funnel performance. Leads create precise hypotheses and order them ruthlessly. Leads’ experiments are always well designed to avoid unhelpful ambiguity of results.

  3. Execution: Leads are DRI for getting tests shipped. Leads run a Product Squad of 1x Engineer + 1x Designer. Tests get shipped rapidly and always to high-quality.

  4. Measure & learn: Leads measure everything important and use that information to inform their future testing.

  5. Improve tooling: You’ll work with the Leads to improve their tooling.

Key Traits

  • Specific to Funnel Conversion:

    1. Experience: You've spent 5+ years leading & running a high volume of experiments for DTC ecommerce brands in high-pace, high-transaction-volume environments. I have a strong preference for people who understand & enjoy the scary intensity of a high-growth startup.

    2. Macro swings: You don’t get stuck in hill climbing when we have no idea whether we’re yet on the right hill.

    3. Zest: You just get consumer. You have strong taste for consumer experience and can tell when a flow feels dead, cringe, slow, confusing, or magical.

    4. Funnel literacy: You understand the ad-to-landing-page handoff and how Funnel Conversion interacts with paid efficiency (CPL, CAC, quality score, LP experience).

    5. Hands-on & autonomous: You've personally owned end-to-end testing, from ideation and setup all the way to QA and readouts. You haven’t simply managed an agency and/or a team. You don’t need your hand held & you don’t get overwhelmed easily.

    6. Analytics: You’re maniacal about your metrics. You're comfortable inside the data, naturally curious, and able to dig past top-line numbers into segments and behaviour. You have a hunger to improve and are constantly upskilling. You care a weird amount about your analytics stack.

    7. Design: You’re comfortable with design principles & wireframing so can work closely with design to get what you want into pixels.

    8. Engineering: You’re sufficiently technical so code doesn’t bother you. You see turning your ideas into pixels as part of your remit, not something separate from you.

  • General for Head-level:

    1. Team: You hate incompetence as much as me. You run a team of strictly A-players, and you truly mean it.

    2. Trenches: You don’t hesitate to get your hands dirty in the trenches. You’re not too pretentious or senior to grind it out when needed — in fact you miss the times when that was more of your day-to-day.

    3. Strategy: You’re excellent in the trenches but you’re also the general at 30,000 ft deciding where to move the troops. You don’t get lost in the weeds and you always make sure we’re taking the required big swings. If not you, who?

    4. Excellence: You’re annoyingly capable at meta skills. You’re an autodidact with impressive speed and resourcefulness. You’re highly organized and can complete multiple projects concurrently. You calmly handle uncertainty and rapidly changing situations.

    5. Agentic: You're a doer. You’ve been pulled into important problems, taken risks, excelled in new areas. You've likely founded something in the past and it’s likely you want to start your own company in the future.

    6. Systems: You think in and build out systems. In solving a problem you recognize the underlying system, then focus on improving the system itself to fix the true cause of an issue.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2030 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

"You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $200k-$400k/yr + up to 0.3%

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

  1. Apply on Ashby

  2. In addition, you’re welcome to email me richie+hiring@joinfella.com

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in Germany.

Join a fully remote game development environment dedicated to creating engaging, high-quality multiplayer gaming experiences with a strong artistic identity. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring game quality throughout development, working closely with engineering, design, art, and production teams. You will develop comprehensive testing strategies, investigate complex technical issues, and help deliver polished, responsive, and reliable gameplay experiences. Your expertise will be particularly valuable in testing Unreal Engine 5 systems, multiplayer functionality, and networked interactions. By identifying risks early and driving continuous quality improvements, you will directly influence the stability and overall player experience of an ambitious PvPvE multiplayer shooter. This opportunity combines technical problem-solving, creative collaboration, and meaningful ownership within a globally distributed team.

Accountabilities

  • Test Planning and Quality Assurance

    • Define and execute comprehensive test coverage across game features, systems, and builds throughout the development lifecycle.

    • Create and maintain structured test plans, test cases, and regression suites based on technical specifications and gameplay requirements.

    • Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and compatibility testing to ensure features meet expected quality standards.

    • Identify potential technical and gameplay risks early, helping prevent issues from escalating during later development stages.

    • Technical Testing and Bug Investigation

      • Identify, reproduce, investigate, and document defects with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, severity assessments, and relevant technical details.

      • Test game features and systems within Unreal Engine 5, applying a strong technical understanding of the engine to investigate issues beyond surface-level behavior.

      • Collaborate directly with engineers, designers, and other team members to diagnose defects, assess their impact, and validate fixes.

      • Investigate gameplay inconsistencies, system interactions, and technical failures to help improve overall game stability and performance.

      • Multiplayer and Network Testing

        • Test multiplayer and networked gameplay systems, identifying issues involving replication, connectivity, latency, synchronization, matchmaking, and player interactions.

        • Validate gameplay behavior across different network conditions and multiplayer scenarios.

        • Support internal playtests, translating observations and player feedback into actionable quality improvements.

        • Help ensure multiplayer features deliver a consistent, responsive, and enjoyable experience.

        • QA Processes, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

          • Maintain accurate bug-tracking workflows, QA documentation, and testing reports using Jira or similar platforms.

          • Monitor defect trends, testing results, and quality metrics to identify recurring problems and areas requiring additional coverage.

          • Contribute to automated testing initiatives, internal QA tools, and scripts where appropriate.

          • Collaborate with production and QA leadership to prioritize defects according to severity, development milestones, and release requirements.

          • Support improvements to QA processes, test efficiency, and collaboration across a distributed development team.

            • Requirements:

            • Strong professional experience in game development QA, ideally in a Senior QA Engineer, QA Engineer, or similarly technical quality assurance role.

            • Proven commercial experience with Unreal Engine 5, gained through a shipped game or a title currently in active production.

            • Solid understanding of game development pipelines and the collaboration required between engineering, design, art, production, and QA teams.

            • Demonstrated experience creating, maintaining, and executing structured test plans, test cases, and regression test suites.

            • Excellent bug investigation and reproduction skills, including the ability to document complex technical issues clearly and precisely.

            • Working knowledge of at least one relevant scripting or programming technology, such as Python, C#, Lua, Unreal Blueprints, or Unreal scripting tools.

            • Experience with QA and defect-tracking platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Bugzilla.

            • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.

            • Experience analyzing QA data, defect trends, and testing outcomes to identify recurring issues, quality gaps, and potential risks.

            • Confidence collaborating directly with technical teams and discussing issues with engineers to support effective investigation and resolution.

            • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work independently across multiple features and development areas.

            • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

            • A proactive, detail-oriented mindset and a commitment to identifying quality issues early rather than relying solely on final-stage testing.

            • Genuine enthusiasm for video games and a strong understanding of what makes gameplay polished, responsive, balanced, and enjoyable.

            • Residence in Europe or a CET-compatible time zone, with sufficient overlap with Central European working hours to participate consistently in team meetings, daily collaboration, and project discussions.

              • The following experience would be an advantage:

              • Previous experience testing multiplayer, PvP, PvE, or shooter games.

              • Experience testing networked gameplay and troubleshooting replication, latency, matchmaking, or online service issues.

              • Experience developing or maintaining automated testing frameworks, QA scripts, or internal testing tools.

              • Familiarity with performance, load, or stress testing.

              • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated build validation.

              • Experience testing games across multiple platforms.

              • Previous experience in AAA game development.

              • Experience working within a fully remote, multinational game development team.

              • Involvement in a game project across multiple production stages, from early development through launch.

              • An active interest in competitive and multiplayer gaming.

                • Benefits:

                • Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely from the Netherlands or another eligible location within Europe, subject to the role's time-zone requirements.

                • Meaningful ownership: Take an active role in shaping game quality and influencing the development of an ambitious multiplayer title.

                • Creative collaboration: Work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and production specialists in a cross-disciplinary environment.

                • International team: Collaborate with talented professionals across different locations, bringing diverse perspectives and expertise to game development.

                • Technical development: Gain hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 5, multiplayer systems, advanced QA workflows, and emerging testing practices.

                • Professional autonomy: Contribute independently, take responsibility for quality outcomes, and help improve development processes.

                • Impact on player experience: Help deliver polished, reliable, and engaging gameplay that meets high standards of performance and enjoyment.

                • Collaborative culture: Join a friendly, open, and communication-focused team that values talent, accountability, and shared goals.

  • Hands-on experience building with or on top of LLMs - agents, RAG, prompt-based features, or tool-calling - in a shipped product
