title: Lead Information Security Analyst
description:
Why Great Gray?

At Great Gray Group, we strive to set the bar for the retirement services industry. Our goal is to deliver advanced retirement solutions that combine our core fiduciary services with robust investment options, innovative technology, and dedicated client service. We focus on making choices clearer, transitions smoother, and the client experience more delightful. Complacency isn't in our vocabulary. Every day, we look for opportunities to better serve our clients, be an excellent business partner, and earn the trust of those who rely on us.

The Role

Great Gray is seeking a Lead Information Security Analyst to join our Information Security team. This role will lead IT governance, risk assessment, and security compliance activities while supporting enterprise risk management and compliance with regulations and frameworks such as SOC 2 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework. The analyst will also coordinate the review, development, implementation, and documentation of policies, processes, procedures, and practices that support the information security management system (ISMS).

Location

This position work remote from the United States. Please note that remote employment in this role is restricted to candidates residing in states where Great Gray is currently registered as an employer. These states are limited to: CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MD, MI, MN, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX and VA.

Visa sponsorship or transfer of an existing visa is not available for this position. Applicants must be authorized to work directly for any employer in the United States without visa sponsorship or transfer.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage GRC functions including compliance monitoring, audit management, and risk assessment.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory requirements and security frameworks (SOC 2, NIST, industry-specific standards, etc.)
  • Prepare for and manage compliance audits, assessments, and regulatory reviews
  • Maintain security documentation, evidence, and audit trails for compliance purposes
  • Develop, maintain, and enforce information security policies and procedures
  • Vendor Risk Management security assessments, onboarding, and reviews.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security and compliance into business processes
  • Mentor and support the Information Security Analysts in both analyst and GRC functions
  • Monitor security posture, identify threats, and recommend remediation measures
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and security assessments on systems and applications
  • Participate in incident response activities and conduct post-incident analysis
  • Stay current with security trends, vulnerabilities, and emerging compliance requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5-10+ years of audit, compliance, or technical experience.
  • Excellent knowledge of IT security control trends as well as auditing & compliance best practices.
  • Effective communication skills (written and verbal) to properly articulate complicated IT controls and compliance issues to leadership and partners.
  • Positive attitude and a strong commitment to delivering quality work.
  • Relevant training and/or industry certifications in auditing, compliance, or IT security.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset to bring best practice ideas to the team.
  • Your standards reflect our core values: Growth Mindset, Disciplined Curiosity, Grit, Results Ownership, Collaboration.

Base Pay Range*

$120,000-$150,000

*This base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

The pay range displayed above is the base pay compensation range that Great Gray expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Individual compensation within this range, or that may warrant a provision for pay beyond this range, depends on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, candidate’s prior education and relevant work experience and training as well as position location and local market demands. Our pay-for-performance culture also includes participation in an annual incentive bonus plan for this position which is not included in the ‘Base Pay Range’ noted above.

Benefits

We have a comprehensive and competitive benefits package at Great Gray. Some of the highlights are:
·Be an integral part of a high-growth organization!
·Competitive compensation package
·Group medical, dental and vision insurance
·Employer-paid life and disability insurance
·Annual well-being stipend
·Eligible employees may also contribute to a 401(k) plan with an advantageous employer contribution model, upholding our mission to support our employees in retirement

Company Background

Great Gray is the leading independent provider of trustee and administrative services to Collective Investment Trusts (“CITs”), with over $385 billion in CIT assets under management, across more than 1,045 funds. We proudly work with more than 80 subadvisors, including leading firms such as AllianceBernstein, American Funds, BlackRock, Franklin Templeton, MetLife, Neuberger Berman, PGIM, PIMCO and Raymond James.
CITs are more than just an investment vehicle. They represent a forward-thinking approach to retirement planning. These tax-exempt, pooled investment vehicles are offered to employer-sponsored retirement plans, like 401(k)s. CITs are comparable to mutual funds, but, because they are tailored for the institutional retirement market, they can offer distinct advantages, including efficient administration and cost-effectiveness. CITs have a history dating back over 90 years; but they have gained favor over the past decade, driven by innovations, and Great Gray has been at the forefront.
Great Gray has consistently delivered year-over-year growth at an above market rate and is investing in the continued development of its core CIT business as well as complementary administrative services and technology solutions for the retirement market.
Madison Dearborn Partners (“MDP”) purchased Great Gray from Wilmington Trust in April 2023. As a result, Great Gray is an independent company owned by funds affiliated with MDP.

Investor Background

MDP is a leading private equity investment firm based in Chicago. Since MDP's formation in 1992, the firm has raised aggregate capital of over $37 billion and has completed over 160 platform investments across nine flagship funds. MDP invests across five dedicated industry verticals, including financial services, healthcare, technology and government services.

An important part of our work is enabling other R&D teams. We create common capabilities and sensible standards while giving developers the tools to handle more of their workflows independently.

The role offers considerable technical variety. One task may involve improving a Kotlin-based pipeline definition, another debugging a Python service, and the next investigating a build agent or hardware-connected test environment.

About you

You have a background in software engineering, computer science, or equivalent practical experience with some years of professional experience. You enjoy working across code, operating systems, infrastructure, and hardware-connected environments.

You also care about whether our solutions work well from the developers’ perspective. You use monitoring, metrics, dashboards, and statistics to understand reliability and performance and to verify that improvements have the intended effect.

You take ownership, balance immediate needs with long-term improvements, and communicate well in English across teams and locations.

You do not need to know our entire technology stack. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, technical curiosity, and sound judgement. Experience with some of the following would be an advantage:

  • TeamCity, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or another CI/CD platform
  • Pipeline configuration as code, particularly TeamCity Kotlin DSL
  • Ansible, Packer, VMware, or other infrastructure automation
  • Docker and containerized services
  • Git, Gerrit, GitLab, Artifactory, REST APIs, and event-driven integrations

We prefer a candidate eager to learn across the stack than someone who matches every item on the list.

At Demant, we value curiosity, collaboration, and technical excellence. You will work in an international, high-trust environment with strong opportunities for growth, while contributing to solutions that improve people’s everyday lives.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in Switzerland.

Join a fully remote game development environment dedicated to creating engaging, high-quality multiplayer gaming experiences with a strong artistic identity. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring game quality throughout development, working closely with engineering, design, art, and production teams. You will develop comprehensive testing strategies, investigate complex technical issues, and help deliver polished, responsive, and reliable gameplay experiences. Your expertise will be particularly valuable in testing Unreal Engine 5 systems, multiplayer functionality, and networked interactions. By identifying risks early and driving continuous quality improvements, you will directly influence the stability and overall player experience of an ambitious PvPvE multiplayer shooter. This opportunity combines technical problem-solving, creative collaboration, and meaningful ownership within a globally distributed team.

Accountabilities

  • Test Planning and Quality Assurance

    • Define and execute comprehensive test coverage across game features, systems, and builds throughout the development lifecycle.

    • Create and maintain structured test plans, test cases, and regression suites based on technical specifications and gameplay requirements.

    • Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and compatibility testing to ensure features meet expected quality standards.

    • Identify potential technical and gameplay risks early, helping prevent issues from escalating during later development stages.

    • Technical Testing and Bug Investigation

      • Identify, reproduce, investigate, and document defects with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, severity assessments, and relevant technical details.

      • Test game features and systems within Unreal Engine 5, applying a strong technical understanding of the engine to investigate issues beyond surface-level behavior.

      • Collaborate directly with engineers, designers, and other team members to diagnose defects, assess their impact, and validate fixes.

      • Investigate gameplay inconsistencies, system interactions, and technical failures to help improve overall game stability and performance.

      • Multiplayer and Network Testing

        • Test multiplayer and networked gameplay systems, identifying issues involving replication, connectivity, latency, synchronization, matchmaking, and player interactions.

        • Validate gameplay behavior across different network conditions and multiplayer scenarios.

        • Support internal playtests, translating observations and player feedback into actionable quality improvements.

        • Help ensure multiplayer features deliver a consistent, responsive, and enjoyable experience.

        • QA Processes, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

          • Maintain accurate bug-tracking workflows, QA documentation, and testing reports using Jira or similar platforms.

          • Monitor defect trends, testing results, and quality metrics to identify recurring problems and areas requiring additional coverage.

          • Contribute to automated testing initiatives, internal QA tools, and scripts where appropriate.

          • Collaborate with production and QA leadership to prioritize defects according to severity, development milestones, and release requirements.

          • Support improvements to QA processes, test efficiency, and collaboration across a distributed development team.

            • Requirements:

            • Strong professional experience in game development QA, ideally in a Senior QA Engineer, QA Engineer, or similarly technical quality assurance role.

            • Proven commercial experience with Unreal Engine 5, gained through a shipped game or a title currently in active production.

            • Solid understanding of game development pipelines and the collaboration required between engineering, design, art, production, and QA teams.

            • Demonstrated experience creating, maintaining, and executing structured test plans, test cases, and regression test suites.

            • Excellent bug investigation and reproduction skills, including the ability to document complex technical issues clearly and precisely.

            • Working knowledge of at least one relevant scripting or programming technology, such as Python, C#, Lua, Unreal Blueprints, or Unreal scripting tools.

            • Experience with QA and defect-tracking platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Bugzilla.

            • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.

            • Experience analyzing QA data, defect trends, and testing outcomes to identify recurring issues, quality gaps, and potential risks.

            • Confidence collaborating directly with technical teams and discussing issues with engineers to support effective investigation and resolution.

            • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work independently across multiple features and development areas.

            • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

            • A proactive, detail-oriented mindset and a commitment to identifying quality issues early rather than relying solely on final-stage testing.

            • Genuine enthusiasm for video games and a strong understanding of what makes gameplay polished, responsive, balanced, and enjoyable.

            • Residence in Europe or a CET-compatible time zone, with sufficient overlap with Central European working hours to participate consistently in team meetings, daily collaboration, and project discussions.

              • The following experience would be an advantage:

              • Previous experience testing multiplayer, PvP, PvE, or shooter games.

              • Experience testing networked gameplay and troubleshooting replication, latency, matchmaking, or online service issues.

              • Experience developing or maintaining automated testing frameworks, QA scripts, or internal testing tools.

              • Familiarity with performance, load, or stress testing.

              • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated build validation.

              • Experience testing games across multiple platforms.

              • Previous experience in AAA game development.

              • Experience working within a fully remote, multinational game development team.

              • Involvement in a game project across multiple production stages, from early development through launch.

              • An active interest in competitive and multiplayer gaming.

                • Benefits:

                • Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely from the Netherlands or another eligible location within Europe, subject to the role's time-zone requirements.

                • Meaningful ownership: Take an active role in shaping game quality and influencing the development of an ambitious multiplayer title.

                • Creative collaboration: Work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and production specialists in a cross-disciplinary environment.

                • International team: Collaborate with talented professionals across different locations, bringing diverse perspectives and expertise to game development.

                • Technical development: Gain hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 5, multiplayer systems, advanced QA workflows, and emerging testing practices.

                • Professional autonomy: Contribute independently, take responsibility for quality outcomes, and help improve development processes.

                • Impact on player experience: Help deliver polished, reliable, and engaging gameplay that meets high standards of performance and enjoyment.

title: Director of Learning Design
description:
About Tergar Schools

Tergar Schools is a Buddhist-inspired K–12 education nonprofit building a new model of learning (MOL). We operate a pilot school in Kathmandu, Nepal, and are constructing a larger campus in the Yolmo Valley in the Himalayas.

Our model rests on a simple starting point: every child possesses basic goodness and its qualities of awareness, love, compassion, wisdom, and joy. It is our job as educators to help them recognize this and give them tools to sustain it. Our long-term aspiration is to help form people who are resilient, altruistic, and joyful.

We’re now building the next chapter of that work: a comprehensive, fully secular model designed to weave into any school’s existing life — not just our own campuses. Rather than build more schools ourselves, we intend to reach 100+ schools in 4+ countries within five years by helping other schools, secular or religious, adopt the model as their own.

Why This Role Exists

Our footprint is growing quickly. Two high-performing private schools will begin piloting our model of learning in 2027. A research lab opens in Nepal with a world-class science team. The interest is real and growing.

What we don’t have yet is a full-time position for building the model itself — the products, courses, training materials, and classroom materials that will constitute MOL — and for leading the team that builds it out.

Today that thinking lives mostly with our Executive Director and the instincts of our founding team. This isn’t sustainable at scale. We need someone who can be fully dedicated to this element of our project: an outside-the-box thinker with real contemplative experience, genuinely excited by the challenge of building an entire family of products from scratch rather than adapting an existing portfolio.

The Opportunity

This is a builder’s role. You will not inherit a finished product, a proven training program, or a team. You will build those things — starting hands-on, in the room, with our first two outside partner schools — and then lead the team that takes them to scale.

We have materials. However, none of them is a comprehensive, fully secular contemplative model designed to weave into everything a school already does. That is what you would be building, and there is no template for it.

If you are energized by deciding who you need around you rather than inheriting an org chart, and comfortable being personally in the work now so that later you can hand it to people you have trained this is the position for you. .

What You’ll Own

Building the model

  • Design the teacher training program at the center of the MOL — the core product.
  • Build out the materials that make the training usable in a real school. Today we imagine adaptable toolkits fitted by hand to each school, a playbook for staff and administrators, and family-facing materials. That is a starting hypothesis, not a spec — the process of choosing what comes is yours to lead.
  • Run the model as a product, not a document. Form real hypotheses about what teachers and schools need, test them in live classrooms, and let what you learn change what gets built.
  • Propose what gets built now and what waits — and defend those calls. We hold two commitments at once: build lean, and be the best in the world at this. We call it Minimum Viable Mastery. You are the person who makes that real week to week, not just in principle.

Nailing the first schools

  • Be personally hands-on with our new partner schools in Nepal as they begin onboarding in 2027. You will do this work in tandem with the Executive Director (ED).
  • Use what you learn there to define what a stable first phase actually looks like, and build the real template other schools will follow.

Building your team

  • Decide what team you need, and in what order — a Nepal Country Director and Trainer, Country Coordinators, strategic consultants, instructional designers, a UX researcher, and others as the shape of the work becomes clear (a Head of Training in Nepal is currently being hired).
  • The ED and the Director of Operations (DOO) authorize and execute the actual hiring. The judgment about who and when is yours.

Setting the standard, over time

  • Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche and the ED hold final say on model fidelity today. As you build a track record — likely marked by a completed first onboarding cycle with our two partner schools — that authority shifts substantively to you.
  • Turn Rinpoche’s two to four multi-day sessions a year into material the team can use again: recorded, distilled, built into training, rather than a remarkable conversation nobody can revisit.

Working with the evidence

  • Partner with the research lab opening in Nepal in late 2026 — led by Drs. Richard Davidson, Robert Roeser, and Robin Nusslock — translating what they learn into real product and training decisions.

What’s Yours, and What Isn’t

You own the model and the team you build around you. Three things sit outside that:

  • Fundraising and donor relationships. A separate role entirely.
  • In-country adaptation and community relationships. Local teams own this on the ground, but you liaise with them directly and are in very frequent communication.
  • Hiring mechanics. You decide who you need and when; the DOO handles offers, contracts, and process.

One thing sits in between: production. Instructional designers, visual designers, and media support will eventually build finished materials from your direction. You will not be making them yourself for long — but their quality is still on you.

Who You Are

What we’re really looking for

  • A builder grounded in pedagogy. Deep pedagogical expertise is essential — you understand how children and adults actually learn, and you've designed for it. What sets you apart is that you build and deliver: you've turned that expertise into programs, curricula, or training that real teachers use. A tech or startup background alongside that is a genuine asset.
  • Fluency in a lean approach to product design. You can talk concretely about strategic experiments, problem/solution and product/market fit, and validated learning — and you have actually worked that way, not just read about it.
  • Real, lived contemplative experience. A genuine taste of practice, not necessarily in Tergar’s own lineage, and not merely theoretical familiarity. This is the one non-negotiable that doesn’t bend for the right resume.
  • Comfortable being hands-on first and stepping back later. Personally in the work with our first schools, then deliberately building the standards and training that let a team carry it without you in the room.
  • Able to build lean and aim to be the best in the world at the same time, without treating those as a trade-off.

Experience

  • You bring substantial experience in education — as a teacher, school leader, curriculum developer, or learning designer — and you've built something real from that experience and gotten it into people's hands without much money or staff.
  • Some experience directing, mentoring, or building a team from scratch, since you will be doing exactly that here.
  • Comfort working directly from a founder’s evolving vision rather than a finished brief — you will be co-writing the brief as you go, especially in the first months.

Personal qualities

  • Discernment above all: knowing which calls are yours to make outright and which need to go to the Rinpoche or the ED. This carries more weight here than almost any other quality, because for a long stretch there is no layer of management between your judgment and the model’s integrity.
  • Genuine curiosity about and respect for a tradition that may not be your own, without needing to adopt it as your own practice.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and a mandate that will keep changing shape under you as the first schools teach you things no one currently knows.

How We Work Together

  • Intensive, hands-on time in Nepal during onboarding and the first deployment of the model. Expect three to five months during the first year.
  • Frequent, close contact with the ED for the first six months, settling into a slower rhythm as trust builds.
  • Two to four multi-day sessions a year with Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche, alongside the wider team.
  • A small, distributed, high-autonomy culture across Vermont, Wisconsin, Ireland, Kathmandu, and Minnesota — deep, steady, skillful work over speed.

Compensation & Logistics

  • Full-time
  • Fully remote.
  • Compensation: $75,000–$100,000, DOE
  • Benefits: flexible schedule, unlimited PTO, and health care reimbursement up to $1,000 per month
Salary: $75,000 - $100,000 DOE

description:
Medicinske Tidsskrifter søger en skrivende redaktør

Kan du finde den væsentlige historie i nye forskningsresultater, stille kritiske spørgsmål og gøre en tekst skarpere? Vi søger en erfaren sundhedsjournalist, der kan skrive, redigere og holde flere nyhedsbreve i luften. Tiltrædelse 1. januar 2027.

Hos Medicinske Tidsskrifter skriver vi til læger om ny forskning, behandling og de beslutninger, der former klinisk praksis. Vi laver både hurtig nyhedsjournalistik og længere gravehistorier, som kræver vedholdende research, dokumentation og kritisk sans.

Vi søger en skrivende redaktør, der har lyst til at tage ansvar for både egne historier og det redaktionelle arbejde. Du skal kunne finde og udvikle historier, redigere andres tekster og planlægge flere nyhedsbreve i løbet af en måned.

En del af arbejdet er at dække medicinske kongresser, hvor du skal kunne vurdere nye forskningsresultater, interviewe eksperter og levere journalistik med høj faglig præcision – også når tempoet er højt.

Dine opgaver

· Skrive nyheder, interviews, baggrundsartikler og længere gravehistorier.

· Planlægge og sammensætte nyhedsbreve på tværs af medicinske specialer.

· Redigere artikler med blik for vinkel, sprog, dokumentation og relevans for læserne.

· Dække medicinske kongresser og omsætte nye data til journalistik for læger.

· Udvikle historier og idéer på tværs af trykte magasiner, online temaer, nyhedsbreve og webinarer.

Vi søger dig, der

· Har erfaring med sundhedsjournalistik og er en sikker skribent.

· Kan læse og formidle klinisk forskning med forståelse for resultaternes betydning og begrænsninger.

· Har redaktionelt overblik og kan håndtere flere udgivelser og deadlines.

· Kan give konstruktiv feedback og løfte en tekst i samarbejde med skribenten.

· Arbejder selvstændigt, opsøgende og kritisk – og trives med tæt redaktionelt samarbejde.

Det er en fordel, hvis du kender medicinalindustrien og dens rolle i sundhedsvæsenet. Vi ser også gerne, at du har lyst til at tænke på tværs af formater og finde den form, der passer bedst til historien og målgruppen.

Hos os får du plads til at udvikle dig

Du får en rolle med både skriveopgaver og redaktionelt ansvar – og mulighed for at udvikle dine faglige ambitioner. Vi giver plads til initiativ og til, at du kan være med til at præge vores journalistik, formater og projekter.

Har du ambitioner om at påtage dig lederopgaver, er der mulighed for at bevæge dig i den retning. Du kan også arbejde på tværs af organisationen og bringe dine idéer og kompetencer i spil i samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af vores medier og aktiviteter.

Du kommer tæt på den forskning og de faglige diskussioner, som påvirker lægers arbejde, og får mulighed for at arbejde med både aktuelle nyheder og historier, der kræver større fordybelse.

Praktisk information

Arbejdssted: Københavnsområdet med en høj grad af hjemmearbejde. Hos os foregår en stor del af arbejdet hjemmefra. Vi mødes fysisk en til to gange om ugen i Københavnsområdet til redaktionelt samarbejde, sparring og planlægning.

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027.

Send din ansøgning, dit CV og gerne et par eksempler på din journalistik til bo@medicinsketidsskrifter.dk senest 20. oktober 2026.

Vi holder samtaler i slutningen af oktober og begyndelsen af november.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte chefredaktør Bo Karl Christensen på samme mailadresse.

title: Senior ML Engineer
description:
Welcome to Your Next Adventure!

What You’ll Get Your Hands On

  • Develop and deploy machine learning and optimization algorithms powering Snoonu’s hybrid autonomous logistics platform, enabling intelligent coordination across human couriers, ground robots, and drones.
  • Design and implement advanced optimization strategies for task allocation, routing, scheduling, and dispatch decision‑making across a multi‑agent fleet environment.
  • Develop and train multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) models to improve fleet‑wide coordination efficiency under dynamic demand and traffic conditions.
  • Build demand forecasting and spatiotemporal prediction models using modern architectures (e.g., Transformers, temporal models, graph‑based methods) to support proactive positioning and better resource planning.
  • Develop energy‑aware and environment‑aware optimization models to improve battery utilization, charging schedules, delivery sequencing, and overall operational efficiency under Qatar’s climate constraints.
  • Integrate ML optimization models into the Robotics‑as‑a‑Service (RaaS) orchestration platform in collaboration with platform/backend engineers, ensuring reliability and low‑latency decision making.
  • Evaluate model performance using defined metrics such as routing efficiency, ETA prediction accuracy, fleet coordination latency, and energy impact—supporting TRL advancement and pilot readiness.
  • Implement experimentation pipelines including offline benchmarking, simulation validation, and controlled field pilot evaluation to improve model accuracy and generalization.
  • Support continuous learning and model lifecycle management, including monitoring, retraining strategies, and mitigation of model drift using operational datasets.
  • Document model architecture, assumptions, validation results, and experimentation methods to support R&D reporting, internal knowledge sharing, and stakeholder alignment.

The Magic You Bring

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, Operations Research, or a related field. (PhD is a plus for research‑driven optimisation work.)
  • 2–4 years of backend development experience, with strong hands‑on Python/C++ expertise.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to work on complex real‑world robotics challenges.
  • Research‑oriented mindset and ability to translate experimentation into production‑ready autonomy improvements.
  • Ability to work effectively in cross‑functional teams (robotics, embedded, platform/software, operations).
  • Clear communication skills and ability to document technical work, trade‑offs, and validation outcomes.
  • High ownership and accountability for results, timelines, and engineering quality.
  • Adaptability to fast‑paced R&D environments involving prototyping, testing, and iterative development.
  • Strong business context understanding, able to translate operational needs into technical solutions.
  • Open to feedback and proactive in applying improvements suggested by senior engineers or tech leads.

Core Backend & Python

  • Strong foundation in Python, including OOP principles, design patterns, and writing clean, maintainable code.
  • Experience building backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
  • Ability to design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs with proper error handling and logging.

AWS & Cloud

  • Experience using AWS services, such as Lambda, SQS/SNS, API Gateway, Step Functions, DynamoDB, RDS, S3, and CloudWatch.
  • Experience designing event‑driven and serverless architectures.
  • Familiarity with IAM, environment configuration, and cloud security best practices.

Embedded systems focus

  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience using deep learning frameworks
  • Hands‑on experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Multi‑Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL)
    • Optimisation and decision systems for routing, scheduling, dispatch
    • Time‑series forecasting and spatiotemporal modelling
    • Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for mobility and routing problems
    • Energy optimisation and predictive control techniques (MPC, hybrid ML+control)
  • Strong understanding of evaluation methodologies, including metrics design, baselines, A/B testing, and offline/online validation.
  • Experience working with large‑scale datasets, feature engineering, and model deployment constraints.
  • Familiarity with simulation environments, digital twins, or synthetic data generation workflows is a strong plus.
  • Knowledge of real‑time systems, streaming data pipelines, and ML model monitoring practices is an advantage.
  • Experience in logistics, last‑mile delivery, fleet routing, or mobility analytics is a strong advantage.

Inside Snoonu’s Universe

Snoonu is Qatar’s homegrown Super App, reinventing daily life with blazing-fast delivery, ride‑hailing, and shopping — all in one place. Powered by tech, driven by a global team, and obsessed with making life easier.

The Dream We’re Chasing

To be the first Qatari Super App that propels the region and its community through innovation and technology. We envision a global expansion where what we do surpasses norms and limitations every time.

The Quest We’re On

To radically transform how people live by leveraging technology to connect them with endless possibilities.

Our Everyday Superpowers

Be Customer Obsessed: “Focus on the customer and all else will follow.”

Act with Integrity: “We are honest, ethical, and trustworthy in everything we do.”

Be Curious and Creative: “We constantly innovate and create solutions to bring a lasting positive impact.”

Lead by Example and Take Ownership: “Be the change you want to see and take ownership.”

Work Smart and Deliver Results: “You can do more by doing less, better, and faster.”

It’s All About People: “Be a team player; together we are stronger.”

Real Builders Ship: “We turn ideas into products, plans into action, and challenges into opportunities.”

Perks & Work‑life Magic At Snoonu

Remote & Global Vibes – Collaborate with a worldwide crew.

Brain Boosters – Learning budgets, access to courses, and tools for your growth.

Builder’s Playground – Own your tasks, own your path! We’re big on autonomy.

Flexible Time Off – We take recharging seriously. Generous leave and wellness policies.

Agile Everything – Scrum isn’t a buzzword here. It’s how we roll, from product to ops.

Beyond the Code: Giving Back Matters

We don’t just build app. We’re committed to doing business sustainably and giving back to the community that fuels us. From eco‑conscious practices to CSR projects, we’re always finding ways to do better—and we invite you to be a part of that mission.

Diversity Isn’t Just a Buzzword

At Snoonu, fairness and inclusion are the foundation of everything we do. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace that welcomes people from every walk of life. Be bold. Be you. Thrive here.

title: Seasonal Key Holder
description:
We’re looking for music and pop culture fanatics to help create the best experience for our customers. As a Hot Topic Seasonal Key Holder, you’ll be a huge part of our success by supporting the store leadership team in providing the best customer experience, ensuring that fellow fans are able to get their hands on the merch they love. You’ll use your fandom knowledge to help train new recruits and ensure their success, while also supporting your Store Manager in daily operations and meeting sales targets

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Provide an amazing shopping experience that will encourage customers to return. They’ll be impressed by your product knowledge, customer experience skills and use of the Force
  • Step in and step up when needed. You’ll provide leadership support and help run the store when your Manager gets pulled away
  • Understand store sales plan and comp sales goals, and help drive sales by increasing key KPIs: UPT and ADT
  • Cover the sales floor zone and ensure that assigned areas are up to visual standards. You’ll also help in the opening and closing of the store
  • Work the register; you’ll process sales transactions and use your fandom knowledge to drive add on sales. We’ll need you to also be able to close out the register and communicate and shortages or overages to your Store Manager
  • Assist with planogram changes including store map, wall, fixture, & merchandising mix
  • Let your voice be heard! You’ll communicate fashion & music trend information to management and respective HQ partners
  • While we welcome wizards, we don’t like it when spells are stolen. You’ll work with Store Management to ensure there’s no misuse of spells and wizardry around theft.
  • Support the maintenance of the mother ship; you’ll help keep the stock room organized and the store tidy.
  • Train and coach new Sales Associates as needed to help them quickly get acclimated to the team
  • Any other activities as assigned by your Store Leader

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Previous experience working in a retail environment. If you love music and pop culture, you’re in the right place!
  • Superpowers in providing customer service and selling
  • A High School Diploma or GED equivalent
  • Avenger like collaboration and communication skills, as well as Captain America-like leadership
  • The usual retail stuff: able to stand and walk around during scheduled hours, reaching for Merch using a ladder, step stool and pole. You’ll also have to be able to move around boxes of awesome merchandise that may weigh up to 50 pounds

title: Production Assistant
description:
Production Assistant | Healthy School Lunches Program

35 hours per week | Monday to Friday | Primary/Secondary school term time

University of Canterbury Student's Association (UCSA)

The Healthy School Lunches Program is a government initiative that aims to reduce food insecurity by providing children with access to a nutritious school lunch every day. The UCSA provides around 2700 of these lunches each day in the Christchurch area.

Based at our Hornby Production Kitchen, the Production Assistant plays a key role in supporting the Production Team with the daily operations of the kitchen. Responsibilities include food preparation and production, ensuring delicious and nutritious lunches are prepared to a high standard and ready on time. You will also work closely with the Production Supervisor to assist with planning, ordering and coordinating designated sections of the kitchen, helping to ensure the smooth and efficient day-to-day running of the production operation.

This is a full-time role of 35 hours per week Monday - Friday, during primary/ secondary term time.

In this role, you will work day shifts which are generally 6.30am – 2.00pm.

You will have:

· At least two years’ previous experience in a kitchen environment

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills - especially the ability to work as part of a team

· Ability to prioritise, multitask, show initiative and work well under pressure

· Physically fit as some heavy lifting is required

· Honest, dependable, diligent, flexible and enthusiastic

· Legal entitlement to work in New Zealand either as a New Zealand citizen/resident or valid work visa

About UCSA

Nau Mai Ki Te Rōpū Akonga ō Te Whare Wānanga ō Waitaha

Welcome to The University of Canterbury Students’ Association (UCSA)

Established in 1894, the UCSA is a registered not-for-profit organisation that supports UC students to succeed and belong.

Our organisation is governed by an elected Student Executive, and we employ over 300 staff. Together, we dish up a range of student-focused services, including advocacy and welfare, representation, subsidised dental and optometry, early learning centres, club support, events, and media.

title: Seasonal Key Holder
description:
We’re looking for music and pop culture fanatics to help create the best experience for our customers at Southcentre mall. As a Hot Topic Seasonal Key Holder, you’ll be a huge part of our success by supporting the store leadership team in providing the best customer experience, ensuring that fellow fans are able to get their hands on the merch they love. You’ll use your fandom knowledge to help train new recruits and ensure their success, while also supporting your Store Manager in daily operations and meeting sales targets.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Provide an amazing shopping experience that will encourage customers to return. They’ll be impressed by your product knowledge, customer experience skills and use of the Force
  • Step in and step up when needed. You’ll provide leadership support and help run the store when your Manager gets pulled away
  • Understand store sales plan and comp sales goals, and help drive sales by increasing key KPIs: UPT and ADT
  • Cover the sales floor zone and ensure that assigned areas are up to visual standards. You’ll also help in the opening and closing of the store
  • Work the register; you’ll process sales transactions and use your fandom knowledge to drive add on sales. We’ll need you to also be able to close out the register and communicate and shortages or overages to your Store Manager
  • Assist with planogram changes including store map, wall, fixture, & merchandising mix
  • Let your voice be heard! You’ll communicate fashion & music trend information to management and respective HQ partners
  • While we welcome wizards, we don’t like it when spells are stolen. You’ll work with Store Management to ensure there’s no misuse of spells and wizardry around theft.
  • Support the maintenance of the mother ship; you’ll help keep the stock room organized and the store tidy.
  • Train and coach new Sales Associates as needed to help them quickly get acclimated to the team
  • Any other activities as assigned by your Store Leader

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Previous experience working in a retail environment. If you love music and pop culture, you’re in the right place!
  • Superpowers in providing customer service and selling
  • A High School Diploma or GED equivalent
  • Avenger like collaboration and communication skills, as well as Captain America-like leadership
  • The usual retail stuff: able to stand and walk around during scheduled hours, reaching for Merch using a ladder, step stool and pole. You’ll also have to be able to move around boxes of awesome merchandise that may weigh up to 50 pounds

Provides residents with services in accordance with health care provider’s orders regarding administration or assistance with medications and treatments, as per state regulations. Provides direct care to residents following the individualized service plan.

Essential Functions

  1. Assists in maintaining the physical, social, and psychological environment that is conducive to the best interest and welfare of the residents.

title: Data Engineering and Platform Manager
description:
Data Engineering and Platform Manager

Data Pipelines Platforms Quality and Reliability

  • Reports to: Chief Data and Analytics Officer
  • Department: IDEA — Intelligence, Data, Engineering & Analytics
  • Team structure: Two Team Leads and four Analysts across Data Platform Engineering and Data Integration & Governance

Position Summary

  • The Data Engineering and Platform Manager is the senior hands-on leader for WBL's analytical data foundation on Azure and Databricks. Reporting to the CDAO, this role manages through two Team Leads, each responsible for two Analysts.
  • Data Platform Engineering builds and operates the lakehouse, pipelines, data models, and platform services;
  • Data Integration & Governance owns analytical ingestion, data quality controls, master/reference data capabilities, and lineage.
  • The Manager sets architecture and engineering standards, translates business and product needs into scalable data capabilities, and remains technically engaged in the design and resolution of high-impact work.
  • The role is accountable for a platform that is reliable, secure, cost-disciplined, well documented, and capable of supporting fast business endpoints and analytical products at scale.

Core Responsibilities

Lead Data Engineering Teams

  • Manage, coach, and develop two Team Leads and four Analysts, with clear ownership, technical standards, feedback, and accountability.
  • Set team priorities, allocate capacity, remove delivery blockers, and maintain appropriate operational coverage for critical data services.
  • Own the platform roadmap and resource plan; hire, assess performance, develop Team Leads, and build succession coverage for critical data capabilities. Maintain regular hands‑on involvement in priority delivery.

Build and Operate the Data Platform

  • Oversee data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, and delivery from design through production support. Work backward from business endpoints and product requirements to define business‑ready data models, schemas, freshness, and performance requirements.
  • Maintain platform availability, performance, monitoring, scalability, and cost discipline, including incident response and root‑cause follow‑up.
  • Set the target data architecture and modernization priorities; translate product needs into delivery commitments and balance capacity, performance, resilience, and platform cost.

Govern Data Quality and Security

  • Set standards for data architecture, master/reference data, testing, deployment, documentation, lineage, access, retention, and change control across the analytical platform.
  • Partner with analytics, intelligence products, security, infrastructure, and business owners to provide dependable governed data; business owners define source meaning and own source‑process corrections. Own analytical‑platform ingestion and data delivery; Software Engineering owns operational application integrations. Agree interface contracts and incident routing at shared boundaries.
  • Lead resolution of material data‑service issues and recurring control weaknesses; agree corrective actions with source owners and technical partners and verify lasting improvement.

Role Expectations

This is a senior manager role with substantial individual contribution. The Manager is expected to personally design or review important data models and architecture, troubleshoot complex pipeline and performance issues, and step into critical delivery when needed. At the same time, the Manager must build a durable organization through hiring, coaching, delegation, standards, performance management, and succession development. Team Leads are expected to contribute substantively to delivery as well as supervise their teams. Analyst is the corporate grade for staff performing data engineering and data integration/governance work.

Appendix Provisional Performance Scorecard

The following scorecard is separate from the core role description. Existing weights are provisional and require agreement after a baseline period; targets should reflect maturity, complexity, and criticality. Assess platform controls and incident response directly; identify source‑data dependencies and agree shared end‑to‑end performance measures with product and engineering owners.

  • Education:
    • Relevant education or professional training in computer science, engineering, information systems, data, or a related discipline is valued. Demonstrated technical depth, leadership, and production delivery experience are the primary qualifications; a degree is not mandatory.
  • Required Experience
    • Twelve or more years of progressive experience in data engineering, data platforms, or data architecture, including at least five years of people leadership and meaningful experience leading Team Leads, managers, or senior technical staff.
    • Demonstrated success building, scaling, or materially modernizing a production data platform or data engineering function. Must be able to coach Team Leads, develop senior technical talent, allocate capacity, establish engineering standards, manage incidents and operational risk, and make roadmap and prioritization decisions with senior business leaders. Recent hands‑on technical delivery is required; this is not a management‑only role.
    • Experience designing business‑ready curated or gold‑layer datasets by working backward from downstream products, calculators, APIs, reporting, or decision‑support requirements rather than treating ingestion as the endpoint.
    • Experience operating data platforms with large datasets and demanding performance requirements, including query and data‑model optimization, partitioning or clustering strategies, caching, and other techniques used to support low‑latency analytical workloads.
    • Experience integrating data from operational systems, third‑party vendors, APIs, files, and batch feeds while managing data contracts, schema changes, reconciliation, lineage, and source‑quality issues.
    • Experience establishing pragmatic data governance inside an engineering organization, including ownership, data‑quality controls, metadata/documentation, lineage, access, retention, and production change controls.
    • Financial‑services, lending, credit, portfolio, or other data‑intensive regulated‑industry experience is helpful but not required.
  • Technical Skills
    • Deep practical experience with SQL, dimensional and analytical data modeling, ETL/ELT, orchestration, APIs, cloud storage and compute, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, monitoring, and incident management. Strong practical ability to design and lead delivery in an Azure and Databricks environment, including lakehouse patterns, workload performance, reliability, and cost optimization.
  • Soft Skills
    • Strong understanding of data quality, lineage, metadata, master/reference data, access control, security, retention, schema evolution, change management, performance engineering, and cloud cost management.
    • Able to translate between business requirements, product requirements, and technical architecture and to explain trade‑offs clearly to both executives and engineers.
  • Preferred Background / Industry Experience
    • Experience in lending or financial services, business‑user support, and data reconciliation preferred.

What We Offer

Compensation in USD.

Benefits include paid time off (PTO).

Work Environment: Fully remote work environment.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager based in Portugal.

Join a globally distributed technology organization where you will drive critical IT and Information Security initiatives across multiple technical and business teams. In this hands-on role, you will coordinate projects from initial planning through implementation and operational handover, ensuring clear ownership, priorities, and measurable outcomes. You will play a key role in advancing security improvements, coordinating vulnerability remediation, and ensuring critical actions are completed on time. By consolidating information across multiple Jira environments, you will turn fragmented project data into actionable insights that support better decision-making. You will collaborate closely with IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and Platform/DevOps teams in a fast-paced, international environment. This is an opportunity to take ownership, improve delivery processes, and make a meaningful impact on technology operations and organizational security.

Accountabilities

  • IT Project and Initiative Management

    • Lead IT projects and internal technology initiatives from requirements gathering and planning through implementation, rollout, and operational handover.

    • Define project scope, milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, timelines, and success criteria.

    • Coordinate delivery across IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Information Security, and business teams.

    • Proactively identify and resolve blockers, manage competing priorities, mitigate risks, and drive decisions to keep projects on track.

    • Oversee initiatives involving identity and access management (IAM/SSO), Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, enterprise SaaS, endpoint technologies, AWS and cloud services, corporate connectivity, internal systems, and IT automation.

    • Information Security Delivery Management

      • Coordinate security initiatives across Information Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform/DevOps, and Red Team and Blue Team functions.

      • Track vulnerability findings and remediation activities from identification through validation and closure, ensuring clear ownership and realistic target dates.

      • Manage follow-up actions arising from penetration tests, Red Team/Blue Team exercises, security reviews, incidents, and ongoing security improvement programs.

      • Ensure security-related tasks are appropriately prioritized, supported by actionable remediation plans, and completed within agreed timelines.

      • Identify stalled, overdue, or high-risk activities and drive escalation, prioritization, and cross-team follow-up.

      • Facilitate security delivery without directly conducting security testing or vulnerability analysis.

      • Jira Management, Task Governance, and Analytics

        • Maintain consolidated visibility of IT and Information Security initiatives distributed across multiple Jira instances, projects, teams, and workflows.

        • Establish consistent reporting practices, ensuring data quality, traceability, and reliable visibility into delivery progress.

        • Monitor backlogs, aging tasks, overdue work, vulnerability remediation progress, throughput, and other relevant delivery metrics.

        • Analyze historical and current data to identify recurring issues, delivery bottlenecks, emerging risks, and performance trends.

        • Automate data collection, aggregation, and reporting wherever practical to improve operational efficiency.

        • Transform fragmented task-level information into actionable management insights that support prioritization and informed decision-making.

        • Cross-Team Coordination and Governance

          • Serve as a central coordination point between Information Security, IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform/DevOps, system owners, business functions, and management.

          • Maintain clear visibility of risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and commitments across distributed teams.

          • Clarify ownership, facilitate prioritization, and resolve coordination challenges when teams have competing demands.

          • Deliver concise management updates focused on progress, trends, exceptions, risks, and decisions requiring attention.

          • Establish practical project governance and delivery processes that strengthen accountability without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

            • Requirements:

            • At least 5 years of experience in IT/IS Project Management, Security Project Management, Technical Project Management, or a related field.

            • Demonstrated experience delivering technology or security initiatives across multiple technical teams and managing complex dependencies.

            • Experience working closely with Information Security and Engineering organizations, with a practical understanding of how technical teams operate.

            • Strong hands-on experience with Jira for project coordination, task tracking, backlog management, and delivery governance.

            • Experience working across multiple Jira projects, workflows, or systems, ideally with an understanding of how to consolidate information from different environments.

            • Proven ability to produce consolidated reports, define and monitor KPIs, and analyze delivery trends using task-level data.

            • Strong project management capabilities, including scope definition, timeline management, prioritization, risk mitigation, dependency tracking, and stakeholder coordination.

            • Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across different functions and time zones.

            • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior management.

            • Strong analytical thinking, organizational skills, and attention to detail, combined with a proactive approach to identifying problems and driving solutions.

            • Ability to work independently, take ownership of delivery outcomes, and balance structured governance with the flexibility required in a fast-moving technology environment.

              • The following qualifications and experience are considered an advantage:

              • Experience managing vulnerability remediation programs and coordinating security improvement initiatives.

              • Familiarity with Red Team and Blue Team activities and the coordination of security testing follow-up actions.

              • Experience consolidating data across multiple Jira instances or building automated Jira reporting solutions.

              • Knowledge of operational dashboards, workflow automation, and delivery analytics.

              • Exposure to AWS, cloud infrastructure, or cloud security environments.

title: Platform Engineer - AI Engineering
description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

The Team:

As AI tools drive immense value across the firm, our organization faces a "Dual Mandate": providing low-friction access to the best frontier AI tools while strictly managing an exponentially growing cost curve. The unified AI Platform Team builds the centralized software, operations, and governance layers that safely route users to the most cost-effective models.

The Role:

We are looking for a Platform Engineer to help build and operationalize our AI tooling ecosystem. Working closely with the Team Lead and Senior/Staff SWE, you will be the hands-on integrator connecting external cloud AI providers, internal models, and end-user tools into our unified control plane.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Configure and manage multi-engine API gateways, implementing dynamic routing rules, rate limits, and fallback logic for LLM requests.
  • Execute the technical migration and integration of firm-wide tools into our centralized management plane to ensure all AI traffic is securely logged and governed.
  • Operate within our Shared Responsibility Model alongside the Cloud team to manage AI services deployed in enterprise landing zones (e.g., managing Azure OpenAI instances, model deployments, and API key generation).
  • Write robust Go and Python code to support the continuous sync loop for our usage dashboard and implement automated "progressive friction" mechanisms, such as alerts.
  • Partner with the Inference Infrastructure pod to ensure our self-hosted, on-premise models are successfully registered and routable within our AI gateways.

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong backend programming experience, specifically in Go and/or Python.
  • Hands‑on experience with API design, integration, and platform/cloud engineering concepts.
  • Familiarity with API gateways, proxy configuration, or distributed system networking.
  • A strong interest in the rapidly evolving LLM ecosystem and the technical mechanics of AI tooling.
  • A collaborative mindset with a focus on writing clean, maintainable code to replace prototype systems.

title: Senior Product Designer - ShareGate
description:
About ShareGate

ShareGate is the leading Microsoft 365 migration and governance platform, trusted by over 100,000 IT pros for its unmatched simplicity.

It offers the simplest, most reliable, and most affordable way to move business data to Microsoft 365.

Whether migrating from Google Workspace, file shares, Exchange Online, SharePoint On-Premises, or tenant-to-tenant, ShareGate gets the job done, without surprises. From cloud transformation to M&A integration, it keeps things just damn simple.

ShareGate also helps organizations stay in control once their data is migrated. Its powerful governance features let users assess environments, uncover issues, and apply fixes on the spot, so everything stays clean, secure, and optimized. It lays the groundwork for safe Microsoft Copilot deployment within organizations.

ShareGate is developed by Workleap Technologies, a Montréal‑based software company.

Your role

Almost every company now runs on Microsoft 365, and almost nobody has it fully under control. Work has to be moved into it and around it, through mergers, acquisitions and reorganizations that touch millions of files and can't afford to lose a single one. And once it's there it sprawls faster than anyone can track, with people sharing things they shouldn't and no clear view of what's actually going on. ShareGate is what IT professionals use to do both jobs. Taking something this complex and this consequential and making it feel simple and trustworthy is what we're here to do.

Your impact:

  • Own a whole product area end-to-end, from framing the problem with your team to shipping the solution customers actually use, and monitoring for learnings after.
  • Design AI-first flows where the product does the real work for customers while they stay fully in control.
  • Turn genuinely complicated situations into something a busy person can understand at a glance and feel confident acting on.
  • Put bold bets in front of real customers early, measure what happens, and let the result change the plan, including when it proves you wrong.
  • Bring AI into your own way of working so you can go from a question to something real and testable in days, and put it in front of customers while it's still rough.
  • Raise the bar for everyone around you through critique, through the standards you hold, and by making your thinking clear enough that the team can carry a decision without you in the room.

Your team

You'll join our design team at ShareGate and partner with a product lead and an engineering lead on every project you own, from first idea to launch. We're hiring across two sides of the product right now: one focused on moving companies into and around Microsoft 365, one focused on keeping it secure and organized once they're there. Both are big, high-stakes problems, and we'll work out together which one fits you best.

We're builders. We care a lot about craft and taste, we expect people to own their work rather than wait to be handed it, and we'd rather take a big swing on what's genuinely best for customers than ship the safe version. AI is part of how we work every day; it helps us move faster and try more ideas, not think less. Work gets shared early and often, feedback is direct, and decisions get made quickly and revisited just as quickly when we learn something new.

The people we design for run IT at their companies. They're experts who get the call when something breaks. Our job is to earn their trust and make complex, high-stakes workflows feel simple.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years designing complex software for businesses, with shipped work you owned from the first question to the last detail;
  • A systems mind: you design the whole journey and think about what happens next, not one screen at a time;
  • The judgment to make design decisions that are hard to take back: what people see first, what they confirm, what they can reverse;
  • A weekly habit of talking to real customers, and the discipline to let what they actually do change your direction;
  • Design rationale you can defend out loud to designers, engineers, and executives alike: the problem, the options you turned down, the trade-off you made;
  • Real fluency using AI in your own workflow, with the judgment to know where it helps and where it gets in the way;
  • The drive to take your work the last mile yourself: refining and polishing in the real product and pushing those changes straight to production;
  • Comfort working without a clear brief: you name the assumption, pick a direction, and learn in the open;
  • Bonus: experience designing for IT, security, data or any audience where the user is an expert and a wrong move is expensive.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

  • Base salary: $125 000 - $160 000.This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale.Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
  • Annual bonus program.
  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gatherings twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

We build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy.

title: Data engineer for analytics platform with BI expertise and an interest in the green energy transition
description:
Data engineer for analytics platform with BI expertise and an interest in the green energy transition

Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative‑taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services?

We are looking for a Data Engineer with BI expertise to join our Data and Analytics team at Nordic RCC. If you are excited about building robust data pipelines, developing high‑quality BI products, and enabling data‑driven decision‑making in a mission‑driven organization, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t meet every requirement.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast‑developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a Data Engineer who likes to make a difference!

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision‑making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs.

As a Data Engineer with BI expertise, you will help design, build, operate, and improve our analytics platform and the data products built on it. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver reliable data pipelines, intuitive BI solutions, and user‑friendly data services.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations, and curated datasets.
  • Develop BI dashboards, reports, and data products that turn complex data into clear insights.
  • Operate and improve analytics platform services, including data platforms, BI solutions, JupyterHub, user‑facing analytics environments, and supporting applications.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, monitoring, and operational visibility across pipelines, BI products, and platform services.
  • Monitor and optimize platform performance, resource use, computer storage, and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver production‑ready analytics solutions.
  • Support the development of platform architecture, metadata, governance practices, and service‑oriented delivery models such as Data-as-a-Service and Platform-as-a-Service.
  • Document data flows, platform components, operational procedures, and technical solutions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.

We are looking for someone with several of the following qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Platform Engineer, Application Developer, or similar.
  • Strong experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, modern data architectures, SQL, and data warehousing concepts.
  • Hands‑on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar.
  • Experience operating and optimizing analytics platforms in production environments.
  • Experience with cloud‑native technologies and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or similar.
  • Familiarity with orchestration, monitoring, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, containerization, Kubernetes, storage solutions, or data platform infrastructure.
  • Experience operationalizing analytics models, enabling data consumption, or supporting service‑oriented delivery models is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of power systems and the energy sector is a plus, but not a requirement.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for.

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values.

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work‑life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days.

You’ll report to Data & Analytics team‑lead and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year.

Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here . Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co‑resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined. Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: 23154 - HMP Styal - Grounds Maintenance
