description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

If you are a current NPS employee, this vacancy may be available on a Loan basis for up to 2 years. Applications are invited from suitable qualified staff.

The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

Benefits

Annual Leave

-The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays

-You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays. These hours are added to your annual leave allowance. There is a requirement to work some public and bank holidays subject to your shift pattern and the operational needs of the establishment

Pension

-The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Work Life Balance

HM Prison & Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. Work life balance provides greater opportunities for staff to work more flexibly wherever managers and establishments can accommodate requests to do so. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

Season Ticket Advance

-After two months’ service, you’ll be eligible to apply for a season ticket advance to purchase a quarterly or longer-period season ticket for travel between home and your place of work

Childcare Vouchers

For any moves across the Civil Service may have implications on your ability to carry on claiming childcare vouchers

Training

HMPPS is committed to staff development and offers a range of training and development opportunities, including areas such as Equality and Diversity, Dealing with Challenging Behaviour, Suicide Prevention and Anti Bullying Programmes

-There are opportunities to access promotion programmes and HMPPS provides a variety of training appropriate to individual posts

-All staff receive security and diversity training and an individual induction programme into their new roles

Eligibility

-All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

-All external candidates are subject to 6 months probation. Internal candidates are subject to probation if they have not already served a probationary period within HMPPS

-All staff are required to declare whether they are a member of a group or organisation which the HMPPS considers to be racist

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

description:

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

The Missions & Insights team is at the absolute core of Motorola Solutions’ next-generation ecosystem. We build the intelligent, data-driven platforms that turn massive streams of real-time critical communications into actionable insights for first responders and enterprise security teams.

Our mission is to empower decision-makers with the right information at the exact moment it matters most. By leveraging advanced analytics, cloud-native architectures, and intuitive user interfaces, our department transforms raw emergency data into life-saving operational intelligence. If you want to build software where optimization and latency directly impact public safety, this is where you belong.

title: Product Engineer/Technical Product Owner
description:

Product Engineer / Technical Product Owner — International SME Fintech Summary
  • Role: Product Engineer / Technical Product Owner
  • Location: Melbourne, Australia — you’ll need to be commutable to the office
  • Work arrangement: Full-time, office-based; Australian work rights required and no sponsorship available

This is a Melbourne office role working across live customer and partner journeys, so fluent English and the ability to work clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders matter. You’ll join a fast-growing international fintech that provides flexible funding to SMEs, with operations across APAC and Europe and more than $5B funded to date.

What you'll do

  • You'll build and maintain lightweight full-stack applications, custom forms, and front-end components that support conversion and product delivery goals.

  • You'll use product data, user analysis, and journey mapping to improve conversion, submission outcomes, and the customer and partner experience.
  • You'll monitor website and form uptime, errors, and incidents, then triage and resolve issues quickly when something breaks.
  • You'll coordinate offshore developers and internal stakeholders while keeping documentation current and meeting privacy, security, SEO, and regional regulatory requirements across nine markets.
Who we're looking for
You’re likely a hands-on junior-to-mid-level web product operator who likes owning a live digital journey end to end, not just writing tickets or only building in isolation.

Must-haves:
  • You’ve already owned a live web or digital product area with real responsibility for releases, production issues, and day-to-day performance.
  • You have hands-on experience across websites, forms, integrations, and lightweight apps, including front-end customisation and working closely with developers and stakeholders to ship changes.

  • You’ve worked with APIs, system or partner integrations, and automation tools such as Zapier, n8n, and AWS Lambda.

Nice-to-haves:
  • Experience with Next.js, plus supporting infrastructure or deployment tools such as AWS, Vercel, and GitHub.
  • Experience with Webflow and/or Figma for landing pages, CMS changes, and design collaboration.
  • Exposure to multi-step application or submission forms, including validation, conditional logic, and CRM or API submission flows.
  • Experience in conversion-led or regulated digital environments where privacy, sensitive data, and partner integrations matter.
  • Experience owning multi-site or multi-market web estates and coordinating work with offshore or distributed teams.
About the Company
A fast-growing international fintech company providing flexible funding solutions to support SME growth.

Originally launched in Australia, the business has expanded across APAC and Europe, building a high-performing, people-first team. The company has funded over $5B in loans and continues to scale rapidly, with strong recognition for its culture, diversity, and customer experience.

This company has been recognized as Australia's #1 Best Workplace™ in Finance and Insurance for 2026, awarded by Great Place To Work

Imagine breaking from tradition to ensure a brighter future for generations to come. At Nature Fresh Farms®, we’re committed to nourishing people and the planet through greenhouse farming.

We are currently looking to fill a full-time, permanent position for a Data Engineer in our information Technology Department at our Leamington office.

What You\'ll Do:

  • Troubleshoot database and pipeline issues, independently performing data profiling and root cause analysis — including review of Source-to-Target Mapping documents and data dictionaries.
  • Design, develop, and implement data controls to ensure data integrity from source to target, including verifying upstream data meets defined quality standards.
  • Lead triage meetings and collaborate with Business and Technology stakeholders to determine and implement fixes for identified data issues.
  • Maintain and continue developing the organization\'s data library and related process documentation to ensure consistency, traceability, and end-to-end visibility across data assets.
  • Lead triage meetings globally and collaborate with required stakeholders to determine fixes for identified data issues.
  • Automate manual data processing tasks and build scalable, repeatable data solutions, collaborating with Technology development and testing teams to ensure data transformation logic is properly developed and tested across lower environments.
  • Collaborate with teams to integrate databases with applications and analytics platforms.
  • Leverage analytical tools to develop metrics that measure data quality across source systems.
  • Leverage AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot to turn data into clear documentation and visuals — including AI-assisted data dictionaries, process write-ups, and dashboards that help stakeholders understand data quality and pipeline health at a glance.

  • Strong working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, primarily Microsoft SQL Server — including T‑SQL, indexing, performance tuning, and backup/recovery — along with experience in ETL/ELT tools and pipeline technologies (e.g., SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or similar).

  • Working knowledge of data governance, cataloging, and metadata management practices; familiarity with cloud object storage (e.g., Amazon S3) and cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake) considered an asset.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead triage and troubleshooting sessions with global, cross-functional stakeholders, and to communicate complex technical details clearly to both Business and Technology audiences.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills, with sharp attention to detail and problem-solving ability.
  • High degree of confidentiality and integrity, with a self-starter mindset, high energy, and strong motivation, along with comfort presenting recommendations to management.
  • Ability to lift and carry items minimum 20 lbs, depending on role requirements.
  • Valid passport and ability to travel within Canada and US
  • Valid driver’s license and personal vehicle required.

  • Requires regular communication and coordination with team members across departments.
  • Standard workdays are Monday-Friday, with rotational on-call require. Afterhours and weekends based on business needs.

title: Data Scientist - AI Engineer
description:
About Shine

Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.

Your hiring experience matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Banking AI Foundation & Ops Efficiency Team at Shine.

Our Banking AI Foundation & Ops Efficiency team accelerates operational efficiency across the Banking Domain by identifying and scaling high-impact, compliant AI-driven workflows.

We're a cross-functional team of Software/AI engineers and data scientists who build these systems end-to-end together.

Our work covers a wide range of AI-driven solutions depending on each team's specific needs and goals.

Evaluation, explainability, and traceability of these AI systems are a dedicated focus within our team, and the data scientists own that foundation across every project we ship.

Your role as a Data Scientist

We're looking for a Data Scientist/AI Engineer to contribute to the evaluation process of our system, as well as contribute to the orchestration design and AI safety foundation behind our AI-driven workflows.

AI solutions are scaling quickly across the Banking Domain, and each new one needs the same evaluation rigour and compliance safeguards we've already built into our existing systems, applied consistently rather than reinvented from scratch each time.

You will collaborate with the team to build and manage agentic systems, and be a key driver of the design of the evaluation process for these systems, with privacy and compliance safeguards in mind throughout the whole process. You will work together with your team to ship end-to-end systems.

About you

  • Define and implement evaluation metrics for our AI systems, tailored to what each use case needs to get right.

  • Curate and maintain "golden" datasets to compare a system's real behaviour against the ideal result.

  • Analyse historical data to determine what a given system's evals should be checking for in the first place.

  • Monitor the AI/LLM-based components of our systems in production to catch regressions before they reach customers or compliance reviewers.

  • Help build the agentic systems themselves, from single-purpose LLM agents to multi-agent systems with tool-calling and orchestration.

  • Own privacy and compliance safeguards, ensuring sensitive data gets detected and redacted correctly and that every system is auditable end to end.

  • Build and maintain observability for our agentic components using an LLM observability tool (Langfuse) to ensure agent behaviour stays traceable and transparent.

  • Partner with the team's software engineers to take the project to production.

  • Contribute to prioritising the automation opportunities across Banking that are worth pursuing, and help other teams adopt what we build.

What success looks like

90 Days: Onboarded on the team's tooling and one live project. Shipped a first evaluation metric or golden dataset, and/or contributed to building or debugging an agent, with close support. Started a well-scoped task end to end. Relationships built with the team's engineers and senior teammates.

6 Months: Owns an evaluation pipeline and/or an agent-building or orchestration workstream for a live project end to end. Production issues within their scope are fixed independently rather than routed elsewhere. Design and evaluation trade-offs explained clearly to the team being supported. Contributing to a second project.

12 Months: Takes a loosely-specified problem, whether that's a new agent to build, a system to orchestrate, or a new eval strategy to define, from data analysis through implementation independently. Trusted as a second opinion on eval design and/or agent architecture by teammates. Contributing to prioritisation or adoption conversations across Banking and CX. Able to directly support a newer joiner on the team.

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: DevOps / Cloud Engineer - Azure (kontraktor)
description:
Kim jesteśmy?

Jesteśmy ITSG Global, firmą software’ową, która od 2007 roku tworzy i rozwija rozwiązania technologiczne dla międzynarodowych klientów. Realizujemy projekty m.in. w obszarze systemów backendowych, platform IoT, rozwiązań chmurowych oraz AI.

Obecnie poszukujemy DevOps / Cloud Engineera do rozwoju i utrzymania środowisk Azure wykorzystywanych przez platformy przemysłowego IoT.

To rola dla osoby, która lubi pracować z systemami produkcyjnymi, automatyzować procesy i dbać o niezawodność, bezpieczeństwo oraz wydajność infrastruktury.

Pracujemy nad platformami przemysłowego IoT, które łączą maszyny i urządzenia terenowe z chmurą oraz umożliwiają monitorowanie ich działania.

Jednym z rozwiązań jest system do monitorowania sprężarek i instalacji sprężonego powietrza wykorzystywanych w przemyśle. Około 1000 bramek i 1800 maszyn przesyła dane telemetryczne do platformy wspierającej analizę stanu urządzeń, obsługę zdarzeń i alarmów oraz zarządzanie zasobami.

Środowisko wykorzystuje Azure IoT Hub, Azure Functions, Event Hubs, Container Apps, Cosmos DB, Blob Storage i Data Explorer. Aplikacje rozwijane są m.in. w TypeScript, Node.js i NestJS, a część rozwiązań w szerszym portfolio wykorzystuje również Java i Spring Boot.

Infrastruktura i procesy wdrożeniowe opierają się na narzędziach takich jak Pulumi, Bicep, GitLab CI i Docker. Monitoring i obserwowalność wykorzystują m.in. Application Insights, OpenTelemetry i Grafana. W zakresie roli znajdzie się również praca z Kubernetes i Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

Warunki współpracy projektowej:

  • Możliwość realizacji współpracy 100% zdalnie, hybrydowo lub z biura w Warszawie.
  • Praca przy produkcyjnych platformach przemysłowego IoT i rozwiązaniach chmurowych.
  • Wpływ na niezawodność, bezpieczeństwo i sposób utrzymania środowisk.
  • Współpraca ze specjalistami backendu, IoT oraz liderem zespołu.
  • Możliwość rozwijania automatyzacji, monitoringu i standardów operacyjnych.
  • Dodatkowo: możliwość korzystania z lekcji języka angielskiego, karty MultiSport, prywatnej opieki medycznej, wydarzeń integracyjnych, budżetu szkoleniowego oraz inicjatyw rozwojowych.

Zakres zadań w projekcie:

  • Utrzymanie i rozwój środowisk chmurowych Azure obsługujących aplikacje produkcyjne.
  • Automatyzacja konfiguracji i wdrażania infrastruktury z wykorzystaniem Infrastructure as Code.
  • Rozwój i utrzymanie pipeline’ów CI/CD, przede wszystkim w GitLab CI.
  • Praca ze środowiskami kontenerowymi, w tym Docker, Kubernetes i AKS.

  • Rozwój dokumentacji operacyjnej i runbooków oraz procedur odtwarzania środowisk.

Oczekiwane kompetencje:

  • Minium 5 letnie doświadczenie w roli DevOps Engineera, Cloud Engineera lub podobnej, obejmujące utrzymanie systemów produkcyjnych.
  • Bardzo dobra praktyczna znajomość Microsoft Azure.

  • Umiejętność tworzenia i utrzymywania procesów CI/CD, najlepiej w GitLab CI.
  • Doświadczenie z monitoringiem, alertowaniem, analizą logów i obsługą incydentów.

  • Umiejętność automatyzacji zadań przy użyciu skryptów, np. Bash, PowerShell lub Python.
  • Doświadczenie w zapewnianiu niezawodności, wydajności i skalowalności aplikacji.
  • Samodzielność w diagnozowaniu problemów i odpowiedzialne podejście do zmian na produkcji.
  • Język angielski pozwalający swobodnie współpracować z międzynarodowym zespołem i klientem.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
NAPA Design Solutions offers a comprehensive solution for 3D ship modeling and design tools covering hull form design and hydrodynamics, hydrostatics and stability, structural design, and information sharing across the shipbuilding process. These are among the most powerful tools in industry, trusted by the world’s largest shipyards and classification societies.

The role: what is it about?

The team is now looking for a Technical Consultant in Busan whose job is to make customers successful with NAPA’s ship design solutions. You answer technical questions, solve structural design-related problems, and deliver user training. You are the first-person Korean shipyards, and design offices turn to when they want to get more out of the software.

The role has two sides. Alongside technical support, you also support sales activities: you give technical guidance while customers evaluate the software, follow up together with sales to turn trials into commercial projects, and spot opportunities to expand NAPA usage in accounts we already work with.

You are also encouraged to bring artificial intelligence (AI) tools into your own workflow and into the way you support customers. We want you to learn where these tools help and where they do not, and to share what you learn with your colleagues.

This job is permanent and full-time.

What you will do

• Answer and resolve customer technical questions on ship structural basic design and detail design.

• Troubleshoot structural design-related problems in NAPA solutions and follow issues through to resolution.

• Plan and deliver user training and onboarding sessions.

• Travel to customer sites for service visits and sales support.

• Support trials with technical guidance during the evaluation, and follow up with sales to convert trials into commercial projects.

• Identify and report opportunities to expand NAPA usage within existing accounts.

• Produce supporting material such as training videos, user guides and FAQs, and keep it up to date in the knowledge base.

• Log and communicate customer requests, defects and improvement ideas to product development.

Your team and job location

You will work as part of the global NAPA Design Solutions Services team. Your closest colleagues are Services experts with whom you share knowledge, training material and support practices every day. You will also work closely with local and global sales teams on joint customer visits and trial follow-up, and with software development, where you are one of the channels that brings customer requests, defects and improvement ideas into the product.

This role is based in Busan, Korea, and you can work at the office or in hybrid mode. And the role includes occasional travel to customer sites.

What we expect from you

What matters most: you understand ship structural design, you enjoy helping people, and you are happy to explain a solution as often as it takes.

Our ideal candidate would have:

• An academic degree (Bachelor’s or higher) in naval architecture, ocean engineering, structural design or a similar field

• Knowledge of ship structural basic design and detail design, including an academic understanding of how this work is done in Korea

• 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in ship structural design, design software support or technical customer service. A recent graduate with a Master’s degree in a related field is equally welcome to apply.

• Problem-solving skills and the persistence to follow a technical issue through to resolution

• Training, teaching and presentation skills

• A customer-oriented service attitude, and communication skills that work across teams and cultures

• Willingness to learn and apply AI tools responsibly, together with the ability to take initiative and work independently

Additionally, the following would be considered an advantage:

• Experience with NAPA products

• Experience in user training or in other customer-facing technical work

• Understanding of how computer-aided design (CAD) and product lifecycle management (PLM) systems are integrated into ship design workflows

• Commercial awareness and the ability to support sales work

• Experience in creating documentation and training material such as videos and user guides

You do not need to tick every box on these lists. If this role feels like a good fit for you and you have most of what we are looking for, we hope you will apply.

We work in English across all our offices, so you need to be comfortable using it in your daily work, both in writing and in conversation. And as you will work closely with Korean customers every day, we are looking for someone who is eligible to work in Korea and native-level Korean.

Why you will enjoy working in this role

• The design work of Korean shipyards and design offices happens in the software you support, and NAPA tools are trusted by the world’s largest shipyards and classification societies

• You see the whole picture of a customer relationship, from the first technical question during a trial to training, onboarding and expanded use

• Your work has a direct route into the product: what you hear from customers is what product development hears from you

• A global team of 240 experts who support you and share what they know, across naval architecture, software development and sales

• You are encouraged to work out how AI tools can make technical support and training better, and to shape how the team uses them

Ready to get on board and join the NAPA crew?

We kindly ask you to send your application and CV to us as soon as possible (by clicking the “Apply for this job” button on the job ad page), but no later than 8 November 2026. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate has been found.

For more information about the position, please send your questions by e-mail to jobskorea@napa.fi. Notice that we cannot accept job applications sent by e-mail.

About NAPA as a company and employer

With over 35 years of operation, NAPA is a leading software and data services provider for ship design and operations to enable safe, sustainable, and future-proof maritime industry. Headquartered in Finland, NAPA employs 240 experts, combining expertise in naval architecture, fleet operations and digital services. NAPA operates globally, with a presence in Japan, Korea, China, Singapore, the USA, Germany, Greece, Romania and India.

With over 90% of new vessels built by NAPA customers, NAPA’s ship design software is the global de facto standard in shipbuilding. Furthermore, NAPA is a market leader in ship stability management and safety data services for passenger ships, and its cloud-based solutions for ship performance monitoring and voyage optimization support shipping’s decarbonization journey. For more information, visit .

Meaningful work

We are proud to play our part in creating a sustainable world, and a career at NAPA means working with a purpose. We focus on building the best possible products for our customers, with whom we have close and long-lasting relationships. We protect the environment and human life at sea by powering safer and greener vessels with our technology.

NAPA way of working

At NAPA, we lead and manage the company together. We help and learn from each other, while making impactful decisions for a cleaner, safer maritime industry.

At its heart, our co-leadership philosophy is founded on trust. We trust that our people are smart enough that if they make a decision, having consulted the right people, it will be good for our company. And if it’s not the right decision on that occasion, that’s fine too. We trust that we’ll make it right, learn from the decision, and grow as a company as a result.

Enjoy working together

...is one of our core values. Learning from and respecting each other provides a healthy and pleasant working environment. We, as NAPArians, share our knowledge and help each other when needed. NAPA has offices and customers around the world, and you will be able to meet people from many different cultures. We are a diverse team with a shared goal.

description:

We are one of Australia’s most trusted and respected health and aeromedical service providers, delivering essential care to people across remote, rural and regional communities throughout South Australia and the Northern Territory.

As part of our ongoing strategic and operational activities within the Northern Territory, we are focused on strengthening our workforce and enhancing capability across the region.

Our five-year Strategic Plan prioritizes building innovative, responsive and better-connected services that improve health and wellbeing outcomes for all Australians. You can watch stories about our people, patients and the communities we serve at rfdsnt.com.au


About this Opportunity

The Royal Flying Doctor Service SA/NT is preparing for the implementation of the Top End Medical Retrieval Service (TEMRS), creating an exciting opportunity for an experienced Change Specialist to join the dedicated project team.

Reporting to the Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in providing specialist advice, guidance and support for the people and change management aspects of this significant service mobilisation, supporting workforce readiness, stakeholder engagement, communication, and the successful transition to new ways of working.

Working closely with project teams, leaders, People and Culture, Communications and key stakeholders, you will provide expert change management advice and support, helping to build organisational readiness, identify and mitigate change-related risks, and foster engagement and adoption across the organisation.

This is an opportunity to contribute to a major service mobilisation that will support RFDS SA/NT to continue delivering vital aeromedical and healthcare services across the Northern Territory.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Develop an understanding of RFDS SA/NT operations to support safe, practical and effective change delivery

  • Partner with the project team to support TEMRS change delivery

  • Conduct change impacts, readiness and risk assessment, implementing practical mitigation strategies to support successful transition and adoption

  • Coordinate change control processes, including documentation, approvals and governance requirements

  • Ensure approved changes are accurately reflected in project plans, schedules and supporting documentation

  • Integrate change activities and milestones into overall project delivery plans

  • Prepare change reports and provide updates on progress, risks, impacts and adoption outcomes

  • Manage priorities, timelines and stakeholder expectations while maintaining compliance with project governance and change management framework

  • Partner with stakeholders to deliver communications and engagement activities that support change adoption

  • Facilitate stakeholder consultation and engagement to support change planning, address concerns and encourage workforce participation

  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders to foster collaboration and support successful change initiatives

  • Engage stakeholders to understand business needs, impacts and risks, and incorporate feedback into change planning and implementation

  • Support leaders to effectively communicate, engage and guide their teams through change initiatives

  • Plan and deliver stakeholder engagement activities, including forums, workshops and briefings, to support effective change implementation


The position is fixed term until 31 March 2028.


About You

You are an experienced change professional who is comfortable working in complex, fast-moving environments and supporting people through significant periods of transition.

You combine strategic thinking with a practical, hands-on approach and understand that successful change relies on strong stakeholder engagement, clear communication, effective leadership and a genuine understanding of how change impacts people in practice.

You are confident working with executives, leaders, project teams and frontline employees and can quickly build trusted relationships across diverse stakeholder groups.

You will bring:

  • Demonstrated experience delivering organisational change initiatives in complex environments

  • Proven ability to conduct change impact and readiness assessments and develop change management plans

  • Experience supporting workforce transitions, service transformations, restructures or large-scale and complex change programs

  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across all levels of an organisation

  • Experience working with project teams, vendors and external partners to achieve successful outcomes

  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse audiences

  • Demonstrated analytical capability to identify risks, assess impacts and recommend practical solutions

  • Experience facilitating consultation, engagement and feedback activities to support change adoption

  • Proficiency in project management and collaboration tools, with the ability to work effectively in a project delivery environment


Relevant tertiary qualifications in Organisational Psychology, Organisational Development, People and Culture, Business, Management or a related discipline are desirable. Significant relevant experience in organisational change, workforce transformation or leadership advisory may also be considered.

Formal change management training or certification such as Prosci/ADKAR, APMG Change Management, Kotter, Lean Change or another recognised change methodology will be highly regarded.

Experience within healthcare, aviation, emergency services or another safety-critical environment will be viewed favourably, as will experience working with industrial and workforce relations considerations and engaging with diverse community groups during organisational change.


Our Benefits

As part of our team, you will be supported to achieve your best while contributing to meaningful work that makes a real difference.

We offer:

  • Generous salary packaging options of up to $15,899, plus $2,650 for meals and entertainment

  • Competitive remuneration

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in United Kingdom.

Join a fully remote game development environment dedicated to creating engaging, high-quality multiplayer gaming experiences with a strong artistic identity. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring game quality throughout development, working closely with engineering, design, art, and production teams. You will develop comprehensive testing strategies, investigate complex technical issues, and help deliver polished, responsive, and reliable gameplay experiences. Your expertise will be particularly valuable in testing Unreal Engine 5 systems, multiplayer functionality, and networked interactions. By identifying risks early and driving continuous quality improvements, you will directly influence the stability and overall player experience of an ambitious PvPvE multiplayer shooter. This opportunity combines technical problem-solving, creative collaboration, and meaningful ownership within a globally distributed team.

Accountabilities

  • Test Planning and Quality Assurance

    • Define and execute comprehensive test coverage across game features, systems, and builds throughout the development lifecycle.

    • Create and maintain structured test plans, test cases, and regression suites based on technical specifications and gameplay requirements.

    • Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and compatibility testing to ensure features meet expected quality standards.

    • Identify potential technical and gameplay risks early, helping prevent issues from escalating during later development stages.

    • Technical Testing and Bug Investigation

      • Identify, reproduce, investigate, and document defects with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, severity assessments, and relevant technical details.

      • Test game features and systems within Unreal Engine 5, applying a strong technical understanding of the engine to investigate issues beyond surface-level behavior.

      • Collaborate directly with engineers, designers, and other team members to diagnose defects, assess their impact, and validate fixes.

      • Investigate gameplay inconsistencies, system interactions, and technical failures to help improve overall game stability and performance.

      • Multiplayer and Network Testing

        • Test multiplayer and networked gameplay systems, identifying issues involving replication, connectivity, latency, synchronization, matchmaking, and player interactions.

        • Validate gameplay behavior across different network conditions and multiplayer scenarios.

        • Support internal playtests, translating observations and player feedback into actionable quality improvements.

        • Help ensure multiplayer features deliver a consistent, responsive, and enjoyable experience.

        • QA Processes, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

          • Maintain accurate bug-tracking workflows, QA documentation, and testing reports using Jira or similar platforms.

          • Monitor defect trends, testing results, and quality metrics to identify recurring problems and areas requiring additional coverage.

          • Contribute to automated testing initiatives, internal QA tools, and scripts where appropriate.

          • Collaborate with production and QA leadership to prioritize defects according to severity, development milestones, and release requirements.

          • Support improvements to QA processes, test efficiency, and collaboration across a distributed development team.

            • Requirements:

            • Strong professional experience in game development QA, ideally in a Senior QA Engineer, QA Engineer, or similarly technical quality assurance role.

            • Proven commercial experience with Unreal Engine 5, gained through a shipped game or a title currently in active production.

            • Solid understanding of game development pipelines and the collaboration required between engineering, design, art, production, and QA teams.

            • Demonstrated experience creating, maintaining, and executing structured test plans, test cases, and regression test suites.

            • Excellent bug investigation and reproduction skills, including the ability to document complex technical issues clearly and precisely.

            • Working knowledge of at least one relevant scripting or programming technology, such as Python, C#, Lua, Unreal Blueprints, or Unreal scripting tools.

            • Experience with QA and defect-tracking platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Bugzilla.

            • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.

            • Experience analyzing QA data, defect trends, and testing outcomes to identify recurring issues, quality gaps, and potential risks.

            • Confidence collaborating directly with technical teams and discussing issues with engineers to support effective investigation and resolution.

            • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work independently across multiple features and development areas.

            • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

            • A proactive, detail-oriented mindset and a commitment to identifying quality issues early rather than relying solely on final-stage testing.

            • Genuine enthusiasm for video games and a strong understanding of what makes gameplay polished, responsive, balanced, and enjoyable.

            • Residence in Europe or a CET-compatible time zone, with sufficient overlap with Central European working hours to participate consistently in team meetings, daily collaboration, and project discussions.

              • The following experience would be an advantage:

              • Previous experience testing multiplayer, PvP, PvE, or shooter games.

              • Experience testing networked gameplay and troubleshooting replication, latency, matchmaking, or online service issues.

              • Experience developing or maintaining automated testing frameworks, QA scripts, or internal testing tools.

              • Familiarity with performance, load, or stress testing.

              • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated build validation.

              • Experience testing games across multiple platforms.

              • Previous experience in AAA game development.

              • Experience working within a fully remote, multinational game development team.

              • Involvement in a game project across multiple production stages, from early development through launch.

              • An active interest in competitive and multiplayer gaming.

                • Benefits:

                • Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely from the Netherlands or another eligible location within Europe, subject to the role's time-zone requirements.

                • Meaningful ownership: Take an active role in shaping game quality and influencing the development of an ambitious multiplayer title.

                • Creative collaboration: Work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and production specialists in a cross-disciplinary environment.

                • International team: Collaborate with talented professionals across different locations, bringing diverse perspectives and expertise to game development.

                • Technical development: Gain hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 5, multiplayer systems, advanced QA workflows, and emerging testing practices.

                • Professional autonomy: Contribute independently, take responsibility for quality outcomes, and help improve development processes.

                • Impact on player experience: Help deliver polished, reliable, and engaging gameplay that meets high standards of performance and enjoyment.

                • Collaborative culture: Join a friendly, open, and communication-focused team that values talent, accountability, and shared goals.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager based in Spain.

Join a globally distributed technology organization where you will drive critical IT and Information Security initiatives across multiple technical and business teams. In this hands-on role, you will coordinate projects from initial planning through implementation and operational handover, ensuring clear ownership, priorities, and measurable outcomes. You will play a key role in advancing security improvements, coordinating vulnerability remediation, and ensuring critical actions are completed on time. By consolidating information across multiple Jira environments, you will turn fragmented project data into actionable insights that support better decision-making. You will collaborate closely with IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and Platform/DevOps teams in a fast-paced, international environment. This is an opportunity to take ownership, improve delivery processes, and make a meaningful impact on technology operations and organizational security.

Accountabilities

  • IT Project and Initiative Management

    • Lead IT projects and internal technology initiatives from requirements gathering and planning through implementation, rollout, and operational handover.

    • Define project scope, milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, timelines, and success criteria.

    • Coordinate delivery across IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Information Security, and business teams.

    • Proactively identify and resolve blockers, manage competing priorities, mitigate risks, and drive decisions to keep projects on track.

    • Oversee initiatives involving identity and access management (IAM/SSO), Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, enterprise SaaS, endpoint technologies, AWS and cloud services, corporate connectivity, internal systems, and IT automation.

    • Information Security Delivery Management

      • Coordinate security initiatives across Information Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform/DevOps, and Red Team and Blue Team functions.

      • Track vulnerability findings and remediation activities from identification through validation and closure, ensuring clear ownership and realistic target dates.

      • Manage follow-up actions arising from penetration tests, Red Team/Blue Team exercises, security reviews, incidents, and ongoing security improvement programs.

      • Ensure security-related tasks are appropriately prioritized, supported by actionable remediation plans, and completed within agreed timelines.

      • Identify stalled, overdue, or high-risk activities and drive escalation, prioritization, and cross-team follow-up.

      • Facilitate security delivery without directly conducting security testing or vulnerability analysis.

      • Jira Management, Task Governance, and Analytics

        • Maintain consolidated visibility of IT and Information Security initiatives distributed across multiple Jira instances, projects, teams, and workflows.

        • Establish consistent reporting practices, ensuring data quality, traceability, and reliable visibility into delivery progress.

        • Monitor backlogs, aging tasks, overdue work, vulnerability remediation progress, throughput, and other relevant delivery metrics.

        • Analyze historical and current data to identify recurring issues, delivery bottlenecks, emerging risks, and performance trends.

        • Automate data collection, aggregation, and reporting wherever practical to improve operational efficiency.

        • Transform fragmented task-level information into actionable management insights that support prioritization and informed decision-making.

        • Cross-Team Coordination and Governance

          • Serve as a central coordination point between Information Security, IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform/DevOps, system owners, business functions, and management.

          • Maintain clear visibility of risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and commitments across distributed teams.

          • Clarify ownership, facilitate prioritization, and resolve coordination challenges when teams have competing demands.

          • Deliver concise management updates focused on progress, trends, exceptions, risks, and decisions requiring attention.

          • Establish practical project governance and delivery processes that strengthen accountability without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

            • Requirements:

            • At least 5 years of experience in IT/IS Project Management, Security Project Management, Technical Project Management, or a related field.

            • Demonstrated experience delivering technology or security initiatives across multiple technical teams and managing complex dependencies.

            • Experience working closely with Information Security and Engineering organizations, with a practical understanding of how technical teams operate.

            • Strong hands-on experience with Jira for project coordination, task tracking, backlog management, and delivery governance.

            • Experience working across multiple Jira projects, workflows, or systems, ideally with an understanding of how to consolidate information from different environments.

            • Proven ability to produce consolidated reports, define and monitor KPIs, and analyze delivery trends using task-level data.

            • Strong project management capabilities, including scope definition, timeline management, prioritization, risk mitigation, dependency tracking, and stakeholder coordination.

            • Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across different functions and time zones.

            • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior management.

            • Strong analytical thinking, organizational skills, and attention to detail, combined with a proactive approach to identifying problems and driving solutions.

            • Ability to work independently, take ownership of delivery outcomes, and balance structured governance with the flexibility required in a fast-moving technology environment.

              • The following qualifications and experience are considered an advantage:

              • Experience managing vulnerability remediation programs and coordinating security improvement initiatives.

              • Familiarity with Red Team and Blue Team activities and the coordination of security testing follow-up actions.

              • Experience consolidating data across multiple Jira instances or building automated Jira reporting solutions.

              • Knowledge of operational dashboards, workflow automation, and delivery analytics.

              • Exposure to AWS, cloud infrastructure, or cloud security environments.

              • Experience working in large-scale online technology organizations or high-availability environments.

              • Relevant professional certifications, such as PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, CISSP, CISM, Security+, Agile, or Scrum.

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
At Epiq, your work contributes to complex, global legal outcomes. You’ll join a values‑driven community where integrity guides decisions, relentless service sets the bar, and we thrive on big challenges together. We invest in your growth with enterprise‑wide learning and mobility. We celebrate who you are, and we respect life beyond work with flexibility that’s recognized externally. Enabled by modern platforms and AI, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career and see your impact at scale.

Job Description:

Epiq supports some of the world’s largest and most complex legal matters, where document collections range from thousands to millions of records. As a Senior AI Platform Engineer, you will design and build the platform our AI agents and accelerators run on, including orchestration, retrieval, evaluation, observability, and the inference path that keeps all of it fast and affordable at production scale. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will write production code; own significant components end to end. You will set the technical direction that other engineers build on. You will also mentor engineers across our Toronto, US, and India teams through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing. You will work across two product areas: AI Agents. Conversational systems that enable legal professionals to ask complex questions and receive evidence‑based answers grounded in case data. AI Accelerators. AI‑powered workflows that automate large‑scale document review tasks including summarization, translation, transcription, language detection, and OCR. Together, these solutions help legal teams reach defensible outcomes faster while reducing review costs and improving quality.

What You'll Do

  • Platform Engineering Build and own the platform capabilities that power AI agents, including orchestration, retrieval, model routing, tool integration, and reliability.
  • Design retrieval systems across large‑scale legal document collections.
  • Develop shared platform services including prompt management, caching, rate limiting, and cost attribution.
  • Define stable APIs and data contracts for product teams.
  • Evaluation & Quality Develop evaluation frameworks that measure accuracy, grounding, citation quality, and overall system performance.
  • Build observability, tracing, and replay capabilities that enable rapid troubleshooting and continuous improvement.
  • Establish quality gates and monitoring to identify regressions before they reach production.
  • Performance, Scale & Cost Optimize latency, throughput, and scalability across both interactive and batch workloads.
  • Drive decisions around model selection, inference strategies, caching, and routing while managing cost as a first‑class engineering metric.
  • Reliability & Governance Build highly reliable systems through monitoring, alerting, incident response, and operational excellence practices.
  • Implement governance, auditability, and human‑in‑the‑loop controls required for legal and regulated workflows.
  • Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and data residency requirements.

Technical Leadership Without Direct Reports

  • Write the design docs and ADRs for consequential platform decisions, including the trade‑offs you rejected.
  • Raise the engineering bar through code review, pairing, and mentoring.
  • Grow other engineers’ judgment, not just their output.
  • Partner with Product Management, legal domain experts, and Review Operations to turn ambiguous problems into shippable scope.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years building production software, with a track record of owning systems end to end.
  • Experience building production AI/LLM systems, including retrieval‑augmented generation and agentic workflows.
  • Strong Python.
  • Comfortable in a TypeScript codebase.
  • Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous and event‑driven architectures, and large batch data processing.
  • Demonstrated ownership of production reliability: instrumentation, on‑call, incident response, and performance work driven by data rather than intuition.
  • Clear written communication.
  • You can explain a design decision and its trade‑offs to engineers and to non‑engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, etc.
  • LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, etc tracing.
  • Vector databases, search infrastructure, and information retrieval fundamentals.
  • Hallucination detection, grounding verification, and benchmarking methodology.
  • Model fine‑tuning, quantization, or inference optimization.
  • React and modern frontend work for internal evaluation and debugging tools.
  • Legal technology, eDiscovery, compliance, investigations, or document review.
  • Multi‑tenant SaaS platforms with strict data isolation requirements.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL.

The Compensation range for this role is $126,000 CAD up to $175,000 CAD annually and may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. This will be based on your background and skills alignment with the role.

title: Senior Mission Software Engineer
description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Mission Software Engineer is responsible for Varda's critical ground segment software, and the platform it runs on which enables spacecraft operations. We operate at the intersection of telemetry and commanding, data acquisition and distribution, mission control interfaces, simulation and test automation, with reliable deployment across lab, test range, and mission operations environments. You'll work hands-on with flight software, avionics, RF/ground systems, and mission ops.

Responsibilities

  • Own Ground Segment Services: Develop and maintain high-reliability services for telemetry ingestion, scaling, distribution, and commanding. Ensure deterministic behavior for real-time operations and post-flight analysis.
  • Mission Control Interfaces: Deliver operator-grade UIs and dashboards that optimize "ops time" and reduce cognitive load across integration, test, and on-orbit operations phases.
  • Simulation and Test Automation: Build tools to run flight-software simulations, device emulators, and scenario-based automated tests - enabling fast, safe iteration for avionics, GNC, and operations teams.
  • Build the Mission Platform: Design, implement, and productionize software for mission and ground software teams. Standardize CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, service templates, infrastructure-as-code, simulation and hardware-in-the-loop frameworks, test harnesses, and observability - all delivered as self-service tooling.
  • Deployments Across Environments: Create robust deployment patterns for lab benches, test stands, and mission networks. Implement safe rollout/rollback strategies and air-gapped or limited-connectivity deployment approaches.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.
  • 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.
  • Expertise with development in Python, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.
  • Have strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, networking, performance, reliability.
  • Experience building real-time data acquisition, scaling, and distribution services - low-latency messaging, time-series and relational stores.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD, dependency/build systems, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • End-to-end observability experience: logging, metrics, tracing.
  • Docker/Kubernetes; release management, phased rollouts, and operational readiness for controlled networks.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Proficiency in C++, Ansible, and/or NiceGUI.
  • Experience with DAQ and closed-loop control (lab/test control environments).
  • Prior work on CI/testing/simulation/data tools integrated with flight software teams.
  • Experience with requirements, test, and certification artifacts from safety-critical or certified workflows.
  • Knowledge of ground systems standards; security in mission networks.
  • Experience building mission-grade UIs with structured command workflows, alarming, and situational awareness.

Pay Range

  • Salary range: Senior Software Engineer: $169,067 - $216,031/ per year.
  • This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.
  • Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.
  • You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

title: Data Engineer - Data Science focus →
description:
_At Trackunit, we collect data from machines and job sites across the globe, and we are building the products that make that data useful. As a Data Engineer in our Data Products team, you will design and operate the pipelines and datasets that sit behind our analytics and future machine learning products. You will work closely with data science and alongside experienced engineers in our Data Foundation team. It is hands‑on work with real ownership, in a small team where what you build actually ships.

What’s in it for you?

Take ownership in a small team. Shape the data engineering work in our Data Products team, with a direct influence on how we build reliable, reusable products for customers.

Build the data behind new insights. Develop pipelines and datasets that support benchmarking, analytics, and future machine learning products as we move from individual customer solutions to products serving many customers.

Work with varied, challenging data. Combine equipment and sensor data with external sources, including satellite and weather data, and make it ready for analysis and modelling.

Work closely with data science. Partner with our data scientist on customer needs, solution design, and data preparation, with opportunities to grow into feature engineering, model deployment, and MLOps.

Learn through collaboration. Work alongside experienced engineers in our Data Foundation team, supported by an international culture of knowledge sharing, feedback, and professional development.

Who are you ideally?

  • You have experience designing, building, and operating production data pipelines, with strong SQL, Python, and data modelling skills.
  • Databricks expertise is a significant advantage. You ideally bring strong hands‑on experience building and operating pipelines with Spark and Delta Lake, managing data quality, and preparing datasets for analytics and machine learning.
  • You treat data quality as part of the product. You build automated validation, monitoring, and alerting, and can investigate problems from a customer‑facing result back to the source.
  • You have worked with cloud data platforms and tools for orchestrating and transforming data, and can make practical choices about reliability, performance, and cost.
  • You understand how to keep pipelines maintainable as data sources change, using testing, CI/CD, clear documentation, and thoughtful handling of schemas and dependencies.
  • You have worked alongside data scientists, or bring a strong understanding of their needs, including preparing reliable datasets for exploration, feature engineering, and model training.
  • You enjoy contributing to requirements and solution design, translating customer needs into practical data solutions, and taking ownership while collaborating across teams.
  • Experience integrating external APIs and feeds, working with geospatial or time series data, or processing large datasets efficiently would be a plus. Interest in model deployment and MLOps is welcome. You don’t need to tick every box. If data engineering is your core strength and you’re curious about data science and the products it enables, we’d like to hear from you.

Our hiring process

Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

  • Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.
  • A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.
  • Assignment‑specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.
  • If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.
  • Offer presentation and walk‑through. We’re lucky to have you!

Coming Together To Connect Construction

We’re committed to construction – one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human‑centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

HOURS AND PAYMENT:

All community organizers will be *independent contractors* and paid $1,250 to complete their assigned tasks. Community Organizers can expect their contracted work to take approximately 25-30 hours to complete, and it must be done between October 25th and November 3rd.


Compensation will be provided by direct deposit, or by mailed check if requested.

title: Chief Clinical Officer
description:
This is a remote position.

Why this role Stands Out

This is a rare opportunity for a senior clinical leader who wants to shape care at the organizational level while staying close to the mission that matters most: helping children and families receive high-quality, compassionate support.

The Chief Clinical Officer will guide clinical strategy, strengthen standards of care, support clinical leaders, and help build systems that improve outcomes across a growing pediatric therapy environment. This is not simply an administrative seat. It is a role for someone who wants to influence culture, quality, family experience, and long-term clinical direction.

About This Opportunity

We are seeking a Chief Clinical Officer to provide strategic, clinical, and operational leadership across therapeutic programs within a well-established pediatric therapy organization.

This leader will oversee clinical quality, ethical practice, staff development, family experience, compliance, and clinical operations. The role is ideal for someone who understands evidence-based care, values collaboration, and can bring structure, consistency, and vision to a multi-site clinical environment.

A strong candidate will be comfortable operating at both the executive and field level, partnering with senior leadership while also mentoring clinical teams and improving day-to-day systems that directly impact children, families, and staff.

What You Will Lead

  • Set and execute the clinical vision across therapeutic programs

  • Build and refine clinical standards rooted in evidence-based, ethical, and compassionate care

  • Advance assent-based, trauma-informed, and family-centered practices across the organization

  • Strengthen quality assurance systems, including audits, chart reviews, outcomes tracking, and feedback loops

  • Improve the family experience through responsive communication, stronger support systems, and consistent service expectations

  • Partner with operational leadership on staffing models, caseloads, scheduling workflows, and clinical resource planning

  • Support compliance with payer, state, federal, professional, and internal standards

  • Lead clinical education strategy, including onboarding, mentorship, CEU development, and leadership pathways

  • Develop clinical leaders through coaching, accountability, and consistent decision-making support

  • Provide executive-level reporting on clinical performance, trends, risks, opportunities, and organizational needs

Why Join This Opportunity

  • High-impact executive leadership role with direct influence over clinical strategy and quality of care

  • Opportunity to shape systems, standards, and culture across a meaningful pediatric therapy platform

  • Mission-driven work focused on children, families, and clinical excellence

  • Collaborative leadership environment where clinical voice and operational partnership both matter
