title: 22919 - M.Instructor
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

If you are a current NPS employee, this vacancy may be available on a Loan basis for up to 2 years. Applications are invited from suitable qualified staff.

The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

Benefits

Annual Leave

-The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays

-You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays. These hours are added to your annual leave allowance. There is a requirement to work some public and bank holidays subject to your shift pattern and the operational needs of the establishment

Pension

-The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Work Life Balance

HM Prison & Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. Work life balance provides greater opportunities for staff to work more flexibly wherever managers and establishments can accommodate requests to do so. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

Season Ticket Advance

-After two months’ service, you’ll be eligible to apply for a season ticket advance to purchase a quarterly or longer-period season ticket for travel between home and your place of work

Childcare Vouchers

For any moves across the Civil Service may have implications on your ability to carry on claiming childcare vouchers

Training

HMPPS is committed to staff development and offers a range of training and development opportunities, including areas such as Equality and Diversity, Dealing with Challenging Behaviour, Suicide Prevention and Anti Bullying Programmes

-There are opportunities to access promotion programmes and HMPPS provides a variety of training appropriate to individual posts

-All staff receive security and diversity training and an individual induction programme into their new roles

Eligibility

-All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

-All external candidates are subject to 6 months probation. Internal candidates are subject to probation if they have not already served a probationary period within HMPPS

-All staff are required to declare whether they are a member of a group or organisation which the HMPPS considers to be racist

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Director of Acquisitions
description:
Harmony Housing Affordable Development Inc. (“HHAD”) is among the largest real estate developers of affordable rental housing in the United States. Our mission is to positively impact communities by creating and preserving quality affordable housing for low wealth households. HHAD is a wholly owned subsidiary of Harmony Housing, a 501c3 not-for-profit owner and operator of affordable housing.

Our fast-growing organization is currently seeking an experienced Director of Acquisitionsto join the expanding Business Development team. This individual will play a pivotal role in identifying, securing, and developing new affordable housing projects within target markets, while also leading business development efforts to expand the company’s portfolio. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of affordable housing finance, development processes, and a proven track record of forging new business relationships within the real estate development and housing sectors. This role is ideal for a proactive, entrepreneurial-minded individual who is passionate about making a positive impact through affordable housing development. This position works in close coordination with HHAD’s Execution and Executive teams, , reporting to the Executive Vice President.

The Director of Acquisitions will be responsible for building and maintaining a pipeline of feasible affordable housing development opportunities that align with HHAD’s strategic plan. The Director of Acquisitions will lead the sourcing, underwriting, and initial execution of affordable housing development opportunities, with a primary focus on projects utilizing 4% and 9% Low-Income Housing Tax Credits (LIHTC). This role is responsible for originating both acquisition-rehabilitation and ground-up development deals, advancing them through site control, and transitioning approved projects to the development execution team.

The Director of Acquisitions will manage all aspects of originating opportunities, preparing initial business plans, financial feasibility analyses, from generating leads to signing up new opportunities, while ensuring compliance with affordable housing regulations. This role requires a deep understanding of the affordable housing sector, strong sales and negotiation skills, and the ability to liaise with various stakeholders including potential clients, buyers and sellers, investors and government agencies. This position requires a great deal of autonomy and accountability, along with strong experience in critical thinking and problem solving, negotiating, networking, and teamwork.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Deal Origination & Pipeline Development:
  • Source new affordable housing development opportunities, including acquisition-rehabilitation and new construction projects within a defined set of target states, including, but not limited to: Florida, Georgia, Texas, Indiana, and Ohio.
  • Conduct in-depth market analysis to identify areas of growth and target opportunities for affordable housing development.
  • Identify and evaluate potential development sites through direct outreach to owners, broker relationships, and market research.
  • Cultivate and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders including owners, nonprofit organizations, real estate brokers, government agencies, lenders, and investors to source new development opportunities.
  • Lead efforts to evaluate RFP / RFQ opportunities and prepare comprehensive, detailed responses; attend and participate in interviews for RFP / RFQ opportunities.
  • Maintain and update HHAD’s Origination Pipeline report, and regularly present to leadership.
  • Financial Analysis & Feasibility:
  • Prepare initial financial models to evaluate project feasibility and ensure that investment decisions are well-informed and based on accurate underwriting.
  • Identify the specific financial resources required for project feasibility, such as 4% and/or 9% LIHTC equity, state LIHTC equity, tax-exempt bonds, soft loans, etc., and confirm funding availability and project eligibility.
  • Conduct preliminary feasibility studies, including financial analysis, site analysis, review of zoning regulations, and community impact.
  • Work with internal teams to develop initial project concepts, design proposals, milestone schedules, and cost estimates.
  • Transaction Management:
  • Prepare, negotiate, and facilitate the execution of Purchase & Sale Agreements, Development Agreements, and/or Joint Venture Agreements to establish control of opportunities under terms that provide high financial returns and mitigate potential risks.
  • Manage relationships with transaction participants from initial contact through closing.
  • Marketing:
  • Develop and implement comprehensive business development strategies to meet or exceed new business targets for affordable housing; collaborate with marketing teams to create promotional materials and online campaigns to attract development opportunities.
  • Represent HHAD at industry events, conferences, and networking functions to build brand recognition and establish strategic partnerships.
  • Community Engagement:
  • Build and maintain positive relationships with local communities, advocacy groups, and other stakeholders to ensure support for new developments.
  • Participate in public meetings, hearings, and community outreach efforts to ensure that developments meet local needs and gain community acceptance.
  • Collaborate with officials and government agencies to develop recommended policies that support the development of and provide resources for affordable housing.
  • Team Collaboration & Reporting:
  • Work closely with internal departments, including finance, legal, and development to ensure the smooth and timely execution of projects.
  • Provide regular updates to senior management on business development activities, pipeline status, and project progress.
  • Develop presentation materials needed for senior team members and the Investment Committee, as well as external meetings (clients, government agencies, lenders, investors, etc.).
  • Support acquisition, disposition, and development teams in evaluating risks during due diligence for new properties.
  • Other:
  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of Business Development functions and obligations
  • Maintain current working knowledge of industry trends, best practices, as well as state and federal regulations regarding affordable housing finance and programs.
  • Ensure individual and departmental revenue goals and objectives are achieved.
  • Ability to travel as needed for site visits, meetings with stakeholders, industry-related conferences, and various networking opportunities; valid Driver’s License required to be always maintained.

Experience, Skills, and Abilities Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, real estate, finance, urban planning, or a related field; a Master’s degree is a plus.
  • Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive professional experience in affordable housing development, real estate investment, or a related field, with a demonstrated successful track record in new business origination and project financing of affordable housing.
  • Established relationships with developers, owners, management agents, and brokers throughout the designated region.
  • Strong financial and analytical skills, with in-depth understanding of real estate fundamentals.
  • Experience reviewing relative property documents (operating statements, rent rolls, audits, loan documents, etc.); ability to process information including gathering, assessing, organizing, auditing, and verifying data.
  • Strong knowledge of affordable housing mechanisms (e.g., programs such as LIHTC and tax-exempt bond financing, FHA mortgage insurance programs, as well as Agency debt products (Fannie, Freddie, USDA), and familiarity with other affordable housing funding programs and compliance regulations.
  • Proven ability to lead complex projects from inception through completion.
  • Demonstrated excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with varying amounts of available information.
  • Ability to recognize and mitigate investment risks; strong negotiation skills.
  • High-energy, accurate, organized, highly detailed, and results-oriented professional with demonstrable ability to successfully manage multiple projects and successfully work under pressure of strict deadlines.
  • Excellent written, oral, and public speaking communication skills with an ability to clearly and concisely express ideas, thoughts, and concepts verbally and in writing to diverse teams.
  • Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe, SharePoint, and SmartSheet and other similar programs).
  • Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage daily responsibilities and projects with minimal direction, while also working in close collaboration with a team to provide solutions where needed.
  • Ability to maintain a “big picture” focus while attending to incredibly detailed work and providing thorough documentation.
  • Resourceful, flexible and maintain the ability to react and respond quickly towards positive outcomes.
  • Strong personal standards and values consistent with HHAD’s core values (entrepreneurial, integrity, caring, and excellence).

A satisfactory background check will be required as part of the selection process.

At Harmony Housing Affordable Development (HHAD), we believe that finding creative solutions for our clients comes from the collaboration of people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives. We strive to build a work environment that empowers all individuals with opportunities to channel their entrepreneurial spirit. HHAD is an EEO employer.

This job description is not inclusive of all responsibilities, skills, requirements, efforts or working conditions associated with this position. While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current position, management reserves the right to modify the position or to require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change. This job description replaces all previous descriptions for this position.

RECRUITMENT SPAM:

HHAD posts open roles only on our official Careers page at hhad.org and on our HHAD LinkedIn page. We communicate with candidates exclusively through @greyco.com email addresses and our verified LinkedIn company page.

We will never request payment, fees, gift cards, or sensitive personal or financial information outside of a formal hiring and onboarding process, and we do not conduct interviews solely via text message or messaging apps.

If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent HHAD and suspect the communication may be fraudulent, please do not respond.

Instead, report the incident through the “Contact Us” form at hhad.org/contact/ and notify the platform where the contact occurred.

HHAD does not authorize or endorse communications from individuals falsely representing our organization.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

King Street East, Toronto, Ontario, Canada, M5A 1L3
full-time . September 9, 2026

Description

At Chexy, we're building modern financial tools for Canadians - starting with their largest expenses. We turn rent, tuition, insurance, and other big bills into opportunities to build credit, earn rewards, and gain financial flexibility.

We're the first platform in Canada that lets users pay nearly any bill using their credit card, while unlocking meaningful benefits like cashback, points, and credit-building tools. With ~$2B in annual payment volume and hundreds of thousands of transactions a month, we're building financial infrastructure that needs to be fast, reliable, and bulletproof.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to own the product surface of Chexy end to end: our web app (Next.js), our mobile app (Expo / React Native), and the TypeScript backend-for-frontend that serves both. You'll be the most senior product engineer on the team.

This is an ownership role. You'll set the bar for product quality, decide how features are structured across web, mobile, and BFF, and be the person the team looks to when a flow is broken and nobody knows why. Over time we'd like you to become the owner of our mobile app - in addition to the rest of the stack, not instead of it. You'll ship the user-facing side of things that don't exist yet in Canada: a chequing account, a card we issue, instant payouts.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the product surface across web, mobile, and the BFF - architecture, quality bar, observability, and roadmap
  • Lead the design of new product flows for chequing, card issuance, and instant payouts across every client
  • Own onboarding and activation end to end - the biggest lever in the company
  • Make the BFF the single reliable contract for web and mobile: strict schemas, versioning, and backward compatibility for app builds in the wild
  • Grow into owning mobile: release process, OTA updates, store submissions, and the health of the app
  • Set the technical bar: review architecture, write the patterns others follow, and push back when something isn't right
  • Mentor product engineers through reviews and pairing
  • Work directly with the CTO and product on what we build next and in what order

What Senior Means Here

  • You make trade-off calls without waiting to be told, and you're right most of the time
  • You surface problems early and specifically - before they hit users
  • You disagree openly, then commit fully
  • You multiply the team - patterns, reviews, mentoring - rather than only shipping your own work
  • You own outcomes, not tasks. If your domain is broken, that's yours to fix, not someone else's to notice

Who We're Looking For

  • Substantial experience shipping production TypeScript across the stack - React/Next.js at scale, plus a real backend (Node - Hono, NestJS, Express - with a proper data layer)
  • React Native / Expo in production, or a strong desire to own it and the judgment to get there fast
  • You've owned a product surface before - not "worked on," owned - through launches, incidents, and redesigns
  • You care about correctness in ways most product engineers don't: schemas, auth boundaries, idempotent mutations, money shown right
  • You have taste, and you can explain it
  • You already build with AI coding tools every day and have strong opinions about where they fail
  • You've been early somewhere and liked it - you're comfortable making decisions with 70% of the information and revisiting them when the picture changes
  • You communicate clearly in writing and don't need a manager to tell you what matters

Bonus Points

  • Fintech or another domain where a wrong number is a real problem
  • Design-system ownership, accessibility, or i18n (we ship in English and French)
  • Datadog RUM or similar frontend observability

How We Build

We're early. The roadmap moves as we learn from users, partners, and regulators - sometimes week to week - and you'll regularly pick things up outside your title. The people who do best here find that energizing. They'd rather make a call with most of the information than wait for all of it, they get curious instead of frustrated when a requirement changes halfway through, and they've usually been early somewhere before and wanted to do it again.

The way software gets built is changing faster than anyone's best practices can keep up, and we're not pretending otherwise. Most of what we ship is written with AI tools - but that's the least interesting part. The interesting part is working out what that means for how we review, test, and take responsibility for code: what you hand to a model and what you never do, what "I read the diff" means when the diff is two thousand lines, how a small team keeps quality up while moving faster than it should be able to. We're writing that playbook as we go, and we want people who want to write it with us, not people waiting to be handed it. We care a lot about attitude - someone who brings energy into a room rather than absorbing it. When something breaks, they're already on it before anyone asks.

Why Join Chexy?

Build payments infrastructure that matters: Your code moves ~$2B a year for tens of thousands of Canadians

Work the way engineering works now: AI-native tooling, category-defining technology, and end-to-end ownership

Join a tight-knit team: Work directly with the founders and CTO, who trust you to make real decisions

Early equity: Access equity in a high-growth fintech

Toronto office: We work in-office 5 days a week

How We Hire

We keep our hiring process clear and human. You'll go through a mix of conversational interviews and technical deep-dives designed to show how you think, how you've solved real problems, and how you work with others.

We use AI tools to help us organize and review applications; every decision about who we interview and who we hire is made by a person. This posting is for an existing vacancy. If you interview with us, we'll let you know within days of your last interview whether a decision has been made.

Chexy is an equal opportunity employer. If you require any accommodations or support during the hiring process, let us know and we'll do our best to help.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
Digital & Technology Team (D&T)is an integral division ofHEINEKEN Global Shared Services Center. We are committed to making Heineken the most connected brewery. That includes digitalizing and integrating our processes, ensuring best-in-class technology, and embedding a data-driven culture. By joining us you will work in one of the most dynamic and innovative teams and have a direct impact on building the future of Heineken!


Would you like to meet the Team, see our office and much more? Visit our website: Heineken (heineken-dt.pl)

Are you passionate about leveraging cutting-edge technology to shape the future of data platform engineering? Do you thrive in dynamic environments, working with modern tools like Databricks, Azure, and Apache Spark? If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you!

At Heineken, we are not just brewers of the world’s most iconic beers—we are a data-driven company that values innovation and continuous improvement. As aSenior Data Platform Engineerin our Global Platform Team, you will play a crucial role in driving our data strategies and transforming how we manage, process, and analyze large-scale data.

Your responsibilities would include:

  • designing and building scalable data processing frameworks that support both streaming and batch workloads, aligning with our metadata-driven architecture
  • working on big data using PySpark and SQL, optimizing data pipelines and contributing to the development of our modern Data Lakehouse built on the medallion architecture
  • collaborating with cross-functional teams to create seamless ETL/ELT processes and drive performance optimization using techniques like Delta optimization, Z-ordering, and liquid clustering
  • taking ownership of building efficient and scalable solutions leveraging the latest trends in Databricks, including Structured Streaming, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Unity Catalog, and DBSQL

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in Spain.

Join a fully remote game development environment dedicated to creating engaging, high-quality multiplayer gaming experiences with a strong artistic identity. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring game quality throughout development, working closely with engineering, design, art, and production teams. You will develop comprehensive testing strategies, investigate complex technical issues, and help deliver polished, responsive, and reliable gameplay experiences. Your expertise will be particularly valuable in testing Unreal Engine 5 systems, multiplayer functionality, and networked interactions. By identifying risks early and driving continuous quality improvements, you will directly influence the stability and overall player experience of an ambitious PvPvE multiplayer shooter. This opportunity combines technical problem-solving, creative collaboration, and meaningful ownership within a globally distributed team.

Accountabilities

  • Test Planning and Quality Assurance

    • Define and execute comprehensive test coverage across game features, systems, and builds throughout the development lifecycle.

    • Create and maintain structured test plans, test cases, and regression suites based on technical specifications and gameplay requirements.

    • Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and compatibility testing to ensure features meet expected quality standards.

    • Identify potential technical and gameplay risks early, helping prevent issues from escalating during later development stages.

    • Technical Testing and Bug Investigation

      • Identify, reproduce, investigate, and document defects with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, severity assessments, and relevant technical details.

      • Test game features and systems within Unreal Engine 5, applying a strong technical understanding of the engine to investigate issues beyond surface-level behavior.

      • Collaborate directly with engineers, designers, and other team members to diagnose defects, assess their impact, and validate fixes.

      • Investigate gameplay inconsistencies, system interactions, and technical failures to help improve overall game stability and performance.

      • Multiplayer and Network Testing

        • Test multiplayer and networked gameplay systems, identifying issues involving replication, connectivity, latency, synchronization, matchmaking, and player interactions.

        • Validate gameplay behavior across different network conditions and multiplayer scenarios.

        • Support internal playtests, translating observations and player feedback into actionable quality improvements.

        • Help ensure multiplayer features deliver a consistent, responsive, and enjoyable experience.

        • QA Processes, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

          • Maintain accurate bug-tracking workflows, QA documentation, and testing reports using Jira or similar platforms.

          • Monitor defect trends, testing results, and quality metrics to identify recurring problems and areas requiring additional coverage.

          • Contribute to automated testing initiatives, internal QA tools, and scripts where appropriate.

          • Collaborate with production and QA leadership to prioritize defects according to severity, development milestones, and release requirements.

          • Support improvements to QA processes, test efficiency, and collaboration across a distributed development team.

            • Requirements:

            • Strong professional experience in game development QA, ideally in a Senior QA Engineer, QA Engineer, or similarly technical quality assurance role.

            • Proven commercial experience with Unreal Engine 5, gained through a shipped game or a title currently in active production.

            • Solid understanding of game development pipelines and the collaboration required between engineering, design, art, production, and QA teams.

            • Demonstrated experience creating, maintaining, and executing structured test plans, test cases, and regression test suites.

            • Excellent bug investigation and reproduction skills, including the ability to document complex technical issues clearly and precisely.

            • Working knowledge of at least one relevant scripting or programming technology, such as Python, C#, Lua, Unreal Blueprints, or Unreal scripting tools.

            • Experience with QA and defect-tracking platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Bugzilla.

            • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.

            • Experience analyzing QA data, defect trends, and testing outcomes to identify recurring issues, quality gaps, and potential risks.

            • Confidence collaborating directly with technical teams and discussing issues with engineers to support effective investigation and resolution.

            • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work independently across multiple features and development areas.

            • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

            • A proactive, detail-oriented mindset and a commitment to identifying quality issues early rather than relying solely on final-stage testing.

            • Genuine enthusiasm for video games and a strong understanding of what makes gameplay polished, responsive, balanced, and enjoyable.

            • Residence in Europe or a CET-compatible time zone, with sufficient overlap with Central European working hours to participate consistently in team meetings, daily collaboration, and project discussions.

              • The following experience would be an advantage:

              • Previous experience testing multiplayer, PvP, PvE, or shooter games.

              • Experience testing networked gameplay and troubleshooting replication, latency, matchmaking, or online service issues.

              • Experience developing or maintaining automated testing frameworks, QA scripts, or internal testing tools.

              • Familiarity with performance, load, or stress testing.

              • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated build validation.

              • Experience testing games across multiple platforms.

              • Previous experience in AAA game development.

              • Experience working within a fully remote, multinational game development team.

              • Involvement in a game project across multiple production stages, from early development through launch.

              • An active interest in competitive and multiplayer gaming.

                • Benefits:

                • Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely from the Netherlands or another eligible location within Europe, subject to the role's time-zone requirements.

                • Meaningful ownership: Take an active role in shaping game quality and influencing the development of an ambitious multiplayer title.

                • Creative collaboration: Work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and production specialists in a cross-disciplinary environment.

                • International team: Collaborate with talented professionals across different locations, bringing diverse perspectives and expertise to game development.

                • Technical development: Gain hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 5, multiplayer systems, advanced QA workflows, and emerging testing practices.

                • Professional autonomy: Contribute independently, take responsibility for quality outcomes, and help improve development processes.

                • Impact on player experience: Help deliver polished, reliable, and engaging gameplay that meets high standards of performance and enjoyment.

                • Collaborative culture: Join a friendly, open, and communication-focused team that values talent, accountability, and shared goals.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the team:

As part of the Data & AI area, we implement projects based on the practical "data science" and "artificial intelligence" applications of an unprecedented scale in Poland. Data & AI is a group of over 150 experienced engineers organized into over a dozen teams with various specializations. Some of them build dedicated tools for creating and launching BigData processes or implementing ML models for the entire organization. Others work closer to the client and are responsible for the implementation of the search engine, creating recommendations, building a buyer profile or developing an experimental platform. There are also research teams in the area whose aim is to find solutions to non-trivial problems requiring the use of machine learning.

We are looking for Senior Scala Engineers who want to build a highly scalable and fault-tolerant data ingestion for millions of Allegro customers. The platform collects 5 billion clickstream events every day (up to 150k / sec) from all Allegro sites and Allegro mobile applications. This is a hybrid solution using a mix on-premise and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services like Spark, Kafka, Beam, BigQuery, Pubsub or Dataflow.

We are looking for people, who:

  • Are programming in languages such as Scala or Java, Python
  • Have strong understanding of distributed systems, data storage, and processing framework like dbt, Spark or Apache Beam
  • Have knowledge of GCP (especially Dataflow and Composer) or other public cloud environments like Azure or AWS
  • Use good practices (clean code, code review, TDD, CI/CD)
  • Navigate efficiently within Unix/Linux systems
  • Possess a positive attitude and team-working skills
  • Are eager for personal development and keeping their knowledge up to date
  • Know English at B2 level

What we offer:

  • Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - our hours can start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
  • Long term discretionary incentive plan based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).
  • Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
  • Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
  • A 16\" or 14\" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.
  • A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
  • English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
  • A training budget, inter-team tourism (more here (https://blog.allegro.tech/2019/09/team-tourism-at-allegro.html)), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
  • An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
  • Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

#goodtobehere means that:

  • You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.
  • You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things.
  • You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.
  • You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.
  • You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).
  • You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers.
  • You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning.
  • You will become part of Allegro Tech - We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Embedded Software Engineer on the Flight Software team is responsible for determining how our spacecraft behaves & operates in orbit and building reliable software to ensure it happens. They are responsible for all phases of development, starting from requirements capture through testing and flight operational support.

Responsibilities

  • Develop reliable firmware to control how the spacecraft, satellite bus, and reentry capsule operate through the entire mission.
  • Own all aspects of software development, from design, testing, and integration.
  • Scope projects including requirements capture and initial design trades given open-ended problems.
  • Write quality structured bare metal, RTOS, or Linux based software for embedded processors in C++.
  • Build highly reliable and available software systems.
  • Ensure system quality and performance through software test, verification, and validation (V&V) techniques.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.
  • 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.
  • Experience developing and testing real-time embedded hardware / software systems.
  • Experience with development in C++, along with a strong understanding of language concepts.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience with safety-critical software, especially for aerospace applications.
  • Experience with additional programming languages such as Python or Rust.
  • Strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, data structures, and computer networking.

Pay Range

  • Salary range: Senior Software Engineer: $169,067 - $216,031/ per year.
  • This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.
  • Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.
  • You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

title: KMO Bankier in Leuven
description:
Bouw mee aan de groei van ondernemers! Ben jij een geboren netwerker met een passie voor ondernemerschap? Krijg je energie van het adviseren van bedrijven, het uitbouwen van klantenrelaties en het spotten van commerciële opportuniteiten? Dan ben jij misschien de KMO Bankier die we zoeken!

Een dag in het leven van een KMO Bankier in Leuven

Als KMO Bankier ben jij het centrale aanspreekpunt voor professionele klanten en prospecten in de regio Leuven. Je vervult een commerciële sleutelrol waarbij je ondernemers begeleidt bij belangrijke financiële beslissingen en hen ondersteunt in de verdere groei van hun onderneming. Vanuit jouw expertise bouw je duurzame relaties uit, begrijp je de ambities van je klanten en vertaal je deze naar passende bancaire oplossingen.

Je maakt deel uit van de Business Hub Leuven, een multidisciplinair team van KMO Bankers en verzekeringsspecialisten. Op dinsdag en donderdag werk je samen met je collega's vanuit het kantoor waar samenwerking en kennisdeling centraal staan.

In deze rol combineer je relatiebeheer met business development. Je bent een commercieel gedreven professional die niet alleen bestaande klantrelaties verder uitbouwt, maar ook actief op zoek gaat naar nieuwe opportuniteiten in de markt.

Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere digitalisering van onze dienstverlening door klanten te begeleiden naar onze digitale oplossingen, ondersteund door het Business Servicing Expert Team.

Je beschikt over de nodige commerciële slagkracht om succesvol te onderhandelen, steeds binnen de geldende beleidskaders rond risico en pricing. Daarbij weet je commerciële opportuniteiten te combineren met een gezonde risico-inschatting en een sterke focus op klanttevredenheid.

Als ambassadeur van Business Banking vertegenwoordig je ING actief binnen het lokale ondernemersnetwerk. Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig op netwerkevenementen, bouwt duurzame partnerships uit en ontwikkelt een sterk netwerk van business promotoren om nieuwe klanten aan te trekken. Daarbij maak je optimaal gebruik van moderne communicatiekanalen en sociale media, zoals LinkedIn, om jouw netwerk verder uit te bouwen en de zichtbaarheid van ING in de regio te versterken.

Verantwoordelijkheden

De ontwikkeling van commerciële relaties zijnde kleine en middelgrote ondernemingen staat centraal door het:

  • Beheren en ontwikkelen van zakelijke relaties binnen je portefeuille, evenals prospecten in dezelfde regio waarbij je optimale klanttevredenheid nastreeft en de winstgevendheid van je portefeuille verhoogt
  • Adviseren van klanten op het gebied van krediet/Leasing, verzekeringen, betalingsoplossingen, FX, globale cross-sell, enz.. in nauwe samenwerking met een intern netwerk van specialisten. Je presenteert complexere kredietdossiers en neemt binnen de grenzen van de verleende mandaten beslissingen.
  • Creëren van interne synergiën met de andere segmenten (Retail, Personal en Private Banking).
  • Verdedigen van de belangen van ING, rekening houdend met de gevolgen voor de klant en zorg je voor een goede risico-rendementsverhouding ten voordele van alle betrokken partijen.
  • Zorgen voor de toepassing van de verschillende interne risicobeleidslijnen voornamelijk op het vlak van KYC en kredieten.

Hoe ben je succesvol

We werven persoonlijkheden aan die met een goede ingesteldheid deze job starten. Onze grootste verwachting is dat je nieuwsgierig blijft. Blijf leren. Neem verantwoordelijkheid. In ruil daarvoor zullen we je ondersteunen om te groeien tot een nog geweldigere versie van jezelf.

Als KMO Bankier herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma.
  • Je hebt relevante ervaring binnen de financiële sector of een bancaire omgeving. Ervaring met het adviseren van zakelijke klanten en kennis van kredietverlening vormen hierbij een belangrijke troef.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met ondernemerschap en beschikt over een goed inzicht in de financiële, juridische en economische context waarin bedrijven actief zijn. Ervaring met krediet- en waarborgstructuren en het analyseren van financiële rapporteringen is een plus.
  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en hebt een goede kennis van het Engels. Kennis van het Frans is een meerwaarde, maar geen vereiste.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden en voordelen

Bij ING vinden we het belangrijk dat je een gezonde balans kunt vinden tussen je professionele en privéleven. Ontdek meer over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

De voordelen van werken bij ING zijn onderandere:

  • Een aantrekkelijk bruto salaris, afgestemd op jouw functiecategorie en professionele ervaring.
  • Flex Budget die gebruikt kan worden voor diverse doeleinden zoals bv. een auto.
  • 20 wettelijke vakantiedagen, aangevuld met 9 tot 11 extra verlofdagen en 4 bankholidays.
  • Winstdeelname (Profit Sharing).
  • Volledige terugbetaling van je trein- of busabonnement.
  • Telefoonabonnement en internetvergoeding.
  • Pensioenplan.
  • Hybride werken (Dinsdag en Donderdag op kantoor Leuven).
  • Tal van kansen voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en uitdagend werk met doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen heel ING.
  • Een informele werkomgeving met innovatieve en betrokken collega’s.

Binnen Business Banking krijg je bovendien alle kansen om te investeren in je persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Je kan rekenen op continue leermogelijkheden, zowel op technisch als gedragsmatig vlak, individuele coaching door de Manager SME en begeleiding van ervaren collega's via peer-to-peer coaching. Dankzij de vele doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen Business Banking en de bredere ING-organisatie krijg je alle ruimte om je carrière verder vorm te geven.

Ben je benieuwd hoe ING mensen en ondernemingen helpt om vooruit te gaan? Ontdek wie we zijn, wat we doen en welke carrièremogelijkheden we jou kunnen bieden.

title: Inbound Logistic Engineer
description:
• Strategic Network Design: Lead the end-to-end setup and execution of Ocean freight lanes for new vehicle programs, employing Value Engineering principles to balance cost, speed, and reliability.

  • Process Automation: Leverage Power Automate and other low-code solutions to digitize manual workflows, reducing administrative lead time and improving data integrity.

  • Monitor shipping risks and prepare contingency plans.

  • Support AI tools for forecasting, shipment tracking, and risk management.

  • Create and maintain Power BI dashboards for logistics reporting.

  • Lead continuous-improvement activities across the inbound supply chain.

  • Implement cost-saving ideas through route and container optimization.

  • Automate manual tasks using Power Automate and other digital tools.

  • Review logistics service provider KPIs and improve performance.

  • Education: B.E / B.Tech with an MBA in Supply Chain, Logistics, or Operations.
  • Experience: 4–7+ years of experience in global logistics, preferably within the automotive or manufacturing sector, with a proven track record of managing complex international networks.
  • Problem-Solving Expertise: Strong command of structured problem-solving techniques (Lean Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis, or A3 thinking) to resolve operational bottlenecks.
  • Technical Proficiency:
    • Data Visualization: Expert-level skills in Power BI or Tableau for creating executive-level analytics.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About The Role

We're seeking a Data Engineer to support an enterprise client's upgrade of their existing WhereScape RED environment. This is a hands-on contract opportunity where you'll help move the platform onto new servers, with new repository databases stood up for each environment. The legacy platform is staying in place for now, and the datasets are largely in maintenance mode, so the focus is on a safe, well-controlled upgrade.

The client is also investing in Databricks as their new data platform, and that's where their future work sits. What You'll Be Doing

  • Configure and manage deployment applications
  • Manage promotion of the upgraded environment across dev, test and prod
  • Work closely with the current team to ensure a smooth handover and overlap
  • Gain exposure to the client's broader data landscape as it transitions towards Databricks

What We're Looking For

  • Strong commercial experience with WhereScape RED (priority)
  • Previous experience delivering a WhereScape RED upgrade (ideal)
  • Experience with repository migration, scheduler and job re-establishment, and deployment applications
  • Experience promoting changes across multiple environments (dev, test, prod)
  • Databricks experience highly regarded. Not required for this work, but it will set you apart for future opportunities with the client
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting while collaborating with a wider delivery team

What Is On Offer

  • Contract through to December, with the possibility of extension
  • Remote delivery, ideally Auckland or Wellington based
  • The chance to work on an enterprise data platform during a key upgrade
  • Strong potential for extension and further work for contractors with Databricks skills, as it's the client's strategic data platform going forward

Please note that only candidates who have the legal right to work in New Zealand will be considered for this role.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in Netherlands.

Join a fully remote game development environment dedicated to creating engaging, high-quality multiplayer gaming experiences with a strong artistic identity. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring game quality throughout development, working closely with engineering, design, art, and production teams. You will develop comprehensive testing strategies, investigate complex technical issues, and help deliver polished, responsive, and reliable gameplay experiences. Your expertise will be particularly valuable in testing Unreal Engine 5 systems, multiplayer functionality, and networked interactions. By identifying risks early and driving continuous quality improvements, you will directly influence the stability and overall player experience of an ambitious PvPvE multiplayer shooter. This opportunity combines technical problem-solving, creative collaboration, and meaningful ownership within a globally distributed team.

Accountabilities

  • Test Planning and Quality Assurance

    • Define and execute comprehensive test coverage across game features, systems, and builds throughout the development lifecycle.

    • Create and maintain structured test plans, test cases, and regression suites based on technical specifications and gameplay requirements.

    • Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and compatibility testing to ensure features meet expected quality standards.

    • Identify potential technical and gameplay risks early, helping prevent issues from escalating during later development stages.

    • Technical Testing and Bug Investigation

      • Identify, reproduce, investigate, and document defects with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, severity assessments, and relevant technical details.

      • Test game features and systems within Unreal Engine 5, applying a strong technical understanding of the engine to investigate issues beyond surface-level behavior.

      • Collaborate directly with engineers, designers, and other team members to diagnose defects, assess their impact, and validate fixes.

      • Investigate gameplay inconsistencies, system interactions, and technical failures to help improve overall game stability and performance.

      • Multiplayer and Network Testing

        • Test multiplayer and networked gameplay systems, identifying issues involving replication, connectivity, latency, synchronization, matchmaking, and player interactions.

        • Validate gameplay behavior across different network conditions and multiplayer scenarios.

        • Support internal playtests, translating observations and player feedback into actionable quality improvements.

        • Help ensure multiplayer features deliver a consistent, responsive, and enjoyable experience.

        • QA Processes, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

          • Maintain accurate bug-tracking workflows, QA documentation, and testing reports using Jira or similar platforms.

          • Monitor defect trends, testing results, and quality metrics to identify recurring problems and areas requiring additional coverage.

          • Contribute to automated testing initiatives, internal QA tools, and scripts where appropriate.

          • Collaborate with production and QA leadership to prioritize defects according to severity, development milestones, and release requirements.

          • Support improvements to QA processes, test efficiency, and collaboration across a distributed development team.

            • Requirements:

            • Strong professional experience in game development QA, ideally in a Senior QA Engineer, QA Engineer, or similarly technical quality assurance role.

            • Proven commercial experience with Unreal Engine 5, gained through a shipped game or a title currently in active production.

            • Solid understanding of game development pipelines and the collaboration required between engineering, design, art, production, and QA teams.

            • Demonstrated experience creating, maintaining, and executing structured test plans, test cases, and regression test suites.

            • Excellent bug investigation and reproduction skills, including the ability to document complex technical issues clearly and precisely.

            • Working knowledge of at least one relevant scripting or programming technology, such as Python, C#, Lua, Unreal Blueprints, or Unreal scripting tools.

            • Experience with QA and defect-tracking platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Bugzilla.

            • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.

            • Experience analyzing QA data, defect trends, and testing outcomes to identify recurring issues, quality gaps, and potential risks.

            • Confidence collaborating directly with technical teams and discussing issues with engineers to support effective investigation and resolution.

            • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work independently across multiple features and development areas.

            • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

            • A proactive, detail-oriented mindset and a commitment to identifying quality issues early rather than relying solely on final-stage testing.

            • Genuine enthusiasm for video games and a strong understanding of what makes gameplay polished, responsive, balanced, and enjoyable.

            • Residence in Europe or a CET-compatible time zone, with sufficient overlap with Central European working hours to participate consistently in team meetings, daily collaboration, and project discussions.

              • The following experience would be an advantage:

              • Previous experience testing multiplayer, PvP, PvE, or shooter games.

              • Experience testing networked gameplay and troubleshooting replication, latency, matchmaking, or online service issues.

              • Experience developing or maintaining automated testing frameworks, QA scripts, or internal testing tools.

              • Familiarity with performance, load, or stress testing.

              • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated build validation.

              • Experience testing games across multiple platforms.

              • Previous experience in AAA game development.

              • Experience working within a fully remote, multinational game development team.

              • Involvement in a game project across multiple production stages, from early development through launch.

              • An active interest in competitive and multiplayer gaming.

                • Benefits:

                • Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely from the Netherlands or another eligible location within Europe, subject to the role's time-zone requirements.

                • Meaningful ownership: Take an active role in shaping game quality and influencing the development of an ambitious multiplayer title.

                • Creative collaboration: Work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and production specialists in a cross-disciplinary environment.

                • International team: Collaborate with talented professionals across different locations, bringing diverse perspectives and expertise to game development.

                • Technical development: Gain hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 5, multiplayer systems, advanced QA workflows, and emerging testing practices.

                • Professional autonomy: Contribute independently, take responsibility for quality outcomes, and help improve development processes.

                • Impact on player experience: Help deliver polished, reliable, and engaging gameplay that meets high standards of performance and enjoyment.

                • Collaborative culture: Join a friendly, open, and communication-focused team that values talent, accountability, and shared goals.

title: Business Partner - Privacy
description:
• Partner with leaders and teams across the organisation
  • Build privacy capability, confidence and accountability
  • Influence how privacy is considered in services, systems and organisational change

At Enable New Zealand, we support disabled people and their whānau to live everyday lives in their communities. We are Aotearoa’s leading supplier of disability equipment, information, advice and modification services.

We are looking for an experienced Business Partner, Privacy to join us for a 12-month fixed-term period and help strengthen privacy capability and practice across our organisation.

Mō te tūranga | About the role

Reporting to the Executive Manager, Governance and Assurance, you will be Enable New Zealand’s trusted advisor on privacy matters. You will partner with leaders and teams to strengthen privacy capability, support informed decision-making and embed good privacy practices into everyday operations.

This is a strategic and practical business-partnering role focused on building organisational maturity and enabling leaders to confidently manage the privacy responsibilities within their areas.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with leaders and teams to integrate privacy into strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Provide trusted, practical and risk-based privacy advice.
  • Influence projects, service improvements, system changes and business initiatives to consider privacy from the outset.
  • Support the development of Enable New Zealand’s privacy governance and management framework.
  • Monitor privacy risks, trends and emerging issues and provide clear insights and recommendations.
  • Build organisational capability through coaching, education, facilitation and practical guidance.
  • Support Privacy Impact Assessments and other privacy risk assessments while ensuring ownership remains with the relevant business area.
  • Guide leaders and teams through the assessment and resolution of privacy incidents, requests and complaints.
  • Contribute to assurance, audit, reporting and continuous improvement activities.
  • Support delivery of agreed privacy priorities and the Privacy Risk Reduction Action Plan.

You will promote shared ownership of privacy outcomes and help create practical, sustainable approaches that balance privacy obligations and organisational risk with operational and service-delivery needs.

Ko wai koe | About you

You are an experienced privacy, risk, compliance, governance, legal or information-management professional who can translate privacy requirements into practical organisational advice.

As a trusted business partner, you will be comfortable influencing without direct authority, navigating complex and sensitive matters, and building strong relationships across different functions and levels of the organisation.

You will bring:

  • Demonstrated experience in privacy, risk, compliance, governance, legal, information management or a related field.
  • Sound knowledge of the Privacy Act 2020 and associated requirements.
  • Experience developing or implementing privacy frameworks, policies and procedures.
  • Experience investigating incidents, complaints or compliance matters.
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical and risk-assessment capability.
  • Excellent written communication and reporting skills.
  • Strong coaching, facilitation and capability-building skills.
  • The ability to establish credibility and provide trusted advice.
  • Sound judgement and the ability to balance legal obligations, organisational risk and operational needs.
  • A high level of integrity, professionalism, discretion and respect for confidentiality.
  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across the organisation.

A recognised privacy qualification, such as CIPP, would be advantageous. Experience in the health, disability or public sector, assurance, risk management or governance environments would also be valuable.

This 12-month fixed-term opportunity will allow you to make a meaningful contribution to strengthening privacy practice across a purpose-led organisation. If you are passionate about helping organisations embed good privacy practice, influencing positive change, and empowering others to confidently manage their privacy responsibilities, we'd love to hear from you.

Applications close: 5.00pm Monday 26 October

To learn more about the role itself, you can view the job description on BambooHR. To learn more about who we are and what we do, visit the Enable New Zealand website.

Please note: You must be a NZ Resident or hold a valid NZ work visa to apply.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Nestmed is building the AI-native operating system for post-acute care.

Millions of Americans get care at home every year. The agencies delivering it run on decades-old software, disconnected tools, phone calls, and faxes, with nothing that ties the work together.

We started with the hardest piece: understanding what actually happens in the visit. Now we're building everything on top of it, so an entire agency runs on one intelligent system.

7 of the 10 largest home health companies in the US already run on Nestmed, across hundreds of thousands of visits a day. We closed our Series A, backed by investors including Max Levchin, co-founder of PayPal, and veterans of the home care industry.

What you'll do

  • Build the operating system itself: the core data model and workflows that every part of an agency runs on, including patients, visits, orders, coding, QA, and billing.

  • Build AI agents that do real clinical and operational work end to end, with clinicians kept in control.

  • Build AI-powered product that clinicians rely on in the middle of patient care, where accuracy and speed both matter. For example, turning visit audio into structured clinical data that drives everything downstream.

  • Own features from start to finish. You'll talk to clinicians and agency leaders, decide what to build, ship it, and watch it run across hundreds of thousands of visits a day.

  • Connect to the medical record systems our customers depend on, and build the enterprise basics large health systems require: single sign-on, account provisioning, and audit trails.

  • Work wherever the problem is: the Django and Postgres backend, the web app, or the native iOS and Android apps.

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years building and shipping product, with solid full-stack fundamentals.

  • You use AI heavily in how you write software.

  • You've worked at a startup and can decide what to do without a spec.

  • Product sense: you listen closely to users, go deep on their problems, and translate what they need into the right technical decisions.

  • You've built something people depended on, where getting it wrong had real consequences.

Bonus

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, HL7/FHIR).

  • LLM products in production: evaluations, multi-step model workflows, agents.

  • Our stack: Python/Django, Postgres, TypeScript/React, Swift or Kotlin, AWS.

  • Audio, real-time systems, or mobile apps that work offline.

If you want to build the system an entire healthcare industry runs on, we'd love to hear from you.

title: IT Business Analyst
description:

Our website:


Position : IT Business Analyst
Location: ECO World,Kuala Lumpur



Role Summary:

We are seeking an experienced IT Business Analyst to support Adecco's IT team by coordinating business and technical workstreams throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The successful candidate will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, gathering and analysing requirements, documenting functional specifications, improving business processes, and supporting solution delivery.
The role will ensure requirements are clear, complete, traceable, and aligned with business objectives, while supporting testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure delivered solutions meet approved business requirements.



Responsibilities:

1. Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements Gathering

  • Identify key stakeholders and establish roles and responsibilities using a RACI matrix.

  • Conduct requirement workshops, stakeholder interviews, and site observations.

  • Review existing business documents, systems, policies, and processes to understand business needs.

  • Gather, validate, and obtain business-owner approval for requirements.

2. Requirements Analysis & Documentation

  • Prepare and maintain Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Specifications Documents (FSD), and Software Requirements Specifications (SRS).

  • Document functional and non-functional requirements, business rules, data requirements, and data dictionaries.

  • Ensure requirements are clear, complete, consistent, and traceable throughout the project lifecycle.

3. Business Process Analysis

  • Analyse existing (As-Is) business processes and design future-state (To-Be) processes.

  • Develop business process models using BPMN 2.0.

  • Conduct gap analysis and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and business outcomes.

4. Solution Design & Technical Coordination

  • Develop use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, wireframes, and screen flows.

  • Document interface, data, and system integration requirements.

  • Conduct requirements walkthroughs with solution designers, developers, QA teams, and other technical stakeholders.

  • Clarify business requirements and support the resolution of functional queries throughout development and delivery.

5. Agile Delivery & Backlog Management

  • Collaborate with the Product Owner to refine and prioritise the product backlog.

  • Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and other project meetings.

  • Ensure user stories meet the Definition of Ready before entering development.

  • Support delivery teams in maintaining alignment between business requirements and project scope.

6. Requirements Management & Change Control

  • Maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) to track requirements through design, development, testing, and acceptance.

  • Manage requirements baselines, documentation versions, and change requests.

  • Conduct impact assessments to evaluate proposed changes against project scope, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.

  • Help minimise rework by identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and ambiguities early.

7. User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

  • Provide input into UAT strategies, test scenarios, and test scripts.

  • Coordinate and facilitate UAT activities with business stakeholders.

  • Support defect triage, issue prioritisation, and resolution tracking.

  • Validate delivered solutions against approved requirements and facilitate business acceptance and sign-off.

8. Transition & Business Readiness

  • Contribute to training materials, user guides, and operational documentation.

  • Support business readiness and transition activities before solution deployment.

  • Assist business users in understanding new processes, system functionality, and changes to existing workflows.

9. Project Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

  • Participate in daily stand-ups, weekly status meetings, monthly service reviews, and project steering committee meetings as required.

  • Provide updates on deliverables, requirements status, risks, issues, dependencies, and upcoming workshops.

  • Escalate unresolved issues through the agreed project governance structure.






Requirements


  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

  • 5+ years of IT Business Analyst experiene, Business Systems Analyst, or in a similar role supporting IT projects and software delivery.

  • Strong experience in requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, validation, and stakeholder management.

  • Hands-on experience preparing BRD, FSD, SRS, user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria.

  • Knowledge of business process modelling, including BPMN 2.0, As-Is/To-Be mapping, and gap analysis.

  • Experience with Agile and/or Waterfall project delivery methodologies.

  • Familiarity with backlog refinement, sprint planning, and collaboration with Product Owners, developers, QA teams, and Project Managers.

  • Experience supporting UAT, test scenario preparation, defect management, and business sign-off.
