title: Principal Analyst, Power Markets Modeler
description:
Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions

The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy’s industry-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real-time trading decisions and mid-to-long-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. It’s both challenging work and work with a purpose.

Be a part of our successful, growing business during international transformation.

Position Summary

As a Principal Analyst, Power Markets Modeler, you will serve as a high-level subject matter expert and strategic lead in the development of our asset-level forecasts. You will dive deep into North American power market fundamentals and regulatory trends to deliver sophisticated insights into renewable, thermal, and transmission assets. In this role, you will not only lead complex modeling projects but also shape the methodology and technical standards that drive our data platform forward.

Position Details

  • Salary range: $155,000 - $185,000
  • Location: Hybrid - Boston (Newton), MA
  • Full-time
  • Hybrid - 2 days in the office
  • Reporting to: Director, Energy Modeling
  • Travel requirements: Occasional travel as needed for client or team collaboration

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop Grid Models: Build and maintain forecasts of the North American electric grid using in-house tools and proprietary procedures.
  • Market Monitoring: Track trends in renewable energy, battery storage, energy policy, and the retirement of conventional generation.
  • Data Automation: Leverage technical skills to automate the ingestion of input datasets and the analysis of model results.
  • Benchmarking & Testing: Plan and execute benchmarking to test model accuracy and drive continuous improvement in future modeling.
  • Quantitative Analysis: Analyze external US power grid data spanning environmental, financial, and operational metrics.
  • Client Collaboration: Serve as a subject matter expert to explain market models and scenarios to clients and success teams.
  • Model Ownership: Own the evolution of your models over time, ensuring they adapt to shifting market fundamentals.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, mathematics, or another quantitative field.
  • Strong data analysis skills with hands-on experience using Python, R, or similar languages.
  • Foundational knowledge of North American power market fundamentals and regulatory trends.
  • Academic understanding of optimization modeling (constraints/shadow pricing) and microeconomics.
  • Basic understanding of elementary finance, including net present value (NPV) calculations.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex findings to diverse teams.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Key Competencies

  • Advanced Degree: Master's or PhD in engineering, mathematics, or economics.
  • Simulation Expertise: Prior experience with power system models like EnCompass, ENELYTIX, AURORA, PLEXOS, or PROMOD.
  • Industry Experience: Previous work in power markets or renewable energy.
  • Energy Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of ISO/RTO market data, including pricing and congestion.
  • Technical Execution: Proficiency in econometrics, statistics, and manipulating data via SQL or Python.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to apply structured thinking to break down complex grid challenges.
  • Systems Thinking: Understanding how data, technology, and market processes interact across the grid.

title: Multimedia Specialist - Test Lead
description:
Salary: $85,000 – $105,000 per year

Your purpose (how you help mod.io)

As the Multimedia Specialist - Test Lead, your purpose is to ensure the robust quality, reliability, and performance of the core API’s functions, backend systems and front end functions that power the mod.io platform.

You will be instrumental in safeguarding the integrity of our services, enabling seamless integration for game developers and a smooth, enjoyable experience for millions of players. You will lead our QA efforts, establishing best practices, managing and mentoring team members, and championing a culture of quality throughout the development lifecycle.

About mod.io

mod.io is the leading solution for the delivery of user-generated content & mods, in-game, on PC, Console, Mobile & VR; live in over 350 games, and trusted by world-class studios and publishers, including Larian Studios, CD PROJEKT RED, Ubisoft, Techland, SEGA, and GSC Game World. Our services are available via dedicated plugins for Unreal Engine and Unity, a C++ SDK for custom game engines, and our API.


By enabling access to UGC & mods on all platforms, mod.io allows game developers to leverage the creativity of their creator community, improving player retention and engagement, and opening new revenue and monetisation opportunities. It’s an automated, scalable, easy-to-implement, white-label and highly customisable service.

The Opportunity

To take ownership of the day-to-day testing process and quality of mod.io’s web products, helping ensure changes are ready to be released confidently to studios, creators and players. Working closely with Delivery Leads, Tech Leads, Product Managers and engineers, you define what needs to be tested across supported browsers, devices, APIs and user journeys, selecting the appropriate level of functional, exploratory and regression coverage. You maintain clear quality visibility, raise actionable defects and release risks, and identify opportunities to strengthen test coverage, automate repeatable checks and improve the team’s development and release processes.

What you’ll be doing in the role (Key Accountabilities)

In this role you will be:

● Leading the implementation and maintenance of our build pipelines across Web, Rest API, Unity Engine, Unreal Engine, C++ and C# SDKs

● Defining the scope and required resources (hardware and software) for testing for each project

● Designing and executing test strategies for multimedia upload, processing, display, and performance across browsers and devices.

● Testing at the product component and API level, as well as at the end-to-end and feature level. You'll also be testing nonfunctional requirements such as: security, reliability, maintainability, scalability, usability, and so on

● Validating integration of multimedia files with web applications, APIs, and content delivery systems.

● Verifying consistency and accuracy of multimedia presentation within user interfaces and embedded game environments.

● Collaborating with development and infrastructure teams to test changes affecting content access, security controls, and platform reliability.

● Helping to define 'Done' for individual stories / tasks and overall project(s)

● Helping to design, build, implement and execute automated and manual tests, including exploratory testing, across multiple platforms, including VR and game consoles and operating systems - our teams will be writing functional, performance, and automated unit tests, as well as creating scripts to automatically deploy code into test environments and executing the tests

● Providing quality and performance feedback to support platform development and enhancement planning.

● Ensuring testing processes support platform stability, data integrity, and continuity of multimedia services.

● Managing and conducting UAT

● Providing testing estimates

● Completing regression testing

● Collaborating with scrum masters and developers to resolve bugs

● Providing test reporting including test case execution, defect reporting and defect tracking

● Other testing support as required in a startup environment

Your skills and experience (what you need to be successful)

We are looking for humble, enthusiastic, self-starters who take ownership over what they create and will help us shape and improve the company. Even if you don’t match the qualifications exactly, if you’re confident you can do the job, or can grow into the role, please throw your hat in the ring.

For this role, we need someone who is passionate about automation and testing, with great problem solving skills and an eye for detail.

Qualifications:

● Practical experience testing production web applications across supported browsers, devices, screen sizes and operating systems.

● Demonstrated experience planning and executing functional, exploratory, regression, integration and release testing.

● Strong understanding of web technologies, including HTTP, REST APIs, browser developer tools, authentication flows and client–server behaviour.

● Experience writing clear test plans, test cases and high-quality defect reports with reproducible steps, expected and actual results, environment details and supporting evidence.

● Ability to assess feature and release risk, prioritise testing effort and communicate quality concerns clearly to Product, Production and Engineering.

● Experience working within an agile software-development lifecycle, including refinement, sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews and release activities.

● Familiarity with test-management and delivery tools such as ClickUp, Jira or equivalent, along with source-control and CI/CD workflows.

● Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to isolate issues across frontend, backend, API and environment boundaries.

● Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to collaborate effectively with Delivery Leads, Tech Leads, Product Managers and engineers.

● Ability to work autonomously on routine testing and release activities while recognising when technical, product or delivery risks need escalation.

● A customer-focused mindset, considering the experience of studios, creators and players when evaluating product quality.

Bonus Points

● Experience with API-testing tools such as Postman, Insomnia or similar.

● Experience using browser automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress or Selenium.

● Familiarity with automated testing in CI/CD pipelines, including interpreting failures and identifying flaky tests.

● Experience testing accessibility, localisation, responsive interfaces, performance or degraded network conditions.

● Basic knowledge of SQL, log analysis, monitoring or observability tools.

● Experience testing payments, account systems, content platforms, developer tools or other integration-heavy SaaS products.

● Experience in gaming, UGC, middleware or products serving external developers and studios.

● Relevant testing certification, such as ISTQB, although equivalent practical experience is equally valuable.

description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

If you are a current NPS employee, this vacancy may be available on a Loan basis for up to 2 years. Applications are invited from suitable qualified staff.

The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

Benefits

Annual Leave

-The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays

-You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays. These hours are added to your annual leave allowance. There is a requirement to work some public and bank holidays subject to your shift pattern and the operational needs of the establishment

Pension

-The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Work Life Balance

HM Prison & Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. Work life balance provides greater opportunities for staff to work more flexibly wherever managers and establishments can accommodate requests to do so. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

Season Ticket Advance

-After two months’ service, you’ll be eligible to apply for a season ticket advance to purchase a quarterly or longer-period season ticket for travel between home and your place of work

Childcare Vouchers

For any moves across the Civil Service may have implications on your ability to carry on claiming childcare vouchers

Training

HMPPS is committed to staff development and offers a range of training and development opportunities, including areas such as Equality and Diversity, Dealing with Challenging Behaviour, Suicide Prevention and Anti Bullying Programmes

-There are opportunities to access promotion programmes and HMPPS provides a variety of training appropriate to individual posts

-All staff receive security and diversity training and an individual induction programme into their new roles

Eligibility

-All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

-All external candidates are subject to 6 months probation. Internal candidates are subject to probation if they have not already served a probationary period within HMPPS

-All staff are required to declare whether they are a member of a group or organisation which the HMPPS considers to be racist

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Project Officer, Schools

title: Founding Frontend Engineer
description:
Role Overview

NAVI is end-to-end production planning, from sales order to shop floor. We connect to a factory's ERP, learn how it actually runs, and pair AI agents with mathematical optimization to plan the materials and schedule the floor in between. We started on the factory floor, solving problems we hit ourselves.

This role is for graduating seniors who care about interfaces the way most engineers care about infrastructure. Our planners make high-stakes calls inside our UI every day. Confusing output does not just annoy, it hits a production floor. You work part-time through your final year and convert directly to a full-time Software Engineer offer in May at $80,000 to $120,000 base plus competitive equity. No re-interview, no separate return-offer process: the part-time work is the evaluation.

We are a small team, in person in NYC, on hard problems, starting early. That is not for everyone and we respect it. Before you apply, be honest with yourself about whether you want to work this way. It is easy to be excited in an interview and burned out by month two. The trade is real: ownership from day one, and room to grow as the company does.

First round is a technical interview. You write a small, smart Python script, no AI assistance. If that is not something you can do on your own, we would rather not spend the time, yours or ours.

What You'll Do

  • Own the frontend end to end, from the data model to the pixels a planner stares at all day.
  • Build dense, fast interfaces for real scheduling data: capacity and due-date views, scenario trees, constraint views that make tradeoffs legible.
  • Sweat the details that prevent mistakes, not just display data: latency, clarity under pressure, and a sane state for every edge case and every pile of messy ERP data.
  • Ship real production code from week one, not a side project parked in a corner.
  • Have a real say in what we build and how it feels, working directly with the team.

What We're Looking For

  • Graduating May 2027, available full-time immediately after.
  • Genuine craft for UI and UX. You notice bad interfaces and cannot leave them alone.
  • Strong JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals, and real opinions about how frontend should be built.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

Benefits

Annual Leave

-The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays

-You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays. These hours are added to your annual leave allowance. There is a requirement to work some public and bank holidays subject to your shift pattern and the operational needs of the establishment

Pension

-The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Work Life Balance

HM Prison & Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. Work life balance provides greater opportunities for staff to work more flexibly wherever managers and establishments can accommodate requests to do so. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

Season Ticket Advance

-After two months’ service, you’ll be eligible to apply for a season ticket advance to purchase a quarterly or longer-period season ticket for travel between home and your place of work

Childcare Vouchers

For any moves across the Civil Service may have implications on your ability to carry on claiming childcare vouchers

Training

HMPPS is committed to staff development and offers a range of training and development opportunities, including areas such as Equality and Diversity, Dealing with Challenging Behaviour, Suicide Prevention and Anti Bullying Programmes

-There are opportunities to access promotion programmes and HMPPS provides a variety of training appropriate to individual posts

-All staff receive security and diversity training and an individual induction programme into their new roles

Eligibility

-All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

-All external candidates are subject to 6 months probation. Internal candidates are subject to probation if they have not already served a probationary period within HMPPS

-All staff are required to declare whether they are a member of a group or organisation which the HMPPS considers to be racist

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Cloud Engineer (AWS, TypeScript)
description:
WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a Cloud Native Engineer, you will drive the backend development and infrastructure of our customer-facing platform to make the impact of companies on people and the environment fully transparent. You will be involved in the entire development lifecycle from concept to implementation, using cloud-native technologies on AWS. As an early employee at a fast-growing VC-backed startup, you will play a vital role in ensuring the successful launch of our product and driving forward the digital transformation of ESG data. You will work with an international and cross-functional team of world-class software engineers, product owners, and designers.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop our cloud-native backend services based on continuous customer feedback, data analysis, and product requirements.
  • Design and implement GraphQL APIs, scalable event-driven workflows, and automate the serverless infrastructure of your team.
  • Continuously monitor the serverless infrastructure and tune it for scalability and cost-efficiency.
  • Shape our early-stage product and company's architecture, toolchain, and development practices.
  • Keep the technical debt low with test automation and writing well-structured and clean code.
  • Learn new things every day and share your knowledge with the team and the outside world.

‍

‍WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • You are highly proficient in building scalable backend systems using Node.js with TypeScript in a serverless cloud environment, preferably on AWS.
  • You are comfortable in managing infrastructure as code, preferably with CDK or Cloudformation.
  • You work collaboratively with your colleagues and consider what is best for the team. You have exceptional communication skills and can work effectively in a distributed team and a remote-first environment. You value diversity and inclusion.
  • You think creatively, are solution-oriented, adaptable to change, and strive to learn continuously.
  • You live and breathe the “you build it, you run it” mentality and write well-structured and tested code.
  • You have profound experience in designing scalable event-driven architectures, preferably on AWS.

‍‍‍Our Tech Stack includes

  • AWS serverless (Serverless framework, Lambda)
  • Node.js with TypeScript
  • GraphQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Cognito, S3
  • React, Next.js
  • Tailwind CSS
  • Cypress & Jest

We are looking for all seniority levels. So don’t feel discouraged if you don’t meet all enlisted skills or do not yet have experience with all technologies. We embrace continuous learning and help each other to grow as a team every day.

‍

‍WHAT WE OFFER‍

We value dedicated people, but we know that it's important to recover, disconnect, and spend time with your family. If you join Atlas, you will receive:

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • A family-friendly work environment with flexibility and understanding around the hours you work
  • Equipment of your choice
  • Full social security benefits
  • 26 days of vacation

We are a remote-first company. You can either work out of our headquarter in Berlin or remotely. Choose the setup that works best for you. Remote locations should be within +/- 3 hours of CET time. We regularly get together at co-location weeks to strengthen a great culture across geographies.

‍
BE WHO YOU ARE

We celebrate diversity and are committed to building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Our mission is to change the way our economic system works and make the impact of companies transparent. We can solve such complex challenges with diverse and inclusive teams.

We are an equal opportunity employer: all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We strongly encourage diverse applicants to apply.

**The Department**

The **Information Technology****Department**plans, implements, and supports secure, reliable, and innovative technology systems that enable all City departments to operate efficiently and deliver quality public services. The department manages infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, data, and user support while aligning technology investments with the City’s strategic goals.

**The Division**

The **Geographic Information Systems (GIS)** Division provides enterprise GIS platforms, spatial data management, and mapping solutions that support City operations and public access to information. The division develops and maintains GIS applications, data standards, and integrations that enable spatial analysis, planning, asset management, and data-driven decision-making. GIS plays a key role in supporting transparency, operational efficiency, and innovative uses of location-based information across the City.

**The Position**

As the entry level class in the technical series, the **Engineering Technician I** **(GIS)** works under immediate supervision, performing variety of routine technical duties in maintaining and supporting City and departmental geographic information systems (GIS) and GIS databases; uses standard GIS tools and generates standard GIS products.

The**Engineering Technician I****(GIS)** performs duties primarily focused on GIS data creation and maintenance to support departmental and City-Wide geographic information systems capabilities. Incumbents utilize standard GIS tools and utilities to enter and correct data in GIS databases, researching a variety of source documents to verify data accuracy and completeness, and to generate standard GIS products including maps. Work assigned involves proficiency in the use of basic to standard GIS software, tools and utilities to carry out assignments ranging from basic to routine and is performed following specific and detailed instructions as to methods, procedures and guidelines.

Equivalent to graduation from high school, including or supplemented by courses in algebra, geometry and trigonometry; and one to two years of experience in civil engineering or related drafting work, surveying work or customer service/permitting work.

Vocational training in drafting or computer-aided design and drafting **_is desired._**

Must possess and maintain an appropriate, valid driver's license.

**Ideal Candidate**

_Successful candidates will possess the following:_

- Previous GIS experience;
- Proficiency with ArcGIS Desktop and/or ArcGIS Pro;
- Working knowledge of GIS applications, cartographic principles and techniques, map design, and database management, gained through formal training and/or professional experience;

- Exceptional customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain positive working relationships; and

This is a hands-on leadership role with the opportunity to influence RACV’s omnichannel strategy, lift digital capability, improve member experiences and help define what great service looks like in an AI-enabled environment.


In this role, you will:


  • Lead, coach and inspire a digitally skilled team to deliver fast, helpful and human service across RACV’s digital channels.

  • Champion digital-first service and bring fresh thinking to how members interact with RACV through chat, messaging, social media and email.

  • Optimise conversational journeys and support the adoption of AI, automation and self-service tools that work seamlessly alongside our people.

  • Use data, conversation analytics and member insights to improve performance, remove friction and create better digital experiences.

  • Balance operational delivery with continuous improvement, innovation and strong risk and compliance discipline.

  • Build team capability for new ways of working alongside AI and automation, enabling specialists to focus on higher-value, complex and empathy-led member interactions.



What will help you succeed:


  • At least three years’ experience leading teams in a contact centre, customer service, digital service or similar operational environment.

  • Experience in digital and/or chat service delivery, with a strong understanding of digital customer or member journeys.

  • Exposure to conversational AI, chatbots, live chat, messaging platforms, digital channel tools or customer experience technologies.

  • A track record of improving service performance, redesigning journeys or supporting digital transformation initiatives.

  • Strong written communication skills suited to text-based service channels, with the ability to interpret data and turn insights into action.

  • A people-first leadership style, with the ability to engage, develop and support teams through change.

  • Sound judgement, curiosity and confidence working in an environment where technology, member expectations and ways of working continue to evolve.

  • Desirable qualifications in business, digital/CX, communications, project management or process improvement.


The RACV difference


At RACV, you will join an organisation with a proud history and a strong focus on the future. We value diverse thinking, inclusive leadership and people who want to make a meaningful difference for our members, customers and communities. We want our people to feel welcome, supported and appreciated for who they are and what they bring to our business. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process and/or the role, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know.


Application process


You can learn more about the RACV at racv.com.au/about-racv/our-people/work-at-racv.


If you are excited by digital service, people leadership and the opportunity to shape the future of member engagement, we would love to hear from you. Submit your CV via the link below.


Applicants will be required to provide evidence of their eligibility to work in Australia and consent to a criminal record check.

Additionally, Applicants must confirm their ability to perform the inherent requirements of the position as outlined in the Job Task Analysis -Corporate and whether any reasonable adjustments may be required.

title: 23130 - Delivery Manager Forward Listing Officer
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity.

Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised role: all successful candidates will be appointed to the nearest viable office nearest to their home postcode and on its respective pay scale. This will be at either a HQ building (subject to desk allocation, a Justice Collaboration Centre (JCC) or a Justice Satellite Office (JSO) – See Map. All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity).

For current MoJ employees, your base location will need to be changed to the nearest viable office (to your home postcode), either at a HQ building, JCC or JSO within the National Office Network and moved its location’s respective pay scale (any legacy arrangements/locations will need to be amended).

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

MoJ candidates who are on a specialist grade, will be able to retain their grade on lateral transfer.

All candidates who are currently in receipt of Mark Time / Pay Protection should ensure they are familiar with the new policy on permanent and temporary promotion which can be found on the employee intranet.

Flexible working hours

The Ministry of Justice offers a flexible working system in many offices. Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week. MoJ welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the MoJ’s Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service.

There is also a scheme to allow qualifying staff to buy or sell up to three days leave each year. Additional paid time off for public holidays and 1 privilege day. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis.

Pension

The Civil Service offers a choice of pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender employees.

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5359 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: [AI Transformation Dept.] Sr. Data Analytics Specialist (7년 이상)
description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

"AI First 크래프톤을 완성하는 데이터의 심장,"

크래프톤 AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여, 데이터와 인프라를 기반으로 임직원들의 워크(Work)와 워크플로우(Workflow) 자동화를 가속화하고 그 압도적인 효율화 성과를 전사로 확산하는 핵심 조직입니다.
Data Foundation 팀은 파편화된 전사 데이터를 통합하고, AI(LLM, AI Agent 등)가 즉각적으로 이해하고 활용할 수 있는 최적의 데이터 구조(Ontology)와 아키텍처를 설계·구축합니다.
크래프톤의 각 조직이 실제로 사용하는 데이터와 업무 맥락을 깊이 이해하고, 이를 AI가 이해할 수 있는 데이터 관리·활용 체계로 직접 기획하고 설계해 낼 분을 모십니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

담당 도메인의 데이터 관리·활용 체계를 직접 기획·설계하고, 설계 산출물(Ontology 설계서, 데이터 모델, 거버넌스 기준 문서 등)을 주도적으로 작성·관리합니다.

  • 도메인별 데이터 구조 분석 및 Ontology 설계: 도메인의 원천 데이터와 업무 프로세스를 분석하고, AI(LLM, AI Agent)가 활용할 수 있는 Ontology(개체·관계·속성 정의) 구조를 주도적으로 설계하며 Ontology 설계서를 작성·관리
  • 비즈니스 용어·지표 정의 및 데이터 거버넌스 기준 수립: 도메인별 핵심 용어(Glossary), 지표 정의, 데이터 오너십·접근 권한 기준을 현업과 협의해 수립하고 거버넌스 기준 문서로 정립
  • 데이터 품질·정합성 분석 및 개선: 원천 데이터의 정합성, 완결성, 중복 여부를 분석하고, 개선 방안을 직접 도출해 Ontology 설계 및 데이터 구축에 반영
  • 현업 부서와의 요구사항 분석 및 데이터 모델링: 담당 조직의 실무자를 인터뷰하고 업무 데이터를 분석하여, 실제 질의·분석 시나리오에 맞는 데이터 모델(테이블 구조, 관계, 계층)을 설계·구축하고 지속적으로 개선

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 데이터 분석, BI, 또는 데이터 모델링 관련 분야 7년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분 (데이터 엔지니어링뿐 아니라 데이터 분석가 경력도 포함)
  • SQL을 능숙하게 다루며, 원천 데이터를 스스로 탐색·분석해 구조를 파악할 수 있는 분
  • 특정 업무 도메인의 데이터와 프로세스를 깊이 이해하고, 현업과 커뮤니케이션하며 요구사항을 구조화해 데이터 모델·지표 체계로 설계해 온 경험이 있는 분
  • 데이터 모델링(테이블 설계, 정규화, 관계 정의 등)을 직접 기획·수행해 본 경험이 있으신 분
  • 새로운 개념(Ontology, Semantic Layer 등)을 빠르게 학습하고 실무에 적용하려는 의지가 강하신 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • Ontology, Knowledge Graph, Semantic Layer 등 개념을 실제 프로젝트에 적용해 본 경험이 있으신 분
  • Databricks 데이터 카탈로그/온톨로지/거버넌스 플랫폼을 사용해 본 경험이 있으신 분
  • 재무, HR, 마케팅 등 특정 도메인에서 데이터 분석가/기획자로 근무하며 해당 도메인 데이터 구조를 잘 이해하고 계신 분
  • 데이터 거버넌스, 메타데이터 관리, 용어 표준화(Glossary) 작업을 수행해 본 경험이 있으신 분
  • LLM, RAG, AI Agent가 데이터를 어떻게 활용하는지에 대한 이해와 관심이 높으신 분

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > 사전 인터뷰 (Phone Interview) > *과제 전형 > 인성검사 (Personality Assessment) > 직무면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 종합면접 (2-3회) (Culture Fit Interview) > 합격 및 입사
  • *해당 절차는 각 포지션 및 후보자에 따라 변동이 있을 수 있습니다.
  • 상시 채용으로 채용 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 필요 시, 인터뷰 및 직무 테스트가 추가될 수 있습니다.

title: Finance & People & Culture Administrator - 12 Month FTC
description:

Showpo was established in Sydney in 2010 from our Founder & CEO Jane Lu's garage. Forward to now, we have disrupted the traditional retail model, are a global fashion destination and one of Australia's home grown true global success stories. We pride ourselves on empowering women worldwide and being one of Australia's largest and most successful social media brands.


The Role:

You will provide joint administrative support across the Finance and People & Culture (P&C) departments. This role handles essential operational, payment, payroll onboarding, and office administration tasks to relieve department heads, assist with projects such as HRIS project implementation and Finance process improvement initiatives, and optimise routine backend workflows.


This is an exceptional learning opportunity to work directly with 2 Leadership team members whilst also supporting our cultural initiatives in a fast paced and dynamic work environment where no 2 days will be the same!

title: Sairaanhoitaja, Pusulan terveysasema, Lohja
description:
Haemme nyt sairaanhoitajaa Pusulan terveysasemalle työskentelemään ammatinharjoittajalääkärin työparina. Tehtävässä sairaanhoitaja ja lääkäri muodostavat kiinteän työparin, joka vastaa yhdessä nimetyn väestönsä hoidosta. Tavoitteena on pitkäjänteinen hoitosuhde, hyvä saavutettavuus sekä laadukas ja vaikuttava hoito.

Työ tarjoaa ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden hyödyntää osaamistasi laaja-alaisesti sekä osallistua toimintamallin kehittämiseen yhdessä lääkärin, terveysaseman johdon ja muun työyhteisön kanssa.

Keskeiset työtehtävät:
- oman vastuuväestön hoidon tarpeen arviointi puhelimitse, vastaanotolla ja sähköisissä palveluissa
- itsenäinen sairaanhoitajan vastaanottotyö
- pitkäaikaissairaiden seuranta ja hoidon koordinointi
- omahoitajana toimiminen vastuuväestölle
- tiivis työskentely ammatinharjoittajalääkärin työparina
- moniammatillinen yhteistyö sekä toiminnan kehittäminen

Työparin tavoitteena on huolehtia oman väestönsä hoidosta mahdollisimman kokonaisvaltaisesti ja jatkuvuutta tukien. Sairaanhoitajan rooli on keskeinen sekä hoidon tarpeen arvioinnissa että potilaiden pitkäjänteisessä hoidossa ja ohjauksessa.

Työpaikan nimi ja osoite: Pusulan terveysasema, Arvelankuja 1, 03850 Pusula
Työaika: 8-16
Tehtävä on vakinainen.

Kelpoisuusvaatimus: laillistettu sairaanhoitaja.

Tehtävässä edellytetään:
- kokemusta terveysasematyöstä
- kokemusta hoidon tarpeen arvioinnista ja puhelinpalvelusta
- aktiivista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta
- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja
- kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti sekä työparimallissa
- hyvää suomen kielen taitoa

Lisäksi edellytämme tartuntatautilain 48§:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä tartuntatautilain §55 mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Virkaan/työsuhteeseen valituilta pyydetään satunnaisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen päihdeohjelman mukaista huumausainetodistusta.

Arvostamme:
- pitkää kokemusta terveysasematoiminnasta
- diabetesosaamista sekä osaamista muista kansanterveyssairauksista ja niiden hoidosta ja ehkäisystä.
- kokemusta sairaanhoitajan itsenäisestä vastaanottotyöstä
-kiinnostusta hoidon jatkuvuudesta ja toimintamallien kehittämisestä
- hyviä tietoteknisiä taitoja ja osaamista Lifecare-potilastietojärjestelmästä

Työntekijöiden hyvinvointi on meille tärkeää ja haluamme tarjota monipuolisia etuja henkilöstöllemme. Tarjoamme kattavan työterveyshuollon lisäksi mm. lounasedun. Saat käyttöösi vuodessa 300 €, jonka voit käyttää toiveidesi mukaan kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi-, liikunta- tai matkalippuetuuksiin.

title: Regional Process Officer
description:
Regional Process Management, Transparency and Business Performance\:

•Act as regional process officer to ensure transparent, efficient and standardized execution of key business processes.

•Ensure clear and transparent decision logic, proper approval, complete documentation and traceable workflows across key regional operational processes, such as\:

•Sales operations, e.g. TA setting, vehicle allocation;

•Network development, e.g. dealer optimization processes;

•Supplier management, e.g. marketing activities for regional conferences;

•Aftersales operations, e.g. Customer Care Budget process;

•Establish structured and transparent financial resource allocation, including budget spending priority lists, taking into account the commercial rationale and business impact of regional decisions (sales, inventory, dealer cash flow, profitability). Ensure alignment with central Controlling.

•Support the definition of process requirements, approval workflows and escalation paths, and facilitate the review of significant or non-standard business decisions.

•Monitor process execution through data-driven reviews and analyses, identify deviations from agreed process standards, and facilitate corrective actions.

•Establish and monitor process performance and risk indicators to increase transparency and support timely management intervention.

•Review major policy, process or system changes to ensure effective process design and sustainable process execution.

•Track implementation of agreed process improvement measures and support business functions in achieving sustainable solutions.

•Consolidate process insights, implementation status and key process risks and provide regular management reporting.

Process Excellence, Digitalization & Cross-Regional Alignment\:

•Standardize regional processes, including roles & responsibilities, decision criteria, approvals, documentation and exception handling.

•Leverage AI and data-driven solutions to enhance process transparency, improve decision-making, and increase operational efficiency through automation and intelligent process optimization.

•Ensure consistent implementation of allocation logic and decision criteria across regions.

•Define requirements for process performance dashboards, exception reporting and early-warning tools.

•Translate findings and deviations into process improvements and system enhancements.

•Identify and share cross-regional patterns and best practices, support knowledge transfer, and promote consistent and sustainable process standards across regions.

•Monitor implementation and ensure effective and lasting adoption of improvements.
